jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
Hello potential future Oatly employee. It’s us, the original oat drink company that started in Sweden back 30 or so years ago.


We’ve emerged as a leading and trailblazing player in the dairy\-alternative market. As we continue to solidify our presence, we're committed to shaping the future of the food and beverage industry. With our rapid growth, we're on the lookout for more brilliant minds to come work with us to maintain our momentum and keep the oat drink flowing.


Our mission is to make it easy for people to eat better and live healthier lives without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources. If this resonates with you, then maybe you’d like work for Oatly, too. So, let’s get to the formal stuff.

**The Role**
------------

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a **Maintenance Engineer** to join our team in Vlissingen.


What makes this role different is the breadth of ownership. This is a highly autonomous role where you'll act as the technical expert behind our maintenance strategy, asset reliability, shutdown planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. You'll influence everything from daily reliability improvements to long\-term asset strategies, helping to ensure the reliability and future performance of one of Oatly's most important production facilities. You will collaborate closely with the Maintenance Coordinator and the rest of the team.


Here’s the main elements of the role:

* Drive our maintenance reliability strategy by developing and continuously improving maintenance plans, inspections, calibrations, and equipment strategies using reliability\-centered and risk\-based maintenance principles.
* Lead technical analyses and planning activities, including RCA (Root Cause Analysis), MOC (Management of Change), criticality assessments, annual maintenance budget preparation, shutdown and turnaround planning, and long\-term asset management strategies to improve plant reliability and performance.
* Become the driving force behind our CMMS/D365 environment, using data, asset insights, and maintenance performance metrics to improve decision\-making, reliability, and spare parts management.
* Depending on your experience and certifications, you may also take ownership as IV\-Responsible (NEN\-1010/NEN\-3140\), providing technical leadership in electrical safety and compliance, and participate in the site's call\-out duty.

**Who You Are**
---------------


Whether you're an experienced Maintenance Engineer looking for greater ownership, or an ambitious engineer ready for your next step, we'd love to hear from you!

* You hold an MBO\+ or HBO degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical \& Instrumentation (E\&I), Maintenance Engineering, or a related technical field.
* You have experience in maintenance, reliability, engineering, or technical operations within an industrial environment.
* You enjoy solving technical problems and combining hands\-on technical knowledge with analytical thinking, systems expertise, and continuous improvement.
* You are comfortable working on a tactical level, using data and systems to make informed decisions. Experience with CMMS systems, asset management, and D365 is a strong advantage.
* Knowledge of ATEX, NEN\-1010/NEN\-3140, reliability engineering methodologies, or food manufacturing environments is welcome but not essential.
* You are structured, proactive, analytical, collaborative, and fluent in both Dutch and English.


Another bulleted list felt redundant, so we wrote this long sentence with all the ways we sweeten the deal to work with us: a market competitive salary, 8% holiday allowance, a 13th\-month bonus, a call\-out allowance, 27 vacation days plus public holidays, great coffee (with as much oat milk as you like), free fruit at work, a fully employer\-funded pension plan, a bike leasing program with a €35 monthly contribution from Oatly, a net vitality allowance, and several other benefits designed to help you stay healthy, happy, and energized.


\[Phew! Well done if you’ve got this far. We’re glad we’ve still got your attention because we’ve got one last super important point to make.  

  

As you can probably tell, we’re a norm\-breaking company. For us, diversity and differences are an obvious asset. We know that amazing candidates can sometimes be put off applying for a job unless they can tick every box, and that makes us really sad. So please trust your gut and pop in your application if it’s feeling right. Good luck!]


\#LI\-TA1

jobs.title: Wetenschappelijk Software Engineer | Grond- en bodembeheer
jobs.description:
Heb je een civieltechnische opleiding en zoek je een baan waarin je jouw talent voor softwareontwikkeling inzet om de wereld duurzamer en leefbaarder te maken? Voor Deltares, het kennisinstituut voor water en ondergrond, zijn wij op zoek naar een wetenschappelijk software engineer.

**Dit kan je verwachten als wetenschappelijk software engineer bij Deltares**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------


Je komt te werken in het domein Geotechnical and Flood Defences software. In deze rol ben je dagelijks bezig met om jouw geotechnische kennis te laten landen in onze verschillende open\-source softwareproducten.  

Al onze producten, binnen de D\-Serie waar jij aan gaat werken, zijn van hoge kwaliteit en dat is nodig! Onze wetenschappelijke modellen worden wereldwijd gebruikt voor beslissingen met grote maatschappelijke impact. Denk daarbij aan het beoordelen van damwandconstructies, funderingsontwerpen en stabiliteitsanalyses van dijken. Onderwerpen die hoog op de agenda staan van gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen. Zo draag jij direct bij aan hoogwaterveiligheid en kustverdediging.


Jouw hoofdtaken zijn

* Het ontwerpen en programmeren van gebruiksvriendelijke wetenschappelijke software;
* Het ophalen en vertalen van gebruikerswensen naar taken die je in samenwerking met (wetenschappelijke) software engineers en specialisten in een scrum\-team uitvoert.
* Het testen en analyseren van functionele en technische softwarevereisten samen met product owners en specialisten;
* Het versnellen en vernieuwen van bestaande simulatiemodellen, waarbij je gebruikmaakt van moderne technologieën, zoals HPC\-clusters;
* Het verkennen van de mogelijkheden van AI en data science, en technologieën zoals cloud computing, voor nieuwe toepassingen in de deltatechnologie.


Je hoeft niet alle technologieën al te beheersen. Er is genoeg ruimte bij ons om verder te ontwikkelen.

**Het** **team**  

Je komt te werken in een team van experts in een samenwerkingsomgeving waarin geotechniek en geavanceerde softwareontwikkeling samenkomen. Een perfecte plek om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen! We werken volgens agile ontwikkelmethodologiën en gebruiken ontwikkeltechnieken zoals Test Driven Development, pair programming en Continuous Integration. De grafische user\-interfaces worden geschreven in C\#, de onderliggende rekenharten in C\+\+ en de analysetools in Python. De specialisten van de diverse disciplines van Deltares zijn nauw betrokken bij de specificatie en de validatie van nieuwe software.

### **Wat verwacht Deltares van jou als wetenschappelijk software engineer?**


Je hebt de ambitie om hoge kwaliteit software te ontwikkelen en zoekt een baan waarin je kunt blijven leren. Daarnaast vragen wij:

* Een afgeronde MSc\-opleiding in Civiele Techniek, Technische Natuurkunde, Geotechnical Engineering of een vergelijkbare studie, met minimaal 1 jaar programmeerervaring vanuit je studie of werk.
* Basiskennis van geotechniek, grondmechanica, funderingen, waterkeringen of ondergrondse infrastructuur.
* Affiniteit met stedelijke en infrastructurele vraagstukken, zoals damwanden, funderingen of pijpleidingen.
* Het vermogen om concepten en modelleringsvereisten te vertalen naar robuuste softwareoplossingen.
* Je hebt ervaring met objectgeoriënteerd programmeren, het schrijven van testen en het gebruik van versiebeheersystemen.
* Het is een pre om kennis te hebben van onderwerpen zoals: softwarearchitectuur, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery, Docker, Kubernetes en/of SOLID en GRASP principes.

### **Wat wij bieden:**


Deltares biedt een jaarcontract (minimaal 32 uur) met intentie tot vast dienstverband na het eerste contract. We zoeken een professional met 1 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring. Inschaling in schaal 15 of 16 vindt plaats op basis van je ervaring (min. €3968 \- max €5100,\- bruto per maand) o.b.v. 40 per week.

* Je krijgt begeleiding van ervaren (scientific) software engineers en bouwt aan software met een wereldwijde impact.
* Heb je behoefte aan flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om wanneer nodig hybride te werken? Dat kan, bij ons kun je goed door ons gefaciliteerd, ook een gedeelte thuiswerken.
* 34 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur, ABP pensioen, een vitaliteitsbudget, een mobiliteitsbudget en een bijdrage aan zorgkosten.
* Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Samen kijken we hoe we jouw groei kunnen stimuleren.
* Een volledig overzicht van onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op onze website.

### **Sollicitatieprocedure**


Word jij enthousiast van deze vacature en herken jij jezelf in het profiel? Solliciteer dan direct. Upload jouw CV en motivatiebrief of video.  

  

**Deadline** 30 september. Sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats in oktober. De procedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken. Vragen over de vacature? Neem contact op met Brian de Bruin, Recruiter (brian.debruin@deltares.nl of app/bel T \+31615267686\). Als we voldoende geschikte sollicitaties ontvangen, kan de vacature eerder worden gesloten dan de aangegeven deadline.  

  

Past de geschetste functie niet bij jou, maar ken je iemand die perfect in het geschetste profiel past? Stuur deze vacature dan gerust door.  

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer Security Defensie
jobs.description:
**JOUW KOERS (de functie)**  

**Als service engineer beveiligingstechniek bij Honeywell zorg je dat beveiligingssystemen optimaal werken en up\-to\-date zijn. Safety first! In deze functie werk je voornamelijk voor onze defensieklant op de marinebasis in Den Helder. Een unieke en interessante werkomgeving waarbij je op locaties komt die vaak voor anderen niet toegankelijk zijn. Je krijgt een baan met veel vrijheid, leuke collega’s en een uitstekend salaris.**

**Dit ga jij doen!**  

\- Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de klant en stuurt onderaannemers aan
  

\- Je lost de eventuele storingen zoveel als mogelijk remote op en verzorgt de coördinatie indien het service team ter plaatse
   

moet zijn.
  

\- Je lost storingen op aan toegangscontrole, aanwezigheidssystemen, CCTV\-cameratoezicht, inbraak\-, intercom\- en
   

gebouwbeheersystemen inclusief bijbehorende IT\-netwerken.
  

\- Je gaat zorgdragen voor een goede rapportage en bespreekt deze met de opdrachtgever.  

  

  



**Werken bij Honeywell**  

Bij Honeywell Building Technologies willen we altijd de beste zijn in wat we doen. We leveren wereldwijd innovatieve diensten, systemen en oplossingen voor het dagelijkse beheer van gebouwen. We zijn vooruitstrevend op het gebied van beveiliging, veiligheid en klimaatbeheersing.  

  

  



**JOUW KRACHT (gewenste kennis/ eisen)**  

Als service engineer beveiligingstechniek bij Honeywell zet jij je samen met je collega’s in om veiligheid van onze klanten te waarborgen. Om jouw werk goed uit te kunnen voeren breng je het volgende met je mee:


* Je hebt minimaal mbo\-werk\- en denkniveau in de richting van engineer beveiligingssystemen (MBV of TBV) elektrotechniek, installatietechniek, IT of vergelijkbaar
* Je bent communicatief vaardig, analytisch, oplossings\- en klantgericht
* Je hebt bij voorkeur kennis van gebouw automatiseringssystemen, servers en netwerktechnologie
* Je bent in het bezit van een geldig rijbewijs B want je gaat met de auto van de zaak naar je werk
* Je bent organisatorisch sterk, leergierig en je weet onder tijdsdruk de juiste prioriteiten te stellen en bereidt om storingsdiensten te draaien.
* Ben je al werkzaam in dit vakgebied en in het bezit van alle diploma’s is dat een grote pre.
* **Omdat je werkt binnen een defensieomgeving, dien je een VOG te kunnen overleggen en in aanmerking te komen voor een VGB\-screening. De VOG vraag je zelf aan; de VGB\-procedure wordt door Honeywell verzorgd.**

  

Ben je al in het bezit van de juiste ervaring en diploma’s dan is dat fijn voor ons en jezelf. Heb je als technici nog niet de juiste ervaring of kom je net van school? Ook dan ben je meer dan welkom. Honeywell leidt je graag op.  



**JOUW KEUZE (arbeidsvoorwaarden)**  

Als service engineer beveiligingstechniek is geen dag hetzelfde. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:


* Een uitstekend salaris
* Direct een vast contract bij Honeywell
* 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantie\- en 13 ADV dagen), collectiviteitskortingen, fietsplan, onkostenvergoeding en goede pensioenvoorzieningen
* CAO Metalektro
* Een goed uitgeruste auto, laptop en telefoon (ook voor privégebruik)
Volop ontwikkelings\- en doorgroeimogelijkheden.  
* 

  

**PAK HET MOMENT**  

Wil jij als service engineer beveiligingstechniek onderdeel zijn van een leuke en hechte club bij een grote multinational waar je de ruimte krijgt om te groeien? Dan is dit de baan die jij zoekt! Pak het moment en solliciteer direct. Dit gaat heel eenvoudig via de knop Solliciteer nu.
  

  

Binnen twee werkdagen ontvang je een reactie op jouw sollicitatie.


  
**Verklaring gelijke kansen**

We zijn een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en waarderen diversiteit binnen ons bedrijf. We discrimineren niet op basis van ras, religie, huidskleur, afkomst, geslacht, seksuele geaardheid, leeftijd, burgerlijke staat, veteranenstatus of handicap.


We zorgen ervoor dat personen met een handicap redelijke aanpassingen krijgen om deel te nemen aan de sollicitatie\- of sollicitatieprocedure, om cruciale functies uit te voeren en om andere voordelen en privileges van het dienstverband te ontvangen.


  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Wil jij:


* Elke week een andere scale\-up helpen groeien?
* Werken met tientallen verschillende datasets?
* Elke dag iets nieuws leren?

Lees dan snel verder!


**Over de baan**
----------------


Goede beslissingen beginnen met goede data. Bij Insight First bouwen we het fundament onder de groei van **snelgroeiende e\-commerce merken**. We zijn een team van gedreven Analytics Engineers en zoeken een technisch sterke Analytics Engineer. Iemand die het leuk vindt om data op te halen, pipelines werkend te krijgen en te houden, en snapt dat een oplossing in de praktijk vooral betrouwbaar en bruikbaar moet zijn.


Je werkt aan alles van API\-koppelingen en ETL tot het modelleren van data in SQL. De ene keer haal je data op met een ETL\-tool zoals Airbyte, de andere keer bouw je een custom script in Python dat draait op Google Cloud Run en wordt getriggerd via Cloud Scheduler. En als er even minder engineeringwerk ligt, pak je net zo goed SQL\-modellering op om data bruikbaar te maken voor dashboards en analyses.


Geen dag is hetzelfde: de ene keer onderzoek je hoe een nieuwe API werkt, de andere keer los je een issue op in een bestaande pipeline of werk je een SQL\-model bij voor een klant. Je vindt het leuk om dingen goed neer te zetten, maar snapt ook dat een pragmatische oplossing soms simpelweg de best oplossing voor de klant is.


Kortom: jij zorgt ervoor dat data van onze klanten betrouwbaar binnenkomt, goed landt en bruikbaar wordt gemaakt voor analyse.


**Wie zijn wij?**
-----------------


Insight First is het **remote data \& BI\-team** voor merken als Pink Gellac, Cloudpillo, Buienalarm en Alpine. Wij halen data op uit 50\+ systemen (Shopify, Amazon, Meta, Google Ads, you name it), modelleren de data en slaan deze op in Google Cloud. Het resultaat: een single source of truth (data warehouse), overzichtelijke dashboards en analyses. We investeren veel in nieuwe tools en innovatie zoals conversational analytics, reverse ETL en automations om onze klanten te helpen sneller en slimmer te groeien op basis van data.


Ons team bestaat uit nieuwsgierige data consultants \& engineers die houden van puzzelen, bouwen en verbeteren. Vanuit ons kantoor bij Utrecht Vaartsche Rijn (met uitzicht op het Ledig Erf ) werken we hybride: de helft op kantoor, de helft thuis.


**Wat ga je doen**
------------------


* **Integraties \& pipelines:** bouwen en onderhouden van API\-koppelingen en ETL\-flows met tools zoals Airbyte en custom Python scripts op Google Cloud Run / Cloud Scheduler.
* **Troubleshooting \& onderhoud:** issues in bestaande pipelines oplossen, logs checken, API’s uitpluizen en zorgen dat datastromen betrouwbaar blijven draaien.
* **Datamodellering:** waar nodig SQL\-modellen bouwen en beheren in DBT en BigQuery, zodat data bruikbaar wordt voor dashboards en analyses.
* **Verbeteren \& automatiseren:** kijken hoe dingen slimmer, stabieler en efficiënter kunnen, zonder onnodig complex te worden.
* **Werken voor meerdere klanten:** schakelen tussen verschillende klanten met elk hun eigen set aan databronnen en vraagstukken. Je werkt in een agency\-omgeving waar afwisseling eerder regel dan uitzondering is.
* **Slimme technische oplossingen:** af en toe iets bouwen of verbeteren in onze tech stack om het leven van jezelf, collega’s of klanten net een stukje makkelijker te maken, bijvoorbeeld een kleine automation, helper tool of script.

Een dag is nooit hetzelfde. Je begint je dag met het uitpluizen van een nieuwe API koppeling die gebouwd moet worden. Je hebt hiervoor een briefing gekregen van een collega en werkt met Claude de mogelijkheden uit en tijdsinschatting uit. Daarna ga je aan de slag met het doortesten van een Cloud Run python script wat je gisteren hebt gebouwd. Het was even puzzelen maar het is gelukt om de data in BigQuery te krijgen én te valideren, yes! Morgen ga je de data koppelen aan de andere sales datasets zodat je collega het dashboard kan afmaken. Eind van de dag komt er nog een foutmelding binnen. Je hebt error handling inmiddels redelijk geautomatiseerd dus er is al een PR voor je klaargezet die je kunt doorklikken. Er was een veldnaam gewijzigd. Hoppa, ook weer afgevinkt. Je werkt meteen ook even je planning bij en schrijft je gewerkte uren (ja, ook dat hoort erbij).


Voorbeelden van wat wij voor klanten doen vind je ook onder Cases op onze website!


**Doorgroeimogelijkheden**
--------------------------


Er is veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng qua automatisering en dingen slimmer doen. We werken graag met state\-of\-the\-art tooling en investeren daar ook graag in. Mocht je ergens zelf niet uitkomen denkt onze CTO of freelance developer graag met je mee. Er is ruimte om dingen te leren op vlak van AI, infrastructuur, cloud en data engineering/ETL. We zijn een groeiende start\-up, dus het is ook wat je er zelf van maakt en je bouwt actief mee aan het bedrijf.


**Wie ben jij en wat neem jij mee**
-----------------------------------


* Ongeveer 3–5 jaar ervaring in analytics engineering, data engineering of een vergelijkbare rol.
* Je bent sterk in SQL en kunt ook goed uit de voeten met Python.
* Je hebt ervaring met het ophalen en verwerken van data via API’s, ETL\-tools of scripts.
* Je hebt ervaring met Google Cloud Run en Scheduler.
* Je vindt het leuk om dingen uit te zoeken en zelfstandig op te pakken.
* Je bent pragmatisch: je snapt wanneer simpel en degelijk beter is dan perfect en complex.
* Je schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende klanten en vraagstukken.
* Je voelt je prettig in een dynamische omgeving waarin niet alles vooraf helemaal is uitgewerkt.
* Je hebt interesse in techniek en nieuwe tools, maar bent vooral gericht op oplossingen die in de praktijk werken.
* Ervaring met e\-commerce data of marketingdata.
* Affiniteit met automatisering, AI of het bouwen van interne tools.
* Je spreekt Nederlands en wil minimaal 32u per week (in Nederland) werken.

**Nice to haves**
-----------------


* Ervaring met DBT en/of AirByte.
* Ervaring in een servicegerichte organisatie of agency\-omgeving.

**Wat bieden wij?**
-------------------


* Een **uitdagende** rol met veel afwisseling en ownership;
* Werken voor de meest **toonaangevende** en **snelgroeiende** merken in e\-commerce;
* Werken met een brede variëteit aan datasets (versus 1 groot bedrijf waar je steeds met dezelfde data werkt);
* Een jong en gezellig team van like\-minded nerds waar je veel van kunt leren;
* Salaris tussen de €4000 en €6000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring;
* Contract: 32–40 uur, hybride werken; NL/EN werktaal;
* Elk jaar een team uitje naar het buitenland, zo zijn we in Praag, Londen en de Ardennen geweest;
* 25 vakantiedagen \+ volledige reiskostenvergoeding;
* Elk jaar een vrije dag om vrijwilligerswerk te doen;
* MacBook, Netto telefoonvergoeding;
* Diverse opleidings\- en trainingsmogelijkheden, dit jaar hebben we bijv. een sales training gedaan;
* Na een jaar in dienst, pensioenbijdrage via Brand New Day;
* Een fijne werkplek in Utrecht vlakbij Ledig Erf;
* Hybride werken tot 50% thuis;

**Apply**
---------


Enthousiast? Mail je cv \+ korte motivatie naar **kim@insightfirst.nl** of bel **06\-49814228**.


Er zijn twee gesprekken op locatie in Utrecht. De eerste inhoudelijk over jou en de baan, de tweede behandelen we een SQL case die je vooraf thuis mag voorbereiden. Ook vragen we je een online DISC test in te vullen, die we in het tweede gesprek bespreken. Voorafgaand aan het eerste gesprek wordt je gebeld door onze collega Emile die in een telefoongesprek van \+/\- 15 minuten alvast kort kennismaakt.


Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

jobs.title: Softwareentwickler C# (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sie wollen mit innovativen Technologien die Zukunft gestalten, Menschen schützen und dabei wirklich etwas bewegen? Dann werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und entwickeln Sie mit uns die Sicherheitslösungen von morgen.


Die GfG ist ein konzernunabhängiges, inhabergeführtes und wachstumsstarkes Familienunternehmen mit Sitz in Dortmund. ### **Description \& Requirements**


**About the Role**


This role will report to the Product Trust Governance \& Compliance Director. As the Product Trust Process Architect, you will define, maintain, and continuously improve the Harman Cybersecurity Management System (CSMS) and its underlying processes, work instructions, templates, guidelines, and checklists on the Harman Business Management System (BMS). You will maintain the CSMS and represent Harman's CSMS during internal and external audits. Within the broader Product Trust framework, you will also support alignment with Functional Safety (FUSA), applicable SOTIF, and responsible AI governance. You will collaborate closely with engineering, quality, procurement, data privacy, and learning functions to embed cybersecurity governance and a strong cybersecurity culture across the organization.


**What You Will Do**


* Define and improve Cybersecurity\-specific processes, work instructions, templates, guidelines, and checklists on BMS.
* Lead the rollout and deployment of the CSMS across all SBUs, managing the organizational change required to embed cybersecurity processes into day\-to\-day engineering operations and drive adoption.
* Monitor the evolving global cybersecurity regulatory landscape (UNECE R155/R156, EU Cyber Resilience Act, regional and OEM\-specific requirements) and translate changes into HARMAN's cybersecurity compliance strategy, roadmap, and process updates.
* Present the details of Harman CSMS in internal audits, customer audit, and certification audits.
* Define, track, and report CSMS performance metrics and KPIs through governance dashboards and management reviews, driving data\-based continuous improvement of the CSMS.
* Interface with Harman Learning and Development to define \& conduct cybersecurity training programs and identify external trainers for cybersecurity courses.
* Participate in the industry cybersecurity community to learn and adopt best practices.
* Benchmark Harman's CSMS and cybersecurity governance practices against industry peers, OEMs, and Tier\-1 competitors to identify differentiators and improvement opportunities.
* Analyze audit findings, non\-conformities, and industry lessons learned from multiple sources to define corrective and preventive actions for the CSMS.
* Support the internal Assessor in reviewing the cybersecurity assessment report prior to its finalization, ensuring completeness, consistency, and alignment with ISO/SAE 21434\.

**What You Need to Be Successful**


* 8\+ years of engineering experience in embedded automotive systems, systems engineering, or Product Trust, or PhD with \+5 years of experience in a related field.
* Minimum master’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity or a relevant technical discipline. Advanced degrees are highly preferred.
* Expert in Automotive Cybersecurity Engineering (ISO/SAE 21434\).
* Knowledge of UNECE R155 and R156 regulations.
* Experience / familiarity with the Product Development Life Cycle.
* Experience / familiarity with data privacy regulations, e.g., GDPR, CCPA, etc.
* Knowledge of tool management rules.
* Knowledge of process reference models such as Automotive SPICE®, TISAX, ISO 26262, and IATF 16949\.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in on site native language

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Prior experience in defining and maintaining CSMS on the organization level.
* Experience representing an organization's CSMS in ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155 / R156, TISAX, or Automotive SPICE for Cybersecurity audits and assessments.
* Knowledge of and experience with Automotive Functional Safety (ISO 26262\), including safety\-by\-design principles and functional safety management.
* Familiarity with SOTIF (ISO 21448\) and its interaction with cybersecurity and functional safety.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining a Functional Safety Management System and supporting functional safety assessments
* Awareness of responsible AI / AI trustworthiness considerations for automotive products.
* Experience conducting supplier cybersecurity capability assessments and third\-party risk management. Experience defining and delivering cybersecurity awareness and training programs.
* Membership in an automotive cybersecurity working group, consortium, or standards body.
* Experience with IoT / embedded systems security.

**What Makes You Eligible**


* Be willing to travel up to 10%, domestic and international travel
* Be willing to work in an office, client\-site in 1 location

**What We Offer**

* Flexible work schedule with a culture encouraging work life integration and collaboration in a global friendly working atmosphere and good work\-life\-balance
* Access to employee discounts on world\-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.)
* Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University
* Competitive wellness benefits
* Tuition reimbursement
* “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development

\#LI\-NR3
  

\#LI\-Hybrid


**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.  

  

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.  

  

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.  

  

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support\-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.  

  

HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Software Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
#### **Your mission**


NanoTemper makes software that runs scientific measurement instruments — used by researchers and biopharma teams to make faster, more confident decisions. The software matters: it sits between precise hardware and the scientists trying to understand complex biology.  

  

**You're role:**  

You will own product features end\-to\-end: from understanding the requirement, through implementation and testing, to release and maintenance. The current product landscape includes C\#/.NET, TypeScript, React, and Python. C\#/.NET is an important part of the existing software, while our technology choices continue to evolve with the needs of our products.  

  

**You may work across several types of software, including:**

* Control and analysis software for scientific instruments.
* Instrument backends that support measurement workflows and interact with the devices.
* Web application components that help users access and work with instrument data.


You will maintain, develop, and take ownership of software in these areas, depending on the product and your experience. You will also work at the boundary between software and hardware — collaborating with embedded engineers where the application talks directly to measurement instruments.  

This is a product engineering role. You will be writing code, reviewing it, fixing things that break in production, and improving the pipelines that ship the product.#### **Your expertise**


Required qualifications:

  

* Proven track record using C\# and .NET
* Experience with Git
* Professional experience shipping and maintaining production software, including ownership of software throughout its lifecycle
* Experience with build pipelines and release processes
* In\-depth experience in automated testing


Preferred qualifications:  

* Proficiency in TypeScript and React
* Familiarity with WPF
* Working knowledge of Python
* Hands\-on involvement in hardware or instrument integration
* A track record of developing software that interfaces with hardware or measurement devices
* Background in scientific, laboratory, or instrumentation software

#### **Why us?**

 **Who are you joining?**  

A team of 8 engineers and 1 product owner. The team has strong engineering foundations and doesn't need to relitigate architecture every sprint — you will find colleagues who want to ship good software and value a teammate who does the same. When we tackle something new, the architecture conversation is open to everyone.  

You will work closely with scientists, hardware engineers, and product managers, which means translating between technical and non\-technical perspectives is a regular part of the job.  

We work in the heart of Munich with excellent public transportation access. We work in a flexible hybrid model. We value regular in\-person collaboration, while offering the flexibility to work remotely when it makes sense.

#### **About us**


Our vision at NanoTemper is to help create a world where every disease is treatable. What drives us is partnering with scientists to ‘make a difference’ in the world.  

With our biophysical instruments we want to push the limits of what is possible for scientific researchers.  

The goals are big and audacious. Hence, it requires very innovative ways and a strong team to get there.  

  

Even if we are an expanding global company with more than 200 employees the heart of NanoTemper beats in Munich. This is where our story began and every day we work as one team to make our devices even better.  

  

Our doors are open for talented people excited about the future of scientific research and our vision.  

Do you want to make a difference with your daily work and become part of our mission? We are looking forward to get to know you.  

  

**But why not let your new colleagues tell you personally what it's like to be part of NanoTemper?**

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Come and build innovative services that protect our cloud from advanced security threats!  

  

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you’ll help build and manage services that detect and automate the mitigation of cybersecurity threats across Amazon’s infrastructure, including advanced persistent threats. You’ll work with security engineers, data scientists, and other software development engineers across multiple teams to develop innovative security solutions at a massive scale. Our services protect the AWS cloud for all customers and help preserve our customers’ trust in us. You’ll get to use the full power and breadth of AWS technologies to build services that proactively protect every single AWS customer, both internally and externally, from security threats – not many teams can say that!  

  

We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers. We want someone who will help us amplify the positive and inclusive team culture we’ve been building.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Software Development Engineer, you will leverage Amazon technology (Lambda, Kinesis, DynamoDB, etc.) to solve AWS Security problems at staggering scale. You will raise the bar on our software architecture and development practices. You will share ownership of our operational excellence, ensuring our system is properly tuned and has appropriate alarms for warning or error conditions. You will help drive our working backwards processes, inventing and simplifying on behalf of our customers. You will build security detections that identify specific security issues and automatically help customers reduce their risk through network and security controls.  

  

On\-Call Responsibility  

This position involves on\-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. You will also have specific on\-call responsibilities to support the European Sovereign Cloud. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.  

  

A day in the life  

* Collaborate with data scientists and security engineers to build automated security detection and mitigation workflows
* Design scalable architectures for low\-latency, big data processing
* Improve the observability, performance, and efficiency of our existing systems
* Raise the bar for testing, repeatability, automation, and operational excellence
* Mentor and develop teammates, both technically and professionally
* Seek out, develop, and advocate for new technologies

  

About the team  

Why Amazon Security?  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  

  

Training \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

On\-Call Responsibility  

This position involves on\-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience (non\-internship) in professional software development

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Config
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services has enabled large enterprises and growing startups to move quickly by increasing developer productivity. Security, auditability and governance in the cloud has moved from being a top concern to top reason for adopting Cloud services. AWS Config and Config Rules have been leading this transition by providing insights into user activity, change tracking and automated security and compliance tools.
  

  

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to join a highly respected team building one of the largest configuration audit platforms in the world. We are building agentic AI solutions that automate the end\-to\-end lifecycle of resource type onboarding \- from research and schema authoring through testing, validation, and deployment. You'll work at the intersection of large\-scale distributed systems and AI\-driven automation, designing agents that can reason about AWS service APIs, author configuration schemas, and validate correctness with minimal human intervention.  

  

Our team also puts a high value on work\-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well\-balanced life—both in and outside of work.  

  

AWS Config is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and operate high\-scale, highly available distributed services that extend AWS Config.
* Design and build AI agent orchestration systems that automate resource type onboarding at scale
* Own solutions across the full lifecycle: design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and support.


\- Own operational excellence for agentic workflows \- monitoring, alerting, and self\-healing mechanisms  

* Mentor and guide junior engineers through design reviews and constructive, rigorous code reviews.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems, manage competing priorities, and make data\-driven decisions.

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Build technology that makes road inspections faster, safer and smarter. Grow your development skills in a small product team, with guidance from experienced colleagues.

**About SmartVision**

SmartVision is reimagining highway inspections with AI. Our platform brings together computer\-vision analysis, geospatial mapping and inspection management, turning road images into practical intelligence that helps teams understand road condition, prioritise maintenance and confirm repairs.

We are building SmartVision as a focused, growing company with a small team and an ambitious product. That means less distance between an idea and its impact — and plenty of scope for the right developer to help shape how we work and what we build next.

**The opportunity**

We’re looking for a curious and motivated Junior Software Developer who is ready to build their skills by solving real product problems. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you’ll help design, build and improve applications across our .NET, SQL and React stack, while also gaining experience with Python and Azure\-hosted components.

This role will suit someone who enjoys learning, asks thoughtful questions and is comfortable in a startup\-style environment where priorities can evolve. You’ll receive guidance and support, while being encouraged to contribute ideas, take increasing responsibility and become a well\-rounded developer as SmartVision grows.

**What you’ll do**

* Help design and develop robust, maintainable applications using .NET, SQL and React.
* Learn how to turn product and customer needs into well\-considered technical solutions.
* Contribute to Azure\-hosted components using Python, object storage and event queues.
* Work with product, test and development colleagues to deliver valuable features.
* Maintain and improve existing applications through updates, refactoring and enhancements.
* Learn to estimate work, communicate progress and raise questions or risks early.
* Test your work thoroughly and build your understanding of reliability, security and performance.
* Investigate and resolve issues with support from the wider team.
* Contribute ideas in team and project discussions and learn from code reviews and feedback.
* Develop your technical knowledge and share what you learn with colleagues.

**What we’re looking for**

* A foundation in C\#/.NET and SQL, gained through study, a bootcamp, personal projects, a placement, an internship or your first development role.
* Some experience with React, or a comparable modern framework such as Angular or Vue.
* Awareness of Microsoft Azure, Python, object storage and event queues, together with an interest in developing your practical experience with these technologies.
* A basic understanding of Git and version\-control workflows.
* An understanding of testing, debugging and the importance of clear, maintainable code.
* Clear communication, attention to detail and a willingness to ask questions and act on feedback.
* Comfort working collaboratively in a small team and adapting as priorities change.
* Curiosity about the product, its users and the real\-world problems the technology is solving.

**Useful, but not essential**

* Commercial experience gained through an internship, placement or first software\-development role.
* Experience with geospatial applications, mapping or Geographic Information Systems (GIS).
* Experience building event\-driven, data\-rich, image\-based or AI\-enabled applications.
* Experience with Visual Studio or the wider Microsoft development ecosystem.

**What you’ll get**

* Visible impact: work on a product that turns complex road data into decisions people can act on.
* Supported development: learn from experienced colleagues through guidance, feedback and code reviews.
* Growing responsibility: take on broader and more complex work as your confidence develops.
* A close\-knit team: collaborate directly with the people shaping and delivering the product.
* Room to grow: develop with the company as SmartVision establishes itself and expands.
* Company benefits such as 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays and a day off for your birthday, and the Bike2Work Scheme.

**How to apply**

Apply through Tech Talent Champions via https://techtalentchampions.com/opportunities using the form on the page.

Include your CV and a short note explaining why SmartVision interests you.

Pay: £26,000\.00\-£32,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer
jobs.description:
Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer**Locations: CT, ME**


Are you a qualified Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer looking for excellent earning potential, structured work and the security of working directly for an established energy supplier?


At Utilita, we're growing our award\-winning Field Services team. Join one of the UK's fastest\-growing energy suppliers and a business that has been recognised as one of the UK's Top 50 Best Workplaces for four consecutive years.


What is in it for you?


You'll receive a base salary of £38,993, alongside uncapped earning potential and a variety of opportunities to boost your overall earnings, including:


* **On\-call payment:** Receive £330 for each on\-call week, based on an average rota of one week in five. (OTE of £42,293 just with the base salary and conducting mandatory on call requirements)
* **Industry\-leading installation bonus:** Benefit from an uncapped installation bonus of £25 per meter or £50 per dual installation once you have completed a minimum of four installations in a day, with additional work opportunities available to further enhance your earnings.
* **London weighting:** Receive an additional £2,000 annual allowance if you live within the M25\.
* **Enhanced overtime:** Enhanced overtime rates for Sunday working.

Alongside your salary and uncapped earning potential, you will receive 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, a healthcare scheme, mental wellbeing support, access to 24/7 GP and counselling services, and a generous pension scheme. You will also receive one paid volunteering day each year and have opportunities to win tickets to events at Utilita\-sponsored arenas and football matches.


Why work at Utilita?

**A schedule that supports your work\-life balance.**


We understand that a great Smart Meter Engineer role is not just about salary. It is also about having a structured working day and being able to plan your life accordingly.


You will be scheduled an average of 4 jobs per day, with an average travel time to jobs of approximately 35 minutes between appointments.


We aim to schedule your work several weeks in advance, giving you greater visibility of your schedule. This helps you plan life outside work while still giving you the opportunity to take on additional work when it suits you.

**First\-class training and support.**


Your journey will begin at our award\-winning training academy in Warrington, where you will receive a comprehensive induction.


You will then receive ongoing mentoring to help you strengthen your knowledge, understand our processes and confidently adapt to the Utilita way of working.

**A team that keeps you connected.**


We understand that working in the field can sometimes feel isolating, which is why creating a connected and supportive environment is so important to us.


Through regular manager check\-ins, access to technical experts, collaborative colleague networks and ongoing communication, you'll always have the support you need and someone to turn to throughout your working day.


What you will be doing.


As a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer, you will represent Utilita in customers’ homes, installing smart meters safely and professionally across domestic properties.


You will play an important role in delivering our customer\-first approach, providing a positive experience while maintaining high standards of safety, quality and service.

**What we need from you.**


To be considered for this opportunity, you will need:

* Smart Metering qualifications, including CCN1 or CMA1 and MET1, or equivalent.
* At least 12 months experience working as a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer.
* A valid full UK driving licence.


Who are Utilita?


Founded in 2003, Utilita Energy was created to challenge the Big Six energy suppliers by offering a fair and flexible service that is good for both the pocket and the planet.


As the first supplier to install a Smart Meter back in 2005 and kick\-start Britain’s smart meter revolution, we continue to invest in smart technology and look for new ways to improve our services through innovation.


We are also committed to sustainability, with an ambition to become a Net Zero business by 2030\. We believe everyone can make a meaningful impact through small, positive changes.


Our values are simple but powerful:

**Fairness. Smart. Sustainability.**


Our employees and customers come from all walks of life. We are committed to championing diversity, creating an inclusive culture and providing an environment where you can be your authentic self.


Utilita is part of the Luxion group whichcomprises Luxion Group Ltd, Utilita Energy Ltd, Luxion Sales Ltd, Utilita Field Services Ltd, Procode Technology Ltd and Canary Care Global Ltd.

IONETIC is a battery technology start\-up based in Brackley, just a few miles from Silverstone—the heart of British motorsport. By integrating proprietary software, mechanical design, and manufacturing technologies into a single technology stack we call Arc, we deliver custom battery systems that meet a wide range of energy, power, and lifecycle requirements. **Job Title**

Staff Engineer – senior individual contributor (no line management)

**Company**

Landmark Systems Ltd

**Location**

Pulborough, West Sussex/(Hybrid \- 2\-3 days on\-site

**Reports To**

Chief Technology Officer

**Salary**

Dependent on experience, circa £65\-£75K

**About Landmark Systems**

Landmark Systems has been providing specialist accounting and business management software to UK farmers for over 39 years. Our KEYPrime desktop software is trusted by thousands of farms across the country. We’re rebuilding years of hard\-won agricultural domain knowledge as a modern, cloud\-native SaaS product, and we’re looking for a Staff Engineer to help us get the big technical decisions right.

**The Opportunity**

Our next\-generation product is cloud\-native, not cloud\-ported. That means genuinely interesting problems, not a lift\-and\-shift:

· **Multi\-tenancy done properly** — from single farms to multi\-entity groups, accountancy practices and resellers. How we model tenants, organisations and licenses is a live architectural question, and you’d help answer it.

· **A model\-driven platform** — much of the product is generated from a declarative metadata layer that produces both the .NET back end and the Vue front end. Knowing when to work with that grain and when to build a bespoke escape hatch is a real craft.

· **AI as a first\-class capability** — our platform ships with semantic search, retrieval and agent tooling built in. We expect our engineers to build with AI, and to build AI\-backed features into the product itself.

· **A long, deliberate migration** — moving a loyal, established customer base from a mature desktop product to the cloud, without breaking the trust that took 25 years to earn.

**Key Responsibilities**

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. jobs.title: Security Engineer, AWS Security
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud provider, providing virtualised infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services to customers all over the world. AWS runs a globally distributed environment, operating at massive levels of scale. Businesses, from start\-ups to enterprises, run their operations and applications on AWS’ multi\-tenant infrastructure.  

  

As a Security Engineer, you’ll help to build and manage services that detect and automate the mitigation of cybersecurity threats across Amazon’s infrastructure. You’ll work with data scientists, software development engineers, and other security engineers across multiple teams to develop innovative, world\-leading security solutions. Our services protect the AWS cloud for all customers and preserves our customers’ trust in us. You’ll get to use the full power and breadth of AWS technologies to build services that proactively protect AWS customers, both internally and externally, from security threats.  

  

You will be working in a team of industry\-leading security experts working with UK customers to operate and continuously improve industry\-leading security programs and processes. This role forms part of our Security Operations Centre (SOC) and you will be responsible for building detections and responding to security incidents. Aside from security incident management, you will be expected to think strategically and build innovative solutions to improve efficiency across the team. As large part of this will be introducing AI and automation.  

  

This is a truly unique opportunity to support and improve the security of a world leading cloud provider, working at the forefront of innovation and alongside world class industry experts.  

  

About Amazon Security  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why Amazon Security?  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organisation is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fuelled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  

  

Training \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Work as part of a Security Operations Centre (SOC).
* Build detections to identify suspicious and malicious behaviour.
* Engineer innovate solutions and automation to improve processes.

  

About the team  

The team consists of a mix of security engineers, ranging in experience from junior to experienced.
  

  

You will need to be a UK national and able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance. Further details found here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united\-kingdom\-security\-vetting\-clearance\-levels  

  

This team works alongside the wider security team, including insider risk, information security, assurance and physical security.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
* Experience programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C\+\+ or similar object oriented language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS products and services
* Experience with any combination of the following: threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security
* Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Advanced Software Engineer (C#/.NET)
jobs.description:
***Posting Type***

Hybrid


***Job Overview***

WHO WE ARE
  

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI\-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high\-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.
  

  

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.
  

  

WHAT WE DO
  

At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code. They harness AI tools to architect, optimize, and deliver scalable software faster while shaping the future of legal technology. They design systems that help industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice, and continuously evolve our platform using cloud\-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling.
  

  

Our AI helps power privacy programs, identify confidential information, and detect language indicating misconduct. We are reimagining how legal professionals uncover truth at scale, and engineering is at the heart of that transformation.
***Job Description and Requirements***

**WHAT** **YOU’LL** **DO**

* Design, develop, and operate cloud\-based services that enable organizations to manage and process data at scale across multiple platforms
* Build full\-stack features across .NET/C\# backend services, React/JavaScript frontends, and SQL data layers that support core product workflows
* Build and maintain integrations with external systems and internal platform services, including third\-party cloud data sources, notification providers, and cross\-team APIs
* Plan and execute service and data migrations, including schema changes, deployment progressions, and feature transitions in live production environments
* Apply cloud\-native patterns including containerization, event\-driven architecture, and infrastructure\-as\-code to deliver scalable and resilient services on Azure
* Manage and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and independently deploy team\-owned services
* Use observability tooling including structured logging, metrics dashboards, and distributed tracing to investigate production issues and drive system improvements
* Triage and remediate security vulnerabilities as part of the team’s ongoing security posture efforts
* Participate in on\-call rotations, contribute to incident response activities, and complete follow\-up work to support continuous improvement
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and adjacent teams to deliver committed sprint work on a regular cadence

**WHAT** **WE’RE** **LOOKING** **FOR**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Proficiency in C\# and .NET, or a comparable object\-oriented language with willingness to ramp up on the stack
* Experience building and operating cloud\-based services
* Ability to work independently through complex features and debug production issues with minimal direction
* Familiarity with relational databases and SQL, including schema change management

**Preferred**

* Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React for full\-stack development
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipeline tooling using GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with observability platforms such as New Relic, Grafana, or equivalent APM and logging tools
* Exposure to authentication patterns including OAuth2, OIDC, or SAML in enterprise SaaS applications
* Experience building or maintaining integrations with third\-party APIs or enterprise SaaS systems

jobs.description:

***Job Overview***

WHO WE ARE
  

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI\-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high\-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.
  

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.
  

  

WHAT WE DO
  

The aiR Assist team builds the chat and agent experiences behind Relativity’s AI products. We create interactive, conversational user experiences that help legal and enterprise users leverage AI capabilities through scalable, reliable, and intuitive interfaces. Our team develops on top of a shared frontend platform that includes composable micro\-frontends, shared AI context services, and a modular component architecture designed for rapid innovation and long\-term maintainability.
  

  

ABOUT THE ROLE
  

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join the aiR Assist team at Relativity. In this role, you will build and evolve the chat and agent experience behind our AI products, delivering the interactive, conversational UI that legal and enterprise users rely on. You will transform rapidly evolving AI capabilities into polished, dependable product experiences.
  

You will own frontend delivery for AI chat and agent experiences while helping shape a modern frontend platform built on composable micro\-frontends, shared context management, and modular architecture. Beyond implementation, you will help establish engineering standards, mentor peers, and drive quality, accessibility, performance, and maintainability across a large\-scale cloud platform.

* Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and GraphQL services, as well as modern frontend state and data\-fetching solutions such as React Query and Zustand.

* Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization, cross\-browser compatibility, and web accessibility standards (WCAG).
* Hands\-on experience developing and maintaining automated tests using tools such as Vitest, Jest, Playwright, or Cypress.

**Preferred*** Experience building frontend infrastructure in cloud environments, particularly Microsoft Azure.
* Experience contributing to a design system or shared enterprise component library.
* Experience with module federation and runtime composition of independently deployed frontend applications.
* Understanding of backend technologies such as .NET or Node.js to support effective cross\-functional collaboration.
* Familiarity with AI\-enhanced frontend experiences, including chat interfaces, streaming responses, agentic workflows, or intelligent UI patterns.
* Interest in or experience with AI/ML\-assisted UI and UX development, including personalization and generative interaction experiences.

**WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT**Impactful Mission
* Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high\-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale
* Work on distributed, cloud\-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting\-Edge Technology
* Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Collaborative Culture

Inclusive Environment

jobs.title: Backend Developer till Synsams Digital Business-team
jobs.description:

Vi söker dig som tar stort eget ansvar, gillar att samarbeta och gärna bidrar med initiativ, kunskap och idéer som utvecklar både våra lösningar och vårt sätt att arbeta.


Hos oss blir du en viktig del av Synsams fortsatta digitala utveckling och vår ambition att vara det ledande och mest hållbara livsstilsföretaget inom optik och ögonhälsa. Du får arbeta med spännande tekniska utmaningar i en miljö där innovation, utveckling och en riktigt bra digital kundupplevelse står i fokus. Är du nyfiken på ny teknik, gillar att lösa komplexa problem och drivs av att bygga smarta och hållbara lösningar? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!

**Om tjänsten**


Som Backend Developer blir du en del av vårt Digital Business\-team, där du tillsammans med Team Lead och kollegor inom fullstack, backend, frontend och test driver utvecklingen av Synsams e\-handelsplattform. Du arbetar med .NET, C\# och Visual Basic och är med och vidareutvecklar stabila lösningar som är en viktig del av våra kunders digitala upplevelse.


Hos oss är ensam inte stark! Du blir en del av ett framåtsträvande och sammansvetsat tvärfunktionellt team där vi samarbetar nära, delar kunskap och lär av varandra. Din närmaste chef, Pasha Ayani, arbetar även som Team Lead och tillsammans med resten av teamet driver ni utvecklingen framåt. Det här är ett team som välkomnar nya idéer, vågar testa alternativa vägar och tillsammans hittar lösningar som skapar värde för både Synsam och våra kunder.

**Ditt arbete kommer bland annat innebära:**

* Designa, utveckla och underhålla skalbara backend\-lösningar.
* Implementera och förvalta integrationer mot externa system.
* Delta i teknisk planering och scoping av initiativ.
* Säkerställa prestanda, säkerhet och stabilitet i våra tjänster.
* Sätta och upprätthålla kodstandarder, samt driva kontinuerliga förbättringar i teamets arbetsmetoder.
* Stötta teamet vid komplexa tekniska utmaningar.
* Utforska och implementera nya teknologier och verktyg för att förbättra våra processer.

**Profil**


Vi söker dig som är en erfaren backendutvecklare och som trivs med att ta ansvar, lösa komplexa problem och bygga stabila och skalbara lösningar. Du är tekniskt nyfiken och håller dig uppdaterad inom ditt område, samtidigt som du har ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt och fokus på att skapa lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.


Du trivs i ett prestigelöst och tvärfunktionellt team där man samarbetar nära och gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap. Du har lätt för att kommunicera med både tekniska och icke\-tekniska kollegor och bidrar gärna till att utveckla såväl våra tekniska lösningar som teamets arbetssätt.

**Vi ser gärna att du har:**

* Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av backend\-utveckling.
* Stark kunskap inom .NET och C\#.
* Erfarenhet av databaser, databasdesign och optimering i MSSQL.
* Erfarenhet av molntjänster, gärna Azure, samt CI/CD.
* Vana av agila arbetsmetoder och att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team.
* Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

**Meriterande:** Erfarenhet av frontend, eventbaserad design och API\-integrationer.

**Några ord från Pasha Ayani, Team Lead.**

*"Det bästa med att arbeta på Synsam är kombinationen av modern teknik, stort eget ansvar och möjligheten att påverka. Du blir en del av ett kompetent och prestigelöst team där vi samarbetar nära, delar kunskap och tillsammans utvecklar den digitala kundupplevelsen. När jag inte jobbar tränar jag brasiliansk jiu\-jitsu, lagar mat och umgås med familj och vänner, en bra balans som jag tycker är viktig även i arbetslivet."*

**Har vi väckt ditt intresse?**  

Vad roligt! Klicka på länken nedan och skicka in din ansökan redan idag! I vår rekryteringsprocess ingår tester, intervjuer samt referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll för slutkandidat. Rollen är en tillsvidareanställning och utgår från Synsams huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team!
