jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Bounty

Bounty has supported UK parents since 1959, when it launched with hospital-given packs for new
mothers, and today reaches millions of families each year through the Bounty app, prenatal packs in
clinical settings, and bounty.com. Bounty is part of Joy, an AI-powered parenting platform that pairs
certified experts with AI to give parents round-the-clock support, alongside sister brands and
services across the group.

The Bounty app and bounty.com support hundreds of thousands of parents each month through
pregnancy, birth, and early parenthood. We're now investing in a full modernisation of the platform
behind that experience — a ground-up rebuild designed to give the business a faster, more flexible
foundation for years to come. We're hiring the person who'll lead that rebuild.

The role in brief

Come in, understand what we've built to date, then design and build a modern replacement for the
backend APIs that power the mobile app and website. Preserve the existing users, their data, and
our search ranking through the move. Then rebuild the website on the new backend.

What you'll be doing

Understand the current platform
Get familiar with our current environment: Sitecore, SQL Server and .NET on Azure IaaS, along with a network of scheduled tasks, SFTP feeds and partner integrations built up over time.
Some areas are better documented than others, so part of the role is building a clear, first-hand picture by exploring the code and observing the live systems directly, supported by AI tooling to move quickly.
Document your findings and recommended approach: target stack, migration plan, realistic timeline, risks, and how we keep the app and website running throughout the rebuild.

Rebuild the backend
Design and build the replacement backend API from scratch. We already have the mobile app's API contract documented (OpenAPI 3.1 spec, around 40 endpoints, mapped from the app codebases). The new backend needs to match that contract so we don't have to re-ship the app.
Migrate existing users and their data (accounts, permissions, engagement history, vouchers, editorial content) into the new data model. Nobody should have to re-register.
Switch over from the current backend once you're confident, with a written rollback plan you've tested in advance.

Rebuild the website
SEO is the biggest priority to protect. Rebuild bounty.com off Sitecore onto a modern stack you propose and we agree together. The site ranks well, and that ranking is worth real money, so URLs, redirects and structured data all need to carry over cleanly.

Keep it running
Once the move is complete, the day-to-day is keeping the new stack healthy and making sure integrations (Klaviyo, Purchasely, partner feeds) stay reliable. Our React-based Voucher
Management System sits with you too, both keeping it running and picking up feature work on it.
You'll also keep the analytics pipelines healthy (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Mixpanel) so the business team can rely on them for reporting.

Build what's next
With solid foundations in place, you'll work with the Bounty team on their product roadmap: new
features, improvements to what's there, and whatever the business needs from a platform built to
move quickly. This is where the rebuild starts paying off.

Who you are

Non-negotiables
Lead-level full-stack engineer. You can own a whole system yourself, from database through backend and frontend to deployment and monitoring, and you're comfortable making the architectural calls. You'll own this project end-to-end, with our mobile app engineers available to support you where the app side needs input.
Strong production backend in Node/TypeScript. We're standardising on TypeScript across the stack, so this role can extend into other engineering work at Bounty (and sister brand Joy) over time. React/TypeScript on the frontend is a given.
API design discipline. REST, OpenAPI, versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation. You've kept a client-consumed API stable over time.
Comfort with established systems. You don't need prior experience with our specific stack, but you're comfortable getting to grips with systems that are new to you — reading the actual code and running the actual systems rather than guessing.
Sensible use of AI-assisted development. You use AI tools day-to-day and know when to trust them and when not to, especially around company data, IP, and hallucinations.
Clear writing. You can put together a technical proposal or a handover document without hand-holding. You'll be writing for non-technical stakeholders throughout.
Good judgement about scope. You know when to park a nice-to-have because it's holding up the critical path, and when to flag a scope risk before it becomes a delivery problem.

Nice to have
You've led a live data migration before, at real scale, without losing data or breaking things. You understand why dual-write, reconciliation and a rehearsed cutover matter.
SEO awareness (URL preservation, canonical tags, structured data, redirect chains).
Azure and/or GCP experience. We're on Azure today and moving toward GCP to align with the wider organisation.

Explicitly not required
Please don't rule yourself out because you haven't used our specific stack or third-party tools before.
None of that is a blocker, the parts that matter, you'll pick up quickly.

What we offer

Salary range £90k–£115k, depending on experience.
Remote (UK), with occasional in-person time for team offsites.
25 days holiday.
Pension: 3% employer + 5% personal contribution.
Life assurance at 2x salary.
Option to enrol in private medical cover after a 6-month probation.
Genuinely interesting work: you'll build something modern from scratch with real autonomy, rather than shipping small features on an existing platform.
A well-established brand with a loyal, sizeable audience — hundreds of thousands of parents will be using what you build.

How to apply

Send a CV plus a short note (under 400 words) covering:
The most complex legacy or platform rebuild you've led, and what surprised you about it.
One thing you'd want to understand about our current setup before committing to a target architecture.

Applications via LinkedIn only. Closing date: 30 September 2026.

jobs.title: Engineering Architect
jobs.description:
As our new Engineering Architect, you will own and evolve the technical foundations that underpin product and service delivery, including engineering standards, development frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, testing harnesses, observability, and operational practices.

Your focus will be on enabling a fast-moving, AI-first delivery team to consistently deliver high-quality, scalable, and supportable solutions without needing to rebuild core foundations for every delivery cycle.

What you'll do

In this varied role, you will:
own and version technical foundations across all seven harness dimensions (Security, performance, coding style, UI/UX baselines, logging and observability, testing) so that every deliverable inherits secure, observable and tested defaults
build and maintain the shared ADO CI/CD pipelines and release governance so that standards are enforced automatically, and DORA metrics are produced from the pipeline itself
own the light-touch technical governance model - automated gates over committee review
ensure observability is instrumented from the first commit through to live running so that everything the team ships can be operated and handed over to a receiving product team
contribute hands-on as a full-stack builder inside each delivery's time box so that the harness stays credible and drift is caught in days rather than at cycle end
own the design and hands-on running of the delivery stack end to end - application architecture, containerisation, virtualisation, networking and deployment topology - so that what the team builds can be stood up, scaled and supported in the Azure estate without external dependency
shape deliveries as one of three leads, testing technical feasibility and setting the no-gos, so that committed work stays inside its appetite
represent the team's technical position in assurance, security and enterprise architecture conversations
proactively track industry trends, emerging tools and agentic engineering practice, and self-initiate the learning needed to apply them - trialling promising techniques and approaches in cooldown and sharing what works back into the harness, rules files and skills library.

What you'll need

We are looking for:
deep, current full stack engineering capability with hands-on delivery in an Azure and Azure DevOps (ADO) ecosystem using infrastructure as code approaches
strong practical coding experience in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with the fluency to work across back-end services, front-end interfaces and automation scripting
sound stack design judgement, with working knowledge of containerisation, virtualisation and networking sufficient to design, deploy and troubleshoot applications across Azure environments
proven ownership of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, release governance and DORA-based delivery measurement
strong grounding in security (secret management, dependency and static analysis scanning, least-privilege IAM), observability (structured logging, tracing and metrics) and test and evaluation automation
practical experience of AI-first, agentic delivery - rules files, known-good templates, curated skills libraries and evaluation harnesses for AI-generated output
ability to codify standards as machine-readable scaffolding rather than documentation, and to balance light-touch governance against delivery speed
credibility to represent the team's technical position with enterprise architecture, security and assurance functions
experience designing and delivering production-grade AI software systems across different domains
proven expertise in designing and/or implementing generative AI systems in production, including agentic systems, RAG pipelines, tool-use patterns, and model adaptation strategies
practical experience in retrieval and knowledge systems
breadth of knowledge across modern AI technologies, including generative models, deep learning, and predictive ML.

What you'll receive

A combined pension contribution of up to 20%.
Career progression and professional development opportunities.
25 days' holiday rising to 28 with length of service.
The opportunity to sell up to five days of holiday every year.
The opportunity to buy up to ten days of holiday each year (subject to conditions).
A healthcare package that allows you to claim back healthcare costs.
Life assurance of up to eight times your salary.
The opportunity to lease a new electric car through salary sacrifice (subject to conditions).
Cashback and discounts from more than 3,000 retailers.
One paid volunteering day each year.
Enhanced family leave and pay arrangements.
Access to an interactive health and wellbeing platform.
Support from trained mental health first aiders.
A £1,000 referral fee if you recommend someone who is successfully recruited by us.

Who we are

YTL UK is part of the international YTL Group based in Kuala Lumpur. The UK companies include:
Wessex Water – one of the top-performing water and sewerage companies in England and Wales, serving 2.9 million people across the South West

YTL Live – the development and operation of an entertainment complex that includes a 20,000 capacity arena, conferencing and exhibition space
plus a number of other retail, environmental and specialist businesses.

Our people tell us that YTL UK is a great place to work, which is why so many of them stay with us! You will have a unique opportunity to develop and progress your career within such a diverse group.

About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

The Team

The Structured Finance (SF) Methodologies team is responsible for a large portfolio of criteria and models spanning the global SF universe, including CMBS, RMBS, CLO, Covered Bonds, Non-Traditional and ABS asset types. The criteria and models that the group develops and maintains help analysts produce independent credit ratings that increase S&P Global’s analytical relevance in the market. As a Methodology Model SME, the position is embedded within the SF team and works closely with the Model and Criteria SMEs, who are responsible for developing and maintaining a growing portfolio of cutting-edge quantitative tools and analysis that enable analysts to continually produce high-quality and transparent credit analysis.

The Impact

The Associate Director enhances S&P Global Ratings’ ability to produce high-impact, insightful research and models and supports the continued growth of S&P Global Ratings’ relevance in an evolving market by synthesizing, analyzing, and deriving value from datasets, developing innovative analytic solutions and tools, and helping to build data analytics capabilities across the SF team.

What’s in it for you?

The role leverages quantitative abilities to develop analytic solutions and tools that enable credit analysts to perform high-quality analysis and research.
The position explores new areas for research and aids in business development initiatives. It supervises and performs implementation and testing of quantitative models as prototypes and production engines using the Quantitative Toolbox as appropriate, to further the study, application and acceptance of quantitative methodologies as part of the firm’s businesses.
The role offers a challenging, steep learning curve, and the position could lead to continued growth within the organization by demonstrating strong analysis and presentation skills.
Gain analytic knowledge of a wide range of global sectors and market topics.
Gain exposure to stakeholders across S&P Ratings and enjoy a strong collegial, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain nimble, user-friendly quantitative solutions and tools that will be used by credit analysts globally in credit rating analyses and research publications.
Synthesize and analyze large datasets to derive analytic value and insights for credit rating analyses and research publications.
Proactively identify and implement creative solutions to drive continuous improvement across models and analytical workflows.
Provide analytical insight and technical guidance to help the team resolve complex, non-routine problems and tasks.
Maintain close interaction with analysts, model developers, and subject matter experts to ensure that data analyses and tools effectively inform analytical decisions.
Work closely with the Model and Criteria Validation group to ensure a high-quality product.
Write clear, concise specifications and development documentation to ensure consistent and thorough documentation in accordance with policy and procedures.
Support criteria projects and be an active member of projects, including testing of new concepts, data gathering, writing and preparation of materials.
Coach and guide junior developers on technical tasks and best practices; support criteria projects by assisting with tool development, testing, and data gathering

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $148,491 to $176,000 USD (This section is only applicable to US Candidates). In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries.

An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 5 to 7 years of experience in quantitative modeling or software development supporting financial analysis.
Knowledge of capital markets and financial instruments, with an emphasis on credit risk modeling preferred.
Basic understanding of database modeling/design and applications, including knowledge of SQL and experience in databases such as Oracle, Sybase, or Access.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/VBA and programming languages such as R, Python, C++, and MATLAB.
Persistent with a natural curiosity about credit markets and technical details.
Displays well-rounded communication skills that implement good listening techniques, clear and good verbal skills. The ability to communicate across a wide range of groups and personalities internally and externally.
Works well in a team environment, focusing on collaboration and adapting to the needs of a diverse team.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field 
Self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across diverse teams.
Able to summarize complex quantitative concepts clearly and concisely for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience supporting multi-stage projects from planning through execution.
Strong time management, prioritization and deadline-management skills.
Effective communication, interpersonal and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder-management skills.
Creative problem-solver who works well in fast-paced environments.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

As a Senior Solutions Architect specializing in containerized solutions, you will play a crucial, pioneering role in this new initiative. Your primary focus will be leading the deployment of these solutions within our customer environments.

Solutions Architects are vital members of our project teams, often serving as the initial technical point of contact for our customers and key technical stakeholders for a successful deployment of Celonis. To ensure our customers achieve value, you will drive the technical setup required to leverage the full range of Celonis features and functionalities, including process mining, execution management, process automation, Action Flow, and task mining.

Given the unique nature of every customer environment, you will be the key liaison for translating the customer's technical requirements to ensure successful deployment on the clients infrastructure and successful integrations with their source systems. Furthermore, you will lead discussions on user management and authentication, acting as a technical partner to remove any technical barriers to user adoption.

The work you’ll do:

On Celonis side you are the key technical stakeholder for a successful technical delivery and onboarding of Celonis for enterprise clients.
Lead technical discussions to analyze customer architecture, recommend optimal solutions, and facilitate deployment, managing expectations amidst technical constraints.
Remove technical obstacles to maximize Celonis user adoption, clarifying technical risks and necessary tradeoffs.
Promote reusability by choosing between dedicated customer solutions and broader platform enhancements in collaboration with Celonis product development.
Establish real-time data integrations between customer systems and Celonis via APIs and internal tools.
Guide customers on authentication, user/group management, and provisioning best practices. Thus, removing all technical barriers to drive user adoption of Celonis.

The qualifications you need:

Proven experience of 5+ years, with at least 3 years in deploying and managing containerized applications on Kubernetes.
Advanced knowledge with at least one specific Kubernetes distribution (Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, RedHat OpenShift, etc.).
Eligibility for UK Security Check (SC) clearance is required; existing clearance is a strong advantage.
Very good understanding of best practices in deploying, scaling, and maintaining highly available, secure and resilient containerized applications on Kubernetes, ensuring efficient resource utilization and operational stability.
Proven experience implementing infrastructure as code (IaC, e.g. with Terraform) is required; Helm or Kustomize experience is strongly preferred. Fluency with additional tools such as ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Ansible, etc., is a plus.
Experience with at least one of the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) would be a plus.
Experience & interest in working with modern tech stack & methods like REST/SOAP API-Management, Data Ingestion & Streaming (Kafka or similar), SSO, LDAP, IT Security, Agile, etc.
Experience in industry with experience to work on Python, SQL, data pipelines & ETL processes for large volumes of data is a plus.
Knowledgeable about security and compliance topics for enterprise applications.Solid experience with project management, outstanding customer-centric & proven experience working with customers.
A solution-oriented professional that enjoys deep technical discussions as much as transferring your technical knowledge into understandable terms to a broader audience

What Celonis can offer you:

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

As Servent continues to expand its Data and AI capability, we are seeking an experienced Data and AI Architect to help grow our Data and AI practice and deliver transformative customer outcomes.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

As a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer
, you are a "developer-plus" technical contributor. You are responsible for building high-quality mock backends, APIs, and demo infrastructure, but with a unique twist: you leverage LLMs and Generative AI
to prototype at high velocity.

This role sits at the critical boundary between Product Engineering and Go-to-Market. While you won't build production systems, you will build "production-shaped" assets: reusable, well-structured, and documented services that enable credible technical storytelling and high-fidelity client validation.

Your core responsibilities will include:

AI-Accelerated Prototyping: Leverage LLMs (e.g., Claude and Gemini) to rapidly scaffold, build, and iterate on proof-of-concept apps and mock services. You move faster than a traditional sprint by using AI to handle the "heavy lifting" of boilerplate and logic generation.
Technical Asset Development: Design, build, and maintain reusable mock services in Node.js / TypeScript. You’ll implement contract-first APIs (REST/GraphQL), manage AWS deployments (API Gateway, Containers), and handle persistence using PostgreSQL or DynamoDB
Infrastructure as Code: Manage demo environments using Terraform, ensuring environments are reproducible and secure using existing OIDC authentication patterns.
Frontend Collaboration: Work closely with frontend engineers to ensure UI components point cleanly to your mock services, debugging integration issues and supporting end-to-end demo flows.
Strategic Pre-Sales Support: Partner with Pre-Sales consultants to translate client "win themes" into working technical artefacts. You will occasionally demo directly to clients, showcasing how Kaluza solves their specific retail challenges.
Product & UX Influence: Collaborate with Design and Product teams for UI direction while developing your own design ideas to make Kaluza’s capabilities shine.
Mentorship & Standards: Set informal engineering standards for the pre-sales team, mentoring others on API design and architecture.
AI Evangelism: Act as the resident expert in GenAI workflows for the Commercial team, mentoring others on how to use AI to bridge the gap between "slide-ware" and "software."

What this role is NOT:

A pure presentation-led role (you will be writing code regularly).
Shipping production code (your value comes from building things that work for a demo, not maintaining production SLOs).

About You

You are a software engineer by trade but a prototyper by heart. You understand the rigour of clean code but know when to lean into AI to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by the immediate impact of winning new clients and validating Kaluza’s value proposition in real-time.

Ideally you’ll have/be:

Software Engineering Foundation: Strong hands-on experience in Node.js / TypeScript and React. You know how to write code from scratch, which is why you’re so good at prompting AI to do it for you.
GenAI Power User: Deep experience leveraging LLMs and Generative AI to build apps, debug complex issues, and accelerate the development lifecycle. You aren't just using an AI assistant; you are "vibe coding" complete PoCs.
API Design Expert: Experience designing clean, well-documented APIs (REST and/or GraphQL) and using Git/Github workflows effectively.
Cloud & Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with AWS primitives and a proven ability to deploy infrastructure using Terraform.
Pragmatic & Autonomous: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, translating vague client requirements into working systems through a high degree of initiative.

What Will Set You Apart

The "Prototyper" Portfolio: A track record of building internal tools, sales demos, or high-fidelity PoCs using AI-first workflows.
Energy Sector Insight: Understanding the specific challenges facing energy retailers globally.
Auth & Security Savvy: Practical knowledge of OIDC-based authentication flows.
Design Thinking: A talent for sharing UX/UI design thinking with wider product teams.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

From us you’ll get

Pension Scheme
Discretionary Bonus Scheme
Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP
Life Assurance
Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app
Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests
Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts
5% Flex Fund to spend on the benefits you want most
26 days holiday
Flexible bank holidays, giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like
With no qualifying service periods, including up to 26 weeks full pay for primary caregivers and 4 weeks full pay for secondary caregivers when welcoming a new addition to your family
Dedicated personal learning and home office budgets
And more…

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working at Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

3+ years of software engineering experience in a production environment, ideally working with data-intensive systems or pipelines.

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering (BI & Analytics)
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Since being founded in 2001, BlackLine has become a leading provider of cloud software that automates and controls the entire financial close process. Our vision is to modernize the finance and accounting function to enable greater operational effectiveness and agility, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions and services to empower accounting and finance leaders around the world to achieve Modern Finance.
Being a best-in-class SaaS company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting-edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.
This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash (I2C) solution, a market-leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.
Work, Play and Grow at BlackLine!

Make Your Mark

As the founding Manager, Software Engineering for our new Business Intelligence & Analytics Engineering team
in Krakow, you have one of the most consequential roles in this new chapter of BlackLine's growth. This is a genuinely multi-disciplinary team - spanning data engineering, cloud data platforms, BI and analytics, and applied AI - and you will be the architect of the team itself: hiring and developing a world-class group of engineers across those disciplines, and shaping the culture, practices, and career trajectories of everyone in it.
You will lead the team through an ambitious delivery arc. You will start by standing up modern data pipelines - using Fabric database mirroring to move data from our Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical data model in Snowflake
- then build the modelling layer and surface insight to customers through Power BI
dashboards. From there, the team will develop true agentic AI experiences for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions (D&D), blending Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) patterns on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework.
You will partner closely with your senior engineers and cross-functional product leadership to ensure the team operates with clarity, urgency, and a high engineering bar. You will champion a culture of AI-accelerated development, where tools like Claude and Cursor are woven into the everyday fabric of how we build. This is not just a management role - it is a founding leadership role with an enduring impact on our mission to deliver autonomous finance and expand BlackLine's office-of-the-CFO footprint.

You'll Get To

Build and Scale the Krakow BI & Analytics Engineering Team:
Lead the hiring, onboarding, and ongoing development of a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team spanning data engineering, BI/analytics, and AI. Be an ambassador for BlackLine's engineering culture in the Krakow hub from day one.
Deliver the Snowflake Analytics Platform:
Own delivery of our modern data platform - Fabric database mirroring from Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical Snowflake data model, the Snowflake modelling and semantic layers, and customer-facing Power BI dashboards that turn that data into insight.
Lead the Agentic Experience Roadmap:
Guide the team from analytics into applied AI - building true agentic agents for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions management, delivering a mix of Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) experiences on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework, integrated with our existing web applications.
Lead, Coach, and Grow Your Team:
Own the career development, performance, and wellbeing of your direct reports across a varied set of specialisms. Conduct regular 1:1s, provide meaningful feedback, and create growth paths that retain and attract top talent in a competitive Krakow market.
Drive Delivery and Execution:
Partner with Product Management to align on priorities, manage engineering capacity, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality software and data products on time. Remove blockers, manage risk, and keep commitments.
Champion AI-Accelerated Development:
Cultivate a team mindset and workflow that embraces modern agentic development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) as force multipliers for velocity and quality - and hold the bar high for what great engineering looks like in this era.
Shape Engineering Culture and Standards:
Establish and uphold best practices across the full stack of the team's work - data pipeline reliability and observability, data quality and lineage, dimensional and semantic modelling standards, code quality, CI/CD, testing, and security. Set the tone for a culture of ownership, craft, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally:
Serve as the primary engineering leadership voice in conversations with Product, Design, and senior stakeholders, and with the analytics and office-of-the-CFO consumers of the team's output. Translate business goals into actionable engineering plans and communicate engineering realities clearly to non-technical partners.
Contribute to Strategic Roadmap Planning:
Participate in quarterly and annual planning cycles, providing technical and capacity input that shapes the product roadmap, the data platform architecture, and long-term agentic-AI direction.
Sustain Enterprise-Grade Quality:
Ensure the team's output - data pipelines, analytics, and AI agents alike - meets the reliability, performance, accuracy, and security standards required by a global SaaS platform serving finance and accounting professionals worldwide.

Technical / Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Proven experience leading and growing engineering teams
in a SaaS product environment, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining engineers at multiple seniority levels.
Strong technical foundation in data engineering and analytics
- hands-on experience with cloud data platforms and pipelines, ideally including Snowflake
, Microsoft Fabric
, and Power BI / DAX
, and dimensional or semantic data modelling - sufficient to earn trust with your engineers and make sound architectural trade-offs.
Solid grounding in application engineering
- production-grade, scalable, secure services, ideally in C# / .NET
- and comfort leading integration with modern web applications (React / C# / SQL Server / PostgreSQL).
Awareness of, or genuine enthusiasm for, building agentic AI / LLM-based experiences
(including HITL and HOTL patterns) and integrating them into enterprise products.
Experience managing in an AI-augmented engineering environment,
or a genuine enthusiasm and aptitude for adopting AI-driven development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to raise team velocity and quality.
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional delivery,
aligning engineering, product, and design stakeholders around shared goals and managing execution with clarity and accountability.
Strong people management skills,
including structured performance management, career development frameworks, and the ability to have direct, compassionate conversations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
comfortable representing the team to senior leadership and working effectively across time zones and cultures.
A high engineering bar:
you understand what great looks like in data quality, pipeline reliability, code quality, CI/CD, testing, and observability, and you hold the team to that standard.

We're Even More Excited If You Have

Experience standing up a new engineering team or office, especially in a greenfield or hub-expansion context where you shaped culture from scratch.
Experience delivering a cloud data-warehouse migration or modernisation (e.g., to Snowflake) and building customer-facing embedded analytics.
Hands-on exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration, or ML-driven decisioning in a production enterprise setting.
Background in regulated industries such as finance, accounting, or fintech, giving you sensitivity to the compliance and reliability requirements our customers depend on - and to the office-of-the-CFO analytics use cases this team serves.
Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and experience guiding teams building on Azure (and comfort across AWS or Google Cloud).
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles and how to guide a team in applying them responsibly when leveraging AI-generated code and autonomous agents in production.
A history of strong cross-timezone collaboration with engineering and product leadership in distributed organizations.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering
is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences
. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About The Role

We’re looking for a product-focused Software Engineer II
to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools
. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model
with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in London, Oxford, Krakow or Lisbon.

What You’ll Do

Drive Impact: Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.
Shape the Product: Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.
Collaborate & Mentor: Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.
Innovate with AI: Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.
Champion Operational Health: Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.
Build for Quality: Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.

Skills & Experience

We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.

Full-Stack Mindset: Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.
Problem Solving: A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.
Data-Driven: A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.
AI Coding: you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code.
Global Mindset: Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively.

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises
in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer

Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our ED&I strategy shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com
.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com
. We have all the answers!

jobs.title: Software Engineer 5— Platform Modernization Engineering
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About The Team

The Platform Modernization Engineering (PME) — Migrations team exists to accelerate Netflix's ability to evolve its infrastructure by driving safe, scalable migrations across the stack. We reduce engineering toil, eliminate technical debt, and enable teams to move forward with confidence as Netflix's technology continues to evolve at pace.

We are not a feature delivery team. We are a revenue protector and accelerator — through our work we enable faster feature delivery, innovation, and security protection across the entire engineering organization.

Netflix operates one of the most sophisticated and high-scale engineering platforms in the world. Keeping that platform on the leading edge requires continuous, intentional modernization. The Paved Path — our curated set of recommended, well-supported infrastructure standards — is constantly advancing as Netflix pushes into new technical territory. Our team exists to bring the fleet along with it: setting clear baselines, accelerating adoption across thousands of services, and protecting that progress from erosion over time. We affect both engineering culture and engineering quality at scale.

We operate in pods (3–6 month cycles), partnering closely with the most strategically critical initiatives across Infrastructure Engineering. We build the automation and tooling that lets us execute these at a scale and speed no manual effort could match, including AI-assisted code modification pipelines and fleet-wide orchestration systems.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced L5 Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of large-scale systems, automation, and cross-functional influence. You will design and build the tooling and automation that powers fleet-wide migration campaigns, partner directly with platform and product teams to de-risk complex infrastructure changes, and help define what excellent Paved Path adoption looks like in practice at Netflix.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You will own migration projects end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through automated execution, quality validation, and completion. You'll also build durable tooling that outlasts any single campaign.

Key Responsibilities

Migration Engineering

Design and execute large-scale code and infrastructure migration campaigns across Netflix's fleet of thousands of repositories and services. Own the full lifecycle: scoping, campaign design, automated execution, validation, and completion.

Automation & Tooling

Build and extend PME's internal automation platforms — leveraging AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration — to scale the team's impact across the fleet with speed and reliability.

Technical Design

Write clear, well-researched design documents. Identify and communicate tradeoffs between migration approaches and drive decisions with data and stakeholder input.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Embed with partner teams driving the most crucial infrastructure-level strategic initiatives to deeply understand migration needs, de-risk project execution, and ensure campaigns land successfully with minimal customer toil.

Paved Path Advocacy

Proactively identify opportunities to improve Paved Path adoption and adherence. Surface patterns and systemic opportunities — then act on them. Influence product strategy and roadmaps of platform teams through direct engagement and data.

Operational Excellence

Instrument migrations with telemetry and dashboards. Monitor fleet health, track adoption rates, and build the feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.

Who You Are

A strong generalist engineer energized by scope and ambiguity — comfortable working across the full stack (backend services, automation pipelines, data models, dashboards) while building depth in the areas that matter most.

A systems thinker who understands that successful migrations are as much about people and process as they are about code — and designs solutions accordingly.

A self-directed owner who can take a high-priority, ambiguous challenge and drive it to completion across teams, time zones, and organizational boundaries.

Someone who builds customer trust through repeated, low-drama delivery. You communicate proactively, course-correct quickly, and leave things better than you found them.

A pragmatic builder who defaults to automation and reuse, builds tools that generalize beyond a single use case, and knows when to ship fast vs. when to invest in durability.

Required Experience

Strong backend engineering skills, with demonstrated ability to build and operate production services at scale (experience in Java or Python is a plus)
Proven experience navigating and operating within large, complex infrastructure ecosystems — understanding service interdependencies, fleet-wide patterns, and the ripple effects of change at scale
Deep, hands-on experience with AI-driven solutions — not as a user, but as a builder. You follow where the technology is going, form opinions, and bring that edge into the work
Proven ability to drive complex, cross-functional technical projects from design through completion
Strong technical writing: design docs, tradeoff analyses, postmortems
Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred: EC2, S3, EKS/Kubernetes)
Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and partner effectively with senior stakeholders

Experience We'd Be Excited About

Experience with large-scale code migration or modernization campaigns
Demonstrated ability to build with or integrate LLMs and AI agents into engineering workflows — you have shipped AI-powered solutions, not just experimented with them
Experience building or operating fleet-management, dependency graph, or service catalog systems
Background in platform or infrastructure engineering organizations
Familiarity with Java or Python in a backend services context
Experience designing campaigns with measurable adoption and adherence metricsa

jobs.description:
Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.

Din roll

Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt engagerade team inom delprojektet Digital Map Generating System (DMGS) / Geodata inom JAS Gripen i rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare.

Vi är en central resurs som har expertis inom GIS, geodata och aeronautisk information. Geodata är en viktig del av de flesta av Saabs produkter och tjänster inom flyg, försvar och säkerhet. DMGS är ett egenutvecklat verktyg baserat på ESRI ArcMap för att behandla, kvalitetssäkra och producera Geodata till Gripen samt dess stöd- och träningssystem.

I rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare ingår t.ex. uppgifter som att arbeta fram kreativa lösningar kring överenskommen kravbild tillsammans med angränsande system. Planering, testning och möjligheten att kommunicera utvecklad funktion till intressenter kan också vara en del av arbetet.

Under funktionsutvecklingen kommer du samtidigt att få lära dig om hur vårt data och system kravställs, utvecklas, testas och distribueras; både i form av geografiska data till flygplan, till 3D-omvärldar för Gripens simulatorer samt till andra intressanta system.

Teamet består idag av roller som uppdragsledare, systemingenjörer och mjukvaruutvecklare och kännetecknas av en trevlig stämning och en god kultur av att hjälpa och lära av varandra.

Det finns en stor möjlighet till att anpassa dagarna med varierade arbetsuppgifter och även möjligheter att få delta på konferenser som sker utomlands.

Din närmsta chef är utbildad coach och om du brinner för personlig utveckling finns det stora möjligheter. Du erbjuds möjligheten att genomföra både interna och externa utbildningar.

Din profil

Kunskap inom C#.NET; gärna även inom WPF, Async Await och TPL.
Du har erfarenhet kring AI i kombination med programmering
Kunskap att se helheten och förstå hur olika delar av ett system interagerar. Detta är kritiskt för att designa skalbara och underhållbara system.
Förmågan att identifiera, analysera och lösa komplexa problem.
Förmågan att kommunicera tekniska koncept på ett sätt som är förståeligt för både tekniska och icke-tekniska teammedlemmar. Detta inkluderar dokumentation och presentationer.
Förmågan att säkerställa att mjukvaran uppfyller högsta kvalitetsstandarder. Inkluderar även testning, säkerhet och prestandaoptimering.
Förmågan att arbeta effektivt i ett team och har en bra kommunikativ approach
Applikationer: MS Visual Studio, ESRI ArcMap, ESRI ArcGIS Pro

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vad blir du en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

The Role

We are looking for a mid-level full-stack developer with a strong sense of ownership and genuine curiosity. You will work across a suite of applications built primarily with .NET, running in Docker-based environments. That means taking features from start to finish, contributing to architectural decisions, and helping improve how the team works.

Day to day, that means building and maintaining backend services in C#, developing front-end components in TypeScript, designing REST APIs, and operating services with Docker and Docker Compose. You will also contribute to infrastructure automation and internal tooling as the need arises.

We are AI-first in practice, not just in name. We actively use AI-assisted development workflows and expect that to deepen over time. The landscape shifts fast, and we are not waiting to see where it lands. We are building with it now. That means we want someone who is genuinely curious about these tools, experiments with them, and develops their own judgment about when and how to use them well.

Why Maranics

Most people spend years executing other people's decisions. At Maranics, you own the outcome. We are a small team building a tool that changes how businesses run in practice. Not prototypes, not internal tools that get quietly abandoned. When something ships here, you feel it.

Because we are small, your work is visible and the people who depend on it are not three teams away. We are genuinely AI-first, and we are building the kind of team that develops real judgment on real problems. Growth here is not rationed. When you are ready for more, you take it.

What We Are Looking For

You have 2–4 years of professional software development experience, solid .NET backend skills, and practical front-end experience. You are comfortable with Docker, Git-based workflows, and taking full ownership of a feature. A good grasp of software architecture fundamentals is important, as is strong written and spoken English.

Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or AI-assisted development tools is a plus. So is having worked in a small, distributed team before. You will know what that feels like.

Who This Is For

This role suits someone who wants more than ticket execution, who notices things, communicates openly, and cares about the outcome. If you want to build real things in a small remote team where your work has visible impact and your name is attached to it, this role will fit.

Practical Information

Location: Maranics is based in Gothenburg and the role works well hybrid, with flexibility on how often you are in the office.
Work permit within EU is required.
Start: As soon as possible, with consideration for your notice period.

About Maranics

Maranics builds a platform that digitalises operational workflows in complex, regulated industries. Where data was previously lost, scattered across silos, or trapped in manual processes, Maranics creates a single connected layer capturing what matters, routing it in real time, and delivering accurate, contextual data directly to the systems that need it.

Collaborate closely with developers to understand requirements and identify potential issues early in the development lifecycle.

Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle—from planning and design to release and maintenance.
Promote a culture of quality by advocating for best practices and continuous improvement throughout the development process.

What You Bring

Proven experience using AI tools for test creation and execution, improving efficiency and accuracy in test automation.
Experience developing QA strategies for AI-based products, including evaluating agent responses and ensuring model fairness and scalability.
Strong hands-on experience with both manual and automated software testing, with the ability to determine the appropriate testing approach based on the feature, risk, and requirements.
Strong programming skills in C#, Python, and TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks and tools.
Experience with contract testing and tools like PACT.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points

Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
Experience with performance and security testing.
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.

Who You Are

A global SaaS leader for seamless digital document workflows, Nitro offers a suite of solutions for PDF, eSigning, identity verification and analytics supported by a best-in-class customer success and change management team. With more than 3 million licensed users and 13,000+ business customers across 157 countries, we serve 67% of the Fortune 500.

How We Work:

We aim to create an environment where talented individuals are empowered to excel. How we collaborate, innovate, and engage with one another is important to us. Our work is driven by 5 key principles:

One team, One mission Our collective dedication to Nitro's mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.

The Role:

We are seeking an experienced, driven, and customer-focused Engineering Manager to lead our team of skilled engineers in the development and delivery of Nitro's Sign product, API and integrations.

The ideal candidate will have a relentless focus on delivering an exceptional user experience, have a strong technical background, proven leadership abilities, and experience in managing teams operating under Agile and Scrum frameworks. Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of front-end, back-end and QA engineers, taking accountability for delivery across your team.
Actively foster a high bar for engineering excellence with a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability.
Encourage and enable a customer-centric mindset within the team, working closely with our product and partner teams to develop solutions that exceed our customer expectations.
Support professional growth through regular feedback, coaching, and performance reviews.
Partner with senior engineers in your area to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
Lead communication with stakeholders from other teams, creating focused space for engineers to do their best work.
Collaborate with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to and improve company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.
Champion and implement modern development practices and workflows to maximize team efficiency and transparency, using metrics to identify process improvements and make data driven decisions.
Align engineering efforts with business goals, product vision, and technical strategy.

Experience working on APIs and enterprise integrations is a plus.
Track record of shipping user focused applications and products.
Hands-on experience with modern development practices such as CI/CD, unit testing, and version control (Git).
Proven experience leading teams using Agile and/or Scrum methodologies.
Ability to quickly build trust, motivate, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
Strong communication, organizational, and decision-making skills.
Ability to work with a diverse set of teams and individuals with various working styles to drive clarity, make decisions and simply get things done.

Our team embraces the hybrid work model, appreciating its blend of flexibility and structure. We combine three days of in-person collaboration at our global offices in Toronto, Dublin, Antwerp, Porto, and Melbourne with the convenience of two days of remote work each week.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Developer to take a leading role in driving the evolution of our Norwegian applications that support the core systems. These systems are very important to our business operations, and we’re seeking someone who can lead their continued development with technical excellence.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with key stakeholders including the Product Owner, Tribe Architect, IT Delivery Manager, and the Mainframe Centre of Excellence. Together, you’ll ensure that our solutions are aligned with If’s architectural principles. You will also have the opportunity to guide and mentor a team of skilled developers.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of the applications that support the core systems, contribute to modernizing legacy platforms, and make a lasting impact on how we deliver value to our customers.

Lead the technical delivery within the Yggdrasil squad, ensuring design, development, and maintenance of stable and secure solutions.
Translate business requirements into efficient technical solutions.
Act as a bridge between business experts, technical developers in Norway and India, and architectural teams.
Ensure consistent coding standards, version control, security and documentation practices.
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing and monitoring.

Ensure optimal usage and cost management of Azure resources.

We offer

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Weekly workout hour
High pension savings

About The Team

The Core Tribe is responsible for maintaining and evolving our business-critical insurance and claims systems. The Tribe operates cross-functionally across Finland and Norway, organized into smaller squads combining business domain experts with IT professionals.

Our IT development teams include colleagues from If’s internal IT units as well as strategic partners such as Tata Consultancy Services, ensuring seamless collaboration across Norway and India.

Yggdrasil squad is one of the squads in the Core Tribe. The mission of this squad is to ensure the ecosystems of applications supporting the Policy and Claims systems within the Norwegian scope is viable, healthy and stable. As the Senior Developer for this squad, you’ll be responsible for maintaining and developing this ecosystem and strengthening our squad technical capabilities.

Who are you?

You are a technically strong and forward-thinking developer with a passion for quality and long-term solutions. You bring deep technical expertise and strong communication skills that enable you to develop effective, maintainable solutions and you collaborate well across roles.

You also take ownership of your work and continuously look for ways to improve. You understand the bigger picture, think with a long-term and solution-oriented mindset, and bring an architectural perspective when designing and evaluating solutions. In Terms Of Technical Experience, You Have

Solid experience with C#, .NET, and Azure application development and maintenance.
Familiarity with enterprise solutions, REST APIs, and message-based architecture.
Good knowledge and practical use of Infrastructure as Code (for example Terraform or Bicep).
Hands-on experience with tools such as Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with static code and security analysis tools such as SonarQube and Snyk.
Experience applying OWASP Top 10 in design, development, and risk assessment of applications.
Experience with authentication and authorization solutions including OAuth2, Curity and Identity Providers.

It´s a Plus If You Have

Experience working in an Agile setup, collaborating closely with product owners and business stakeholders.
Python and Databricks competence.
Familiarity with integration patterns between distributed systems and IBM z Mainframe.
Experience with monitoring and observability using Dynatrace, Application Insights, Splunk or similar tools.
Understanding of basic networking concepts including firewall rules and ability to use Wireshark for troubleshooting when needed.

You play a key role in engaging with stakeholders, gathering and refining requirements, demonstrating solutions, and proactively identifying how we can best support business goals.

Support customers in their digital transformation across areas such as data modelling and architecture, system integrations, platform modernization, and AI-driven solutions.
Engage in regular discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
Translate high-level architectural directions into concrete guidance for development teams.

Collaborate closely with Nortal colleagues, including development, project management, and data/architecture experts.

Ability to understand business needs and ways of working, enabling smooth collaboration.

As a Game Engineer on Subway Surfers, you’ll work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to take ideas from concept through implementation and into the hands of the above-mentioned hundreds of millions of players. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve both the game and the way we build it.

Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#
Professional experience developing games, ideally on mobile
Solid hands-on experience with Unity
Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns
Experience collaborating with multiple disciplines to develop and deliver game features

Experience working in Agile methodologies

Experience working on a live game and regularly shipping new features and content
Experience developing or integrating client/server features and backend services

About SYBO

We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

As a not-for-profit organisation, it makes contributions to the Tote Board to fund a wide range of causes in social service, community development, sports, arts, education and health sectors.

Since 2004, over $5 billion have been channelled to the Tote Board. In addition, Singapore Pools also contributes about $2 billion annually to the Government in the form of taxes and duties. Its responsible gaming practices have been awarded the highest level of certification (Level 4) by the World Lottery Association’s Responsible Gaming Framework since 2012.

Since inception, Singapore Pools’ staff have a long-standing commitment to doing good and giving back to those in need. Staff volunteers support activities held all year round, from helping disadvantaged children, youth-at-risk, underprivileged families, and elderly, to conserving the environment.

jobs.description:
Job description:

BUILD MARKETS. SHAPE ECONOMIES.
At SGX Group, we create markets. We turn ideas into products and expand access to new opportunities. We are building the future of the exchange in-house: from architecture and platforms to the critical systems that power markets. The biggest decisions are still open to people who join us now.

The opportunity
The Executive Director, Software Engineering is a seasoned technology leader responsible for shaping SGX’s enterprise software engineering vision, platform strategy, and technical operating model. This role holds broad accountability for engineering excellence across architecture, platform resilience, governance, and leadership capability, ensuring SGX’s technology estate remains secure, scalable, and future-ready. Working across multiple teams and domains, the role translates strategic priorities into modern engineering practices, drives critical technology decisions, raises technical standards, and enables senior engineering leaders to deliver high-performing platforms that strengthen SGX’s long-term competitiveness, innovation, and operational resilience.
This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of software engineering at SGX by influencing enterprise architecture, platform strategy, and the engineering practices that underpin critical market infrastructure. It is suited for a leader who is motivated by building long-term capability, modernising engineering at scale, and leaving a lasting impact on how technology enables business growth, resilience, and innovation.
Beyond immediate leadership accountability, the role provides a compelling career path into broader enterprise technology leadership, with opportunities to deepen influence across strategy, engineering transformation, architecture governance, and organisational capability building. It is an ideal platform for a senior leader seeking to expand enterprise impact, develop the next generation of engineering leadership, and play a defining role in SGX’s technology evolution.

The Software Engineering team
Software Engineering builds, runs and evolves the applications and platforms behind SGX Group's business and market infrastructure.
The team works closely with product, architecture, platform, security and delivery colleagues to turn business priorities into secure, resilient and scalable services. Its remit spans the full engineering lifecycle, from technical design and delivery through to production ownership and continuous improvement.
Our next phase is about strengthening engineering ownership, modernising platforms and practices and building consistency across teams without flattening the different needs of each business domain.

What you will do
Software Development: Define the enterprise engineering vision and drive transformation of the software delivery process across SGX Tech.
Software Design: Shape enterprise-wide software architecture strategy and technology evolution.
Secure Software Development: Define Tech org-wide application security and engineering risk strategy.
Testing & Quality Engineering: Drive Tech org-wide quality transformation and delivery assurance strategy.
System Integration: Define Tech org-wide integration and interoperability strategy.
SDLC & Delivery Excellence: Drive Tech org-wide operational resilience and service reliability direction.
Observability & Production Support: Define organisational service ownership and operational excellence strategy.
Automation & Productivity: Lead organisational productivity strategy and investment priorities, driving productivity transformation through automation and AI.
Leadership & Mentoring: Define engineering culture, workforce strategy and long-term capability development.
Agentic AI Engineering: Reimagine software delivery around AI-native operating models and ecosystem capabilities.
Act as a senior technology leader and trusted partner to business and technology stakeholders, influencing strategic decisions and positioning engineering as a driver of resilience, innovation, and competitive advantage.

What we are looking for
Experience: Extensive experience in senior software engineering, platform engineering or technology leadership roles, with accountability for multiple engineering teams, senior leaders or enterprise platforms in complex, high-availability environments.
Track record: Strong track record of defining enterprise engineering direction and translating strategy into scalable operating models, governance frameworks and long-term platform evolution.
Technical stack: Deep expertise in modern distributed systems including microservices, service mesh and observability platforms, with strong cloud platform knowledge across AWS EKS, Azure AKS and GCP GKE, and advanced knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering practices such as incident management, chaos engineering and capacity planning.
Standards & environment: Track record of improving operational resilience and service maturity across mission-critical, regulated enterprise platforms.
Communication & leadership: Proven ability to lead leaders and scale engineering organisations through mentoring, upskilling strategies and performance frameworks, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence major technology decisions and align engineering outcomes with enterprise priorities.
Education & certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information and Communications Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
Domain Knowledge: Exposure to financial market infrastructure, including securities and derivatives trading, clearing, settlement, market operations, or exchange-related systems.

Why this role matters
You will work on technology that underpins critical market infrastructure, where engineering decisions have direct consequences for the business, its customers and the markets it serves. Not many engineering roles carry that weight.
The mandate is real. You will shape how platforms are engineered, owned and evolved, and what software engineering becomes at SGX Group. The work is demanding and the organisation is still changing, which is exactly where the opportunity sits. There are not many chances in a career to build something that outlasts you.

About SGX Group
SGX Group is one of the world's most trusted international marketplaces, known for its stability and openness. Anchored in Singapore, we enable price discovery, capital formation and risk management across asset classes, supported by resilient infrastructure and robust clearing. We convene issuers, investors and intermediaries to create and grow markets that stand the test of time. Find out more at www.SGX Group.com.
