jobs.title: Senior Server Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
### **Who we are**


Sandbox Interactive is the ambitious game development studio behind the award\-winning game Albion Online. The game is the first true cross\-platform MMO, and is playable on Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android with more than 350\.000 daily players and over 2 million monthly visitors on our website. We started as a small independent group of experienced gaming professionals in 2012, and now employ an international team of more than 100 people. Since 2020, Sandbox Interactive has been part of the Stillfront Group. Our team is passionate about making Albion Online the best game it can be, and we’re constantly on the lookout for talented individuals to join our growing team in the heart of Berlin.

### **Your Game**


As a Senior Server Developer, you will help design, develop, and maintain the systems that keep Albion Online world running smoothly. You’ll work on backend features and services that support millions of players, ensuring stability, scalability and performance across a continuously evolving live environment.


This role requires deep technical expertise, a proactive mindset and a passion for large\-scale online systems. You’ll collaborate closely with game developers and designers to deliver reliable tools, features and infrastructure that enhance the gameplay experience and support ongoing content updates.

* Architect and maintain high\-throughput backend systems that power Albion Online’s large\-scale, persistent world
* Develop and optimize server\-side gameplay features, live tools and real\-time networking systems using C\#
* Work with our Release Operations team to ensure smooth deployment of patches and content updates
* Ensure system reliability, performance and scalability across global regions and large player populations
* Implement monitoring and observability tools to improve issue detection and system resilience
* Collaborate with client engineers and game designers to integrate gameplay logic and backend functionality
* Participate in architectural discussions and technical planning for feature growth and long\-term system health
* Support and mentor other engineers, fostering a culture of technical pragmatism and performance

### **Your Talent**

#### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of experience in backend or network programming for online or multiplayer games.
* Strong proficiency in C\# and experience with the Unity engine
* Proven experience with client\-server architecture, game server logic and live game maintenance
* Solid understanding of database systems (SQL/NoSQL), cloud environments and distributed server infrastructure
* Experience with performance optimization, debugging, and profiling in large\-scale systems
* Excellent communication skills (presentation, verbal and written) in English

#### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working on MMORPGs or sandbox games
* Familiarity with Albion Online or similar persistent\-world systems
* Understanding of live operations workflows, including event management, hotfixing and content rollout
* Knowledge of DevOps practices, monitoring tools and CI/CD pipelines
* Passion for games and player\-driven online experiences

### **Our Offer**

* **BVG corporate ticket**:


	+ Receive a free company ticket for Germany's public transportation system
* **Personal Development:**


	+ Have a high degree of autonomy and ownership from the start
	+ Develop your skills through company\-sponsored training and language courses
	+ Enjoy company\-sponsored tickets for Gamescom Dev \& other game conferences
* **Hybrid Work model:**


	+ Combine the best of both worlds, and enjoy the freedom to switch between working in the office and working remotely
* **Health \& Wellbeing:**


	+ Discounted membership to Urban Sport Club for fitness and wellness
	+ Access to nilo health for confidential mental health support, coaching, and wellbeing resources
	+ Extra vacation days awarded based on years of service, up to a maximum of 30 days annually
* **Modern \& Well\-Equipped Office**:


	+ Work in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, a central, vibrant neighborhood in Berlin with many dining and entertainment options
	+ Enjoy height\-adjustable tables, ergonomic chair options, dimmable lighting, and acoustic panels
* **Start\-up perks**:


	+ Benefit from free drinks and snacks in the office
	+ Participate in team events, breakfast weeks, summer and winter parties
* **Sustainable business**:


	+ Be part of a successful, profitable company on a continued growth path
* **Gaming\-driven culture**:


	+ Work alongside a supportive team of gaming enthusiasts who are deeply committed to their craft
* **Global reach**:


	+ Join a team of industry experts shaping a game enjoyed by hundreds of thousands worldwide

jobs.title: Senior Product Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you a pragmatic SaaS engineer who thrives on building data pipelines that turn raw data into insights that prevent real\-world infrastructure failures? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.

  

As our new **Senior Product Development Engineer**, you will be designing and developing cloud\-based analytics framework components that process diverse data sources into actionable insights — from data import and cleansing through calculation pipelines to dashboards that predict critical events such as sewage overflows in pump and pipe systems.

 **What you will be doing**


As a key part of the Analytics Platform Engineering team, you'll create impact by building the intelligent analytics framework that empowers utilities worldwide to prevent infrastructure failures before they happen, protecting communities and the environment.

  

Your main responsibilities include:

  

* Architect and develop framework components and calculation pipelines for our cloud\-based analytics product (MAP platform)
* Implement data import, cleansing, and processing workflows that transform third\-party and internal data into meaningful insights
* Resolve production bugs and work through the engineering backlog to improve platform reliability and performance
* Build and maintain predictive analytics features such as overflow alerts for sewage pumps and pipes
* Contribute architectural decisions that ensure the platform scales reliably in a real cloud environment

 **What makes you a great fit**

  

Above all, you are a hands\-on, pragmatic cloud software engineer with real\-world experience shipping and maintaining production systems — someone who has been through release cycles, handled upgrades, responded to customer feedback, and knows what it takes to get the job done. **You have experience building, enhancing, and supporting applications in a .NET environment.**

  

We would also imagine that you have:

  

* 7\+ years of experience in software product development with cloud\-based systems (design, build, deploy, and maintain)
* Strong skills in building data processing pipelines — including data import, transformation, cleansing, and calculation workflows
* Demonstrated experience with architectural design of scalable framework components in a production environment
* Proven ability to work autonomously in small agile/scrum teams and deliver iterative releases

  

It is a plus if you also have

  

* Experience with analytics or IoT platforms, particularly in utilities, water management, or industrial domains
* Familiarity with dashboard development and alert/notification systems
* Background working with third\-party data integrations and building extensible framework products

 **Why you will love working here**

  

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.

  

We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't.

 **Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!**


To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com

jobs.title: Automate QA Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title**

Automated QA Engineer

**Company**

Landmark Systems Ltd

**Location**

Pulborough, West Sussex/Hybrid \- 2\-3 days on\-site

**Reports To**

Chief Technology Officer

**Salary**

Dependent on experience, £52K\-£58K

**About Landmark Systems**

Landmark Systems has been providing specialist accounting and business management software to UK farmers for over 39 years. Our KEYPrime desktop software is trusted by thousands of farms across the country. We’re a focused team of around 40 people, backed by a larger European agricultural software group — the stability of an established, profitable business with the energy of a product being built afresh. We win on agricultural depth: VAT and Making Tax Digital, farm and estate structures, the real working lives of the businesses we serve.

**The Opportunity**

Currently our automated testing is thin — there’s a modest Selenium regression suite, that’s limited and needs rebuilding, no proper end\-to\-end or API automation above the unit tests.

**Responsibilities, (but not limited to)**

· Design, build and own the automated test framework for KEYinfinity (end\-to\-end, API and regression).

· Get automated suites running on every build in our CI/CD pipeline, with clear pass/fail signals.

· Grow automated coverage of the critical journeys — VAT returns, bank reconciliation, MTD submission, invoicing, payments, permissions — one feature area at a time.

· Work with the Product Manager to write testable acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then) before development starts.

· Coach developers to build quality in and write their own automated tests.

· Help define the shared release exit criteria and keep quality evidence current and visible.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the hard technical decisions end to end — multi\-tenancy, data modelling, platform trade\-offs.

· Set the technical direction on the problems that matter most and bring the rest of the team with you.

· Elevate the performance of those around you : coaching senior engineers, strengthening how we design, review and ship.

· Lead the solution architecture conversations — bringing engineering, product and domain experts into the room and guiding them to decisions everyone trusts.

· Work pragmatically inside a vendor platform we don’t fully control — pushing it where it helps, working around it where it doesn’t.

· Be the person who gets to the bottom of the hard problems — the intermittent, cross\-layer, “nobody knows why” bugs that span generated code, data, tenancy and infrastructure.

· Build AI\-native workflows into both how we engineer and what our customers use.

**Essential Requirements**

· Strong hands\-on **test automation engineering** — you write test code, not just click through UIs.

· Real experience with a modern **E2E/UI automation framework** (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar) and **API test automation** (REST).

· Solid coding ability in **TypeScript/JavaScript and/or C\# (.NET)** — enough to build and maintain a framework other people will rely on.

· Experience wiring automated tests into **CI/CD pipelines** (Azure DevOps ideal), with Git and version control second nature.

· A **shift\-left mindset** — you know good testing starts at requirements, and you can turn vague stories into testable acceptance criteria.

· The temperament of a **quality enabler, not a gatekeeper** — you make others better rather than being the bottleneck.

· Sound grasp of **test design technique** (equivalence partitioning, boundary values, state transitions) applied through automation.

**Desirable Requirements**

· Experience testing multi\-tenant SaaS, BDD tooling (Reqnroll/SpecFlow/Cucumber)

· Testing against Azure and Kubernetes environments

· Accounting, fintech or agri\-tech domain exposure

· An interest in how AI\-generated code changes what testing needs to be.

**Our Stack**

Vue 3 · TypeScript · .NET / C\# · a model\-driven platform generating parts of the app · PostgreSQL · multi\-tenant SaaS · Azure · Kubernetes · Azure DevOps CI/CD. Test tooling today: Jest (frontend units), xUnit (backend) and a modest Selenium regression suite \- the automation framework proper is yours to build, and the tooling choice is open.

**Why join us**

· A rare chance to build the automation capability properly — you own it end to end, with a clean mandate to set it up right rather than patch what’s there.

· Real influence on how our quality Accounting and Property Management product moves to the cloud.

· A small, capable team where a QA engineer’s work is visible and valued, not siloed.

· Backing from a larger European agricultural software group, and hybrid working from our Pulborough Office.

**What We Offer**

* The chance to shape a product used by thousands of UK farmers
* Investment in your development
* Yearly Performance bonus/Share of the Profits (if business delivers on profit)
* Hybrid working 2\-3 days per week in our Pulborough office/home working
* Holiday allowance to include "birthday holiday" and office closure during Xmas period
* Pension scheme (5% employer contribution after qualifying period)
* Death in service
* Enhanced sick pay
* Private Health Insurance
* Company Events
* Nice office environment, casual dress code
* Free on\-site parking, near train station
* **Landmark Systems Ltd** is an equal opportunities employer.

Pay: £52,000\.00\-£58,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Casual dress
* Company events
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Enhanced maternity leave
* Free parking
* Paid volunteer time
* Private medical insurance
* Profit sharing
* Sick pay

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pulborough

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
As an **IT Infrastructure Engineer** at Cabot Credit Management, you will play a key role in delivering and supporting robust, secure, and scalable technology services across our organisation. With a primary focus on UK operations and an awareness of wider European business needs, you’ll take a hands\-on approach to infrastructure support, system administration, and project delivery.


Operating within our IT Operations team, you’ll provide expert 3rd line support and technical leadership across a diverse technology landscape \- proactively troubleshooting, optimising systems, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure our IT services remain reliable, resilient, and fit for the future.

**What you can expect as an Infrastructure Engineer:**

* Permanent
* Hybrid role from our Kings Hill office, Kent. ME19 4UA.


Not only are we offering a competitive salary and a fantastic bonus scheme, you’ll also be entitled to loads of great benefits including, discount and cash back on hundreds of high\-street shops and private health insurance, plus much more.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Ensure high availability, reliability, and security are embedded across infrastructure and service delivery.
* Lead vulnerability management, patching, and preventative maintenance across platforms.
* Provide technical leadership and 3rd line support, resolving complex and high\-impact incidents.
* Review, validate, and contribute to infrastructure design and project delivery.
* Support IT governance, compliance, and audits (including SOX, PCI\-DSS), ensuring adherence to controls and regulations.
* Operate within ITIL frameworks, managing incidents, problems, and changes effectively.
* Plan and execute disaster recovery testing to ensure business continuity.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise systems to maintain performance and integrity.
* Collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and vendors to deliver and support services.
* Integrate security and best practice into all technology and lifecycle decisions.
* Support ongoing system administration, service improvements, and out\-of\-hours escalation where required.

**We are looking for someone with:**

**Essential:**

* Expert level NetApp Ontap and AFF skills
* Strong expertise in Windows Server platforms.
* Experience with VMware and Microsoft AVD
* Microsoft Exchange (2016/2019 Hybrid), Office 365, and PowerShell scripting.
* Dell Server Hardware knowledge
* Veeam Backup and Replication
* Web technologies (IIS, .NET).
* Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DFS, DHCP, WINS.
* Windows/SQL clustering.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and service management.

**Desirable:**

* Azure administration (servers, storage, networking).
* Office 365 support (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint).
* Intune device management.
* Security tools (CrowdStrike, Rapid7\).
* Experience in financial services environments.
* Monitoring tools (e.g., PRTG).
* Azure Entra administration.
* Ivanti patching and deployment.
* Certifications (Preferred):
* MCSE, VCP, VMCE, NCDA

**What happens next?**

If this sounds like you and you’d like to join our rapidly expanding company that offers excellent career progression, then apply now!

**Working for Cabot:**


You’ll be working for an award winning; Investors in People Gold accredited organisation. We’re passionate about the ethical treatment of our customers and employees. Our mission is to create pathways to economic freedom. Our vision is to make credit accessible by partnering with our consumers to restore their financial health.

**Diversity and inclusion** are very important to us at Cabot, and we value a multitude of diverse talent within our business. We want everyone to be themselves at work and encourage a culture that includes everyone. Our policies ensure that every candidate and employee are treated fairly and with equal opportunities.

*\*\*At Cabot we are highly regulated by our clients, as such, any successful candidates will have to undergo a basic credit check and criminal background check. Please note that we are unable to proceed to interview stage if a CCJ, IVA or Bankruptcy appears on a credit file, or if you do not have full right to work in the UK – we are unfortunately unable to offer sponsorship.*

jobs.title: Senior Graphics Engineer, Shader Systems
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**
-------------------


The Unity Engine is used by millions of creators around the world to build powerful and engaging real\-time experiences. At the heart of this is our flexible and powerful RT3D offering, giving users control from the initial point of content creation down to the final pixels on the target device.


In the graphics department, we focus on bringing pioneering graphics features to all the platforms Unity supports now and in the future! Our mission is to enable Unity developers to write rendering code without foreknowledge of what API it will ultimately be running on.


As a Senior Graphics Engineer on the Shader Systems team, you will be an integral part of collaborating with other graphics teams within Unity to improve workflows for artists and shader authors. This position will see you tackle problems across our shader tech stack, from runtime variant handling to dealing with our cross\-platform shader compiler systems and building new ways for developers to define their shader workflows.

**What you'll be doing**

* Develop and maintain high\-quality and performant shader management system
* Maintain existing systems, improving performance, testability and stability
* Work with multi\-functional teams to bring new engine features to all platforms
* Enable Unity shaders to work across platforms, render pipelines, and performance levels
* Build automated tests for new features and bug fixes

**What we are looking for**

* Demonstrated programming skills in C\+\+ and modern shader languages
* Knowledge of real\-time 3D graphics and Modern Graphics APIs
* Ability to collaborate with developers, customers, and leadership, both verbally and via documentation

**You might also have**

* Understanding of modern engine systems and rendering architectures and experience of working on real\-world productions or large multi\-platform engines
* Understanding of modern shader compilers (DXC, Slang) and IL such as DXIL, SPIR\-V, and MSL
* Familiarity with the Unity engine, C\# programming, and writing production shaders
* Familiarity with asset management, import, and build pipelines


Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location:


Zone A: £59,600 \- £89,400 GBP gross


Zone B: £68,200 \- £102,200 GBP gross


Zone A: kr684,200 \- kr1,026,200 DKK gross


Zone A: CA$125,300 \- CA$175,300 CAD gross


Zone B: CA$135,400 \- CA$203,000 CAD gross

 *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.*

**Benefits**

  

At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance.

  

Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status.

  

While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance \| Commute subsidy \| Employee stock ownership \| Competitive retirement/pension plans \| Generous vacation and personal days \| Support for new parents through leave and family\-care programs \| Office food snacks \| Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support \| Employee Resource Groups \| Global Employee Assistance Program \| Training and development programs \| Volunteering and donation matching program

**Life at Unity**

  

Unity \[NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and celebrate our employees across age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. horizons.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, environmental, planning and project delivery disciplines, helping clients develop and deliver safe, efficient and sustainable overhead line solutions.

Join a growing overhead line engineering team delivering some of the UK's most strategically important electricity transmission projects, with particular focus on Scotland's expanding transmission network.

* Review engineering deliverables and ensure designs comply with industry standards, client requirements and applicable regulations.

*

* Degree qualified in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Power Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in the design and delivery of overhead transmission line projects up to 400kV.
* Strong understanding of overhead line design principles, including structure spotting, route optimisation, conductor selection, clearance assessments and line performance requirements.
* Experience supporting major transmission infrastructure projects, grid reinforcement schemes, renewable energy connections or wider energy network developments.
* Experience of conductor upgrade projects, including the application of High Temperature Low Sag (HTLS) conductor technologies and network optimisation solutions.
* Working knowledge of industry design standards, utility requirements and engineering best practice relating to overhead transmission systems.
* Experience using industry\-standard design tools such as PLS\-CADD, PLS\-TOWER and PLS\-POLE would be highly advantageous.
* Knowledge of advanced technical studies including conductor galloping assessments, EMF and field effects calculations, acoustic assessments, wake effects and AC interference studies would be beneficial.

jobs.title: Senior Application Support Engineer
Application Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Harris Health Alliance (HHA), a Harris Computer company, are currently recruiting for an Application Support Engineer on a permanent, full\-time, remote\-working basis.


The Application Support Engineer will join our Maternity brand K2 Medical Systems. This is an established role within the business, and you will become part of a growing team that supports our cloud\-based healthcare applications within Maternity, with new products and services currently being onboarded, it’s an exciting opportunity to help develop the role in the business.


The Application Support Engineer will be a core part of our support team, acting as an escalation point for 1st line queries as well as taking ownership of more complex, technical cases. You’ll triage, investigate and resolve issues across our cloud\-based healthcare applications, working towards full 2nd line capability – querying databases, reading error logs and diagnosing issues with .NET applications – while continuing to provide excellent front\-line customer service.


This is a developing role: you’ll be supported to grow your technical skillset over time, working closely with our 2nd/3rd line and engineering teams, while also mentoring newer colleagues as your own experience builds.


**Position \& Responsibilities**

In performing this role your core duties and responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to:


* Act as a point of contact for support queries via phone, email, and ITSM tools, escalating specialist or highly complex cases where required.
* Log, categorise, and triage tickets within SLAs.
* Provide troubleshooting and resolution for both common and more complex, escalated issues.
* Reproduce issues internally and liaise with developers regarding software defects.
* Support upgrades, patches, and configuration changes.
* Contribute to knowledge base articles, support documentation and root cause analysis.
* Deliver excellent customer service through clear, professional communication.
* Mentor colleagues by sharing technical knowledge as your own experience develops.
* At times support developers and/or technical client resources with further investigations.

**What we are looking for**

* **A positive Attitude and Aptitude –** We’re looking for someone with the drive, determination, and ability to expand their own horizons and to help others grow their career, with a positive can\-do attitude.
* **Engaged to represent our business –** Embody Our Values.
* **Preferably you’re accredited –** A degree with IT/scientific content or equivalent professional certification, relevant experience is also considered.
* **Eligible to work in the UK –** At the point of application.
* **Ability to work away on occasion –** At times you may need to attend a customer’s premises, it is highly desirable that you are able and willing to do so on occasion.

### **Required**

* Strong problem\-solving, analytical and diagnostic skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A customer\-focused mindset with empathy, professionalism and a strong customer service ethos.
* Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
* Working knowledge of, or willingness to develop, SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) to support debugging, querying and data updates.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office applications (i.e. Outlook, Word, Excel).

### **Desirable**

* Exposure to IT support/helpdesk environments.
* Knowledge/experience of cloud service environments, e.g. Microsoft Azure.
* Familiarity with healthcare IT systems, NHS systems or other regulated environments.
* OS experience (Windows Server (2012 onwards), Kubernetes and some Linux).
* Existing knowledge of networking and web server troubleshooting.
* Experience of working within a Quality System.

Note: Regarding travel as part of this role, it is an expectation that at times you may need to attend a customer’s premises in performing this position.


**About HHA**

HHA is a collaboration of companies, all working to provide software services to healthcare and government agencies. With specialist brands focusing on Maternity, Genetics, and health integrations.


Working at HHA will provide you with a competitive edge in your career and offer excellent growth opportunities. You will be an important member of our inclusive team and supported by our technical experts to develop the role and your own personal abilities.


At Harris, we strive to create a respectful and united environment where all members of our globally diverse community are empowered and have equitable opportunities to succeed.


**Benefits**

Harris offers an extremely competitive UK employee benefits programme. 5 Personal Days leave entitlement are granted over and above the standard 25 days holiday and bank holidays. Harris also offers all UK employees an annual Lifestyle Reward amounting £325 per annum/pro rata.


**Supporting your application**

jobs.title: Principal Architect T&S Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
, United Kingdom

Regular

September 16, 2026

Information \& Digital Technology

Experienced Professionals  

  

**Job Description:**

**What’s the role**

The Principal Architect for Trading \& Supply Data \& Analytics is accountable for defining and governing the architecture that enables T\&S’ data\-powered future. The role leads the design and evolution of an integrated data ecosystem that connects data, digital services, and enterprise intelligence at scale, ensuring that data and analytics capabilities are secure, reusable, interoperable, and aligned with business outcomes. The role collaborates on architectural guidance to organise and structure the delivery of AI use cases leveraging AI Platform foundational services.


A key accountability is the architecture, design, and implementation of the T\&S Data Platform landscape, providing the foundational capabilities required for trusted and AI\-ready data consumption. This includes ownership of the architectural direction, standards, integration patterns, and platforms. The role ensures these services are established as reusable T\&S capabilities.


The Principal Architect ensures solutions are architected once and leveraged many times, balancing innovation with governance, scalability, maintainability, and long\-term value creation. Working across the many parts of the T\&S business, data, digital, and technology teams, the role drives the adoption of common platforms, architectural patterns, and delivery approaches that accelerate business value realisation while reducing duplication and technical debt.


The Principal Architect is accountable for architecture direction, decision coherence and architecture outcomes across a connected set of domains, portfolios or enterprise transformation landscapes. The role translates business and enterprise strategy into target architectures, investment roadmaps, standards and guardrails, ensuring architecture decisions create enterprise value, reduce complexity and enable safe, scalable digital, data and analytics transformation.


**What you’ll be doing**

Key Accountabilities:


* Provides architecture leadership that aligns business strategy, enterprise architecture, and technology investments.
* Accountable for enterprise architecture direction and outcomes across a connected set of domains, portfolios or enterprise transformation landscapes, ensuring architecture decisions deliver enterprise value, coherence, resilience, security, scalability and simplification.
* Translates business and enterprise strategy into target architecture, strategic roadmaps, platform direction, standards, principles and guardrails across business process, application, data, integration, technology, cloud and security dimensions.
* Ensures cross\-domain architecture coherence, resolving conflicts between T\&S LoB domain strategies, product roadmaps, delivery priorities and enterprise target states.
* Acts as enterprise decision authority for material architecture choices spanning domains, portfolios or major transformation landscapes, including approval of significant trade\-offs, exceptions, deviations and step\-outs from enterprise guardrails.
* Represents architecture in executive governance forums, providing trusted advice to CIOs, business leaders, enterprise architects and senior technology stakeholders.
* Shapes enterprise portfolio and technology investment decisions, ensuring funding, sequencing and prioritisation align to target architecture, business capabilities, enterprise value, risk reduction and simplification outcomes.
* Drives adoption of enterprise standards, reusable patterns, reference architectures and enterprise technology services across domains, reducing duplication, complexity, risk and technical debt.
* Leads and develops a multi\-layer architecture organisation, line managing Lead Architects and ensuring effective leadership of their architecture teams, architecture capacity, performance, succession and capability development.
* Sets strategic technology direction for the supported enterprise landscape, including platform strategy, lifecycle choices, simplification themes, reuse priorities and emerging technology implications.
* Leads and champions the data\-first architecture transformation across the enterprise scope, scaling AI\-enabled and AI\-ready architecture practices, machine\-readable artefacts, structured decision records, automated validation, AI\-assisted assurance and responsible AI guardrails.
* Ensures responsible AI is embedded in enterprise architecture decisions, including data quality, transparency, security, privacy, explainability, human oversight, auditability, operational support and regulatory considerations.
* Influences enterprise technology strategy and transformation outcomes, using market, technology, regulatory and business insight to shape opportunities, risks, investment choices and enterprise roadmaps.

**What you bring**

* Master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Extensive IT experience, including senior architecture leadership roles.
* Experience across large\-scale, complex, multi\-domain technology environments.
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise\-wide architecture transformation and strategic technology initiatives.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the trading business domain, commodity trading knowledge is preferred.

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.


* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values\-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
* Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
* Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non\-birthing parents.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.

jobs.title: Repair Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: **Repair Engineer**


Location: **TXO Group, Solihull, West Midlands \- Onsite Laboratory**


Reports to: **Group Repair Operations Manager**


Responsible for: **Testing, Diagnosing, and repairing parts in accordance with specifications and procedures.**

 **ABOUT US**


At TXO, we are transforming technology for a more sustainable future. Our people enable organisations worldwide to optimise and transform technology across its entire lifecycle, helping customers unlock value while reducing environmental impact through circular economy solutions.

  

Working at TXO means contributing to real\-world change. Our global teams support critical infrastructure for customers in more than 140 countries, extending the life of technology, reducing waste and helping organisations operate more sustainably. From engineering and operations to sales, finance, supply chain and corporate functions, every role plays a part in delivering meaningful impact.

  

We combine global reach with local expertise, creating opportunities to work on complex challenges across technology, commercial, operational and business disciplines. Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation and technical excellence, empowering our people to deliver practical solutions that make a measurable difference.

  

As we continue to grow globally, backed by TowerBrook Capital Partners' impact strategy, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where our people can develop, thrive and help shape the future of sustainable technology.

 **JOB FUNCTION**


Reporting to the Group Repair Operations Manager, this exciting new role is responsible for testing, diagnosing and, where capability exists, repairing parts in accordance with specifications and procedures. Assist with the design and implementation of new projects into the Repair Operations workshop and working with TXO and external customers to ensure the successful implementation of new products and services.

 **SKILLSET**

* Component\-Level Fault Finding
* PCB Repair \& Testing
* SMT \& Through\-Hole Soldering
* Electronics Diagnostics
* Reverse Engineering
* Hardware Testing \& Screening
* Electronics Maintenance

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**


The following outlines the primary areas of responsibility. Additional responsibilities or functions may be required as necessary to support the business.

  

* Follow all company Policies and Procedures including but not limited to Quality, Health \& Safety, Environment and Information Security.
* Expected to perform any reasonable requests which are not defined but in the ability of the individual
* Test and Repair customer equipment to client requirements
* Ensure that all test specifications are in line with manufacturers or industry standard
* Test, Repair, and Screen equipment and stock and return to working stock with correct identification or prepare dispatch documentation to return back to customers within agreed SLAs
* To effectively manage the handover of relevant projects into the workshop and oversee continuous improvement techniques to new and existing projects with the Repair Operations
* Document all test procedures and processes for the relevant projects and act as principal point of contact/ Subject Matter Expert (SME) of equipment and parts
* Working with wider repair team, to effectively train and develop other Repair Operations Engineers to meet the changing needs of the business and ensure a successful handover of new developments and individual Test Specifications ready to implement with the business
* To meet the needs of the defined budget and understand the financial constraints and parameters within which the projects need to be developed
* Assist with the development, maintenance and update of repair capability within the business
* Track all individual parts process through the screening centre, maintaining a record of equipment identifying and categorising as No\-Fault found/Fault identified; Last time part came into Repair Operations; Number of times part has been screened; Warranty status (where possible), etc
* Upgrade parts to be required revision of software and hardware
* Break\-down stock to lower order items and return to good stock as requested by client
* Build higher order part from lower order items on request from client and vice\-versa
* Self\-motivated to develop and increase product knowledge

 **ABOUT YOU**

  

* Extensive component level repair and screening / testing experience
* Good component understanding
* Ability to reverse engineer boards to understand design and functionality
* PDH/SDH equipment, Digital Microwave, Datacomms, Power supplies, GSM Base Station, Switching Systems
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Sound knowledge of workshop techniques and safety practices
* Working under minimum supervision
* Ability to adapt to customer deadlines
* Enjoy a fast paced, a high\-change environment and don't rely on structure / hierarchy to get things done
* Challenger mindset, always looking to drive improvement
* Enthused by our business \- you like what you've seen of the TXO Group of companies, and you're motivated by the journey we're looking to go on in the coming years

 **REWARDS \& BENEFITS**

  

Working here, you'll receive an attractive salary and a range of competitive benefits, but \- more than that \- you'll be joining an ambitious organisation with a culture of togetherness, collaboration, and inclusivity, that takes a genuine and proactive interest in your progress and development.

  

* Up to £35,000 basic salary \+ bonus
* Overtime
* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays)
* Employee assistance programme
* Company events
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* On\-site free parking

 *Our top priorities are people, ethics, safety, and sustainability. With TXO Group brands, you are uniquely positioned to make a positive impact on global net\-zero targets. The driving force behind reaching these goals is our greatest asset: you. Our people come first, and our strength is in our diversity. Because diversity leads to fresh perspectives that drive performance and innovation!*

You enjoy building software, understanding how things work, and seeing a solution through. You’re comfortable taking initiative, while knowing when to involve others and work through a problem together.


**We’re looking for:**

• Strong professional experience with C\#. • Backend development experience, ideally with Java.


• Experience with, or working knowledge of, React, TypeScript and Electron. • Confidence supporting and debugging software across Windows, macOS and Linux.


• A working understanding of Unix systems. • An interest in writing maintainable code and improving how it is tested and delivered.


* Good communication skills in English.

Build something, you can put your name to If you’re looking for room to grow, experienced colleagues to learn from, and the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a security product, we’d like to hear from you.


Join Appgate’s Core team and help shape what comes next.

### **A world\-class company**



Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.



Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.



We develop and manufacture precision\-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.



We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting\-edge solutions.



Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state\-of\-the\-art technologies to provide services to our high\-profile clients in the region.



The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

  

### **The department**



As Senior Embedded Software Developer you will join our Development and Engineering team, currently consisting of 30 colleagues with various nationalities and educational backgrounds within electronic, firmware and mechanical design. We typically work in smaller groups together to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise.



As a team, we support the global company, by providing customized high technological solutions and innovations while also sustaining the already existing technology. The work environment is informal, creative, fun, and with clear measurable targets. Furthermore, it can be challenging and hectic due to the nature of the industry we operate in but simultaneously rewarding and exciting as we solve real life challenges for customers globally.

  


### **The position**



The main success drivers in this position are to maintain and improve embedded firmware solutions to our existing and new intervention tools consisting of motors, sensors, actuators, valves and data communication infrastructure and therefore the overall architecture must be well structured. The Senior Embedded Engineer/Software Developer maintains and leads system architecture from embedded to cloud, specifications, implementation through to test and validation.  

  

Beside the technical tasks, you will act the technical lead together with another Senior Embedded Engineer and train other engineers in best practices and procedures related to embedded software. Furthermore, you will be in periods be the liaison between D\&E and 2\-3 external consultants who perform firmware related tasks for Welltec.

  

**As our new Senior Embedded Engineer/Software Developer you will:**


* Define, plan, lead, and implement data infrastructure connecting several devices
* Cooperate with sub\-contractors
* Co\-own the embedded software release process
* Participate in exhibition and forums related Data Protocols, Embedded Electronics, Sensor applications, motor\- and valvedrivers etc.
* Challenge the business with new ideas and concepts
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Development and Engineering Department

  

### **The candidate**



You are a passionate Senior Embedded Engineer/Software Developer with strong experience in efficient data infrastructure ranging from low level serial communication to local network to cloud solutions.



You would like the challenge of creating reliable data connection for controlling and visualisation of robotic operations for extreme harsh environments. In addition, you get energized from working in close collaboration with the best hardware and firmware designers, consultants, and sub\-contractors.  

As a person, you are creative, practical, and organized in both the design and verification process of your system designs. Finally, you have a good overview of projects, tasks and stakeholder communication and like to take the lead on complex challenges to provide the best possible solution to your stakeholders. You like to assume responsibility and provide guidance to the team in order to ensure a consistent high quality of embedded software design and implementation.

  


**The preferred candidate has the following profile:**


* Master’s or bachelor’s degree and specialized in embedded software development
* Minimum 7 years’ of experience in embedded software, design and implementation
* Expierenced in selecting protocols for the different protocol layers
* Proactive with an energetic attitude towards implementing embedded software systems and continual improvements
* Ability to work in teams across departments
* Project management skills or flair


**The following technical skills and competencies are required:**


* Programming in C\+\+17, using STL, knowing design patterns
* Linux application programming under POSIX (threads, synchronization objects, IPC, sockets etc.)
* Familiar with TCP/IP, Ethernet, UART, CAN, USB under Linux
* Deep understanding of Realtime Operating Systems
* Code documentation with Doxygen
* Docker: build images, run containers, host\-container interface
* Working with git, svn, Azure DevOps, make, gcc and Linux server
* Professionalism in software design and architecture, system design
* Google unit\-testing on high level
* Microcontroller programming in C and assembler
* Bare metal software designs for microcontrollers
* Experienced in implememnting low level serial data protocols


**Further, it is an advantage but not a requirement if you are familiar with:**


* IOT and Automotive data protocols
* FPGA programming
* Experiences with MPLAB and dsPIC\-Microcontroller serie
* TMS320 and C2000 IDE
* gRPC
* Know how to use a oscilloscope or logic ananlyzer
* Bash shell scripting
* C\# is an advantage
* Familiar to work in an international environment on cross site projects
* Knowledge of electronics


In addition to the above, you are ambitious, passionate about succeeding together and through the efforts of the team and a total commitment on delivering results.


### **What we offer**



Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

  

### **The process**



If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online.



Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.

In the graphics department, we focus on bringing pioneering graphics features to all the platforms Unity supports now and in the future! Our mission is to enable Unity developers to write rendering code without foreknowledge of what API it will ultimately be running on.

jobs.title: Software Developer (deltid)
jobs.description:
**Hos os er dit job fyldt med udfordringer og ansvar fra start**
----------------------------------------------------------------


Som Software Developer hos os kommer du til at få fingrene i koden på et spændende kundeprojekt fra start. Vi har stor tiltro til dine evner, og vi arbejder ud fra et princip om tillid og fleksibilitet. Vi gør vores ypperste for at imødekomme dine ønsker til projekter og konkrete teknologier, som sikrer din kontinuerlige faglige udvikling.

#### **Dine arbejdsdage kommer til at se nogenlunde sådan ud:**

* Du arbejder med forskellige teknologier på varierende projekter, som matcher din egen motivation for faglig udvikling.
* Du bliver tilknyttet et softwareteknologisk projekt og hjælper med at udvikle løsninger for vores kunder som konsulent.
* Du er i tæt dialog med kunden og er med til at definere de rette teknologier og systemer.
* Du indhenter hjælp og sparring efter behov og kan opkvalificere dig gennem kurser og certificeringer.
* Du deltager i faglige oplæg og workshops og bidrager med din nysgerrighed og viden.
* Du tager del i fællesskabet og vores mange sociale aktiviteter og klubber.


Mulighederne er mange – og fair nok, hvis du mister pusten ved at deltage i det hele. Så deltager du bare i det, du synes, er fedest – eller opfinder dit eget event.

#### **Hvem er du?**

* Du har en stor passion for software – måske nørder du egne projekter i fritiden?
* Du vil arbejde med moderne teknologier på projekter af høj kvalitet med simpel kodestruktur.
* Du elsker måske at se det store billede i en kompleks kodebase?
* Du er i gang med en relevant IT\-uddannelse med fokus på softwareudvikling.
* Du kender .NET (C\#), Java eller JavaScript og har evt. erfaring med fx React, Angular, SQL/NoSQL og DevOps.
* Du taler og skriver flydende dansk.

#### **Hvem er vi?**


I IT Minds er vi ca. 120 kollegaer i en god blanding af erfarne og nye. Vores kultur er præget af fleksibilitet, tillid og en uformel tone. Fællesskabet er centralt, og vi har mange faglige og sociale arrangementer. Arbejdstiden er fleksibel og kan tilpasses familieliv og fritid.


Vi fokuserer på høj faglighed og kvalitet med moderne teknologier. Vores software løser forretningsproblemer og minimerer omkostninger. Det er fremtidens software udviklet af nutidens talenter!

#### **Har du spørgsmål?**


Kontakt Rune Østergaard, Team Lead, på rune.ostergaard@it\-minds.dk

jobs.description:
***Facilities Engineer***

***Gul Circle, Singapore***

**About Honeywell Aerospace**

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission\-focused execution.


Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.


Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.


Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.


\#LI\-Onsite


Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on\-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.
  

  

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17\.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com
  

  

Engines \& Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep aircraft flying. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------



The Data Engineer will design, develop and support secure, scalable backend applications using .NET Core, C\#, the Microsoft technology stack and AWS cloud services. The role focuses on building reliable APIs, microservices and event\-driven integrations using AWS services such as SNS, SQS, Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway and managed data services.

* Analyze business and technical requirements for backend, API, cloud and integration solutions
* Design and develop .NET Core applications, REST APIs, microservices and reusable integration components
* Build AWS\-based event\-driven solutions using SNS, SQS, Lambda, EventBridge and API Gateway
* Apply asynchronous messaging, queue\-based processing, retries, dead\-letter queues and idempotency patterns
* Create and maintain technical documentation, API contracts, message schemas and operational support notes
* Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, DevOps/SRE, cloud platform and vendor teams
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Design, develop, test and maintain backend applications using .NET Core, C\#, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, Entity Framework Core and related Microsoft development frameworks.
* Build secure RESTful APIs and integration services with clear contracts, versioning, validation, authentication, authorization and effective error handling.
* Implement event\-driven and asynchronous communication patterns using AWS SNS, SQS, Lambda and EventBridge, including publish/subscribe, queue\-based processing, retries, dead\-letter queues and message tracing.
* Support cloud\-native workloads on AWS using services such as API Gateway, Lambda, EKS/ECS, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, Secrets Manager, IAM and CloudWatch.
* Apply microservices, distributed systems, resiliency, observability, logging and monitoring practices to improve system reliability and supportability.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, API, database, messaging and cloud infrastructure issues across development, test and production environments.
* Create technical specifications, solution notes, sequence diagrams, API contracts, event/message schemas and operational documentation.
* Support CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, release activities and infrastructure as code using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence, Terraform, CloudFormation, Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, QA, DevOps/SRE, cloud platform teams and third\-party vendors to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, documentation and continuous improvement across the development team.
**Requirements**
----------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (or similar)
* 6\-8 years of software development experience across design, development, testing, release and production support.
* Strong hands\-on experience with .NET Core / .NET 6\+, C\#, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, asynchronous programming and secure coding practices.
* Experience with the broader .NET and Microsoft stack, including Visual Studio, NuGet, dependency injection, configuration management, authentication/authorization, unit testing and diagnostics.
* Hands\-on AWS development experience with SNS, SQS, Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway, EKS/ECS, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, Secrets Manager, IAM and CloudWatch.
* Practical knowledge of event\-driven architecture, including publish/subscribe, queue\-based processing, fan\-out, dead\-letter queues, retry policies, idempotency, correlation IDs and eventual consistency.
* Experience with microservices, REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON, XML, API\-led integration and service\-to\-service communication.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD, Git\-based development, automated builds, deployment pipelines and infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Familiarity with engineering and testing tools such as Postman, JMeter, Swagger/OpenAPI, Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket and monitoring/logging platforms.
* Good understanding of unit testing, integration testing, contract testing, performance testing and test automation practices.
* Understanding of application security, secrets management, encryption, least\-privilege access, OWASP principles and secure API design.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across application code, APIs, databases, queues, cloud services and deployment pipelines.
* Good communication, collaboration and documentation skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Ability to work effectively in Agile delivery teams and coordinate across product, architecture, engineering, QA, DevOps/SRE and vendor stakeholders.
* Organized, detail\-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Edge Services Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Bouw mee aan de razendsnelle en veilige contentlevering voor de grootste mediagroep van de Benelux**


Bij DPG Media geloven we dat een feilloze gebruikerservaring en topprestaties hand in hand gaan met ijzersterke beveiliging. Als Edge Services Engineer ben je een onmisbare schakel in ons innovatieve Edge Services\-team. Samen verleggen we de grenzen van onze IT\-infrastructuur en zorg jij voor de optimalisatie en beveiliging van webapplicaties die primair op het internet draaien. Bouw samen met ons aan de toekomst van digitale mediadistributie!


Jouw werkveld? De Tech Platforms cluster binnen onze grote IT\-afdeling. Dit betekent dat jouw werk impact heeft op de héle organisatie, over alle landen (NL/BE) en business units heen.

#### **Wat ga je doen?**


Het is het doel van het Edge Services\-team om een gecentraliseerd platform te bouwen en te onderhouden, waarmee onze diverse IT\-teams en business units zelfstandig aan de slag kunnen (self\-service). Jij draagt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het distribueren van petabytes aan digitale media naar onze eindconsumenten. Tegelijkertijd verdedig je onze media\-assets tegen internet kwetsbaarheden zoals DDoS\-aanvallen en andere web attacks (inclusief bot\-management).


Ook AI speelt een rol in jouw dagelijkse werk: je gebruikt AI als assistent om je werk efficiënter te maken, en zorgt er tegelijkertijd voor dat onze media\-assets afgeschermd blijven van ongewenste AI\-exploitatie.


Concreet zien jouw verantwoordelijkheden er zo uit:

* **Beheer en optimalisatie:** Je bent de beheerder van ons Content Delivery Network (Akamai CDN) en de Web Application Firewall (Akamai WAF).
* **DNS \& Domeinnamen:** Je zorgt voor geautomatiseerd en gecentraliseerd beheer van onze publieke DNS en meer dan 10\.000 domeinnamen (\+1\.000 DNS zones).
* **Automatisering \& API's:** Je gebruikt bestaande en creëert nieuwe API's om Edge Services breed toegankelijk en self\-service te maken voor andere teams.
* **Adviseren \& Verbinden:** Je communiceert proactief met applicatieteams (zoals content websites, video streaming en online services) om hen te laten zien hoe ze Edge Services kunnen inzetten om hun productiviteit te verhogen.
* **Operations:** Je pakt operationele taken op zoals rapportages, request handling en incident response, met een scherp oog voor kostenefficiëntie en veiligheid.

#### **Wie ben jij?**


 Jij snapt dat het verenigen van verschillende eisen en tooling in één samenhangend platform de kern is van Edge Services. Om dit complexe, heterogene landschap optimaal te leveren én te beschermen, breng je het volgende mee:

* Kennis van Content Delivery Networks en Web Application Firewalls (bij voorkeur Akamai).
* Diepgaande kennis van domeinnaam\-protocollen en DNS vanuit een operationeel perspectief.
* Kennis van AWS Cloud Infrastructuur vanuit een DevOps\-oogpunt.
* Ervaring met API\-architectuur en Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Ervaring in grote, internationale organisaties en je bent vertrouwd met Scrum/Kanban en Atlassian tooling (Jira/Confluence).
* Je werkt analytisch, nauwkeurig en zelfstandig, maar bent ook sociaal, overtuigend en communicatief sterk.
* Je hebt een hands\-on mentaliteit en bent altijd op zoek naar *business value*.
* Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en/of Engels.

**Nog niet overtuigd?**

* **Jouw speelveld:** De grootste mediagroep van de Benelux! Denk aan HLN.be, deMorgen.be, AD.nl, de Volkskrant, Tweakers.net, NU.nl, RTL.nl, Qmusic, VTM, VTM GO, Streamz, Videoland, Buienradar en nog veel meer...
* **ICT binnen DPG Media?** Dat is een groot, ijzersterk team waarin samenwerken de sleutel tot succes is. Met een échte Agile mindset bouwen we aan compleet nieuwe mediaproducten, redactiesystemen, video broadcasting\-platformen en websites.

  

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor **alle talent** in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan **hier**!

#### **Wat mag je verwachten van DPG Media**

* Deze opportuniteit biedt je een fantastische job in het toonaangevend Mediabedrijf van België, binnen een moderne en groeiende afdeling waar ieder talent zich thuis voelt;
* We geloven daarnaast in een gezonde werk\-privébalans waarbij we je voldoende zuurstof geven door ons well\-being en flexwerk beleid;
* De strategie van DPG Media focust op de digitale versnelling en hoe we ervoor zorgen dat we als leidend mediabedrijf voorop blijven. Daarvoor zijn ook jouw talenten, kennis en skills cruciaal. Dus geven we je alle kansen om te blijven groeien. Zo houd je grip op je toekomst. Via verschillende opleidingen en de “Academy by DPG Media” neem je ownership over jouw ontplooiing;

**Wat zit er nog in je pakket?**


**Beloning die bij je past:** Krijg een salaris dat net zo indrukwekkend is als je cv en talenten.


**Alles wat je nodig hebt:** We zorgen dat je alles in huis hebt: laptop, telefoon en maaltijdcheques zodat je helemaal los kunt gaan op je werk.


️ **Zorgeloos verzekerd**: Met onze verzekering ben je helemaal gedekt, no worries!

**Flexibiliteit:** Met mogelijkheden voor thuiswerkdagen kies je wat het beste voor jou werkt! Alles om werk en privé in balans te houden.

**Deel in ons succes:** Als DPG Media scoort, scoor jij ook. Extra zakcentjes op basis van onze prestaties. Ka\-ching!

**Slimme mobiliteit:** Of je nu fietst, met het OV komt of parkeert, jij kiest wat het beste werkt.

**Blijf groeien:** Ontdek continu nieuwe hoogtes via de DPG Media Academy. Wie zei dat leren saai moest zijn?

**Tijd voor ontspanning**: Met 32 vakantiedagen kun je je batterij weer helemaal opladen.

**Kantoren vol creativiteit**: Laat je inspireren in onze bruisende hubs in Antwerpen of Vilvoorde.

**Media Kortingen:** Scoor leuke deals op onze media en evenementen. Want wie houdt er niet van een goede deal?

**Top sfeer:** Van spontane feestjes tot teamuitjes, hier voel je je meteen thuis. En ons legendarische personeelsfeest? Daar wil je niets van missen!

#### **Solliciteren, en dan?**

* Interest in coding, data analytics, machine learning, or automation for sustainable building design.
* Previous university projects, coursework, or research relating to environmental design, energy, carbon, or building performance.

* Attractive salary and benefits package
* A strong commitment to your continuous development. Whatever stage in your career, we have a learning and development programme that will enable and empower you

* An international culture that wherever your career takes you at Buro Happold, you won’t be far from the exceptional.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Netherlands.

This is a fully remote opportunity for a senior engineer who can take ownership of complex software projects from concept through launch. You will contribute across the full technology stack, building new product capabilities while maintaining a strong focus on quality and automated testing. The role combines hands-on development with technical ownership, architectural thinking, and continuous exploration of new technologies. You will work closely with a distributed engineering team to shape technical solutions, coding standards, and development practices. The environment values autonomy, curiosity, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership. You will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a growing SaaS product while working with a modern cloud-based technology stack.

Accountabilities

Deliver senior-level implementation of new product features across the full technology stack.
Own projects from technical conceptualization through implementation, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
Design and implement reliable, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.
Build comprehensive test automation for new development, including unit and integration testing.
Solve complex technical challenges while balancing product requirements, engineering quality, and maintainability.
Research, evaluate, propose, test, and implement new technologies, techniques, and development approaches.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders on technical design, coding standards, development practices, and best practices.
Contribute to maintaining a high-quality engineering environment with minimal technical debt.
Continuously improve development processes, tooling, and engineering practices.
Take ownership of technical decisions and proactively identify opportunities to improve the product and engineering experience.

Requirements

7+ years of full-stack software development experience, with strong expertise in C# and .NET/Core, ideally within SaaS products.
Strong experience with modern frontend JavaScript frameworks.
Strong hands-on experience developing and integrating Web APIs.
Advanced SQL skills, with SQL Server experience preferred.
Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development and automated testing, including both unit and integration testing.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud.
Azure DevOps experience is a plus.
Strong ability to build intuitive, reliable, and maintainable software.
Ownership mindset with a track record of following through on commitments and taking responsibility for technical outcomes.
Comfortable working independently in a small-team environment while actively collaborating with others.
Curious and proactive approach to learning, experimentation, and adopting new technologies.
Willingness to ask questions, challenge assumptions, learn from mistakes, and continuously improve.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to engineering excellence.
Self-driven approach with the ability to use sound judgment and seek alignment when needed.
Currently based and legally authorized to work within a European country in the CET, EET, or WET time zones.

Benefits

Annual compensation of $75,000–$85,000 USD, depending on experience and qualifications.
Fully remote work within Europe.
Flexible working schedule.
Competitive benefits package and paid time off.
Creative and collaborative working environment.
Direct exposure to leadership across different departments.
Significant ownership and the opportunity to make a visible impact on the product and customer experience.
Structured engineering onboarding designed to support rapid learning and integration.
Choice of PC or Mac hardware.
Opportunity to work with modern platforms, frameworks, development tools, and engineering standards.

Modern technology stack including Azure, .NET 8.x, C# 12, Ember.js 5.7, Bootstrap 5.x, Selenium, Entity Framework 8.x, SQL Server 2022, and Azure DevOps.
Collaboration within an international, distributed engineering team spanning more than 20 countries.

jobs.title: Software Engineer/ Architect
jobs.description:
De functie

Eekels | TBI is voor de locatie Kolham op zoek naar een Software Engineer/Architect. Als Software Engineer/Architect ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de standaardisatie en automatisering van software architectuur en modules binnen onze ‘Configure to Order’ (CTO) productfilosofie. Je ontwikkelt modulaire en schaalbare softwareoplossingen die perfect aansluiten op onze elektrische modules. In deze functie zorg jij ervoor dat onze software architectuur en softwarestandaarden worden geoptimaliseerd en geborgd binnen het CTO-proces. Je werkt aan de ontwikkeling van gestandaardiseerde modulaire oplossingen, waardoor configuratie eenvoudiger wordt en onze klanten een flexibel productaanbod krijgen. In deze functie werk je nauw samen met de Product Manager, productie en andere disciplines van het ontwikkelteam om technische haalbaarheid en efficiënt produceren op elkaar af te stemmen. Je assisteert af en toe op de productielocatie om ontwerpen te bespreken en implementaties te begeleiden. In jouw rol rapporteer je direct aan de Product Manager.

Wat wordt er van jou verwacht?

Ontwikkelen en beheren van modulaire software architectuur en ontwerpen die passen binnen de CTO-filosofie;
Afstemmen van softwarecomponenten met elektrotechnische engineers voor een geïntegreerd en configureerbaar productportfolio;
Definiëren en documenteren van standaard software modules om productconfiguratie, producttestbaarheid en productie-efficiëntie te verbeteren;
Definiëren en realiseren van automatische softwareparametrisatie op basis van de klantspecifieke functionaliteit en de geleverde configuratie;
Uitvoeren van productontwikkelingstrajecten, waarbij je softwareontwerpen borgt binnen de productlevenscyclus;
Ondersteunen van de productie (productiefaciliteit Galati, Roemenië) bij de implementatie van nieuwe softwarestandaarden en verbeteringen in het product;
Het ontwikkelen van software t.b.v. geautomatiseerd testen van product modules tijdens productie;
Borgen van informatie en ontwerpen in Plastic SCM en andere version control methodieken om productbeheer en samenwerking binnen het team te optimaliseren.

Werkomgeving

De business unit Products, gevestigd in Kolham, opereert onder de merknaam Corvia. Corvia is het nieuwe merk van Eekels Technology. Wij zetten ons in voor slimmere en duurzame voortstuwingsoplossingen voor de maritieme sector. Met onze belangrijkste innovatie, het Modular Propulsion Platform (MPP), bieden we scheepseigenaren een flexibel, toekomstbestendig systeem dat de transitie naar emissievrije scheepvaart ondersteunt.

Ervaring

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel?

Aantoonbaar hbo werk- en denkniveau en opleiding op het gebied van Technische informatica of Elektrotechniek;
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in softwareontwerp, productontwikkeling en/of CTO-omgevingen;
Kennis van en ervaring met C#, .NET, CODESYS en industriële netwerken;
Ervaring in de maritieme sector is een pré;
Affiniteit met technische producten, industrieel ontwerp, standaardisatie en automatisering van softwareontwerp;
Communicatief vaardig, werkt gemakkelijk samen en neemt binnen het team de rol van technisch kartrekker op zich;
Proactieve werkwijze en een goed analytisch vermogen;
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wat wij bieden

Bij Eekels Technology bieden we een breed scala aan aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Cao: de cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf is op jou van toepassing.
Aantrekkelijk salaris: passend bij jouw functie, kennis en ervaring.
Een ruim aantal vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen op fulltime basis (afhankelijk van jouw leeftijd wordt dit aangevuld met extra seniorendagen).
Aantrekkelijke vergoedingen en regelingen: waaronder een bovengemiddelde reis- en overurenvergoeding en thuiswerkregeling.
Winstdelingsregeling: deel mee in het succes van ons bedrijf en ook onze winst!
Collectieve pensioenregeling: via het “Pensioenfonds Metaal en Techniek”.
Stimuleren van jouw gezondheid: door onze jaarlijkse (sport)activiteitenkalender.
Fiscale voordelen: voor de aanschaf van een fiets of een fitnessabonnement.
Jouw vakmanschap: door onze leercultuur blijf jij scherp binnen jouw vakgebied en verbreed jij jouw kennis.
Actieve personeelsvereniging: het hele jaar door diverse georganiseerde (sport) activiteiten met collega’s (meestal ook voor jouw eventuele partner of kind(eren)!).
Plezierige werkomgeving: met een goede werksfeer en collega’s waar je blij van wordt.
Interessante projecten: werken aan prestigieuze, technische projecten en producten met een duurzame impact, waar je trots op kunt zijn.
Personeelskortingen: met flinke kortingen op mode, elektronica, wonen, dagjes uit, verzekeringen en meer.
Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling: alle ruimte om te groeien en verder te komen.
Bedrijfsmiddelen: goed gereedschap en (digitale) middelen zijn het halve werk. Wij zorgen voor de middelen om jou jouw functie goed uit te kunnen laten voeren.
TBI Holdings: achter onze organisatie staat een financieel sterke moedermaatschappij met daaronder een 20-tal dochtermaatschappijen.

Interesse?

Klinkt dit als jouw ideale uitdaging? Solliciteer dan nu en ontdek wat Eekels voor jou kan betekenen!

Maatschappelijke impact

Werken bij een TBI-onderneming betekent werken bij een onderneming met een grote maatschappelijke betrokkenheid. Die maatschappelijke betrokkenheid blijkt onder andere uit de TBI Klimaattrein, TBI Praktijkfonds en het TBI Studiefonds . Met het TBI Studiefonds komen jouw kinderen mogelijk in aanmerking voor een studietoelage van TBI Studiefonds (vanaf de middelbare school). Lees hier meer over onze maatschappelijke fondsen .

Our formula for success is to hire exceptional people, encourage their ideas and reward their results.

As a Software Developer Intern
, you will build advanced trading and risk applications leveraging cutting-edge technology. DRW enables our Software Developer Interns to develop computationally intensive software under the guidance of senior technologists with the goal of deployment during your ten weeks. While your days will have you immersed in complex projects directly driving DRW’s progress, your evenings will be spent exploring the city with organized social events to truly discover what it is like to live and work in Amsterdam.

How You Will Make An Impact…

Design, develop test, and deploy proprietary software solutions across the firm. Examples include creating:
Decoders to receive raw pack data from various exchanges and translate it into a more accessible form.
Normalisers which take decoded data and build a book for each instrument traded on that exchange
Applications to facilitate communication around executed trades to our compliance team

Identify innovative solutions to complex problems and advocate for their implementation to your team by communicating your ideas in a clear and concise manner
Conduct robust research using a data driven approach to employ statistical analytics on large data sets
Collaborate with other software developers, quantitative traders and researchers as well as business analysts in cross-functional team environments

What You Bring To The Team…

Are pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, mathematics or any related science discipline and have an expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028
Have exposure to network programming (TCP/IP), multi‐threaded applications, computational intelligence, algorithms, real‐time programming or GUI programming
Have strong understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
An eagerness to learn and apply what you have learned, and to know the impact of your code

Have strong communication and collaboration skills

What To Expect During The Internship…

Meaningful projects: You’ll receive a challenging project to complete during your time here. Each project, advised by a software engineer, promotes a comprehensive learning experience and provides you with meaningful work experience.
