We operate with respect, curiosity, and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters – it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer (Fluent Dutch speakers only)
jobs.description:
Vacancy

Automation Engineer (Fluent Dutch speakers only)

At ParaSoll , you don’t automate for a client you’ll never meet. Everything you build is used in education and makes a direct difference for teachers, IT teams, and students. We’re looking for an Automation Engineer with experience in Azure who enjoys working on a mix of client projects and in-house product development, alongside students.

Apply directly

This job opening is intended for candidates who speak Dutch fluently and live and work in the Netherlands. We will not respond to applications from outside the Netherlands.

Build something that a school will actually use next week

In most automation jobs, you automate processes for a client you never meet. At ParaSoll , it’s different. We work exclusively for the education sector. The scripts, pipelines, and cloud solutions you build are used by schools and universities and make a direct difference for teachers, IT teams, and students. A digital exam system that works flawlessly when 800 students log in—that’s your work.

The function

To strengthen our Azure team, we are looking for an Automation Engineer. You will work on a mix of external projects and internal product development.

For clients—typically IT teams at educational institutions—you’ll automate the setup and management of Azure environments. This includes infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and eliminating manual tasks that nobody really wants to do anymore. You’ll provide advice, write designs, and handle the technical implementation.

In addition, we develop our own products in collaboration with a school consortium. Students come to work with us in groups on a final project that results in a real product. One example is an AI bot trained to handle security incidents, which students in the security program use to practice de-escalation techniques. Each period is a sprint in which the product advances to the next level. You’ll be the technical linchpin in this process: you’ll ensure quality, contribute to the development, and help students get their ideas up and running.

Who are you?

You’re passionate about automation and the cloud. You see repetitive work as a problem that can be solved with code. You have experience with Azure and tools such as PowerShell, Bicep, or Terraform, as well as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Experience with AI tools in your work is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity and the willingness to quickly learn those tools, however, are essential.

You’re good with young people who don’t have much business experience yet. You explain things without being condescending, adapt your language and leadership style, and at the same time keep the ultimate goal in mind: an educational, enjoyable internship and a successful product iteration.

Technology holds no secrets for you, and you stay up to date on what's happening in your field.

Your Career Path

We assume that you're still relatively early in your career. You've proven yourself in the business world, but there's still plenty to learn.

At ParaSoll , you get to decide what your career path looks like. Together, we’ll explore your long-term ambitions and the steps needed to achieve them. Do you want to broaden your skills, deepen your expertise, or take on a coordinating or advisory role? Common career paths include Azure automation specialist, architect, project manager, or department manager. We’ll work together to determine the balance between technical work and other aspects of the role.

Our guiding principle: Your responsibility and sense of ownership determine your success. You’ll have a great deal of freedom, and much is possible through mutual discussion. You take charge of your work, your development, and your opportunities.

A position ranging from 32 to 40 hours per week, starting immediately

Work that matters: Everything you build finds its way into education

Word jij blij van een stabiel cloudplatform, slimme automatiseringen én techniek die gewoon goed in elkaar zit?

Als Cloud Engineer bij Veneta bouw je mee aan een veilige, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige Azure-omgeving. Je zorgt niet alleen dat onze cloud goed blijft draaien, maar vooral dat we deze steeds slimmer kunnen beheren en verder ontwikkelen.

Je automatiseert infrastructuur, richt monitoring in, verbetert security en helpt nieuwe oplossingen veilig naar productie. Van een deployment pipeline tot een nieuwe Azure-service of AI-oplossing: jij zorgt dat het fundament klopt.

De uitdaging 🚀

Samen met twee collega’s vorm je het Platform & Engineering-team. Jullie zijn verantwoordelijk voor het cloudfundament waarop Veneta iedere dag bouwt. Dat betekent dat je werkt aan beschikbaarheid, performance, security en schaalbaarheid, maar ook aan de manier waarop we onze infrastructuur ontwikkelen en beheren.

Ons cloudplatform ondersteunt de digitale diensten en koppelingen waarop Veneta dagelijks draait. Van de online klantreis en onze data tot de processen achter verkoop en dienstverlening: een betrouwbaar en goed ingericht platform is onmisbaar om onze collega’s en klanten snel te kunnen blijven helpen.

Je kijkt verder dan dagelijks beheer. Handmatige handelingen wil je automatiseren, terugkerende incidenten los je structureel op en nieuwe cloudresources rol je zoveel mogelijk uit via Infrastructure as Code.

Ook denk je mee over de architectuur van nieuwe oplossingen. Welke Azure-services passen het beste? Hoe regelen we identity, networking, logging en security? En hoe zorgen we dat een oplossing straks betrouwbaar, beheersbaar én betaalbaar blijft?

De roadmap ligt niet volledig vast. Dat betekent dat je veel ruimte krijgt om samen met het team te bepalen welke technische verbeteringen de meeste waarde opleveren. Zie jij dat iets slimmer, veiliger of sneller kan? Dan maak je een plan en ga je ermee aan de slag.

Wat je gaat doen 💻

Je bouwt, beheert en optimaliseert onze Microsoft Azure-omgeving.
Je ontwikkelt en beheert cloudinfrastructuur met Bicep en Terraform.
Je bouwt en onderhoudt CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps en GitHub.
Je automatiseert beheertaken en deployments met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell, Azure CLI of Python.
Je richt monitoring, logging en alerting in en vertaalt signalen naar structurele verbeteringen.
Je werkt aan Azure-netwerken, identity, toegangsbeheer, secrets en veilige verbindingen tussen systemen.
Je implementeert securitymaatregelen met onder andere Azure Policy, RBAC, Microsoft Defender for Cloud en Key Vault.
Je zorgt dat back-up, herstel en continuïteit goed zijn ingericht en regelmatig worden getest.
Je onderzoekt incidenten tot de kern en zorgt ervoor dat problemen niet onnodig terugkomen.
Je draait samen met je collega’s volgens een afgesproken rooster mee in de storingsdienst.
Je bewaakt het gebruik en de kosten van Azure en zoekt naar mogelijkheden om resources slimmer in te zetten.
Je adviseert development-, data- en business-teams over het veilig en betrouwbaar gebruiken van cloudservices.
Je helpt nieuwe applicaties en oplossingen van ontwerp en proof of concept tot een stabiele productieomgeving.
Je onderzoekt nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI-platformen en Large Language Models, en kijkt hoe we deze veilig en schaalbaar kunnen inzetten.
Je documenteert architectuurkeuzes, technische standaarden en beheerprocessen, zodat kennis niet alleen in hoofden blijft zitten.

Wat je krijgt 💰

Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.000 en € 6.500, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.
Een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur per week.
Een werkplek op ons kantoor in Zwolle, waar we als team graag samenwerken, met de mogelijkheid om maximaal twee dagen per week vanuit huis te werken.
Een uitgebreide onboarding waarin je Veneta én je collega’s goed leert kennen.
Veel ruimte om de technische richting van onze cloudomgeving mede te bepalen.
Volop mogelijkheden om certificeringen te behalen in Azure, cloud architecture, AI en security.
Tijd en ruimte om nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken en proof of concepts uit te werken.
Een goede pensioenregeling met een eigen bijdrage van 6%. Veneta legt 17% in.
25 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.
Reiskostenvergoeding. Of je nu met de fiets of de auto komt: altijd kassa.
Bedrijfsfitness met korting op je sportabonnement.

Jouw talent 🎯

Je hoeft nog niet ieder onderdeel van onze omgeving volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede basis hebt, graag automatiseert en jezelf verder wilt ontwikkelen in platform engineering, cloudsecurity en Azure.

Je hebt ervaring als Cloud Engineer, Azure Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer of in een vergelijkbare technische functie.
Je hebt hands-on ervaring met Microsoft Azure en begrijpt hoe onderdelen zoals compute, storage, networking, identity en monitoring met elkaar samenwerken.
Je hebt ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld met Bicep, Terraform of vergelijkbare tooling, en vindt het leuk om met beide te werken.
Je hebt ervaring met CI/CD en Git en begrijpt hoe je infrastructuur en configuraties gecontroleerd naar productie brengt.
Je automatiseert graag en kunt overweg met PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python of een vergelijkbare taal.
Je hebt een goede basis in cloudnetwerken, security en monitoring.
Je pakt technisch eigenaarschap, zoekt problemen graag tot de kern uit en kunt jouw keuzes duidelijk uitleggen aan anderen.

Mooi meegenomen 🙌

Ervaring met containers, Kubernetes of Azure PaaS-diensten.
Ervaring met FinOps, kostenoptimalisatie of capacity management.
Ervaring met platformen voor data, integraties of AI.
Certificeringen zoals AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400 of vergelijkbaar.

Heb je nog niet overal ervaring mee, maar herken je jezelf wel in de functie? Ook dan nodigen we je graag uit om te reageren.

* Improve developer experience by reducing build times, deployment friction, environment blockers, and unclear release processes.
* Create and maintain practical documentation, runbooks, deployment instructions, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.
* Ensure DevOps / platform work is tracked, communicated, and prioritized through agreed tools and processes, including Azure DevOps where applicable.

**Required Qualifications (Must-Haves):**

* Experience with release management, deployment validation, rollback planning, environment troubleshooting, and production support.

* Ability to work with software engineers, QA, DBAs, infrastructure engineers, security teams, Product / Delivery Managers, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to diagnose build failures, deployment failures, environment issues, configuration problems, access problems, and production symptoms in a structured way.

* Practical experience with Git-based workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, release tagging, and deployment traceability.

* Prior work supporting ERP, warehouse, internal business platforms, B2B transaction systems, e-commerce, supply chain, logistics, or similar business-critical environments.
* Track record of improving DevOps maturity in an organization where process, ownership, and documentation are still developing.
* Familiarity with cost optimization, license awareness, and practical platform efficiency improvements.

jobs.description:
About The Company

Siemens Healthineers is a globally leading medical technology company dedicated to shaping the future of healthcare. With a rich history rooted in innovation and a commitment to improving patient outcomes, Siemens Healthineers offers a wide range of diagnostic and therapeutic solutions, including imaging, laboratory diagnostics, molecular medicine, and digital health services. Employing over 74,000 professionals across more than 70 countries, the company is at the forefront of technological advancements in healthcare, delivering innovative products and services that benefit millions of patients worldwide. Siemens Healthineers fosters a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and diversity, striving to create a better healthcare environment through technological excellence and customer-centric solutions.

About The Role

We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Software Developer (w/m/d) specializing in Identity & Access Management to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be pivotal in designing, developing, and maintaining secure access solutions for our digital healthcare products. Your expertise will contribute to enhancing the security and usability of our systems, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product owners, software architects, and international development groups, to implement innovative authentication and authorization mechanisms. This position offers flexibility regarding remote work, including the possibility of mobile working within Germany and abroad under certain conditions, supporting a balanced work-life integration.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, complemented by several years of professional experience in Authentication & Authorization. Proficiency in software development using C# and the .NET framework is essential, along with practical knowledge of Identity & Access Management concepts such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and JWT. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized microservice architectures is highly desirable. Familiarity with cloud-native development, deployment, and operation across cloud, on-premise, and edge environments is required. Candidates should also have experience with CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps or GitLab. Additional skills in Microsoft Entra ID, cybersecurity, or Zero-Trust architectures are advantageous. Prior experience in regulated environments, especially within healthcare, will be considered a plus.

Responsibilities

Support the development and enhancement of modern authentication and authorization solutions for digital healthcare products.
Implement and integrate identity and access management systems based on established standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
Contribute to the creation of high-performance, maintainable backend components in C#/.NET tailored for distributed microservice architectures.
Participate in the deployment and operation of software solutions across cloud, on-premise, and edge environments, ensuring reliability and security.
Assist in optimizing Kubernetes-based deployments and managing containerized applications.
Collaborate closely with product owners, software architects, and international development teams to align technical solutions with business needs.
Drive automation initiatives, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), as well as testing and release processes, to improve efficiency and quality.
Bring in your technical expertise to continuously improve development workflows and contribute to innovative project solutions.

Benefits

Siemens Healthineers offers a competitive benefits package that includes flexible working arrangements, opportunities for professional development, and a supportive work environment. Employees enjoy access to ongoing training and development programs, fostering continuous learning and growth. The company promotes a healthy work-life balance through flexible hours and remote working options. Additionally, Siemens Healthineers provides comprehensive health and wellness programs, employee discounts, and a collaborative corporate culture that values diversity and inclusion. Being part of a global organization also offers international exposure and career advancement opportunities, allowing employees to grow within a forward-thinking and innovative environment.

Equal Opportunity

Siemens Healthineers is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diversity and equal opportunity. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, and ensure fair treatment throughout our hiring processes. Our company believes that diverse teams drive innovation and better serve our global customer base. We adhere strictly to equal employment opportunity policies and provide a work environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

Our culture is central to everything we do - encouraging passion, adventure, adaptiveness and diversity of thought. This role is with one of Dex's trusted partner companies. We work closely with their teams to truly understand their culture, goals, and what they're looking for, so we can match you with the right opportunity and give you context about the role before you commit to a process.

If you're interested sign up to Dex to apply.

Dex is an AI recruiter agent that helps you run your job search. Tell Dex your stack, seniority, and what you want to build. We will manage your applications and surface other opportunities that are a fit.

The role

This team is building a truly proactive AI assistant. Not a chatbot, but an agent that maintains a living model of a user's entire work history — emails, messages, documents — to anticipate needs and act on their behalf. They are in private alpha with early customers, backed by leading investors, and founded by a small group of repeat founders with deep technical backgrounds.

As a Founding Senior Engineer, you won't own a slice of the stack. You'll manage the whole thing: desktop application, backend, and algorithmic development, working directly with AI researchers. This is a chance to define your scope, not inherit it, building a complex system from first principles in a small, high-calibre team. It's for engineers who want to build, not just integrate.

The work

Build and own the desktop application, front and back end.
Develop core algorithms that bridge the AI model and user actions.
Design and implement the backend systems for continuous data ingestion and model maintenance.
Work directly with AI engineers, translating research into robust, shippable product features.
Drive architectural decisions across the entire stack, from user interface to data persistence.

What You Bring

A PhD or demonstrable personal ownership of a hard, end-to-end technical project.
5+ years building complex, comparable systems, solving genuinely hard problems.
Strong in TypeScript, Python, Rust, or C++, with a proven ability to quickly master new languages.
Experience owning the full engineering lifecycle: shipping robust products, working from user requests, and ideally running scientific processes.
Comfortable with cloud infrastructure, SQL/NoSQL databases, and self-organising in an ambiguous environment.
Willingness to work in person in London (Elephant and Castle) five days a week.

Why apply through Dex

This is a rare founding role at a company building genuinely novel AI. Opportunities like this are often oversubscribed or hard to find. Apply through Dex to get a full brief on the company and role, skip the cold application process, and explore other similar high-impact positions.

This is an opportunity to join a well-established engineering team working on a global SaaS platform used by automotive retailers and OEMs around the world.

You will be hands-on in the development of new product features, integrations, improvements, and bespoke customer solutions, with the chance to work within a complex enterprise environment.

Commercial experience developing software within a SaaS, enterprise software, or similar environment.
Strong experience developing applications using C# and .NET / .NET Core.
Good understanding of SQL and relational databases, with experience writing and optimising queries.
Experience building web applications using HTML, JavaScript, and Razor or similar front-end technologies.
Experience working with REST APIs and integrating applications with third-party systems.

Understanding of modern software development practices, including Agile methodologies, version control, and collaborative development workflows.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on writing clean, maintainable, and high-quality code.
Experience with Azure, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, or other cloud and deployment technologies would be beneficial.
A proactive approach to learning new technologies, collaborating with colleagues, and contributing to continuous improvement within the Engineering team

Competitive salary based on experience

Pinewood's cloud-based secure end-to-end ecosystem unlocks the value of every customer. Our vision is to be the full-service technology partner that helps automotive retailers and OEMs run more efficiently and increase revenue by making better commercial and business decisions more easily.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Appgate · Core Team · Gothenburg, Sweden

Want to build software where you can see the difference your work makes?
At Appgate, we develop IT security software that helps organizations control access to their applications and infrastructure. We're looking for a senior fullstack developer with strong C# experience to join our Core team, building the Appgate SDP client with C# and React/TypeScript. You'll also contribute to the Java REST backend that the same team works on.
We offer a balance that can be hard to find: a company large enough to surround you with experienced engineers, and small enough for your individual contribution to matter. Here, you can take ownership of substantial features and entire subsystems, help shape technical decisions, and follow your work from the first idea through to customers using it. Why Appgate? The people around you make a difference.
At Appgate, you'll work with colleagues who bring deep experience in software development, networking and security. There are people to learn from, discuss difficult problems with, and help you explore unfamiliar areas.
At the same time, there is room to make your own mark. We value developers who ask questions, suggest improvements and take responsibility for moving things forward. As your knowledge of the product grows, so does your opportunity to influence it.
Appgate is growing, with major customer contracts driving expansion across our engineering teams. We're also developing new capabilities in areas such as operational technology (OT), helping secure access to industrial systems. Joining now means contributing as those capabilities take shape.
We're also developing AI-related capabilities in Appgate SDP. As a client and controller developer, you may contribute to how these features connect with the rest of the product, bringing new functionality into the applications and services you work on.

Requirements

Your role in the Core team

The Core team develops the client and controller at the heart of Appgate SDP.
The client is the software users interact with to connect securely. The controller manages the policies and access decisions that determine what they can reach.
This is a fullstack role:
your work will span the client, its C# logic and React/TypeScript interface, and the Java REST backend that powers it. You'll move across this boundary regularly, understanding how a feature connects from backend logic through to what the user sees. 1 Appgate | Core Team We use agentic AI tools as part of our development workflow and continue to explore where they can help us build, test and improve software. You'll have the opportunity to help shape how we use these tools, applying the same engineering judgment and attention to quality that we bring to the rest of our work.
You'll help us:

• Develop features for the Appgate client, using C#, React/TypeScript and Electron.
• Develop features for the Java REST backend.
• Investigate and resolve problems across applications, operating systems and networks.
• Improve automated testing, developer tooling and build and release workflows.
• Shape technical solutions through design discussions, code reviews and collaboration across teams.
What you bring

You enjoy building software, understanding how things work, and seeing a solution through. You're comfortable taking initiative, while knowing when to involve others and work through a problem together.
We're looking for:

• Strong professional experience with C#. • Backend development experience, ideally with Java.
• Experience with, or working knowledge of, React, TypeScript and Electron. • Confidence supporting and debugging software across Windows, macOS and Linux.
• A working understanding of Unix systems. • An interest in writing maintainable code and improving how it is tested and delivered.
• Good communication skills in English.

Benefits

Build something, you can put your name to If you're looking for room to grow, experienced colleagues to learn from, and the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a security product, we'd like to hear from you.
Join Appgate's Core team and help shape what comes next.

jobs.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide Facts

Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will be responsible for building and running the products your team owns, covering everything our members need to run their business, from banking and payments through to administration and operational tooling.

This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our Engineering Managers to make real architectural decisions that affect their domain and shape the future of Tide’s Platform.

We operate in domain-aligned, full-stack teams that own products end to end. Engineers self-organise, collaborate on technical challenges, and define shared standards through Communities of Practice.

Leading & Directly managing a cross functional team of 8-12 engineers
Partnering with a Product Manager to form the Product Engineering Duo
Deeply caring about what’s being built as much as the how
Being responsible of the delivery of the team - quality, stability, timelines, dependencies
Being responsible of the tech excellence and architecture within the scope of the team
Driving the continuous improvement of the team performance as measured by DORA
Securing the continuous growth and wellbeing of the engineers on their team
Being hands-on, carefully dividing your time between design, coding and coaching other team members. You will be the person people turn to seeking advice and solutions to difficult problems.

What We Are Looking For

Extensive experience (10+ years) building server-side applications and detailed knowledge of of Python, Java, C#, or another similar language
Sound knowledge of a backend framework (e.g. Spring/Spring Boot)
Experience with running microservices and implementing and consuming RESTful APIs
Experience engineering scalable and reliable solutions in a cloud-native environment
A mindset of delivering secure, well-tested and well-documented software
Full ownership of your code and technical solutions across their entire lifecycle, from development to production.
Experience integrating with various third party providers and partners
Sound knowledge and experience working with relational databases
Work effectively in an agile environment, using its practices to deliver value consistently and adapt quickly
Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience
Apply continuous integration, delivery, and deployment practices in day-to-day development to deliver software reliably to production
A technical hands on leader who is in the details of what the team is working on day to day
Experience leading teams
Experience directly managing people

Our Tech Stack

Python, Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

What You’ll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €68,400 to €101,250 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
25 days paid annual leave
3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
Personal L&D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year
Additional health & dental insurance
Mental wellbeing platform
Fully covered Multisports card
Food vouchers
Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
WFH equipment allowance
Flexible working from home
Sabbatical Leave
Share options

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

We are Forge Digital – a technology agency with cutting-edge solutions and strong domain knowledge in digitalization across manufacturing, retail & logistics, and energy. What we look for

As a Senior Developer or Architect at Forge, you will design and build robust, scalable systems – from operational and business applications to industrial operator interfaces and real-time situational awareness solutions. You will take technical ownership of complex projects, collaborate closely with clients, and help shape how we work.

Here are a few examples of what you could be working on at Forge:
Development of AI-powered solutions: applied AI for decisioning, optimization, and predictive systems, as well as agentic and generative AI capabilities embedded directly into business applications
Development of operational work-enhancing solutions and real-time situational awareness systems
Development of integrations connecting production, business, and automation systems (IT/OT)
Development of data pipelines, data platforms, and event-driven architectures
Business-critical and high-availability system development
Legacy system modernization for AI-assisted development practices

Our main technology stack includes .NET, C#, Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript – though we are technology-agnostic and always select the best tools considering the entire solution lifecycle. We work with Azure and AWS cloud platforms, hybrid cloud environments, and on-premises solutions.

Fluency in both written and spoken Finnish and English is required.

AI-assisted development
: You are comfortable working in AI-assisted development workflows – using AI tooling to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and maintain high standards of human oversight.
Software architecture
: You can design and own the technical architecture of complex, distributed systems – making sound decisions that consider the full solution lifecycle.
Core technologies
: Strong knowledge of most of our main technologies (.NET/C#, Node.js/TypeScript) and databases such as MS SQL, PostgreSQL, and/or document databases.
Container environments
: Comfortable working with containerized applications and deploying to Kubernetes or similar environments.
Event-driven architectures
: Solid experience designing and building event-driven systems and messaging patterns, using tools such as RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus.
Domain knowledge
: Background in manufacturing, logistics, or energy sectors.
Cloud and infrastructure mindset
: Solid understanding of Azure and/or AWS services, cloud-native architectures, and hybrid environments.
Communication & client interaction

Experience building and integrating LLM-based solutions, including agentic workflows and MCP-based systems
Experience with industrial data exchange standards such as OPC UA or similar IT/OT integration patterns
Frontend development experience (React or similar)
Python and data engineering or analytics background

More than anything, we value a learning-oriented mindset and genuine willingness to keep developing your skills.

At Forge, senior developers and architects have real influence over how systems are designed and delivered – you will shape technical direction, define standards, and solve problems that directly affect project outcomes. Our clients operate in sectors where the systems you build genuinely matter.

You will join a highly motivated and experienced team, with whom to build the story of Forge Digital. As a newly established company, we provide a real opportunity to put your mark on how we work, operate, and innovate with clients.

Our comfy offices in the GO21-building in Tampere and Helsinki city center offer a great atmosphere to work in. We work in a flexible hybrid model and put a lot of focus on building a strong team culture and cohesion. In addition, we offer:
A competitive salary, which within the framework of this role is approximately 5000-6000€/month, depending on your experience level
Lunch benefit
ePassi Flex budget of 1 000 €/year
Mobile phone benefit
Home internet
Health and accident insurance
Daily refreshments at the office

Your supervisor will be there to spar on personal learning, career development, and possible training needs.

Our recruitment process

If Forge's approach resonates with you, send us your application and join our skilled team! Our application form is easy and quick: simply add your contact information, CV, and cover letter to the form below. You can also share your LinkedIn profile or attach any other relevant documents you wish. Apply soon, as we will process applications during the application period. In our recruitment process, you can expect to have a couple of interviews, including technical interview.

Som Associate Operations Engineer er du med til at sikre, at kundernes dataplatforme kører stabilt og forudsigeligt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med erfarne kolleger og tager gradvist mere ansvar, efterhånden som du bliver tryg i rollen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:
Overvåge alerts og håndtere standardincidents inden for scope ved hjælp af godkendte runbooks.
Udføre restarts, re-runs og validering af data loads og refreshes.
Bruge AI til at opsummere incidents, give forslag til runbook-opdateringer og fremskynde log-analyse – altid med validering, før noget output bruges aktivt.
Dokumentere fund og bidrage til løbende forbedring af runbooks og known-issues.
Eskalere korrekt med tydelig kontekst og evidens, når en sag ligger uden for scope.
Give klare skriftlige opdateringer i tickets, Teams og mail efter en simpel struktur (Hvad er der sket / Status nu / Næste skridt / Ansvarlig) og sikre gode overdragelser, så den næste kollega kan fortsætte uden at miste kontekst.
Deltage aktivt i supportvagten kl. 07:00-17:00

Sådan bliver du en succes i rollen

Du håndterer standardincidents og service requests konsekvent og korrekt ved hjælp af etablerede runbooks.
Du leverer klar dokumentation og gode overdragelser, som gør det nemt for kolleger at tage over.
Du bruger AI-værktøjer ansvarligt – med fokus på korrekthed, ingen misbrug af følsomme data og altid validering før handling.
Du deltager pålideligt i supportvagten med forudsigelig udførelse og tydelige overdragelser.

Din profil

Denne rolle er skabt til dig, der er tidligt i din karriere. Du behøver ikke have en lang erfaring i bagagen – bare en solid teknisk grundforståelse og lyst til at lære. Rollen giver dig et bredt indblik i drift af moderne dataplatforme og kan være et naturligt afsæt til videre specialisering inden for fx AI, data platform eller platform engineering.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:
Har en grundlæggende forståelse af dataplatforme, databaser og cloud-teknologier – gerne med kendskab til Microsoft Azure, SQL, Power BI, Fabric, Databricks eller lignende.
Har stærke analytiske evner og kan fejlfinde struktureret.
Kommunikerer klart med både kunder og tekniske kolleger.
Arbejder struktureret med incidents, opgaver og dokumentation.
Tager ejerskab for mindre tekniske opgaver og følger dem til dørs.
Har gode engelsk- og tyskkundskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt.

Derudover er du nysgerrig, proaktiv og har lyst til at lære. Du har en stærk ansvarsfølelse, er serviceminded og trives med direkte kundekontakt. Du kan holde hovedet koldt, når flere sager kører samtidig, og du er ikke bange for at spørge og lære af erfarne kolleger, mens du gradvist tager mere ansvar.

NUS CUTE (Creating Unique Technologies for Everyone) Center is a multi-disciplinary research institute where some of the key areas of focus are physical embodiments and tangible interaction, along with Virtual Reality visualisation. Website: https://www.nus.edu.sg/cutecenter/

We are looking for a resourceful Software Engineer to help design and build the next generation of our immersive training and simulation systems on the Unity platform, and to help transition legacy, static VR training into a highly adaptive platform powered by Generative AI. You will help integrate large language models (LLMs), the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and dynamic prompt-based generation into a distributed Unity environment.

Evaluate feasibility of project requirements and give reasonable estimates on tech-related tasks.

Singapore citizens or PR only.

As part of the H&F Integration team you are crucial in delivering new mechatronic features on Multi ECU, Multi CAN vehicle network architectures for this high performance agricultural equipment.

Key Responsibilities

Define the control system software requirements, software specification and software structure for vehicle applications
Maintain, archive, and control application source code, manage SW releases
Implement the software architecture and strategies, requirements for closed loop control algorithms, User Interface and related software control logic dealing with complex product offering
Perform unit testing and system integration testing with the hardware and software, via simulation and on-board executions.
Define & Execute test scenarios to verify the implemented control / monitoring strategy
Support Product Validation and Verification Engineers as they conduct Functional and Performance testing
Analyse and interpret field data to improve feature development and troubleshooting. (i.e. CAN traces)
Produce documentation in support of design, implementation, and test activities

Experience Required

Bachelor or Master degree in Electrical, Computer or similar engineering discipline
Experience/knowledge of using C & C# Programming language
Experience with industry coding standards for software development such as MISRA-C
Experience with CAN and/or LIN protocols and diagnostic tools such as Vector CANalyzer®
Demonstrated problem-solving capabilities and experience

Proficient in English, both written and verbal

Experience with code debuggers, code analysis, and memory management

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Working at CNH means working in an environment where, thanks in part to its international character, numerous development opportunities are available. More than 2,500 people work at CNH Belgium’s site in Zedelgem. This single location houses various departments, ranging from design—with an R&D center employing around 400 people—to production, service, dealer training, and all support departments.

CNH Belgium in Zedelgem is also located in a traffic-free area and is easily accessible.

We offer a very attractive salary package with numerous fringe benefits such as insurance, eco vouchers, meal vouchers, a cafeteria plan (Flex Ben), and no less than 20.5 working time reduction days on top of the statutory vacation days (in a full-time system).

Are you as passionate as our people? Would you like to be part of a great team and help build the most innovative and largest agricultural machines on the market? Apply now!

Was machst du als Senior Developer .NET - Agentic Engineering bei Delegate?

Agenten übernehmen Boilerplate, Refactorings, Test-Scaffolding und Code-Suche. Design, Trade-offs und Qualität verantworten Menschen. Gemergt wird nur nach menschlichem Review.

Fehler analysieren und beheben:
Du arbeitest strukturiert an Fehleranalysen und -korrekturen.

Sparringpartner sein:
Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für technische Fragen und unterstützt Produktteam, Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen bei der Umsetzung von Anforderungen.

Mindestens 5 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung - du hast Systeme gebaut, produktiv gebracht und über Jahre gewartet. Diese Erfahrung ist die Grundlage dafür, dass du generierten Code beurteilen kannst.

Erfahrung in der Entwicklung SQL-basierter Datenbankapplikationen, speziell Microsoft SQL Server

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1)

Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2) - die Sprache unserer internationalen Standorte

Erfahrung in der Modernisierung gewachsener Systeme - schrittweise Ablöse, Strangler-Fig-Ansatz, API-first

Security-Bewusstsein im regulierten Umfeld: DSGVO, Cyber Resilience Act, Dependency- und SBOM-Management

Erfahrung mit MCP-Servern oder der Anbindung eigener Tools und Datenquellen an Coding-Agents

Kenntnisse im Bereich Warenwirtschaft, Foodmanagement oder Healthcare-IT

TDconsulting es la consultora tecnológica integral de Grupo TOPdigital: una sola marca con todas las soluciones que empresas privadas y administraciones públicas necesitan para su transformación digital. Integramos tecnología, datos, procesos, movilidad, ciberseguridad y marketing en un único ecosistema adaptado a cada cliente. Trabajamos con grandes cuentas y entidades públicas, con presencia nacional y más de 10 años de experiencia tecnológica.
Estamos en plena transformación tecnológica e implantando un modelo ágil y profesional de entrega de valor, y buscamos a quien lidere ese proceso desde dentro.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Liderar la planificación, coordinación y mejora continua de los releases de nuestro equipo de desarrollo, siendo el punto único de coordinación entre desarrollo, QA, DevOps, infraestructura y negocio.

¿Qué harás en este puesto?

Definir y mantener el calendario de releases de todos los proyectos de desarrollo (.NET, Angular, Vue).
Homogeneizar el Way of Working: Agile, Scrum/Kanban, definiciones de ready/done y uso de Jira y Confluence.
Asegurar la implantación de buenas prácticas de CI/CD y DevOps en todos los equipos.
Medir y mejorar continuamente la entrega: lead time, frecuencia de despliegues, tasa de fallos y otras métricas clave.
Actuar como punto de coordinación entre los equipos técnicos y el negocio.

¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia sólida como Release Manager, Delivery Manager o similar en entornos de desarrollo de software (.NET, Angular, tecnologías enterprise).
Experiencia en entornos con mezcla de legado y código nuevo (.NET Framework + .NET Core).
Conocimiento profundo de Agile (Scrum/Kanban) y coordinación de equipos técnicos.
Experiencia con Jira y Confluence: configuración de flujos, dashboards y reporting.
Conocimiento de CI/CD y DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, pipelines y branching strategy.
Capacidad para definir y hacer cumplir estándares de proceso sin perder agilidad ni pragmatismo.
Habilidades de comunicación y liderazgo para trabajar con perfiles técnicos y de negocio.
Mentalidad data-driven: orientación a la mejora continua basada en métricas.

Se valorará especialmente:

Conocimientos de gestión de riesgos y planificación de releases críticos.
Interés en participar activamente en la transformación tecnológica y de procesos de la compañía.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Oportunidad de diseñar y liderar el modelo de releases de una compañía en plena transformación.
Trabajo directo con el CTO y los Tech Leads del equipo.
Entorno donde se fomenta el uso profesional de Agile, DevOps e IA.
Modalidad híbrida: Málaga + remoto.
Contrato indefinido y condiciones competitivas según perfil.

Become one of our +10.000 tech and business leaders on cloud, data and cyber security. Let’s fuse creativity with technology together and build innovative solutions that actively change things for the better.

Job Description

The QA Architect is the technical owner of the QA Test Center offering.

Working alongside the QA Manager, he defines and evolves the technical QA strategy (governance, test automation, AI, tooling), owns the deployment of all tooling that supports the offering, and represents the offering technically in front of clients — including presentation meetings and, where a client already runs its own setup, adapting the solution accordingly.

Key Responsibilities

Contribute to defining the offering's QA strategy (governance, test automation, AI adoption, best practices), together with the QA Manager.
Design, implement and maintain the technical architecture of the QA Test Center: tools, integrations, environments and automation pipelines.
Deploy, configure and evolve all tooling supporting the offering (test management, automation, CI/CD, reporting, dashboards, etc.).
Turn the current draft of the offering into a solid, documented and repeatable technical value proposition, ready for go-to-market.
Support the sales process: take part in client meetings, present and technically defend the proposed setup.
Assess a client's existing QA setup and adapt the solution (tools, processes, integrations) when the client already has its own stack in place.
Prepare demos, proofs of concept and technical materials to support sales activities.
Keep the offering technologically up to date, tracking trends in test automation and AI applied to QA.
Act as the technical reference point for delivery teams using the offering on client projects.

Qualifications

Solid experience (ideally 5+ years) in QA/Testing, including time spent in technical architecture or technical leadership roles.
Proven track record defining and implementing end-to-end test automation strategies.
Experience with QA governance: processes, metrics, quality and reporting.
Client-facing experience, including technical presentations and adapting solutions to different contexts.
Test automation tools (e.g. Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or equivalents).
Test management and quality tools (e.g. Azure Test Plans, Xray, TestRail, qTest, or equivalents).
CI/CD pipeline integration (e.g. Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
Knowledge of and applied interest in AI for QA (test generation, defect analysis, coverage optimization, self-healing tests, etc.).
Understanding of systems architecture and integrations (APIs, cloud environments, containers).
Ability to design and document technical architecture (diagrams, specifications, setup guides).
Strong technical communication skills, including in front of business and client audiences.
Consultative mindset, able to defend and argue technical choices.
Flexibility and pragmatism to adapt solutions to a client's context without losing technical rigor.
Ownership mindset — able to work autonomously on an offering that is still maturing.
Strong collaboration skills within a small, cross-functional team, working closely with the QA Manager and the Business Manager.
Results-driven with good business acumen, even though this is not a sales role by nature.
Fluency in English (spoken and written).

Nice to Have

Relevant QA/Testing certifications (e.g. ISTQB Advanced/Expert) or automation tooling certifications.
Prior experience structuring or launching a QA offering/product (internally or at a consultancy).
Knowledge of quality governance frameworks (e.g. TMMi) or DevOps/SRE practices applied to QA.
Experience in technical pre-sales.

Additional Information

jobs.description:
Job Role:
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
Job Location:
London, UK
Experience:
Mid-Senior Level
Work Type:
Hybrid / Open for full-time & Contract

About Company:

At Synechron, we believe in the power of digital to transform businesses for the better. Our global consulting firm combines creativity and innovative technology to deliver industry-leading digital solutions. Synechron’s progressive technologies and optimization strategies span end-to-end Artificial Intelligence, Consulting, Digital, Cloud & DevOps, Data, and Software Engineering, servicing an array of noteworthy financial services and technology firms. Through research and development initiatives in our FinLabs we develop solutions for modernization, from Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain to Data Science models, Digital Underwriting, mobile-first applications and more. Over the last 20+ years, our company has been honored with multiple employer awards, recognizing our commitment to our talented teams. With top clients to boast about, Synechron has a global workforce of 14,700+ and has 55 offices in 20 countries within key global markets. For more information on the company, please visit our website or LinkedIn community .

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative-action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.
All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Role Overview :

Client is building a small, senior team of Forward Deployed Engineers to design and ship agentic AI applications across our Corporate Functions — Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Marketing and Sales operations. You will be embedded directly with the people who own the process, taking a real business problem from idea to a working, production-grade solution in weeks rather than quarters.
This is hands-on engineering. You will typically be the sole technical seat in a small pod alongside a process owner and a business sponsor, building applications that run multi-step workflows, hold state across many users, and act directly on enterprise systems of record. That is materially harder than a chatbot, and it is the point of the role.
You will build on Microsoft Fabric as our enterprise data platform and on Azure AI services, and you will help set the technical patterns the wider team reuses. If you want to build serious AI systems that change how a 50,000-person business actually works, and you want the autonomy to do it properly, this is the role.

What You Will Do:

Design, build and harden agentic AI applications that read from and write to enterprise systems of record, grounded on Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI services.
Embed with a Corporate Function team as the technical lead of a small, multi-functional pod — moving from problem, to prototype, to production at pace.
Run a tight, iterative build cycle: align on the outcome, prototype, gather feedback, refine and finalize, typically within one to two weeks per loop.
Own the quality of what you ship end to end — security, reliability, scalability, observability, and safe, governed write-back to source systems.
Make the right build call for the problem: low-code and agent-builder platforms where they fit, custom code where they do not.
Ensure the data behind each solution is AI-ready — modelled, governed and documented in Fabric, with lineage and access control that will stand up to audit.
Set and document the reusable technical patterns, components and guardrails the team applies across every engagement.
Become credible in a new business domain quickly and challenge requirements constructively to land on the right solution rather than the requested one.

Required Qualifications:

Proven experience building agentic or multi-agent AI systems that run in production and serve real users — working systems, not demonstrations.
Strong command of state management, concurrency, idempotency and authorization for systems that act on a system of record on behalf of many users.
Substantial software development experience in at least one language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C# or Java — you can architect, write, review and debug production code.
Hands-on integration experience with enterprise APIs and data platforms, including designing safe read and write paths and handling failure gracefully.
Working knowledge of modern AI application patterns — retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context design, agent orchestration, tool use and protocols such as MCP.
Strong, hands-on command of a major cloud platform, ideally Azure — able to independently provision, configure, deploy, secure and operate cloud resources, owning an application end to end rather than only consuming pre-built services.
Demonstrated ability to prototype rapidly, using AI-assisted development and fast iteration to turn a loosely defined idea into something usable in days.
The judgement and autonomy of a senior individual contributor — able to make sound architecture and feasibility calls alone, under time pressure, and explain them to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

Direct experience with Microsoft Fabric — Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Power BI and OneLake — or a comparable enterprise data platform.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Foundry, or agent-builder platforms such as Lyzr or Moveworks.
Integration experience with major Corporate Function systems of record — for example Oracle HCM, SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics 365 or ServiceNow.
Familiarity with enterprise governance concerns: identity and access management, data classification and residency, responsible AI policy, and evaluation of model output.
A background that blends software engineering with consulting, business transformation or a Corporate Function discipline.
Experience delivering in short, iterative cycles directly with non-technical business stakeholders.

How We Will Assess You:

A practical build exercise: take an ambiguous business problem to a working agentic prototype and explain your design trade-offs.
A systems design discussion covering state, concurrency, authorization and safe write-back to a system of record.
A stakeholder conversation testing how you scope, challenge and communicate with a non-technical business owner.

jobs.title: Erfaren .NET-utvecklare till anti-penningtvätt
jobs.description:
Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.

Några Anledningar Till Att Välja Rollen

Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.

Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).

Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.

Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och förvalta IT-lösningar i C#, .NET och .NET Framework
delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.

Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI-utveckling är meriterande.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om Banken

Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.

Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.

Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar

Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

Aufgaben

Entwicklung und Wartung von Backend-Systemen:
Du entwickelst und pflegst robuste und skalierbare Backend-Lösungen mit Python und Django, die die Grundlage für unsere Chatbot-Plattform bilden.

Du entwirfst und implementierst skalierbare

Softwarearchitekturen, die den Anforderungen einer wachsenden Nutzerbasis gerecht werden.

Als Project Engineer ben jij straks degene die onze beveiligings systemen tot leven brengt in onze projecten. Geen dag is hetzelfde: het ene moment werk je aan een principeschema, het andere moment sta je met een klant te sparren over de beste technische oplossing.

**Over TKH Security**


Bij TKH Security geloven we dat veiligheid en gemak hand in hand moeten gaan. Al meer dan 20 jaar ontwikkelen we vanuit onze thuisbasis op de Dutch Tech Campus in Zoetermeer innovatieve oplossingen voor Security Management, Asset \& Site Management en Parking Guidance. Onze systemen draaien wereldwijd, bij overheden, ziekenhuizen, scholen, energiebedrijven, luchthavens en logistieke bedrijven en stuk voor stuk plekken waar veiligheid er echt toe doet.


Met twaalf vestigingen en ruim 360 collega’s wereldwijd zijn we groot genoeg om impact te maken, en klein genoeg om elkaar nog gewoon bij de voornaam te kennen. We geloven in elke dag een beetje beter worden, en investeren dan ook voortdurend in de ontwikkeling van ons team: dus ook in die van jou.

**Jouw rol als Project Engineer**


Als Project Engineer maak je onderdeel uit van de afdeling Projects (onderdeel van Operations) en werk je nauw samen met de Manager Projects. Jij bent de schakel tussen een goed idee op papier en een werkende oplossing op locatie. Je duikt in specificaties, denkt mee over de beste technische aanpak en zorgt dat alles, van principeschema tot testmatrix, tot in de puntjes klopt.


Geen ivoren toren voor jou: je hebt regelmatig contact met klanten en partners, denkt actief mee met de Manager Projects en staat de Technical Specialist Projects bij waar nodig. Zo help je, stap voor stap, mee om onze projecten (groot en klein) tot een goed einde te brengen.

*Dit ga je onder andere doen:*

* Oplossingstypicals en principeschema’s opstellen, en aansluit\-, functionele en testmatrices creëren
* Specificaties vertalen naar een functioneel en technisch ontwerp en zo het systeemontwerp continu verbeteren
* Klanten adviseren over de implementatie van onze producten
* De productconfiguratie verzorgen en inrichten voor partners en klanten
* Engineeringdocumenten actueel houden en zorgen voor heldere rapportages
* Installatie\- en implementatie\-instructies opstellen, en de voortgang van de werkzaamheden bewaken

**Dit neem jij mee**


We zoeken geen kant\-en\-klare senior, maar wel iemand met een gezonde dosis ervaring en een flinke portie nieuwsgierigheid. Je hebt een MBO\- of HBO\-achtergrond in de elektrotechniek, en de afgelopen 3 tot 5 jaar al aardig wat kennis opgedaan van Security Management Systemen. Je voelt je thuis in AutoCAD, schakelt moeiteloos tussen Nederlands en Engels, en bent net zo goed in het schrijven van een heldere rapportage als in het voeren van een goed gesprek met een klant.


Verder ben je resultaatgericht, communicatief sterk en heb je oog voor kwaliteit. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, ben je bewust van je eigen rol binnen het team, en vindt het net zo leuk om anderen te helpen groeien als om zelf te blijven leren. Kortom: iemand met lef en oog voor innovatie.

*Dit staat op je cv:*

* MBO/HBO werk\- en denkniveau, richting elektrotechniek
* 3 tot 7 jaar relevante werkervaring
* Kennis van Security Management Systemen
* Ervaring met AutoCAD
* Uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels, in woord en geschrift

**Wij bieden**


Naast een fijne plek om elke dag met plezier naartoe te gaan, bieden we je natuurlijk ook de dingen die er financieel en praktisch toe doen: een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring, een goede pensioenregeling en een collectieve korting op je zorgverzekering. Je werkt vanuit ons moderne kantoor op de Dutch Tech Campus in Zoetermeer, met de ruimte om ook een paar dagen vanuit huis te werken.


Maar minstens zo belangrijk: je komt terecht in een hecht team dat gelooft in samen leren en samen bouwen. Je krijgt volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en we investeren met interne opleidingen en trainingen graag in jouw groei – net zo hard als in onze producten.

**Interesse?**


Herken jij jezelf in dit verhaal en wil je onderdeel worden van ons team? Dan maken we graag kennis! Solliciteer hieronder, of stuur gerust een mailtje naar jobs.nl@tkhsecurity.com als je eerst nog even wilt sparren over de rol.

jobs.title: Platform engineer
jobs.description:
Wil jij als platform engineer in **Amsterdam** werken aan technologie die het opsporingswerk van de Belastingdienst ondersteunt? Je bouwt aan een modern platform waarop ontwikkelaars veilige en schaalbare toepassingen maken. Met jouw werk help je collega’s om sneller en slimmer technologie in te zetten voor het opsporingsproces. Je werkt tussen 32 en 36 uur per week en ziet direct het resultaat van jouw bijdrage.
* Bachelor\-hbo
* 24\-36 uur
* ICT
* € 4\.132,\- / € 6\.275,\- bruto p.m.
* Amsterdam / Apeldoorn
  
* 


* Reageer t/m 7 oktober 2026
**Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst**
-------------------------------------

Je werkt aan een containerplatform dat ontwikkelaars dagelijks gebruiken. Je automatiseert processen, verbetert de ontwikkelervaring en zorgt dat toepassingen veilig en stabiel werken. Daarbij werk je samen met ontwikkelaars, data engineers, machine learning engineers, ontwerpers en testers. Met betrouwbare technologie ondersteun je de vernieuwing van het opsporingsproces en help je teams om hun werk beter uit te voeren.
**Een bijzondere baan, omdat...**
---------------------------------

* je werkt aan technologie die helpt bij het opsporen van fraude;
* je ontwikkelaars ondersteunt door processen te automatiseren en te verbeteren;
* je werkt met moderne technieken in een cloud native omgeving;je samenwerkt met specialisten uit verschillende vakgebieden;
* je veel ruimte krijgt om nieuwe kennis op te doen en toe te passen.

* **De afdeling \- Directie Informatievoorziening**
-------------------------------------------------

Toon inhoud van De afdeling \- Directie Informatievoorziening


De directie Informatievoorziening is hét ICT\-bedrijf van de Belastingdienst. Met ruim 3\.000 collega’s zorgen we dat Nederland kan rekenen op betrouwbare informatievoorzieningen en ICT\-systemen. Heel Nederland? Ja, onze ‘klanten’ zijn niet alleen Belastingdienstmedewerkers, maar ook 8\.600 grote ondernemers, 2,2 miljoen mkb\-ondernemers en 8,5 miljoen burgers. En wist je dat wij werken volgens een agile\-mindset? Open, transparant en gericht op leren en kennis delen. Door de toepassing van een DevOps\-werkwijze en ons aanbod van geautomatiseerde technieken kunnen de systemen van de Belastingdienst dagelijks miljoenen data en euro’s verwerken.


Bij ons werk je in een moderne tech\-organisatie met ménsen als kloppend hart. Of je nu als engineer of in een andere rol bijdraagt aan effectieve ICT; jouw inzet doet ertoe. Net als jouw ontwikkeling, waarin wij graag investeren. En jouw ideeën, waar we graag naar luisteren. Ook is er volop ruimte om samen te innoveren met externe partijen. Niet alleen om te moderniseren, maar vooral om nieuwe producten en diensten te ontwikkelen die passen bij de belevingswereld van burgers, bedrijven en collega’s.
*“Ik werk aan technologie die direct helpt bij het opsporen van fraude. De samenwerking met collega’s en de ruimte om te leren maken dit werk bijzonder. Samen bouwen we aan oplossingen die echt verschil maken voor het opsporingswerk.”* Lars, platform engineer


**Wanneer past deze baan bij je?**
----------------------------------

* Je hebt hbo werk en denkniveau.
* Je hebt ervaring met het bouwen en beheren van containerplatformen met Docker en Kubernetes.
* Je kunt infrastructuur als code toepassen met hulpmiddelen zoals Ansible of Terraform.
* Je beschikt over het vermogen om open source frameworks effectief toe te passen.
* Je kunt beveiligingsmaatregelen toepassen met hulpmiddelen zoals Trivy, SonarQube of vergelijkbare oplossingen.
* Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed in woord en geschrift, omdat communicatie en documentatie voornamelijk in het Nederlands plaatsvinden.


**Jouw competenties**
---------------------

* resultaatgerichtheid
* samenwerken
* zelfontwikkeling
* plannen en organiseren
* klantgerichtheid


**Meer over de vacature?**
--------------------------

### **Neem contact op met Jasper Snoeij, teamleider**

* Contact via Whatsapp: 06 \- 18 60 24 58
* 06 \- 18 60 24 58
**Solliciteren bij de Belastingdienst**
---------------------------------------

Het sollicitatietraject bij de Belastingdienst loopt via onderstaande stappen. Hiermee willen we zo veel mogelijk te weten komen over jou, maar laten we je ook kennismaken met ons.


1
### **Sollicitatie \+ selectie**

Solliciteren is mogelijk tot aan de deadline die in de vacaturetekst genoemd wordt. We beoordelen je cv en motivatiebrief op de genoemde functie\-eisen.


2
### **Voorselectietest**

Voor sommige functies is een online voorselectietest onderdeel van de procedure. In dat geval ontvang je per e\-mail meer informatie over de procedure en de uiterlijke inlevertermijn. Het maken van de test duurt ongeveer 120 minuten. De test kan in de meeste gevallen thuis worden gemaakt.


3
### **Sollicitatiegesprek**

We nodigen je per telefoon of e\-mail uit voor een sollicitatiegesprek, waarin een selectiecommissie je beoordeelt op de competenties van de functie aan de hand van een competentiegericht gesprek.


4
### **Assessment**

Een assessment kan deel uitmaken van de procedure. In dat geval word je telefonisch of per e\-mail hiervoor uitgenodigd.


5
### **Arbeidsvoorwaarden**

We nodigen je uit voor een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek. Na een positieve afronding, treffen we samen verdere voorbereidingen voor jouw eerste werkdag! Wil je alvast meer weten over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Op P\-direkt vind je informatie over onderwerpen zoals financiën, vrije dagen, loopbaanontwikkeling, rechten en regels en nog veel meer.

  

* 
* **Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden**
---------------------------

Toon inhoud van Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden


### **Salarisniveau**

Schaal 11


### **Salarisomschrijving**

Inschaling vindt plaats in de bij de functie behorende salarisschaal. Elke salarisschaal kent 11 salarisnummers met bijbehorende maandbedragen; deze staan vermeld in de salaristabel op de website CAO Rijk. De inschaling vindt plaats op basis van relevante kennis en het aantal relevante werkervaringsjaren passend bij de uit te voeren werkzaamheden in de nieuwe functie.Als voorbeeld: met 3 jaar relevante werkervaring word je ingeschaald in nummer 3 van de betreffende salarisschaal.


### **Maandsalaris**

Min €4\.132,\- \- €6\.275,\- (bruto)


### **Dienstverband**

Bepaalde tijd, voorafgaand aan onbepaalde tijd


### **Minimum aantal uren per week**

24


### **Maximum aantal uren per week**

36


### **Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden**

Naast salaris ontvang je ook een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Jouw IKB bestaat uit geld (IKB\-budget) en tijd (IKB\-uren). Het IKB geeft je de mogelijkheid om naar eigen keuze een deel van je IKB\-budget te laten uitbetalen op de door jou gekozen tijdstippen. Én je hebt de mogelijkheid om je IKB\-budget deels om te zetten in verlof of andersom. Ook kun je het IKB\-budget besteden aan een fiscaal\-vriendelijk doel, zoals bijvoorbeeld een fiets, bedrijfsfitness of vakliteratuur.


De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer studiefaciliteiten, ouderschapsverlof en een vergoeding woon\-werkverkeer.


Wij verwachten van onze werknemers dat ze integer zijn en we vragen aan nieuwe medewerkers een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Als deze niet kan worden overlegd voor de indiensttreding, volgt geen arbeidsovereenkomst.
* **Bijzonderheden \- Belangrijk voor je sollicitatie!**
------------------------------------------------------

Toon inhoud van Bijzonderheden \- Belangrijk voor je sollicitatie!


We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word\- of PDF\-bestand. Neem in de bestandsnaam jouw voor\- en achternaam op. Als je een beroep doet op een voorrangspositie, stuur dan ook een kopie van die kennisgeving mee.


Onze selectieprocedure voor deze functie ziet er als volgt uit:


	+ Allereerst wordt beoordeeld of een voorrangskandidaat binnen de Rijksoverheid in aanmerking komt voor deze functie.
	+ Daarna wordt beoordeeld of jouw cv en motivatiebrief voldoen aan de gestelde functie\-eisen en vinden de selectiegesprekken plaats.
Onderaan deze vacature vind je meer uitleg over de stappen die je doorloopt in de sollicitatieprocedure.


De voorkeur gaat uit naar kandidaten die het meest aansluiten bij het opgestelde profiel. Dit heeft betrekking op zowel de genoemde kennis en werkervaring als op het opleidingsniveau. Vermeld deze daarom duidelijk in je cv.


De Belastingdienst zet zich in voor de banenafspraak: zoveel mogelijk banen realiseren voor mensen met een arbeidsbeperking. Val jij in deze doelgroep? Wij zullen je ondersteunen zodat je optimaal kunt functioneren, en daarmee jouw bijdrage aan Nederland kunt leveren. Of het nu gaat om aanpassingen op je werkplek, bepaalde voorzieningen in het vervoer of bijvoorbeeld vergoedingen van het UWV: samen met jou, je leidinggevende én een jobcoach gaan wij kijken naar jouw kwaliteiten en mogelijkheden om een passend werkpakket uit te voeren. Wil jij weten of je hierbij hoort en wat dit exact betekent voor jou?


Een (online) voorselectietest en/of een assessment kan deel uit maken van de sollicitatieprocedure, evenals het maken van een casus, het opvragen van referenties en (online) screening, bijvoorbeeld via databanken, (zoekmachines) en sociale netwerken.


Jouw sollicitatie wordt alleen in behandeling genomen als je met de sollicitatie\-button reageert en je cv en motivatiebrief zijn bijgesloten. Na sluitingsdatum is het niet meer mogelijk om je sollicitatie in behandeling te nemen. Houd er rekening mee dat het solliciteren technische problemen met zich mee kan brengen. Wacht hiermee dus niet tot het laatste moment.


Wanneer je solliciteert op een functie maak je eenmalig een account aan. Met je account kan je de status van je sollicitatie inzien.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Architect (40h per week)
