jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Engineer \- Open Banking Europe
Overview:  

Software engineers working on Mastercard’s Open Banking platform play a key role in the development and maintenance of the products that secure high quality connectivity to banks across Europe. Building on the strong foundation of our state\-of\-the\-art bank connectivity APIs, the engineers create turn\-key solutions that take the burden of handling account information and payment initiation services from customers that want to spend their efforts building great products that leverage the full potential of the Open Banking standard.  

  

Role:  

Open Banking engineers work at the bleeding edge of the account information and payment initiation technologies, often solving problems that are yet to be tackled within the industry in areas of API security, data accessibility, processing, and analysis. You will be joining a group of highly skilled individuals working together as a team to push the limits of what is possible to achieve with open banking.  

  

You will have many colleagues around different countries, with your nearest peers being located primarily in Denmark, Ireland and Poland.  

  

About you:  

We are looking for motivated individuals that are looking to be a part of an established team comprised of both industry veterans as well as newcomers. What they all have in common is the understanding that in order to achieve great things, being able to work together as a team is a must.  

You will be spending most of your time in the Microsoft domain, meaning APIs built in C\# with .NET (latest version) and ASP.NET deployed to the cloud (Azure, AWS). Deep knowledge of at least some of these areas is a requirement. However, we believe that learning is a part of the job, so if you for example have extensive experience building ASP.NET apps, but not in the cloud, do not hesitate to apply regardless.  

  

Beyond that, it is expected that you have experience building software using modern development standards, meaning it should not come as a surprise that we utilise all the tools at our disposal from standard ticketing systems (Azure DevOps), VCS, test automation, to CI/CD pipelines.  

Additionally, if you have experience with provisioning infrastructure as code (Terraform) as well as interest in computer security (Certificates, HTTPS) it would be a great benefit. Prior experience from working in closely regulated industries (financial, medical, etc.) is welcome, but not required.  

  

And above all, we hope that you love solving problems!**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Software Security Engineer
jobs.description:
**Published**: 2026\-09\-15
**Department**  

IT, Finance \& Compliance
  

Nils Foss Allé 1  

3400 Hillerød  

  

**Country**  

Denmark


At FOSS, we are driven by a strong sense of purpose, and we hope you are too. By 2030, the world population will exceed 9 billion and the middle class will have doubled. This means we will need to be outstandingly smart about our global food production. FOSS is on a mission to enable the sustainable use of the planet’s food resources, and thus to the nutrition of the people of the world. As a global market leader, we contribute through innovative food analysis, which is used to secure food quality, reduce waste, and optimize food production. If that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, read on!

**What you will be doing**


FOSS builds software in two very different places: the software for and in our analytical instruments, and the IQX cloud platform those instruments are connected to. Both ship to customers, and both are in scope for the EU Cyber Resilience Act and NIS2\. What we do not currently have in FOSS, is someone who will make that software secure in the it is written, rather than how it is tested afterwards.


As our new Software Security Engineer, you will build secure development into how FOSS writes software in IQX and in R\&D. You report to the Head of Information Security, which keeps the role independent of any single delivery organization and you daily work with the IQX department, SRE and, development teams across R\&D.


Key responsibilities include:

* Own our static and composition analysis tooling, including SonarQube quality gates and exceptions. The goal is scanning that teams use, not a gate they work around
* Build secure development practice across IQX and R\&D: coding guidance, code review, dependency and supply\-chain hygiene, and security checks inside the CI/CD pipeline rather than beside it
* Provide security input into architecture and design decisions with the IQX Architect, SRE and R\&D teams, early enough that it changes the design
* Own cloud security posture: Microsoft Defender for Cloud findings, secure score and recommendations, triaged into work that gets done
* Handle customer security questionnaires and assess the third\-party components and vendors we depend on
* Triage vulnerabilities in our software, from scanning, our own penetration testing or outside reports, and drive what matters to closure with the teams that own the code
* Train and coach developers, so secure development becomes something the teams do rather than something one person checks

**What we hope to see you bring**


This role sits between security and engineering and only works if both sides take you seriously. If you are strong on most of it and interested in the rest, apply and tell us which is which.

* A solid grounding in application security \- OWASP, secure SDLC, DevSecOps \- and experience making it work inside real development teams
* A software engineering background. You have shipped production code and can discuss a finding with a developer as a peer. C\#, Python, C, C\+\+ or comparable
* Experience with SAST and SCA tooling such as SonarQube, including quality gate design and the judgement to grant an exception without hollowing out the gate
* Cloud security posture management, ideally Azure and Microsoft Defender for Cloud
* Enough working knowledge of the Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2 and GDPR to turn them into engineering requirements rather than policy text
* Credibility with developers, the ability to influence without direct authority, and the pragmatism to tell apart a control that improves security from one that only produces evidence
* Professional\-level English. Danish is an advantage, not a requirement

**Why choose FOSS?**


You get two quite different software worlds in one role: a cloud platform under active development, and embedded software inside instruments that measure most of the world’s milk and grain. The role is new, the mandate is real, and it reports to the Head of Information Security rather than to a delivery team where security competes with the release date. We support relevant certification and training. The position is full\-time at the FOSS Innovation Centre in Hillerød, with onsite presence and occasional travel.

**We would love to hear from you!**


Submit your application . We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply early. If you have any questions about the role, please contact Christian Ryge, Head of Information Security, at \+45 2091 6692\.


FOSS is committed to maintaining an inclusive and diverse culture. You can help us sustain an unbiased recruitment process by not including photo and age in your application.

**About FOSS**


Today, more than 8 billion people around the world are dependent on nutritional food. Tons of food being produced in a million different ways and under varying conditions, creating challenges all the way from field to fork. One of them, obviously, is the effect it has on climate change.


FOSS helps the world’s 100 biggest food companies, and more than 40,000 others around the world navigate exactly that with intelligent, data\-driven and innovative analytical solutions. We are making sustainability a better business, and we’re doing so as the global market leader in our field – improving food quality, minimizing food waste, ensuring food safety, and securing fair payment.


Join a pioneering and innovative company in the food and agriculture industry. A company on a mission, with offices all around the world and 1,750 talented colleagues across 34 different countries.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
En tant que BHS Software Engineer, vous prenez en charge les applications de gestion des bagages, le support de production, l’intégration de systèmes et la configuration d’installations aéroportuaires internationales. Vous travaillez sur des environnements critiques, résolvez des problématiques opérationnelles complexes et contribuez à la fiabilité des processus de traitement des bagages aux côtés des acteurs aéroportuaires, des fournisseurs d’équipements et des équipes projets internationales.


Chez Equans, nous croyons que la diversité des talents renforce nos équipes. Nous construisons activement un environnement de travail inclusif où chacun se sent le bienvenu, peut être soi\-même, et nous encourageons chacun à postuler.


**Votre mission se déroule :** Machelen.


#### **Zoom sur la fonction :**


* assurer le rôle de primary maintenance engineer pour des applications de gestion des bagages sur différents sites aéroportuaires internationaux
* analyser et résoudre les incidents de production, notamment les problèmes d’affichage, de tri, de données de vol et de performance des systèmes
* réaliser des analyses de causes racines sur des problèmes logiciels complexes liés aux messages bagages, au contrôle du tri et aux workflows
* rédiger et présenter des rapports de maintenance aux parties prenantes des aéroports
* collaborer avec les techniciens sur site, les équipes IT des aéroports et les fournisseurs d’équipements afin de résoudre les problèmes intersystèmes
* piloter l’intégration technique entre les logiciels EDAS et les systèmes de gestion des bagages de fournisseurs tiers
* développer et maintenir des connecteurs entre les applications BHS et les équipements industriels tels que les trieurs, convoyeurs et scanners
* configurer les paramètres de sécurité, résoudre les problèmes de communication au niveau des protocoles et garantir la fiabilité des flux de données
* configurer et maintenir les systèmes de traçabilité, de tri et de réconciliation des bagages
* concevoir et tester des configurations à haute disponibilité et des mécanismes de redondance
* assurer le support de 2e et 3e ligne pour la suite d’applications BHS EDAS
* travailler avec des message brokers, les standards de messagerie IATA et des pipelines de traitement de données en temps réel
* travailler avec des protocoles de communication industriels tels que OPC UA et les messages IATA 1745 BSM
* maintenir les interfaces de sortation allocation pour le routage des bagages en temps réel
* analyser et résoudre les problèmes liés aux moteurs de workflow, aux intégrations de message brokers et à la logique de tri
* intégrer les systèmes avec les airline departure control systems et les plateformes de réconciliation des bagages
* maintenir la documentation technique, notamment les documents de configuration, les spécifications d’intégration, les guides de dépannage et les runbooks opérationnels
* documenter le comportement des connecteurs, les procédures de déploiement et les configurations de redondance
* contribuer au partage de connaissances et à la base de connaissances interne
* identifier les problèmes récurrents et mettre en place des améliorations durables
* contribuer aux initiatives de stabilisation logicielle du portefeuille applicatif
* participer au développement d’environnements de test et de plateformes virtuelles de simulation aéroportuaire
* contribuer aux activités de refactoring afin d’améliorer la maintenabilité et la qualité du code

#### **Venez comme vous êtes, avec idéalement :**


* bachelier ou master en informatique, software engineering, automatisation industrielle ou dans un domaine technique connexe, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente
* minimum 3 ans d’expérience en software engineering, intégration de systèmes ou support technique dans un environnement industriel, logistique, transport ou de production 24/7
* expérience avec les applications de gestion des bagages, les systèmes de traçabilité, de tri et de réconciliation des bagages
* bonne connaissance d’OPC UA, IATA 1745 BSM, SITA messaging, MQTT, AMQP et des concepts d’intégration de systèmes
* solides compétences en debugging et en analyse de causes racines sur les couches applicatives, bases de données, réseaux et protocoles
* expérience avec C\# (.NET Framework/.NET Core), Python, PowerShell ou Bash
* connaissance de SQL Server, PostgreSQL, des procédures stockées, de l’optimisation des performances des bases de données et des processus de migration de données
* expérience dans l’administration de Windows Server et Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux/CentOS)
* familiarité avec VMware, Hyper\-V, VPN, RDP, SSH et les solutions d’accès à distance sécurisé
* expérience avec Git, GitLab, GitHub, les concepts CI/CD, Docker, Jira et Confluence
* compréhension du dépannage réseau, des firewalls, de TLS/SSL et de la segmentation des réseaux industriels
* connaissance de l’architecture des systèmes de gestion des bagages, des systèmes SAC, du BMR, de l’intégration avec les airline DCS et des standards IATA pour les opérations aéroportuaires
* capacité à produire une documentation technique claire et à communiquer efficacement avec les clients, partenaires et collègues
* organisé et à l’aise avec la gestion d’activités sur plusieurs sites et projets
* approche collaborative tout en étant capable de travailler de manière autonome lorsque nécessaire
* connaissance du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, constitue un atout pour collaborer avec de nombreuses parties prenantes aéroportuaires

#### **Et si vous deveniez BHS Software Engineer chez Equans ?**


**C’est aussi :**


* un salaire conforme au marché et à votre formation \& expérience
* de belles opportunités de formation et de développement
* une assurance groupe, une assurance hospitalisation
* des écochèques, des chèques\-repas, des frais de représentation, 13ème mois, pécule de vacances
* voiture de société électrique, plan de leasing vélo
* smartphone avec abonnement, intervention internet
* des congés RTT, congés d’ancienneté, télétravail
* des réductions via Benefits@Work (culture, sport, voyages, etc.)
  
**À propos d’Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS)**
Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS) est l’entité logicielle BHS (Baggage Handling System) d’Equans Belux. Nous concevons, développons, déployons et maintenons des solutions logicielles critiques pour les systèmes de traitement des bagages dans les aéroports à travers le monde, en Europe, en Amérique du Nord, en Afrique et au Moyen\-Orient.
Au sein d’Equans ICT, nous combinons une expertise approfondie de la logistique aéroportuaire avec des pratiques modernes de développement logiciel. Notre équipe de 9 développeurs travaille en étroite collaboration avec les chefs de projet, les support engineers et les techniciens sur site afin de fournir des systèmes fiables et hautement disponibles qui assurent la circulation continue des bagages.
Nous menons actuellement un important programme de transformation axé sur la stabilisation logicielle, l’automatisation CI/CD, le développement de plateformes d’accès à distance et la modernisation des environnements de test. Vous rejoignez une période passionnante de renouvellement technique.

As a BHS Software Engineer, you take ownership of baggage handling applications, production support, system integration and configuration for international airport installations. You work on mission\-critical airport systems, solve complex operational issues and contribute to the reliability of baggage handling operations while collaborating with airport stakeholders, equipment vendors and international project teams.


At Equans, we believe that diverse talents strengthen our teams. We actively build an inclusive work environment where everyone feels welcome, can be themselves, and we encourage everyone to apply.


**Your work location:** Machelen.


#### **Zoom on the job:**


* act as the primary maintenance engineer for baggage handling applications across international airport sites
* diagnose and resolve production incidents including display issues, sorting problems, flight data discrepancies and system performance issues
* perform root cause analysis on complex software issues related to baggage messaging, sortation control and workflow processing
* prepare and present maintenance reports to airport stakeholders
* collaborate with on\-site technicians, airport IT teams and third\-party equipment suppliers to resolve cross\-system issues
* lead the technical integration between EDAS software and third\-party baggage handling systems
* develop and maintain connectors between BHS applications and industrial equipment such as sorters, conveyors and scanners
* configure security settings, resolve communication protocol issues and ensure reliable production data flows
* configure and maintain baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
* design and test high\-availability and redundancy configurations
* provide 2nd and 3rd line support across the EDAS BHS application suite
* work with message brokers, IATA messaging standards and real\-time data processing pipelines
* work with industrial communication protocols including OPC UA and IATA 1745 BSM messaging
* maintain sortation allocation interfaces for real\-time baggage routing
* troubleshoot workflow engines, message broker integrations and sortation logic
* integrate systems with airline departure control systems and baggage reconciliation platforms
* maintain technical documentation including configuration documents, integration specifications, troubleshooting guides and operational runbooks
* document connector behaviour, deployment procedures and redundancy configurations
* contribute to knowledge sharing and the internal knowledge base
* identify recurring issues and implement permanent improvements
* contribute to software stabilisation initiatives across the application portfolio
* participate in test environment development and virtual airport test platforms
* contribute to software refactoring activities to improve maintainability and code quality

#### **Come as you are, ideally with:**


* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, industrial automation or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* minimum 3 years of experience in software engineering, systems integration or technical support within an industrial, logistics, transport or 24/7 production environment
* experience with baggage handling applications, baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
* solid knowledge of OPC UA, IATA 1745 BSM, SITA messaging, MQTT, AMQP and system integration concepts
* strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across application, database, network and protocol layers

* able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with customers, partners and colleagues
* organised and comfortable managing activities across multiple sites and projects
* collaborative approach with the ability to work independently when required
* knowledge of French (both written and spoken — valuable for communication with many airport stakeholders)

#### **What if you became BHS Software Engineer at Equans?**

* a market rate salary in line with your education and experience
* interesting training and career opportunities
* group insurance, hospitalization insurance
* eco vouchers, meal vouchers, representation allowance, 13th month, holiday pay

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS)
jobs.description:
Thousands of hotels, resorts, and casinos around the world depend on Duetto's platform to run their revenue strategy — and you'll be one of the people making sure it never lets them down. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll own the infrastructure that powers our global SaaS platform: designing for scale, building for reliability, and driving the kind of security\-first culture that keeps us ahead of the curve. If you thrive in complex cloud environments, love solving hard problems, and want your work to have real, tangible impact — this is the role.


**What makes us different?**



Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue \& Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability.



Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the \#1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the \#1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025\. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.


**What you'll be doing**


* Design and implement robust, scalable AWS infrastructure — supporting key system migrations, platform growth, and the reliability our customers depend on.
* Own the reliability, performance, and security of our production environment: high uptime, rapid incident resolution, and proactive capacity planning.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and infrastructure\-as\-code using Terraform, Terragrunt, and Chef.
* Monitor system health using enterprise observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog), defining metrics and response playbooks that get ahead of incidents before they happen.
* Lead security\-first practices across the infrastructure estate — proactively addressing vulnerabilities and driving SOC 2 compliance.
* Partner with engineering teams to integrate operational requirements into the development lifecycle and align on architecture decisions.
* Champion AI adoption within DevOps and SRE workflows, evaluating tooling that increases team velocity and reduces toil.
* Respond to on\-call incidents with urgency — troubleshoot complex issues, lead detailed root cause analyses, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.


**What we're looking for**


**You may be a great fit if you have:**


* 5\+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role.
* Hands\-on AWS experience across IAM, VPC, EC2, ELB, RDS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail — including multi\-account management and SSO.
* Proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure\-as\-code, plus experience with configuration management tools like Chef or Ansible.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling including GitHub, GitHub Actions, JFrog Artifactory, and Jenkins, with familiarity with GitOps methodologies.
* Experience with container and orchestration technologies — Docker, ECS, or EKS.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise monitoring platforms — Prometheus, Grafana, or DataDog.
* Solid troubleshooting skills and a track record of leading root cause analyses and implementing durable fixes.
* Proficiency reading Java, Ruby, Bash/Zsh, HCL, Python, and JavaScript.
* Experience with SOC 2 compliance and security\-first infrastructure practices.
* Comfort with a weekly on\-call rotation.


**Strong candidates may also have:**


* Experience migrating workloads from on\-prem or colocation environments to AWS.
* Familiarity with Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS, and .NET environments.
* Experience administering and synchronising MongoDB replica sets.
* Knowledge of ISO 27001, Layer 7 load balancing, or Terragrunt.
* Background in hospitality technology.
* A degree in Computer Science or a related field — or equivalent experience.


**Why Duetto?**


* **Infrastructure that matters —** your work directly underpins a platform that hotel operators around the world rely on every day. The stakes are real, and so is the satisfaction.
* **AI is how we work —** we're not just talking about AI adoption; we're actively investing in it across every function, including DevOps. You'll have space to evaluate and implement tooling that makes a genuine difference.
* **A team that moves fast —** you'll report into the Senior DevOps Manager and work alongside engineers who are serious about craft, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* **Growth with purpose —** backed by GrowthCurve Capital, we're scaling our platform and our team. There's a lot being built here, and senior engineers have real influence over how it's done.
* **Come as you are —** we're a diverse, distributed team that values different perspectives and builds inclusively.


**The details**


**Location:**Croatia


**Work model:**Remote


**Reports to:**Senior DevOps Manager

  


*Duetto is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*


**Sound like you?**



We'd love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box. Diverse perspectives and non\-traditional paths make our team stronger. Apply and let's talk.

  



\#LI\-REMOTE

* 5\-10 years proven management experience
* Proven ability to maintain focus and work effectively with multiple demands
* Can\-do mentality and fast, eager learner
* Eager to learn new ways of working using GenAI tools like Co Pilot or AmazonQ
* Excellent communications skills and fit to work with team members in different geographical locations.
* Comfortable working in a performance\-based and structured environment while demonstrating high ethical standards.
* Leading by example, supporting team members in personal development, and challenging them to their best performance
* Experience in Change management; essential to implement new technology and integration methods.
* Must be able to recognize basic procedural issues as they arise and escalate to the appropriate level.
* Strategic view to foresee future developments
* JIRA expertise to understand backlog, dependencies, reporting on status.

**Experienced or familiar with the following technologies/tools:**


* Core Java \& Frameworks
* Strong proficiency in Core Java (Java 11 or higher) AND Deep understanding of OOP concepts, design patterns, and SOLID principles
* Spring Framework (Boot, MVC, Security)
* Hibernate/JPA
* RESTful APIs and Microservices
* Memory management and performance optimization
* Message queuing systems (Kafka/RabbitMQ)
* Database, Development Tools \& Practices
* SQL/NoSQL databases
* Git, Maven/Gradle
* CI/CD pipelines
* Unit testing (JUnit, Mockito)
* Cloud \& Infrastructure
* Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Message queuing (Kafka/RabbitMQ)
* Application monitoring and logging.

**What can we expect from you:**

* Think APIs, MFIs and Microservices ;
* Can push the team to further improve their Scrum maturity
* Always strive for quality over quantity;
* Must possess strong communication and presentation skills. Strong time management skills for managing multiple, diverse and conflicting activities are required.
* Experience in building and consuming services (WCF, Rest, and NET WEP API).
* Basic knowledge on AWS.
* Ability to review strategy, architecture, and design for web applications
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Business, and IT teams (Development and QA)
* Apply design patterns and best practices in enterprise application development
* Understanding of fundamental design principles for building a scalable application.
* Strong analytical/functional background and experience with support and operations activities

* Autonomy \& Proactivity:
* Ability to detect performance bottlenecks in tooling or developer workflows, proposing and implementing quick wins without requiring micromanagement.

* Backend \& BFF (Backend\-for\-Frontend):
* Backend Ecosystem: Advanced domain in developing robust and scalable services using .NET Core / C\# and Node.js (NestJS / Express).

* Module Federation: Hands\-on experience with Webpack / Vite Module Federation for runtime dynamic loading of MFEs, managing shared scopes, and error isolation (Error Boundaries).
* Authentication \& State: Management of OIDC / OAuth2 identity and authentication flows, along with global/context state management.

* Kubernetes (K8s): Experience in orchestrating, deploying, and administering applications in K8s clusters (deployments, services, ingresses, configmaps).
* CI/CD, GitOps \& Quality:
* CI Pipelines: Creation and management of Continuous Integration pipelines for build automation, executing unit/integration tests, static code analysis, and pushing images to registries (Harbor).

* Testing: Experience in automated testing and a shift\-left quality culture.
* Nice\-to\-Have:
* AI\-Assisted Development \& Agents: Experience or strong interest in AI\-powered development workflows (Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, etc.), as well as integrating or developing AI agents and conversational interfaces to automate development or platform tasks.
* Cloud Computing (Multicloud \& GCP): Experience in Multicloud environments. Practical knowledge and experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Cloud Run, GKE, IAM, Secret Manager) or involvement in cross\-cloud migration projects from Azure to GCP.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform: Knowledge or experience in provisioning and automating cloud resources using Terraform, facilitating the creation of scalable, replicable environments integrated into platform deployment workflows.

Be the true you

Natuurlijk ontdek je voortdurend nieuwe manieren om moeilijke problemen op te lossen en wil je tot de kern van het echte probleem van de klant komen. Een diploma in het hoger/universitair onderwijs op het gebied van Computer Science, Software Engineering/Development, Artificial Intelligence, of andere relevante formele onderwijservaring.
Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python, Apex (zeer vergelijkbaar met Java), JavaScript, SQL, HTML en CSS.

Jij bent de katalysator van deze transformatie: je schrijft code, configureert systemen en fungeert als technisch sparringpartner voor onze klanten. Tegelijk groei je voortdurend via ons Delivery Excellence Program—een intensief ecosysteem van trainingen, kennisdelingssessies en certificeringen die je naar het volgende level tillen.

Wil je graag meer weten over Deloitte Digital? Bezoek onze pagina of neem een kijkje op onze LinkedIn .

Het verkennen en toepassen van innovatieve technologieën zoals Agentic AI, Conversational AI, Voice Assistants en andere geavanceerde oplossingen, met de focus op het stimuleren van creatief denken en het aanjagen van impactvolle bedrijfsinnovatie.

We stellen kwaliteit en veiligheid voorop en streven naar schaalbare excellentie—standaarden die groeien zonder te buigen.
Je gaat samenwerken in vaak multidisciplinaire- en culture teams bij klanten die Agile werken om nieuwe functionaliteit te ontwikkelen en implementeren in het toonaangevende SaaS-platform Salesforce.

Je bent gedreven om jezelf voortdurend te ontwikkelen, zowel professioneel als persoonlijk. We zouden je graag willen leren kennen!

jobs.description:
About Oneleet

Oneleet is a rapidly growing security and compliance platform focused on making cybersecurity and compliance more effective, accessible, and straightforward for businesses.

The platform helps companies build, manage, and monitor cybersecurity programs while working toward compliance standards such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Oneleet monitors cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Azure, helping identify security risks such as exposed storage, inadequate encryption, overly permissive IAM policies, and compliance gaps.

Following a $33 million Series A, Oneleet is expanding its customer base and engineering organization as it works to reshape the cybersecurity and compliance industry.

About the Role

Oneleet is seeking a Software Engineer, Integrations to build and maintain the integrations that connect its security platform with cloud providers, security tools, and third-party services.

This is a backend-heavy engineering role focused on reliability, data quality, and integration coverage. You will ensure that Oneleet can consistently collect the right security signals from external systems and make that information available to downstream security and compliance features.

As part of the engineering team, you will collaborate closely with the founding team and other engineers to understand business and customer needs and help build the core technology powering the Oneleet platform.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain integrations with AWS, GCP, and Azure cloud environments.

Develop integrations with third-party security tools and external services.

Discover cloud resources, synchronize configurations, and surface relevant security data.

Design data pipelines that normalize and validate inputs from diverse APIs.

Handle real-world API challenges including inconsistent responses, pagination, rate limits, and evolving schemas.

Implement authentication flows using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, API keys, and service accounts.

Build reliable and recoverable integrations with strong error handling and retry mechanisms.

Implement monitoring, observability, and alerting for integration failures and operational issues.

Create clear documentation covering integration behavior, data mappings, and troubleshooting procedures.

Improve engineering standards, tooling, and reusable patterns that make future integrations faster to develop.

Collaborate with engineering teams to understand downstream data requirements.

Ensure integrations consistently deliver the data required by Oneleet's security platform.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of professional software development experience, particularly in backend APIs, integrations, or data pipelines.

Experience with strongly typed compiled programming languages such as:

Go

Java

C#

C++

Rust

Strong preference for Go experience.

Experience integrating with REST APIs and working from API documentation.

Ability to handle real-world API behavior and integration challenges.

Experience working with SQL.

Experience building or maintaining SaaS platform backends.

Strong problem-solving abilities and a willingness to take ownership of technical challenges.

Comfortable working independently in an environment that values initiative and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of authentication standards including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML.

Professional experience in information security.

Familiarity with cloud provider APIs and SDKs, including:

AWS SDK

GCP client libraries

Azure SDK

Experience with integration testing and debugging tools.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Cloud & Integration Technology

The role focuses heavily on building reliable integrations across modern cloud and SaaS environments.

Engineering Focus

You will help build the foundational integration layer that powers Oneleet's security capabilities.

Key engineering challenges include:

Reliable API integrations

Cloud resource discovery

Security data collection

Data normalization and validation

Backend SaaS development

Who We're Looking For

Oneleet values passionate self-starters with a growth mindset, a bias toward action, and strong personal accountability.

The company is particularly interested in engineers who:

Enjoy solving difficult technical problems.

Are comfortable working in ambiguous environments.

Challenge outdated approaches and look for better solutions.

Are decisive while remaining collaborative.

Communicate clearly and take ownership of their ideas.

Want to make a meaningful impact on the product and company.

Remote-First Work Environment

Oneleet operates as a remote-first company and hires globally in regions where it can legally engage employees directly or through an employer-of-record partner.

The role is listed in Amsterdam, Netherlands, while the company supports global hiring based on applicable employment arrangements.

Perks & Benefits

Why Join Oneleet?

This is an opportunity to work on the foundational technology behind a modern cybersecurity and compliance platform.

As a Software Engineer, Integrations, you will directly influence how Oneleet connects with cloud platforms, security tools, and third-party services. Your work will help organizations automate security processes, improve compliance, and maintain more secure cloud environments.

You will also have the autonomy to make meaningful technical contributions while working alongside a passionate engineering team in a rapidly growing Series A startup.

The Client AI & Analytics team is building AI-powered tools inside ClientCenter, our custom platform used by private bankers, relationship managers, and other commercial staff to manage client relationships and deliver highly personalized client service at scale. We build practical, impactful AI tools that fit naturally into how bankers and advisors actually work, always with humans firmly in the loop.

Over the past period, the team has added a growing set of AI-powered capabilities to the platform, including meeting preparation, live transcription, automated documentation, data quality improvements, and compliance support. We are now taking the next step: developing a native iOS app, backed by our C#/.NET API layer, that makes these intelligent capabilities available anytime, anywhere, on secure managed devices within our corporate environment.

As a fullstack engineer, you will help build the corporate mobile app and the backend that powers it, enabling our commercial colleagues to work faster, smarter, and more effectively, with AI-assisted ClientCenter functionality right at their fingertips.

Your talents

"Passionate about mobile and backend technology, AI, growth mindset, collaborative and hands-on" — this is how we can best describe you in this role. You use these talents to continuously improve the digital experience of our commercial colleagues.

of the following, and working
knowledge of the other:

iOS development

Strong understanding of REST architectural principles (resources, statelessness, idempotency, proper use of HTTP methods/status codes) and experience applying this when consuming APIs in a mobile context

HERAUSFORDERUNG UND PERSPEKTIVE

Softwareentwicklung verändert sich gerade schneller als jemals zuvor. Nicht in fünf Jahren. Nicht nächstes Jahr. Heute. Während andere Unternehmen noch Pilotprojekte starten, entwickeln wir bereits vollständig AI-gestützt.

Agentic Coding ist bei uns kein Experiment, es ist der Standard. Du arbeitest täglich mit autonomen AI-Agenten, die eigenständig Entwicklungsaufgaben übernehmen, Architektur analysieren, Refactorings durchführen, Tests schreiben und komplette Workflows unterstützen. Deine Arbeit wird dabei auf keinen Fall an fehlenden Tokens scheitern!

Was Dich Erwartet

Du entwickelst eine hochverfügbare, skalierbare Plattform auf Basis einer modernen Microservice-Architektur. Mit .NET und Python baust du leistungsfähige Backend-Services, die über ein modernes Angular-Frontend für unsere Kunden erlebbar werden. AI begleitet dabei jeden Schritt – von der Architektur bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Konkret bedeutet das für deinen Arbeitsalltag:

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Engineering und Founding Team bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform

PERSÖNLICHKEIT UND QUALIFIKATION

Wir suchen keine Entwickler, die AI als Werkzeug nutzen. Wir suchen Menschen, die AI bereits als selbstverständliches Teammitglied betrachten.

Du passt zu uns, wenn…

AgenticCoding für dich Alltag ist.
du AI-Tools täglich produktiv einsetzt.
du ständig neue Modelle testest, bevor andere überhaupt davon gehört haben.
du lieber deine Zeit mit neuen AI-Workflows verbringst als mit Framework-Diskussionen.
du Probleme automatisierst, bevor andere anfangen, sie manuell zu lösen.
du Eigeninitiative nicht erklären musst.

Was Wir Bieten

Zugang zu den modernsten AI-Modellen und Tools
Arbeiten an der technologischen Speerspitze der AI-gestützten Softwareentwicklung
Maximale technische Freiheit
Ein Team aus Menschen, die AI genauso obsessiv nutzen wie du
Viel Verantwortung und viel Einfluss

UNTERNEHMENSKULTUR UND UMFELD

Wir sind ein founder-led AI-Scale-up mit kurzen Wegen, hoher Geschwindigkeit und dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche neu zu denken. Bei uns arbeitest du in einem Team, das sich gegenseitig vertraut, unterstützt und gemeinsam wächst #RealConnections .

Wir arbeiten fokussiert, feiern Erfolge gemeinsam und verlieren dabei nie die Freude am Aufbau von etwas Großem. Denn die besten Ideen entstehen dort, wo Neugier, Teamgeist und der Mut zum Ausprobieren aufeinandertreffen #SeriousFun .

https://www.june.tech/de/karriere/

JUNE definiert die juristische Arbeit neu – mit Künstlicher Intelligenz, Automatisierung und einem ganzheitlichen Plattformansatz. Seit 2020 entwickeln und vermarkten wir in München eine KI-unterstützte Plattform, die juristische Prozesse intelligent, effizient und skalierbar macht.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.

The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
(Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About You

5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open fully remote, or hybrid from our Berlin, Germany hub if you prefer time with the team in person.

NYC Salary: $180,000 - $300,000 USD

jobs.description:
EngRadar / DeepL

Senior Software Engineer | Identity and Access Management | Full-Stack

DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems, offering a Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing, and real-time voice translation.

DeepL
is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs.

Remote London Full-time Posted today aitranslation

Apply directly →

Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team
. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health
Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers
Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Qualities we look for

Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, monitor the systems in production, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn
A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Who Are We?

Not just another building society. Not just another job.

What’s In It For You?

jobs.description:
EngRadar / DeepL

Senior Software Engineer | Enterprise | Full-Stack

DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems, offering a Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing, and real-time voice translation.

DeepL
is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs.

Remote London Full-time Posted today aitranslation

Apply directly →

Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Business Acceleration Track (BAT)
. This is the engine room of DeepL’s global growth. While our Research teams build the models, BAT builds the Revenue Flywheel
that allows 200,000+ Enterprises (like the Fortune 500) to actually use and pay for them at scale .

We are moving upmarket. We are transitioning from a consumer-focused app to a mission-critical Enterprise Platform. You will be part of the team architecting the "Financial Nervous System" of DeepL — handling everything from Identity & Access Management (SSO, SCIM) to complex multi-seat Subscription Architectures and Fraud Prevention .

We don't hire engineers to just implement UI tickets. We hire Missionaries
who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will own the full vertical: from the user-facing Admin Console in React to the distributed billing logic in C#/.NET.

Your Responsibilities

Architect Revenue-Critical Flows: You will design and ship complex, high-stakes features like "Enterprise Licensing" or "Automated Seat Provisioning." You ensure that when a customer upgrades, the UX is instant, and the billing ledger is immutable.
Own the "Enterprise Experience": You will build the tools that empower CIOs and IT Directors to manage DeepL. You translate complex backend constraints (RBAC, Rate Limits) into simple, elegant UI workflows.
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You work directly with Sales, Product, and Finance to translate "Annual Recurring Revenue" goals into scalable technical architectures .
Drive System Reliability: You understand that billing systems cannot fail. You build for idempotency and resilience, ensuring that our financial data is auditable and flawless, while maintaining a high-velocity frontend experience.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.
Full-Stack Fluency: You are comfortable traversing the stack. You can design a React component for an Admin Dashboard in the morning and debug a distributed transaction in the backend in the afternoon.
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS—Identity (SAML/SSO), Monetization, and Compliance. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .
High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Job Description

Software and Systems Engineer

Derby (Hybrid)

Full-Time, Permanent

We are looking for software and systems engineers to help design, deliver and support the next generation of aerospace test facilities globally with a main focus testing of software developed by the team. The Rolls-Royce Measurement & Test Engineering organisation are responsible for designing and delivering the infrastructure required to test the next generation of gas turbine engines for both Civil and Defence applications. This includes Test Bed 80, the world’s largest indoor aerospace test bed.

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

The Experimental Systems team are responsible for delivering a wide range of measurement and control system technologies. The team have just completed the design, installation, and commissioning of all the data systems on Test Bed 80 from concept to first engine run and helped complete the first run on the UltraFan (our most instrumented engine ever).

The software design side of the team are responsible for developing bespoke applications to support the planning, conducting, monitoring, and reporting of engine tests and their data. They are also responsible for managing the IT infrastructure supporting the test facilities. Successful candidates can either specialise in a key skill or obtain a broad range of engineering and IT skills which are required to provide data systems and services that support Rolls-Royce’s core aero-engine products throughout their lifecycle.

What You Will Be Doing

Building of automated test frameworks
Development of applications and data pipelines
Integration of IT systems including networks, data movement and storage
Support the design and integration of new measurement and control system solutions, including high speed data acquisition
Utilising DevOps to perform CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery) and to work within an Agile framework
Requirements capture and analysis, and the preparation of system specifications
Implement and drive cyber security best practices

Who Were Looking For

You will have the confidence and ability to work as part of a team and take the lead on technical projects. The role will be based in Derby, but the global nature of the business requires the flexibility to support the Civil Aerospace global business model, and the requirement for short-term assignments around the globe.

Qualifications

Qualified to degree level or equivalent in computer science or in a relevant engineering discipline.

We are looking for people with the following experience and skills;

Software testing and test automation
Software engineering with experience in scripting and/or low-level languages including but not limited to: Python, C/C++, C#, Java, Terraform
An appreciation of IT infrastructure including operating systems (Windows, Linux), hardware (computers, servers, and network hardware) and associated software
Experience in requirements capture/analysis methods, such as Systems Engineering
Experience in the development of Azure build and release pipeline
Experience of software testing, including automated test of user interfaces

In Addition, The Following Role Specific Skills Are Preferred

Experience of software vulnerability scanning using tools like SonarQube
System and software architecture design
Good knowledge of current products, technologies and methods
Experience in Dev Ops and Agile work practices
Understanding of Data Acquisition, including high speed measurement techniques
Experience of driver development and testing for Windows and Linux
Experience of containerisation for software development and testing

You will have a demonstrable track record of delivering under pressure to both tight and changing project deadlines. Highly self-motivated and enthusiastic, you will be able to produce work of a consistently high standard.

Regional Benefits

Our People are our power, so when join Rolls-Royce you are offered more than a salary. You are given a choice of flexible benefits from life insurance to gym discounts and tax free cycling.

Generous Annual Leave
Retirement Savings through the Rolls-Royce Retirement Savings Trust
Group Life Assurance provides for a lump sum benefit if you die whilst employed by Rolls-Royce
Group Income Protection provides an income in the event that you are unable to work due to illness or injury
Your Shares: Matched is a simple way to own Rolls-Royce shares and invest in our future, together. Buy one share, get one free!
Digital GP provides a convenient way for you to access GP consultations

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Requirements

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs
Startup experience: shipping products in small, fast moving teams
Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries
Cloud & DevOps: comfortable working in AWS, linux and wrangling build pipelines. We have dedicated DevOps people, but you do need to be competent in the core skills here
Fluent written and spoken English. Communicating with the team is as important as the technical work. You need to be able to effectively collaborate on everything from low level details to long term strategic planning

Nice to have

Trading, market making or exchange experience

Private healthcare insurance
Long term illness insurance
Gym membership
