jobs.description:
About This Role

Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer – Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Location:
Edinburgh

About The Role

BlackRock is seeking a Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer to join Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering within Analytics & Compliance Engineering. This role is for a hands-on engineering leader who can build scalable agentic solutions while helping accelerate the adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices across the product development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of investment technology, investment compliance workflows, full-stack engineering, and applied AI. They will help design and deliver capabilities across the Aladdin platform that support investment professionals, compliance teams, and business stakeholders operating in complex global markets.

About Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Aladdin is BlackRock’s technology platform used by investment professionals to manage portfolios, analyse risk, execute workflows, and make decisions at scale. Within Investments & Trading Engineering, Analytics & Compliance Engineering develops technology that helps teams manage investment guidelines, regulatory obligations, analytics-driven workflows, and operational controls across global markets.

The Investment and Trading Compliance Engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining tools to ensure that organizations using Aladdin® comply at different stages of the asset management process. This includes ensuring that clients follow guidelines established internally, by themselves, and by the market regulators. The system accomplishes this through high-throughput rule-based compliance engines, which sit at the heart of the investment system and process millions of calculations per day.

Our engineering teams build products with real reach, real complexity, and real impact. We are evolving our platform with persona-based, workflow-driven experiences, modular architecture, resilient services, and responsible AI capabilities that improve productivity, decision-making, knowledge discovery, and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deliver high-quality full-stack Agnetic product capabilities across the Aladdin platform, with a focus on Analytics & Compliance Engineering workflows.
Act as a hands-on technical leader across the product development lifecycle, contributing to technical design, implementation, testing, deployment readiness, production support, and continuous improvement.
Partner with product managers, engineers, compliance specialists, and business stakeholders to translate complex business problems into clear specifications, technical designs, delivery plans, and actionable Agile backlogs.
Apply AI-enabled engineering practices to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, software development, testing, code review, documentation, and operational support.
Help embed responsible AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services, including intelligent assistants, workflow automation, semantic search, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning over compliance and investment information.
Build scalable, resilient, and operable systems that balance functional requirements with non-functional concerns such as performance, latency, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability.
Influence architecture and technical direction across initiatives, articulating design trade-offs and aligning stakeholders around pragmatic engineering choices.

Title And Summary

Senior Engineer - Open Banking Europe

Overview

Software engineers working on Mastercard’s Open Banking platform play a key role in the development and maintenance of the products that secure high quality connectivity to banks across Europe. Building on the strong foundation of our state-of-the-art bank connectivity APIs, the engineers create turn-key solutions that take the burden of handling account information and payment initiation services from customers that want to spend their efforts building great products that leverage the full potential of the Open Banking standard.

Role

Open Banking engineers work at the bleeding edge of the account information and payment initiation technologies, often solving problems that are yet to be tackled within the industry in areas of API security, data accessibility, processing, and analysis. You will be joining a group of highly skilled individuals working together as a team to push the limits of what is possible to achieve with open banking.

You will have many colleagues around different countries, with your nearest peers being located primarily in Denmark, Ireland and Poland.

About You

We are looking for motivated individuals that are looking to be a part of an established team comprised of both industry veterans as well as newcomers. What they all have in common is the understanding that in order to achieve great things, being able to work together as a team is a must.

You will be spending most of your time in the Microsoft domain, meaning APIs built in C# with .NET (latest version) and ASP.NET deployed to the cloud (Azure, AWS). Deep knowledge of at least some of these areas is a requirement. However, we believe that learning is a part of the job, so if you for example have extensive experience building ASP.NET apps, but not in the cloud, do not hesitate to apply regardless.

Prior experience from working in closely regulated industries (financial, medical, etc.) is welcome, but not required.

And above all, we hope that you love solving problems!

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Tech Advisor-Software Dev
jobs.description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

About Landmark

Landmark, a Halliburton company, builds the software and data platforms that help the global energy industry make better decisions. Our products span subsurface interpretation, well construction planning, reservoir simulation, production optimization, and digital operations. These are tools used daily by engineers and scientists at the world’s largest energy companies and run as cloud-native SaaS platforms and as enterprise on-premises solutions.

About The Role

You are a senior developer with a designer's eye and in-depth knowledge of computer graphics. You shape 3D engineering applications and digital twins, connecting back-end data processing with real-time rendering and 3D user experience (UX) design. Drawing on extensive experience with professional CAD and 3D software, you use established interaction patterns to make navigation, selection, and manipulation efficient, helping engineers stay oriented in complex models. You work across the full stack with Unity, WebGL, Three.js, Babylon.js, and modern web frameworks, taking solutions from prototypes through to production.

What You Will Do

Own the architecture and technical direction of the 3D component, working closely with product management and domain specialists.
Design and build 3D and extended reality (XR) interactions for inspection, measurement, well planning, and collaboration.
Develop processing pipelines, shaders, and reusable tools. Improve memory use, efficiency, and responsiveness with large datasets.
Prepare and integrate CAD models, geospatial and subsurface data, point clouds, and volumetric datasets for accurate real-time visualization.
Lead design and code reviews, strengthen testing and debugging tools, and maintain the code through successive releases.
Evaluate and integrate AI where it improves engineering workflows, with attention to reliability, privacy, and cost.

Qualifications

Masters’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
20 or more years of wide-ranging experience across software development, computer graphics, and design
Deep proficiency in Unity and C#, with experience owning and improving a substantial real-time 3D codebase
In-depth knowledge of rendering, shading, geometry, and performance optimization, supported by hands-on 3D production experience
Experience designing and implementing 3D and XR interactions, from user research and prototypes to testing with domain users
Strong aesthetic judgment, including composition, lighting, materials, and visual hierarchy, applied to clear, usable engineering tools
Experience converting and optimizing large CAD and geospatial datasets, including coordinate systems, terrain, and point clouds
Communication skills sharp enough to explain a technical trade-off to a product manager and a design choice to a junior engineer with equal clarity
Practical knowledge of AI tools and model integration, including the capabilities and limitations of hosted and local models

Preferred

Experience with WebGL, Three.js or Babylon.js, TypeScript, and full-stack development with automated delivery using Git and Docker
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation
Familiarity with geospatial coordinate systems and transformations, georeferencing, point clouds, and volumetric data such as voxel grids
Experience with industrial digital twins, subsurface visualization, or collaborative VR tools.
Experience contributing to open-source projects, or integrating open-source components at scale.

How You Work

The senior engineer who succeeds in this role thinks at the level of the system, not only the feature. You work end to end, understanding how back-end data, software architecture, real-time graphics, and user interaction affect one another. You stay hands-on from scoping through implementation and delivery. You explain technical choices clearly to developers, designers, domain experts, Product Management, and leadership, with the detail each needs to make a decision.

You bring the experience to know when a technical decision will cost the team later, the credibility to say so clearly, and the follow-through to drive it toward a better outcome. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and pragmatic enough to ship when the solution is sound, even if it is not perfect. You do not wait for someone to identify what needs fixing. You see it, own it, and drive it to resolution.

You stay technically sharp because you are genuinely curious, and you bring what you learn back to the team. You invest in the people around you because you understand that your long-term contribution depends on the quality of the team, not only the quality of your own code.

Why Landmark

We build small, high-ownership teams and invest in the quality of every person on them. You will work in a business where software is the product, the work you do matters, and the standards are high. Here you have the autonomy to make real technical decisions, peers strong enough to challenge you, and problems deep enough to be worth solving well. We offer competitive compensation including bonus and long-term incentive programs, a strong career path, and a role where your technical judgment shapes what gets built.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Empirical Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Position

As agile development scales to larger, more complex organizations, software engineering is being transformed by a set of intertwined changes. Continuous software engineering is converging development and operations to enable frequent releases, while AI is touching every stage of the software lifecycle, bringing agents that work alongside developers. Together, these changes are reshaping team composition and dynamics, as well as enabling shorter feedback loops, while introducing new roles and requiring new skillsets.

The purpose of empirical software engineering research is to study these shifts as they unfold, examining real-world practice to generate knowledge that can guide how teams and organisations build quality software. As a PhD Candidate, you will carry out this work within the Software Engineering group at the Department of Computer Science, one of Norway's leading software engineering environments. The group works closely with industry and publishes at leading international venues.

Your immediate leader will be the head of unit.

Duties of the position

Develop research-based knowledge on continuous software development, grounded in empirical studies.
Carry out empirical studies in Norwegian software companies, with the aim of publishing in recognised journals and conferences.
Responsible for conducting your own studies and for taking part in project teams together with master's students.
Contribute to teaching activities, including lab sessions and supervision
Other career-promoting work agreed with the department, such as work on smaller related research projects or collaboration with organisations in the public and private sectors. Applicants who hold a position outside the university may, by agreement, retain part of that position as career-promoting work.

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required Selection Criteria

You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
You must have a relevant Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
You must master English as a professional language, both written and orally.
You must attach a project outline (1500 words) to your application. It should set out your theoretical and methodological approach to the research topic, together with proposed research questions.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred Selection Criteria

Academically relevant background within software engineering or information systems

Experience from the software industry
Experience with empirical studies and scientific publishing
Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to:

A good team player
A good communicator
Eager to learn
Results-oriented
Work independently

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

An exciting job with an important mission in society
Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
Working capital that can be used to implement the project
Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary.

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work. (A minimum of three work years of the total term period must be dedicated to doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About The Application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note:
the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The Application Must Include

Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
CV
Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages)
Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
Possibly certificates
Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Joakim Klemets (Associate Professor), phone +47 413 51 921, email: joakim.klemets@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR at hr@idi.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10..2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.

About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Group Functions

Group functions in DNV are experts on finance and accounting, human resources, communication and sustainability, legal, tax and compliance – providing company-wide support, governance and strategic projects. Group also includes our strategic Research and Development unit, which provides science-based insights and foresight to tackle transformations and challenges across the industries we serve.

About The Role

We are looking for students in their 3rd or 4th year
of studies who are interested in the future of safety-critical and software-intensive systems.

Modern ships, energy systems and industrial assets are becoming increasingly autonomous, connected and data-driven. As these systems grow in complexity, society needs new ways of understanding whether they remain safe, reliable and compliant throughout their lifecycle.

In this project, you will explore how engineering knowledge, requirements, safety objectives, operational data and simulation results can be combined to support informed and trustworthy decisions.

Working together with students focusing on simulation and risk analysis, you will investigate questions such as:

How can we understand the impact of design changes, software updates or maintenance actions?
How can requirements be traced throughout the lifecycle of a system?
What information is needed to justify confidence in a safety-critical system?
How can engineering evidence be structured and updated as systems evolve?
How can future classification and certification processes become more digital, dynamic and data-driven?

The work combines elements of systems thinking, software engineering, safety, AI-enabled engineering and decision support for complex technical systems.

jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Skal du være vores nye Senior Backend Developer? Så er det nu du har chancen! Vi står nemlig og har brug for endnu flere dygtige kollegaer, som kan være med til at løfte efterspørgslen fra vores kunder i Commerce. Derfor leder vi nu efter en Senior Backend Developer, som vil være med til at bygge kernen i platformen, ikke bare features oven på den. Så får du et sus i maven, når vi nævner ord som C#, .NET, modulær microservice-arkitektur, API-first og event-drevne integrationer? Og deler du vores ambition om at transformere e-handel gennem API-baserede løsninger? Så skal du sende os dit CV i dag 🚀

Vi kunne skrive os trætte i sælgende floskler om NORRIQ, og vores Commerce-afdeling, men i stedet vil vi holde det kort og godt, så du kan komme ned til ”Ansøg” knappen. Vi forventer, at du med din viden og kompetencer, hjælper os med at indfri vores kunders fulde potentiale gennem teknologi og digital transformation. Til gengæld kan du forvente en arbejdsplads, der dyrker tryghed, fællesskab og medarbejderudvikling, så du har de bedste forudsætninger for at blive dygtigere, mens du er her. For vi tror ikke kun på potentialet hos vores kunder, men også i potentialet hos dig.

Eksempler på dine kommende arbejdsopgaver kunne være:

Designe og udvikle API-baseret forretningslogik og integrationer i nyeste .NET-version. Du skal være med til at bygge kernen i platformen, ikke bare features oven på den
Eje den tekniske løsning på dine projekter, fra arkitektur og estimat til drift i produktion
Bygge event-drevne integrationer mod ERP, PIM og økonomisystemer, hvor datamængder og ydeevne er reelle problemstillinger
Udvikle NuGet-pakker og fælles komponenter, der bliver genbrugt på tværs af hele porteføljen
Være projektlederens tekniske modpart i leverance, estimering og planlægning og deltage i beslutninger på strategisk niveau, der sætter retningen for best practices i afdelingen
Sidde med kunden og oversætte forretningsbehov til teknisk løsning

Vi leder derfor efter en kollega som:

Har 6+ års erfaring med C#/.NET og har bygget og drevet løsninger i produktion, ikke kun leveret dem
Har designet integrationer mod ERP (gerne Business Central), PIM eller økonomisystemer, hvor datamængder og ydeevne var reelle problemstillinger, du selv har løst
Er hjemmevant i event-drevne arkitekturer og asynkron beskedhåndtering (eksempelvis RabbitMQ eller Azure Service Bus) og kender faldgruberne: Idempotens, genafspilning og fejlhåndtering
Har lyst til at løfte, ikke kun dig selv, men også holdet omkring dig gennem review, sparring og mentoring

Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med Kubernetes/AKS, Elasticsearch, Redis, MongoDB, MediatR eller Azure DevOps, men vi forventer slet ikke, at du krydser alle felter af!

Lidt om Commerce

Din (måske) fremtidige afdeling i NORRIQ. I Commerce bygger vi på vores eget produkt. Det betyder, at du ikke starter forfra på hvert projekt, men er med til at videreudvikle en fælles platform af microservices, API'er og genbrugelige pakker, som lever hos en lang række kunder. Arkitekturen er headless, event-drevet og modulær, og vi lægger et abstraktionslag over infrastrukturen, så vi kan vælge den rigtige teknologi til opgaven frem for at være låst til én leverandør.

Til dagligt får du base på vores kontor i København, Aarhus eller Aalborg, og vi arbejder hybridt. Du bliver en del af et Commerce-team med backend-, frontend-, UX-, PIM- og QA-kompetencer, hvor du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med både arkitekter og projektledere.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Software Engineer og Azure udvikler

Har du evnen og interessen for at prøve kræfter med udvikling af komplekse Azure cloud-løsninger? cVation søger erfarne software udviklere til at indgå i vores voksende team, hvor høj faglighed, innovation og udviklerglæde er i højsæde.

cVation er et dansk udviklings- og konsulenthus, som bygger avancerede cloud-løsninger på Azure med afsæt i markedets hurtigste og mest agile metoder. cVation blev stiftet i 2014, har modtaget tre Børsen Gazeller og vundet Microsofts Partner Award for App Innovation tre år i træk. Vi arbejder dedikeret med agile arbejdsmetoder, DevOps og Test Driven Development, og er på forkant med mange af de nye teknologier, herunder IoT. Vi sætter desuden en ære i at levere software af den højeste kvalitet.

Hvilken rolle får du?

Du vil blive en del af et team, der designer og udvikler avancerede cloud-løsninger på Azure. Din rolle bliver bl.a. at rådgive om valg af Azure services, implementere og vedligeholde værktøjer, der sikrer continuous integration og continuous delivery og understøtter applikationsudviklingen. Vi har en meget høj release-frekvens i vores projekter, da brugen af vores egenudviklede tool CADD resulterer i ekstremt agile IT-projekter.

Udviklerne i cVation er samlet i teams på 5-8 udviklere. Du vil have fuldt fokus på et projekt/team af gangen. Ud over de hyppige releases til produktion har vi en ekstrem høj grad af automatisering af alt fra unit tests til integrationstests og UI-tests. Det betyder, at de repetitive processer er fjernet, så der er luft til at tænke innovativt, hvilket kommer vores kunder til gode. Kort sagt får de hurtigere udviklede løsninger af højere kvalitet og med en større forretningsmæssig værdi – og du får mulighed for faglig fordybelse og udvikle dig indenfor de nyeste teknologier.

Hvad forventer vi af dig?

Erfaring med cloud udvikling og særligt PaaS og IaaS services fra Azure, vil være en klar fordel.
Du har en kandidat i softwareudvikling
Du er erfaren i C#, og at du går op i kodekvalitet og at skrive testbar kode
Du har arbejdet med automatisering af test, build og release pipelines samt Infrastructure as code
Du er vant til at arbejde med versionskontrol, gerne Git
Du vil gerne arbejde med de nyeste teknologier i Azure med fokus på PaaS og IaaS
Du vil gerne indgå i et agilt setup, hvor krav og retning hurtigt kan ændres, men hvor medbestemmelse og frihed er i højsædet
Du taler/skriver flydende dansk, og taler/skriver engelsk på et medium/højt niveau.

Som person er du ansvarsbevidst, initiativrig, eksekverende og resultatorienteret. Du gør dig umage med dine opgaver og trives med at løfte i flok som del af et team. Hvis du også er engageret, nysgerrig, drevet af at lære nyt og sætter en ære i at dygtiggøre dig passer du perfekt ind hos os. Du må også gerne gå op i at forbedre både kode, værktøjer samt processer.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du kommer til at indgå i vores voksende team, hvor høj faglighed, innovation og arbejdsglæde er i højsæde. Det høje faglige niveau blandt dine kollegaer giver en unik mulighed for at arbejde med de bedste, og vi tager din faglige udvikling alvorligt. Vi har en flad organisation med et minimum af administration, hvor ledelsens døre altid er åbne, og der er god plads til både bordfodbold, fredagsbar, frokost på kajen og et aktivt liv udenfor arbejdstid. Flere gange om året afholder vi hackathons, hvor vi i teams dykker ned i præcis de emner, som udviklerne finder interessante. En del af vores kultur er også, at vi gerne ser alle komme med input til hvordan vi kan optimere, forbedre og udvikle cVation.

Hvorfor vælge os som din nye arbejdsplads?

Vores fundament er løsninger bygget på Microsoft Azure Cloud. Alle vores medarbejdere mestrer cloud-native udvikling og DevOps. Vi arbejder i projekter og engagerer os hands-on i fælles teams med vores kunder for at sikre kvalitet og effektiv videndeling.

Vi er passionerede omkring at hjælpe vores kunder med at få det maksimale ud af cloudteknologien. For os er cloud ikke blot infrastruktur eller et nyt datacenter i skyen. Teknologien giver virksomheder mulighed for at skabe væsentligt mere værdi og arbejde med agilitet og innovation på en helt ny måde.

Vi har været med fra starten, da cloud blev udviklet og tilgængeligt. Vi tilbyder således vores årelange erfaring og dybe cloud ekspertise samt en værktøjskasse med alle vores best practices i form af accelerationsplatformen CADD . Den dækker over gennemprøvede værktøjer, rammeværk, effektive udviklingsmetoder og færdige automatiseringskomponenter. Alt dette for at sikre, at projekter kommer hurtigt og sikkert fra start.

Vi har også etableret et CCoE (Cloud Center of Excellence), som løbende vurderer nye cloud services og opdaterer værktøjskassen med relevante opdateringer. CCoE arbejder tæt sammen med de enkelte udviklingsteams, som har fingeren på pulsen ude på kundeprojekterne.
Du vil få kollegaer, der er interesseret i at lære og har ønske om at blive de bedste til det, de gør.

Vi tilbyder derfor gode muligheder for at udvikle dig. Du vil blive en del af en virksomhed, som tror på, at alle har betydning, og at det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde hver dag.

Interesseret?

Klik på Easy Apply knappen, hvis du vil arbejde med de nyeste teknologier. Hvis du har under 5 års erfaring, bedes du også vedhæfte dine karakterblade i samme fil som dit CV.
Vi behandler din ansøgning fortroligt og arrangerer løbende interviews.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, eller vil du høre mere om cVation, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Maiken Pelby, Head of People & Culture, T/ 42612828, map@cvation.com

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

We are growing fast and looking for someone who wants to build the agents that put AI to work inside large organisations. Not just prototypes, but production agents that are secure, governed, and built to scale.

About KPMG NewTech

KPMG NewTech works with some of Denmark's largest organisations to put AI to work. Our team sits at the centre of this, operating across two areas that go hand in hand: we design and implement AI solutions and transformations, and we help organisations change how they work through AI adoption.

A big part of what makes us different is our NewPractice methodology, our approach to redefining how organisations build AI-native processes from the ground up. It is not about putting AI onto existing ways of working. It is about rethinking work itself.

We are a team that is motivated by learning, works efficiently and follows through. We are growing quickly, and the people joining will have meaningful influence on where we go.

What You Will Be Doing

You will build agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and stand up the governance that lets them run safely at enterprise scale. That means designing and shipping agents that solve real business problems, and putting in place the policies, guardrails, and controls that keep them secure and compliant across the client's environment.

You will work directly with clients, from the first design conversation through to a live agent that people actually use. You are equally at home in the build and in the governance model, and you understand that at enterprise scale the two cannot be separated.

A central part of the role is working with AI yourself. We use AI across everything we do: running our projects smarter, developing our methods faster, and showing clients first hand what good adoption looks like. You will use AI tools regularly in your own work and help build a team culture where that is the norm, not the exception.

In practice, that means:

Designing and building agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, from first prototype to a solution that is ready for production.
Connecting agents to enterprise data and systems through Power Platform, Microsoft Graph, and custom connectors and APIs.
Setting up the governance foundation that lets agents scale safely: environment strategy, policies, access and role models, and data loss prevention.
Defining and enforcing the guardrails that keep agents secure, compliant, and under control across the tenant.
Establishing lifecycle and quality practices so agents stay reliable as they move from pilot to enterprise scale.
Working directly with client teams to turn business needs into agents that are built well and governed properly.
Using AI tools actively in your own work and helping clients and colleagues do the same.
Building the reusable patterns, templates, and standards that make our delivery faster and better.

What We Are Looking For

You probably have 3 to 6 years of experience building on the Microsoft platform, from consulting or a similarly demanding environment. You know how to ship something real, and you focus on doing it in a way that holds up at scale.

More specifically, we look for:

Practical experience building with Microsoft Copilot Studio and the wider Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse).
A solid grasp of how to govern AI agents at enterprise scale: environments, policies, access and role models, data loss prevention, and security.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Azure, and how Copilot fits into the broader Microsoft ecosystem.
Comfortable working with connectors, APIs, and integrating agents with enterprise systems and data.
A structured way of working with a focus on quality: you prioritize doing things right, not just fast.

You use AI tools in your work today and are motivated to push that further.
Genuinely curious about agentic AI and where enterprise works.

Fluency in English and Danish.
A relevant master's degree with good results.

jobs.title: Senior AI Controls Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
About Phaidra

Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.

The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:
We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.
We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.
We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.

Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo , to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.

Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Agency, Velocity, Craft, and Truth. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture

Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR . Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India.

Who You Are

As an AI Controls Solutions Engineer, you'll play a critical role in operationalizing and scaling Phaidra's solutions for enterprise data center customers.

**We are seeking a team member located in the following areas: Singapore

Responsibilities

You will work closely with the Technical Program Managers (TPMs) and Data Scientists (DSs), as the technical experts for Phaidra's customers. Your role is to use Phaidra's platform and tools to put AI into production, leading complex, high-impact implementations across multiple customers and environments.

This role can be broken down into four concrete areas of responsibility:
You will use Phaidra’s products and your knowledge of the customers' needs to create a model of the facility for ingestion by our product lineup. This will require working closely with our Data Science team. You’ll understand the facility and configure our products according the facility and customer requirements. Then, you will commission and tune our products and assist in analyzing and triaging these systems in the support phase across multiple concurrent projects.
You will work with the product team to identify and define product requirements based upon each customer’s specification and needs. You will work closely with other AI Controls Solutions Engineers and the Product team to ensure our automated tools enable Phaidra to scale across thousands of customers. You will translate a combination of customer-stated and customer-implied needs into coherent needs documentation for use by the software development team.
You will provide ongoing support of deployed products, including support issue resolution and monitoring of performance across multiple customers. ****You will lead the deployment and support of multiple Solutions, perhaps in parallel. This includes resolving onboarding or support tickets by coordinating with the appropriate stakeholders or providing direct solutions. You will possesses deep knowledge of Phaidra’s pipelines and effectively identify and addresses issues and manage risks actively. You will analyze the performance and viability of your engineered solutions, as well as troubleshoot, triage, and analyze issues with control systems and equipment. You will possess deep knowledge of Phaidra’s pipelines to effectively identify and address issues and actively manage risk.
You will act as an internal and customer-facing SME, leading a range of initiatives, including the delivery of platinum support to customers, providing technical advice to research projects, and supporting sales and marketing efforts.

*This role can include 25% travel

Key Qualifications

10-15 years of work experience as a controls engineer, programmer, or equivalent
Possesses expertise in HVAC and Data Center cooling control methodologies and strategies and displays knowledge of chiller plant fundamentals, configurations, and sequence of operations.
Has the ability to operate independently as a senior member of the team, managing complex projects across multiple customers.
Understanding of applied thermodynamics for cooling systems, refrigeration systems, and hydronics.
Experience designing, programming, or strong working knowledge of industrial and commercial control systems and protocols such as BACnet and Modbus.
Understanding the applications and control strategies of air side chilled water and direct expansion cooling systems.
Strong proficiency in working with data center operations teams and contributing to solving field operations related problems and challenges.
Experience programming control systems with PLC, ladder logic, text, or block programming languages.
Passion for problem solving and using scalable solutions to solve repeat problems.
Good educational background in one or more related disciplines pertinent to your area of expertise. Example disciplines include Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Control Theory, Applied Mathematics and other various engineering and applied science fields.
Ability to read and write Python scripts (in collaboration with the software engineering team) to implement Insights and scrappy tooling.
Exhibits excellent communication skills and has the ability to explain complex domain specific concepts to non-domain experts and also explain complex AI and ML specific concepts to non-AI/ML specific customers.
Ability to own and manage large sections of documentation, fostering a culture of high standards in documentation and communication.
Ability to understand customers well and drive a culture of pragmatic urgency and customer satisfaction.
Ability to own project delivery within team, work as an independent contributor, and rally other individuals on the team to accomplish substantial tasks that cannot be completed independently.
Ability to mentor peers, delegate within team, handle project stakeholders, build relationships with other departments within Phaidra, and collaborate with their manager on the roadmap, backlog, and work planning.
Uses AI tools strategically to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and guide others in effective AI-assisted workflows.
Alignment with Phaidra's values: Agency, Velocity, Craft, & Truth.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Experience with rapidly prototyping new technologies and converting into commercially viable products.
Experience building, owning, and operating your own codebases/services.
Experience architecting services within cloud platforms.
Experience applying AI and ML in controls applications.
Experience with statistics, analytics, etc.
Experience with domain relevant optimization problems and solutions.
Familiarity with markup languages like Xml, Json, or Yaml.

Onboarding

In your first 30 days...
You will have a solid understanding of what Phaidra does and how we do it.
You will have met with team members across Phaidra and started building relationships that will help you be successful at your job.
You will have become proficient at navigating the Solution team’s processes and software tools.

By your first 60 days...
You will introduce yourself to our customers
You will understand our customer onboarding process
You will dig into Mort, our project workflow tool
You will build a toy system from scratch

By your first 90 days...
You will participate in troubleshooting issues
You will participate in customer onboarding and new system creation
You will create and refine business processes
You will attend site visits

General Interview Process

All of our interviews are held via Google Meet, and an active camera connection is required.
Meeting with People Operations team member (30 minutes)
Meeting with Hiring Manager (60 minutes)
Meeting with Data Science team member (30 minutes)
Meeting with Technical Program Manager (30 minutes)
Culture fit interview with one of Phaidra’s co-founders (30 minutes)

We use Kula as our hiring platform. During your interview, Kula's AI Notetaker will record a transcript of the meeting to allow the interviewer to focus on the interview, not the note taking.

Base Salary

Singapore Residents:
Tier 1 (CBD, Marina Bay, Orchard): 129,597 SGD - 194,396 SGD

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for equity. Final salary will be determined based on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, expertise, education and location. In some cases, final compensation may fall outside the posted range. Salary ranges are regularly reviewed and may be adjusted in response to market trends.

jobs.description:
About Finom

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round
(around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer
who thinks like a product builder, thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, and is passionate about creating robust, scalable financial infrastructure. You'll be part of a domain team where various engineering crafts (Backend, Frontend, Mobile, ML/AI engineers, and QA) work together to own and evolve a shared product area that delivers real value to hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

About You and What You'll Do:

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team where everyone contributes to solving the same customer problems. Above all, you're curious – about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

As a product-minded backend engineer, you don't just implement tickets. You understand the "why" behind what you're building, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to create better outcomes. You're comfortable discussing trade-offs with product managers, explaining technical constraints to business stakeholders, and collaborating with frontend and mobile engineers to design elegant end-to-end solutions.

You have deep expertise in .NET and C# with a strong appreciation for maintainable, scalable code, and distributed architectures. But more importantly, you know when to apply that expertise and when simpler solutions serve the product better. You've built data-intensive applications before and understand the concepts of working in a regulated environment.

You take ownership not just of your code, but of the outcomes. You move without being prompted, whether that's jumping into a customer issue, improving team processes, or mentoring colleagues. You're curious about adjacent domains – you might peek at the frontend code, ask questions about the ML models, or dive into analytics to understand how features perform.

Quality is non-negotiable for you. Automated testing, thorough code reviews, and security best practices are fundamental to how you work. You balance technical excellence with pragmatism, always keeping the end user and business goals in mind.

Your experience includes:

At least 5 years of professional backend development with a product engineering mindset
Excellent knowledge of .NET platform and C#
Hands-on experience architecting and evolving distributed systems in production
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, and engineers from other disciplines
Strong business acumen – you understand how your work connects to company objectives
Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences
A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code

Our tech stack

Backend: .NET/C#, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes, GCP.
You'll work alongside teams using React (Web), Swift (iOS) / Kotlin (Android), Python/ML frameworks, and modern test automation tools (Playwright, Appium).

Recruitment flow:

Recruiter Interview
First Technical Interview
System Design Interview
Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
Offer

What You Will Get In Return

Make a genuine impact on the product

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

Work in the EU

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Become a stock options holder

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

Receive unwavering support and care

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

Work & Swim program

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

As a Cloud-Native Software / Solutions Architect at Devoteam Creative Tech, you will take a leading role in designing, building, and evolving cloud-native application architectures for our clients. Design and lead the architectural strategy for cloud-native applications, ensuring high availability, scalability, and resilience in hybrid or multi-cloud environments.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a strategic mindset.

Solid grasp of security concepts, compliance standards, and DevSecOps best practices.
Excellent communication and leadership skills — ability to lead technical workshops, present to C-level stakeholders, and mentor teams.
Genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for AI — you actively experiment with AI tools and stay on top of the latest developments in generative AI, LLMs, and AI-assisted engineering.
Willingness to continuously learn and obtain certifications in cloud technologies and AI.
Fluency in Dutch or French, and English.

Technical Requirements

Languages & Cloud Platforms

Programming Languages — Java, Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript, or similar.
Cloud Platform Expertise — Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud with hands-on experience in cloud-native services.

Infrastructure & DevOps

Containerization & Orchestration — Docker, Kubernetes, AKS/EKS/GKE.
Infrastructure-as-Code — Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, or CloudFormation.
CI/CD Pipeline Design — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins.

APIs & Integration

API Design & Management — REST, gRPC, GraphQL, API gateways.
Message-Driven Architectures — Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, Pub/Sub.

AI Skills

This is an AI Augmented role.
The following AI competencies are mandatory:

Hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Google Gemini, Claude, or similar).
Practical understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and how to integrate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI) into applications.
Experience with or strong understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, pgvector), and embedding models.

Understanding of responsible AI principles: bias mitigation, explainability, data privacy, and ethical AI use.

Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Architect).
AI/ML certifications (e.g., Claude Architect, Google Cloud ML Engineer, AWS ML, Azure Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect).
Experience building AI agents or multi-agent systems (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
Experience with MLOps practices and model deployment pipelines.
Experience with serverless architectures (Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions).

Additional Information

Work on cutting-edge projects combining modern software development with AI innovation.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
A TestIT egy magyar kézben lévő, budapesti és 2022 szeptembere óta új pécsi irodával is rendelkező IT szolgáltató. 2016 óta foglalkozunk nagyvállalati informatikai fejlesztések támogatásával, tesztelésével és koordinációjával. Ezen felül vállalati szintű tesztelési módszertanok kialakítását és üzleti folyamatok automatizációját végezzük. A tesztelési és robotizációs kompetenciánk mellett a nagyvállalati projektmenedzsmentben is kiváló referenciákkal rendelkezünk.

A magyar piacon telekommunikációs, pénzintézeti, biztosítói és energiaipari ügyfeleink mellett nemzetközi projekteken is dolgozunk hazai csapatunkkal.

Csapatunk eredményeit saját belső képzési rendszerünkkel biztosítjuk, a jó kedvet pedig rendszeres munkaidőn belüli- és kívüli csapatépítő programokkal garantáljuk. A kölcsönös rugalmasság és bizalom tesz minket közösséggé, ahol a szakmai fejlődés nem elvárás, hanem kiugrási lehetőség.

Tapasztalt Quality Automation Engineert keresünk Innovation Teamünkbe, aki aktívan hozzájárul új tesztelési és quality engineering megoldások fejlesztéséhez.

A pozíció fókuszában olyan újrahasznosítható megoldások tervezése és fejlesztése áll, amelyek javítják a szoftvertesztelés, a termékminőség és a fejlesztési folyamatok hatékonyságát. A megoldások az adott problémától függően hagyományos szoftverfejlesztést, workflow-automatizációt, alkalmazott AI-t vagy ezek kombinációját is magukban foglalhatják.

Szorosan együtt dolgozol majd az Innovation Leaddel belső és ügyféloldali kihívások feltárásán, ötletek validálásán, valamint prototípusok és pilot megoldások fejlesztésén. A sikeres koncepciókat stabil, dokumentált megoldásokká fejlesztjük tovább, amelyek több projektben is alkalmazhatók.

Az adott kezdeményezéstől függően senior test automation engineerekkel, AI engineerekkel és más technikai szakértőkkel is együtt dolgozol majd.

Visszatérő tesztelési és quality engineering kihívások azonosítása és lehetséges technikai megoldások feltárása.
Tesztautomatizációs frameworkök, eszközök és újrahasznosítható komponensek tervezése és fejlesztése.
Prototípusok készítése új ötletek megvalósíthatóságának és várható értékének felmérésére.
Sikeres koncepciók stabil és mérhető pilot megoldásokká fejlesztése.
Automatizációs megoldások létrehozása hagyományos szoftverekkel, workflow-platformokkal, alkalmazott AI-jal vagy ezek kombinációjával.
Tesztelési, fejlesztési és vállalati rendszerek integrációja API-kon és automatizált workflow-kon keresztül.
Új megoldások integrálása CI/CD pipeline-okba.
Megfelelő quality gate-ek meghatározása, valamint a megbízhatóság, a teszteredmények és a hatékonyság javulásának mérhetővé tétele.
A fejlesztett megoldások karbantarthatóságának, biztonságának és tesztelhetőségének biztosítása, valamint megfelelő dokumentálása.
Új technológiák értékelése és gyakorlati alkalmazási lehetőségeik meghatározása.
Ügyfélprezentációk, technikai workshopok és presales tevékenységek támogatása.
Aktív részvétel új innovációs ötletek értékelésében és fejlesztésében.
Többéves gyakorlati tapasztalat tesztautomatizáció vagy quality engineering területén.
Magabiztos programozási tudás legalább egy széles körben használt nyelven, például Python, TypeScript, Java vagy C#.
Tapasztalat tesztautomatizációs framework tervezésében vagy jelentős továbbfejlesztésében.
Gyakorlati tapasztalat webes vagy API-alapú tesztautomatizációban és stabil teszttervezési ismeretek.
A regressziós tesztelés, a tesztek stabilitásának és karbantarthatóságának ismerete, valamint a különböző tesztszintek megfelelő alkalmazásának képessége.
Gyakorlati API-, Git- és CI/CD-ismeretek.
Szoftverfejlesztői szemlélet a kódstruktúra, automatizált ellenőrzések, hibakeresés és dokumentáció területén.
Gyakorlati tapasztalat LLM-alapú alkalmazással, AI-támogatott megoldással, agent-alapú workflow-val vagy modern workflow-automatizációs platformmal.
Képesség részben definiált problémák feltárására és gyakorlati technikai megoldássá alakítására.
Képesség hatékony munkavégzésre meglévő és újonnan kiválasztott technológiai stackekkel egyaránt.
Nyitottság új technológiák felfedezésére és azok objektív, gyakorlati értékének felmérésére.
Magabiztos magyar és angol nyelvtudás szakmai környezetben.
Webes, API-, mobil-, desktop-, contract- vagy performance testing eszközök és módszerek ismerete.
Workflow-automatizációs platformok, például n8n, Power Automate vagy Copilot Studio ismerete.
LLM API-kra vagy AI-agent alapú megoldásokra épülő alkalmazások fejlesztésében szerzett tapasztalat.
Agentic workflow-k, strukturált outputok, tool calling, RAG, MCP, AI evaluation vagy tracing ismerete.
Teszteredmények elemzése, observability és automatizált quality gate-ek.
Docker, cloud platformok vagy egyszerűbb webes felületek fejlesztésének ismerete.
Tanácsadói, ügyféloldali vagy presales tapasztalat.
Belső képzési és mentorprogramunkkal, valamint heti angol- és németórákkal támogatjuk szakmai fejlődésedet.
Lehetőséged lesz alakítani egy fejlődő innovációs terület technikai irányát, és valós tesztelési és quality engineering kihívásokon dolgozni az első ötletektől egészen a működő pilot megoldásokig.
Tapasztalt test automation és AI szakemberekkel dolgozhatsz együtt, különböző ügyfeleken, folyamatokon és technológiai stackeken. Ahogy az innovációs terület növekszik, úgy a szakmai felelősséged és a döntésekre gyakorolt hatásod is egyre nagyobb lesz.
A szakmai fejlődés mellett egy tudásmegosztó közösség része leszel, ahol számíthatsz a kollégák technikai támogatására, valamint a kölcsönös bizalomra, rugalmasságra és jó hangulatra.
Részt vehetsz túrákon, társasjáték-esteken, családi napokon, síeléseken vagy akár faültetéseken is, és bekapcsolódhatsz a TestIT társadalmi felelősségvállalási programjaiba.
A próbaidő után juttatási csomagot is biztosítunk: havi bruttó 60 000 Ft cafeteria, évi bruttó 600 000 Ft bónusz, valamint privát egészségügyi szűrések és járóbeteg-ellátási szolgáltatások várnak.

jobs.title: Director - Digital Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director - Digital Engineering will provide technical leadership across Qiddiya's core digital product streams, ensuring that all platforms, services, and digital capabilities are designed and delivered to the highest engineering standards. The role is accountable for ensuring that digital products are built with a reusable, scalable, resilient, reliable, observable, and extensible architecture that can be leveraged across multiple Qiddiya assets. This includes setting the technical direction, challenging low-level engineering decisions, governing solution quality, and ensuring that all delivery outcomes meet the standards defined by Qiddiya Investment Company. The Director - Digital Engineering will work in a multi-vendor delivery environment and will play a critical role in ensuring that vendors, engineering teams, and embedded technical leaders are aligned to Qiddiya's technology strategy, architecture principles, and operating model.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Engineering Governance

Lead the technical oversight of Qiddiya's core digital product streams, ensuring that all solutions are designed and delivered in line with Qiddiya's target architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technology vision
Define and enforce engineering principles around reusability, scalability, resiliency, reliability, observability, maintainability, security, and performance across all digital products and platforms
Ensure that all technical decisions are properly reviewed, challenged, and validated by Qiddiya, with clear ownership and governance over architecture and engineering direction
Act as a senior technical authority capable of engaging at low-level design, architecture, code, integration, infrastructure, and operational decision-making levels
Challenge vendor proposals, solution designs, implementation approaches, and technical trade offs to ensure that Qiddiya retains control over critical engineering decisions

Product Architecture & Reusability

Ensure that digital products are built as reusable capabilities that can be extended and adopted across multiple Qiddiya assets, rather than being designed as isolated one-off implementations
Drive the creation of reusable patterns, components, services, APIs, integration approaches, and engineering guidelines that support product scalability across the Qiddiya ecosystem
Partner closely with architecture, product, delivery, DevSecOps, cloud, and security teams to ensure that product delivery aligns with the overall digital target state

Leadership of Staff Engineers

Lead and manage Staff Software Engineers who will be embedded within product streams and work closely with vendor teams
Set clear expectations for Staff Engineers around technical governance, architecture review, engineering excellence, code quality, observability, resiliency, and vendor challenge
Ensure that Staff Engineers are actively influencing product delivery, reviewing technical decisions, and protecting Qiddiya's long-term technology interests
Build a strong internal engineering capability that reduces dependency on vendors for critical technical decisions and strengthens Qiddiya's ownership of its digital platforms

Requirements

Significant experience in senior engineering leadership roles, ideally within large-scale digital platforms, e-commerce, entertainment, travel, hospitality, fintech, or other high-traffic consumer digital environments
Strong hands-on technical background with the ability to challenge detailed engineering, architecture, integration, infrastructure, and implementation decisions
Proven experience leading engineering teams in a complex multi-vendor or system integrator delivery model
Strong experience governing the delivery of reusable digital platforms, shared services, APIs, and scalable product architectures
Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, DevSecOps, cloud-native architecture, observability, resiliency, reliability engineering, and secure-by-design delivery
Experience working with executive stakeholders and translating technical risks, trade-offs, and recommendations into clear business and delivery decisions

jobs.title: Chief Integration Architect
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the programme: the central integration layer, adapters to SAP and non-SAP systems, connectivity to the accredited service provider, interfaces to the reconciliation platform, and the security and deployment views. You are the technical authority who takes the design through the client’s architecture review board.

Key responsibilities

• Author the solution architecture document, solution design document (SDD) and integration/API design specifications; obtain approval from the client’s architecture/design review board and security function.
• Design the central integration layer — ingestion, orchestration, validation (PINT-AE/UBL), status tracking, ERP write-back and managed file transfer services — as cloud-native services on Kubernetes within the client’s private cloud / Azure tenant.
• Define integration patterns and standards (REST/SOAP/OData, IDoc/BAPI, events and queues, webhooks, polling, SFTP/MFT) exposed through enterprise API gateways (Azure API Management / webMethods) with mutual TLS and OAuth 2.0/OIDC.
• Lead requirements-confirmation workshops with AR, AP, tax and IT stakeholders across entity groups; own the interface catalogue and canonical data model.
• Ensure conformance with the client’s reference architecture and anti-pattern rules (no point-to-point integrations, no hard-coded credentials, no database-to-database access) and with non-functional requirements (throughput, latency, resilience, observability, performance at scale).
• Define the environment strategy (Dev/QA/UAT/Pre-prod/Prod), platform-service requirements and infrastructure-as-code approach; act as technical recovery lead in the BC/DR plan.
• Technically lead and review the SAP, non-SAP, ASP-connectivity and reconciliation-platform leads; run design and code reviews for architectural compliance.

Required experience and skills

• 12+ years in enterprise integration / solution architecture, including 5+ years as lead architect for integration platforms in SAP-centric landscapes.
• Deep expertise in API-led and event-driven integration, API management (Azure APIM, webMethods or similar), messaging/queues, MFT and cloud-native deployment (Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, IaC).
• Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA integration surfaces (OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, SAP Integration Suite/BTP or PI/PO) and non-SAP ERP integration (Oracle Fusion REST/SOAP).
• Working knowledge of UBL/EN 16931-based eInvoicing standards and the Peppol 4/5-corner model; UAE PINT-AE and FTA eInvoicing framework knowledge strongly preferred.
• Experience with enterprise IAM (Microsoft Entra ID, SAML 2.0/OIDC, SCIM), SIEM log integration, secrets management and zero-trust integration security.
• Ability to write and defend architecture at review-board level; excellent English documentation skills.

Nice to have

• TOGAF or equivalent; Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
• Experience with tax-clearance or B2B network integrations (Peppol, ZATCA, EDI).
• Exposure to AP automation / reconciliation platforms.

Why Faculty?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About The Team

Our Defence team is focused on building and embedding human-centered AI solutions which give our nation a competitive edge in the defence sector. We collaborate with our clients to bring ethical, reliable and cutting-edge AI to high-stakes situations and maintain the balance of global powers essential to our liberty.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Defence clients, you will need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work between 2 to 4 days per week on-site with these customers which may require travel to locations throughout the UK.

When not required on client sites, you’ll have the flexibility to work from our London office or remotely from elsewhere within the UK.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer in our Defence business unit, you will lead backend and edge/IoT engineering for critical work streams, implementing robust, scalable patterns. You’ll bridge the gap between machine learning research and production-grade software, raising the technical bar through hands-on contribution and peer mentoring.

Working alongside Lead Engineers and Data Scientists, you will scope and deliver high-impact solutions that provide immediate value to our customers in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

What You'll Be Doing:

Designing and building robust backend and edge/IoT components for diverse client deliverables across multiple software domains.
Scoping and executing bounded technical problems to ensure high-velocity delivery.
Shipping production-ready code in Python and at least one compiled language such as Rust, C++, Go, C#, or Java.
Implementing scalable CI/CD processes, containerisation with Docker, and deployments on Kubernetes or bare metal.
Mentoring and pairing with fellow engineers to share best practices and empower the team to deliver their best work.
Collaborating with Machine Learning and Data Science teams to operationalise agentic software and advanced AI tooling.

Who We're Looking For:

You possess strong hands-on experience in application development and a solid understanding of modern system architecture and design.
You have a proven track record of shipping code used by paying customers in both Python and a compiled language.
You are highly skilled in DevOps practices, including GitLab CI/CD, Docker, and managing applications in production environments.
You bring experience with agentic software development and a passion for understanding and solving complex customer problems.
You thrive when acting as a key contributor within a squad, taking ownership of technical challenges and elevating the team's output.
You communicate effectively with technical and commercial stakeholders, translating complex requirements into robust engineering solutions.

The Interview Process

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
**Wat ga je doen?**


Als Quality Engineer bij WILVO ben je de schakel tussen onze klanten en de interne organisatie op het gebied van kwaliteit. Dankzij jouw persoonlijke aanpak en betrokkenheid zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten optimaal worden geholpen bij kwaliteitsproblemen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het waarborgen en structureel verbeteren van de product\- en proceskwaliteit om aan de verwachtingen en specificaties van de klant te voldoen.


* Fungeren als verbindende schakel tussen Sales Engineering, Projectmanagement, Operations en Kwaliteit bij de introductie van nieuwe producten en klanten (NPI). Je zorgt voor een succesvolle en kwalitatief geborgde overgang van projectfase naar vrijgegeven productie.
* Analyseren en oplossen van klant gerelateerde kwaliteitsproblemen.
* Coördineren van interne en externe audits en zorgen voor de implementatie van verbeteringen.
* Samenwerken met verschillende afdelingen om procesverbeteringen door te voeren die de productkwaliteit verhogen.
* Opstellen en beheren van kwaliteitsdocumentatie en rapportages.
* Monitoren van klanttevredenheid en initiëren van acties om deze te verbeteren.

**Wat breng je mee?**


* HBO werk\- en denkniveau in een technische richting en affiniteit met de metaalbranche.
* Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie binnen de metaalindustrie.
* Uitgebreide kennis van kwaliteitsmanagementsystemen en \-methodieken zoals FMEA, 8D, P\-FMEA \& Auditeren.
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en klantgerichtheid.
* Analytisch denkvermogen en probleemoplossend vermogen.
* Beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Duits is een pré.

**Wat bieden wij?**


* Een salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring;
* Een 38 – urige werkweek en je weekend begint vrijdag al om 13:30 uur;
* Flexibele werktijden (start tussen 6:00 en 9:00 uur);
* Omzetbonus van maximaal € 2000,\- afhankelijk van bedrijfsdoelstellingen;
* Gratis deelname aan de personeelsvereniging die de leukste uitjes en feesten organiseert.
* Extra's die het werken bij WILVO nét wat leuker maken, zoals een gratis sportschool abonnement en fietsplan.
Afdeling
