**Werken \& Leren**
-------------------


**Ontwikkelen in je eigen tempo**  

  

Bij WILVO stopt leren nooit. Met de WILVO Academy® krijg je alle kansen om jouw vakmanschap te versterken, je kennis te verdiepen en nieuwe vaardigheden op te doen. Van specialistische technische trainingen en veiligheidscursussen tot leiderschapsontwikkeling en praktijkbegeleiding door ervaren collega’s, we investeren in jou.  

  



  

Jouw groei is onze kracht. Of je nu wilt doorgroeien naar een andere functie, je vak wilt perfectioneren of nieuwe technieken wilt leren: jij bepaalt het tempo. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat we elke dag een beetje beter worden. We geven iedereen binnen WILVO alle ruimte om zijn kennis te delen en over te brengen op anderen. Want, hoe mooi is het wanneer je een collega de hand kunt reiken en handvatten kunt bieden, die hem of haar beter maken?

jobs.title: Junior Engineer
jobs.description:
* Techniek
* Fulltime (40 uur)
* € 3\.730 \- € 5\.328
* Duiven
* HBO


  
*Deze vacature sluit op 01 november 2026*


Wil jij techniek combineren met maatschappelijke impact? Als junior engineer stationswerk werk je aan elektriciteitsstations die onmisbaar zijn voor de energietransitie. Je leert hoe je ontwerpen maakt, projecten voorbereidt en technische uitdagingen oplost. Dit betreft een functie voor 32 à 40 uur. Jij maakt het net duurzamer bij Alliander.


**Dit ga je doen**
------------------


**De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als junior engineer stationswerk**


Als junior engineer stationswerk werk je aan de renovatie, uitbreiding en nieuwbouw van elektriciteitsstations die een cruciale rol spelen in een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energienet. Je vertaalt technische vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen en zorgt ervoor dat projecten goed voorbereid en technisch haalbaar zijn. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's, aannemers en andere partners. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. Als engineer stationswerk draag jij hieraan bij. Zo houd jij je onder andere bezig met:


* het analyseren van projectaanvragen en vertalen van technische vraagstukken naar concrete ontwerpen;
* het verzorgen van vergunningen en technische documentatie voor een soepele projectvoorbereiding;
* het bestellen van materialen en bewaken van projectkosten;
* het afstemmen van werkzaamheden en plannen met interne en externe stakeholders;
* het signaleren van knelpunten en aandragen van slimme oplossingen voor een veilige en efficiënte uitvoering.

Om je een vliegende start te geven, krijg je tijdens de eerste maanden een opleiding in ons team. Na deze eerste periode werk je met een buddy die je verder begeleid in het doorontwikkelen naar zelfstandig engineer.


**Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander**
  

Wist je dat Alliander bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die samen werken aan een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energienet? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers in Nederland. Alles wat we doen, doen we met oog voor de mensen die op ons rekenen: onze klanten. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken we de energietransitie mogelijk, voor en mét onze klanten.

  

En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel Liander. Hier werk jij aan het beheer, onderhoud of de aanleg van onze elektriciteits\- en gasnetten. Veiligheid staat bij ons altijd voorop: jij zorgt voor veiligheid in je dagelijkse werk en wij zorgen dat je daarbij wordt ondersteund. Zo leveren wij op een veilige en betrouwbare manier energie aan huishoudens, bedrijven en onze andere klanten.


**Jij maakt het net energieker**


Jij brengt de juiste basis mee om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen het vak. Je bent nieuwsgierig, pakt verantwoordelijkheid en krijgt energie van samenwerken aan technische vraagstukken. Daarnaast beschik je over:


* een afgeronde mbo 4\- of hbo\-opleiding in een technische richting;
* minimaal 1 jaar relevante werkervaring;
* de motivatie om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen en nieuwe kennis op te doen;
* ervaring met systemen zoals SAP of GAIA, of de bereidheid om deze te leren kennen;
* een klantgerichte instelling: je begrijpt dat alles wat we doen uiteindelijk impact heeft op onze klanten en handelt daar ook naar.
  

**Voor jou net beter geregeld**


Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40\-urige werkweek:


* een salaris van € 3\.730,\- tot € 5\.328,\- bruto per maand (schaal 7\) afhankelijk van de ervaring vind inschaling plaats;
* jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past.
* 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, ruim aan te vullen vanuit je IKB.
* een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris.
* elk jaar een DI\-budget van € 700,\- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport of hobby, verduurzaming en vergroening van je huis, of het verlichten van je studieschuld bij DUO. Jij bepaalt waar jouw budget naartoe gaat.

Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over Alliander en al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden.


**Voor jou net wat meer informatie**


Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton op deze vacature! Binnen 5 werkdagen krijg je een reactie van ons. Een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van jouw sollicitatieprocedure. In onze screeningsvoorwaarden vind je meer informatie.


Meer weten over de functie\-inhoud? Thijs Schlief vertelt je hier meer over via \+31627740930\. En heb je nog vragen over de selectieprocedure of screening? Dan helpt Daphne Kleuver jou graag verder via \+31610767113\.

jobs.description:
Wij zijn Wildflowers, een high\-tech consultancybureau dat zich richt op het leveren van de beste engineers aan toonaangevende klanten door heel Nederland. Onze klanten werken aan innovatieve en uitdagende projecten binnen onder andere industriële automatisering, machinebouw, overheidsinstellingen en de high\-tech industrie.


Bij Wildflowers draait het om méér dan alleen inzet op een project. Wij geloven in duurzame samenwerkingen, persoonlijke aandacht en continue ontwikkeling. Onze engineers krijgen de ruimte om te groeien, nieuwe technologieën te ontdekken en zich zowel inhoudelijk als professioneel te blijven ontwikkelen.

**Bij Wildflowers groei je niet alleen \- je bloeit!**

**Wat ga je doen?**


Als Software Engineer werk je aan het ontwikkelen van geavanceerde softwareoplossingen binnen een high\-tech omgeving. Je vertaalt complexe technische en wiskundige vraagstukken naar robuuste, schaalbare en reproduceerbare software.


Je ontwikkelt algoritmes en modellen die direct impact hebben op fysieke systemen of productieprocessen. Denk aan parametrische modellering, optimalisatie\-algoritmes, data\-analyse of het genereren van aansturingssoftware voor technische systemen. Daarbij houd je rekening met performance, nauwkeurigheid, validatie en systeemintegratie.


Je test en valideert je oplossingen grondig, analyseert afwijkingen op basis van data en optimaliseert structureel waar nodig. In gereguleerde omgevingen zorg je daarnaast voor volledige documentatie, traceerbaarheid en naleving van geldende kwaliteits\- en compliance\-eisen.

**Jouw verantwoordelijkheden bestaan uit:**

* Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van technische software en algoritmes
* Vertalen van theoretische modellen naar werkende code
* Analyseren van systeem\- en meetdata ter validatie van resultaten
* Optimaliseren van performance, stabiliteit en schaalbaarheid
* Samenwerken met multidisciplinaire teams
* Documenteren van ontwerpkeuzes en validatieprocessen
* Een afgeronde hbo\- of wo\-opleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering, Technische Informatica of een vergelijkbare technische richting
* Ervaring met één of meerdere programmeertalen zoals Python, C\+\+, C\#, Java of vergelijkbaar
* Kennis van softwarearchitectuur, design patterns en gestructureerde ontwikkelmethodieken
* Ervaring met versiebeheer (bijv. Git) en werken binnen een CI/CD\-omgeving
* Affiniteit met systeemintegratie, performance\-optimalisatie en schaalbare softwareoplossingen
* Analytisch sterk en in staat om complexe technische vraagstukken te vertalen naar robuuste oplossingen
* Ervaring met werken in een Agile/Scrum\-omgeving
* Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands

**Wat wij bieden**

* Een vaste functie binnen een innovatieve hightech\-omgeving
* Een marktconform salaris, passend bij ervaring en senioriteit
* Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden
* Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, verantwoordelijkheid en groei
* Werken binnen een klein, informeel en professioneel team
* Een prettige werkomgeving met goede bereikbaarheid
* Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via opleiding, training en kennisdeling

Danny Oertel, HSE Manager


Jenny Seib, HR Business Partner

The company’s strength lies in its diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and Höganäs is committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS Billing
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Agreements team within AWS Billing is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team in Berlin.  

  

Are you interested in building the next generation, cloud\-based commerce system for AWS that’s used by millions of customers worldwide? Are you excited by the idea of building real\-time stream processing systems that operate at millions of records scale? Do you want to make an impact at a several\-billion\-a\-year business? Then we need to talk!  

  

Computing AWS bills, at its core, is a challenging, distributed systems problem that requires calculations performed over trillions of usage records, millions of accounts, and hundreds of thousands of different rates. Furthermore, our applications must meet strict requirements for accuracy and once\-and\-only\-once processing.
  

  

As a Software Development Engineer, you will own problems end\-to\-end — whether that's the agentic automation powering zero\-touch launches, the core data stores for agreements, or the systems that publish agreement and pricing information to AWS downstream clients. You will build on AWS technologies like DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and CDK, and collaborate directly with AWS service teams to deliver platforms that let them bring new products to market in minutes, not weeks.  

  

The Agreements team within AWS Billing is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) team which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring to market innovative products and services.
* Design, build and operate innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
* Build distributed systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
* Work in an agile environment to deliver high quality software.

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Artlogic is a leading technology platform for the art world. Founded in 1989, Artlogic empowers over 6,000 galleries, dealers, and art professionals worldwide to streamline their operations and grow their businesses. The company's integrated platform combines inventory management, CRM, websites, sales, marketing, and payment tools, everything needed to run a modern and successful art business.



In 2021, Artlogic was acquired by tech investors Cove Hill Partners to accelerate innovation and expand its global reach. Since then, the company has doubled in size, with employees across London, New York, Atlanta, and Cape Town.



Today, Artlogic is entering an exciting new chapter through its merger with ArtCloud, another industry leader in art technology. Together, the two companies are uniting complementary platforms to build the most comprehensive, forward\-thinking solution for the art world. This collaboration brings together deep expertise across CRM, sales, marketing, inventory, payments, and AI\-powered tools, empowering galleries, artists, and collectors worldwide.



Joining Artlogic means becoming part of a growing global team that is shaping the future of how art is bought, sold, and managed, both online and in person.



Our technology team comprises over 50 people across Product, UX and Engineering working in cross\-functional teams geographically distributed principally between the UK and Brazil with a technical operations team in the UK and South Africa. At present, our technology stack comprises a combination of Python, Typescript, C\# in Azure, GCP and AWS cloud environments.


**About the role**



We are seeking a pragmatic, impact\-driven AI\-Native Senior Software Engineerto help evolve and extend our platform while guiding technical direction and supporting team development.



This role centres on solving real\-world problems for art professionals, making thoughtful technical decisions that balance business impact with engineering trade\-offs. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and engineers to take ideas from inception through to production, ensuring we build the right solutions for our customers.



You will act as both a senior technical contributor and a product\-minded engineer, someone who doesn't just implement requirements but actively shapes them. You will challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and help ensure we are solving meaningful problems in the most effective way.



You will contribute to technical strategy by identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, performance, and user experience within our current architecture, while also supporting the evolution of our strategic platform.  

  

This role will play a key part in driving the adoption of AI across engineering, leveraging emerging technologies and embedding AI\-native workflows to improve how we design, build, and deliver software.



This role is predominantly hands\-on, with around 20–30% of time on technical leadership: architecture, mentoring, and shaping how the team works.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Help the team move faster by adopting AI\-native workflows and the shift to an agentic development lifecycle, without compromising the architectural qualities that make our platform reliable, scalable, and maintainable over the long term.
* Define guardrails, review practices, and validation gates that hold AI\-generated code to our standards for security, reliability, and cost\-efficiency (FinOps). These are first\-class concerns in agentic pipelines, not afterthoughts.
* Design, build, and operate software across our platform, applying the same rigour to AI\-augmented work as to anything else you ship.
* Embed deeply with Product and Design from the earliest stages of discovery, using rapid prototyping and iteration to compress the gap between idea and validated solution.
* Act as feature lead on a rotating basis, taking accountability for the development and delivery of a feature from shaping through to production. This means partnering with Product and Design on the approach, breaking the work down, coordinating the engineers contributing to it, removing blockers, and being the person who knows the state of the feature at any point
* Serve as a critical technical voice, stress\-testing AI\-generated solutions, surfacing second\-order risks, and ensuring the team builds the right thing, not just the fast thing.
* Shape platform architecture with an architectural lens, contributing to long\-term decisions about how AI tooling, LLM integrations, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls evolve across the stack.
* Continuously identify and exploit opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and user experience, using observability and analysis to find signals in noisy systems.
* Navigate confidently across legacy and greenfield contexts, applying AI tooling pragmatically to modernise where it matters most.
* Set the engineering standard, demonstrating through your own work what excellent looks like when much of the code is AI\-generated.
* Grow the team's capability and confidence with AI\-native practices, coaching more junior engineers to think critically about model outputs, prompt design, and the boundaries of automation.
* Define and evolve best practices for code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery in a world where much of the first draft is AI\-generated.
* Evolve CI/CD pipelines to incorporate agentic workflows, automated testing, AI\-assisted code review, and intelligent deployment gates.
* Champion secure by design principles across both human\-written and AI\-generated code, embedding security validation into the development pipeline rather than treating it as an afterthought.
* Own system observability and reliability, moving from reactive alerting to proactive, model\-assisted incident prevention.
* Participate in on\-call rotation, bringing the same rigour to incident response that you bring to day\-to\-day development.

  


**About you**
-------------



You're a hands\-on senior engineer with a product mindset and the judgement to know which trade\-offs matter. You care about business impact as much as engineering quality, and you've been building with AI tools long enough to know how to use them effectively.


**You'll likely bring:**


* Deep experience building scalable, secure, cloud\-based systems, giving you the foundation to confidently guide and validate agentic workflow outputs.
* Proven ability to work across both legacy and greenfield codebases, using modern tooling to improve reliability and evolve architecture pragmatically.
* Strong system design fundamentals across scalability, performance, and distributed systems, including API design (REST, GraphQL).
* Hands\-on experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, or similar) and a data\-informed approach to system health and reliability.
* Solid SQL and data management skills, with an appreciation for AI\-enabled, data\-driven systems.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, containerisation (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker), and DevSecOps practices in modern AI development environments.
* A pragmatic approach to testing, knowing what to cover, what to skip, and how to use AI to improve efficiency.
* Experience mentoring engineers and supporting the adoption of modern tools and AI\-native workflows.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade\-offs clearly.


**You'll stand out if you:**


* Ask "what problem are we solving and why?" before reaching for a solution.
* Act as a genuine partner to Product and Design, shaping the problem, not just delivering against a spec.
* Balance technical debt and feature delivery with long\-term business value in mind.
* Make confident decisions with incomplete information and thrive in fast\-moving, evolving environments.
* Bring curiosity and hands\-on experience with agentic workflows, using them to raise the bar for engineering..

  


**What we offer**


* Company profit sharing scheme
* 25 days annual leave (plus 10 public holiday days)
* Long service entitlement
* Flexible working
* Premier private health insurance including dental, optical \& EAP
* Childcare nursery benefit scheme
* Cycle to work scheme
* Tech buying scheme
* Free eye test
* Company pension scheme
* A focus on continued professional development including access to courses and training programs


**Artlogic is an equal opportunities employer**



Artlogic is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment and employment practices. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.



We are committed to making reasonable adjustments for disabled applicants and employees. If you have a disability and would like us to make adjustments to the application or interview process, or to discuss any adjustments to the role, please let us know.



Please note that this position is UK\-based and involves hybrid working with attendance at our London office for a minimum of 2 days each week, to support effective collaboration and engagement. Candidates must therefore have, or be able to obtain, appropriate immigration status entitling them to work in the UK for us in the role. Please note that we \[do not have a sponsor licence] and we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position. The successful candidate will need to provide evidence/information to enable us to verify their right to work, prior to commencement of employment, and in accordance with current Home Office right to work guidance.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
UTEC, Acteon’s Geo\-services business line, harnesses data to optimize designs, save time, and maximize your project’s economic value by providing a holistic understanding of the marine environment. Our insights underpin customers’ decision\-making from design to asset life extension, ensuring every decision delivers.

  

We are sourcing a Senior Software Engineer on a full time, permanent basis. Based at our facility in Wokingham, the Senior Software Engineer is to develop and maintain application software for UTEC leading line of products in line with the Software Manager. To ensure that the delivery team is supported during project delivery. These applications provide support for our in\-house developed Renewable and Oil\-Gas structural monitoring systems and services globally.

  

UTEC develops wide range of .net applications of which may be standalone or web based. These applications are used to implement a software stack to ultimately transmit time\-series data from acquisition devices over a range of network protocols securely to the internet or to direct to customer networks and servers. We also develop applications for data processing and analysis of data. User interfaces and data visualisations are also often required and developed.

  

The role requires a competent .net developer who has proven competence C\# application development in .net environment using WPF framework. Equally we require same developer to have skills in asp.net core Web\-page front and back\-end development using Razor, Blazor or related UI frameworks. Our applications are deployed on range of operating systems and often as containers running in cloud, hence some knowledge or familiarisation of Docker is required. We require at least basic network knowledge of TCP/IP networking concepts and client server interfacing. Further, supporting the network nature of our product line, knowledge of implementing REST API client and server interfaces for our clients is a must have.

  

Our client’s requirement often differs so we provide data interfaces presented via a range of protocols for example MQTT, OPC\-UA and Modbus. Knowledge of one of more of these would be an advantage but not essential.

  

Duties \& Main Responsibilities

* To form a core part of the Technology Agile Development Team, ensuring software development and bug fixing during each sprint.
* Working with the Senior Software Manager, Commercial IT engineers and Data scientists implementing the solution.
* To assist and support the Senior Software Manager to plan and deliver software scopes on time.
* To identify key bottle necks and escalate to Senior Software Manager, including providing support and solutions to remediate identified bottle necks/issues.
* To take ownership of resolving software deficiencies and supporting the delivery team in achieving their goals.
* Working closely with the Software test and System engineering teams to debug software and be accountable for their problem resolution
* Taking ownership with Software department to build and maintain the software platform.
* To mentor and support other developers as needed.
* To maintain and help develop s/w implementation and delivery process
* Utilising Azure Dev Ops and executing Epics, Users stories, bugs, and work items as part of sprint or backlog.
* To document the Software implementation and maintain change logs, keeping Azure work items status up to date
* Working with the Software/Firmware and Commercial IT teams to develop test strategies and platforms. Including Automated Software unit testing.

  

**Requirements**  

* Able to think long term implications of changes to software
* Able to work within a framework and utilize the Agile development process
* Able to write software in C\# for ,net and asp .net core.
* Ability to support the software design team providing guidance in respect to software testing and reliability.
* Ability to develop testing approaches for software.
* Skills in web development technologies such as ASP.NET is essential with Visual Studio.
* Understanding of deployment and containerisation technologies such as Docker.
* Data interface and protocol knowledge e.g. MQTT, Modbus, REST API, OPC\-UA Experience.
* Experienced in developing software for Windows systems (3\-5\+ years min) specifically in the Visual Studio Environment.
* Agile Development and Testing
* In\-depth knowledge of Bug tracking using tools such as Azure DevOps or GIT.
* Understand modular design patterns.
* Have worked with Docker Containers and .NET core ecosystems.
* Excellent communications skills both written and verbal.
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Eager to develop new skills and learn new technologies as the business requires it.
* Attention to detail
* Passion for solving problems
* Practical approach in thinking

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------



Would you like to help drive the growth and technical software delivery expertise of a global company that works with 91% of the Fortune Global 500? Are you an experienced engineer who is fluent with the latest AI and agentic tooling, thrives on AI agent\-led delivery, and can think on your feet to propose innovative solutions to challenging problems? If so, we have an exciting opportunity to join our Willis Neuron Technology team in the UK.



This is an exceptional opportunity to play a key role in developing the change capabilities of a global financial services organisation, where our delivery model is pivoting towards AI agent\-led development, and the focus is on practical delivery and reacting to the highest value business needs.



You will hit the ground running: building AI\-enabled products with large language models and modern agent frameworks and directing AI coding assistants to deliver at pace. You will turn concepts from our architects and product managers into working software quickly, challenge technical design and delivery choices, and bring the analytical rigour needed to take AI solutions safely into production.


**The Role**

  


* Design, build and productionise AI\-enabled features and services using large language models, RAG, prompt engineering and agent frameworks / orchestration (such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel).
* Take AI solutions beyond prototype, owning evaluation, testing, guardrails, observability, security and cost management.
* Rapidly prototype and validate ideas, turning concepts into working software within days and proving out how to build the solution properly at scale.
* Deliver hands\-on development of class leading web\-based applications and services, integrating AI capabilities with our existing platform (C\# / .NET, React and/or Angular, Python) and our Azure cloud and DevOps tooling.
* Direct AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) alongside your own hands\-on expertise, and rigorously review both human\-written and AI\-generated code against our architectural, development and security standards.
* Own delivery of a small suite of business\-related projects, ensuring architectural and solution alignment with the wider technical vision.
* Drive adoption of AI agent\-led delivery across the team, coaching others in effective and responsible use of AI tooling so the capability spreads.
* Challenge established development processes and procedures, particularly how AI agents are integrated into the SDLC, and work closely with the Engineering Leads on tooling adoption and delivery outcomes.
* Track AI and agentic technology trends outside the organisation and apply them pragmatically to our products, whilst developing deep domain knowledge.
**Qualifications**
------------------



**What you’ll bring**

  


**Essential Experience**

  


* Practical experience building with AI and agentic technologies: large language models, RAG, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks / orchestration (such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel).
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) in a professional delivery setting, and the ability to critically review, validate and secure the code they produce.
* Strong hands\-on software engineering experience (minimum 10 years commercial), with React and/or Angular, TypeScript, C\# / .NET and Python.
* Hands\-on commercial experience in Azure cloud, using GitHub and Azure DevOps, across all phases of the SDLC and Agile delivery.
* Proven ability to rapidly prototype and validate ideas, moving a concept from whiteboard to working demo in days.
* Demonstrable experience leading, influencing and mentoring through hands\-on contributions.
* Experience of working in a financial services organisation, preferably with exposure to the insurance industry / insurance broking. Where this directly relevant experience is not available, we will be looking for an ability to rapidly become effective in a new, unfamiliar environment.
* First\-rate communication skills, applied to rapid and creative problem solving with technical and business stakeholders in an occasionally pressurised environment.
* Comfortable working on your own initiative or as part of a broader project team, remotely or face to face, and confident challenging established approaches.

**Desirable Experience:**


* Experience running AI / LLM solutions in production at scale, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails and cost management.
* Experience designing or orchestrating multi\-agent workflows, and familiarity with agent protocols (e.g. MCP) for integrating AI agents with engineering pipelines and enterprise data.
* Experience with microservice based architectures and containerisation.
* Experience building and working with mathematical algorithms, or with geospatial, catastrophe or financial\-modelling data.
* Experience understanding and translating complex business processes across multiple stakeholder groups.
* BSc degree qualified in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Science or Computer Science).

  



The role offers hybrid working with travel to office expected on a regular cadence for meetings and workshops. Some occasional travel may be required as part of the engagement with business and technology stakeholders.


**What we offer**



Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

  



We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle\-to\-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

  


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

The SPTS division of KLA, designs, manufactures and markets wafer processing solutions for the global semiconductor and related industries. SPTS provides industry leading etch and deposition process technologies on a range of single wafer handling platforms. End\-market applications include micro\-electromechanical systems (MEMS), advanced packaging, LED, high speed RF device IC’s and power semiconductors. SPTS is part of KLA Corporation which develops industry\-leading equipment and services that enable innovation throughout the electronics industry. We provide advanced process control and process\-enabling solutions for manufacturing wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. In close collaboration with leading customers across the globe, our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers design solutions that move the world forward.
**Job** **Description/Preferred** **Qualifications**

KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA's metrology and inspection products, is looking a **Mechanical Design Engineer** to join the team based in **Newport, UK.**

**Purpose of the role**

We are looking for a **Mechanical Design Engineer** who is hands on, highly motivated, and a team player. The candidate will be engaged during the entire product lifecycle, from prototype to productization, and play a decisive role in the mechanical design and qualification of future KLA products.


The engineer will support the design, building, and qualification of a wide range of KLA equipment front end modules (EFEMs) and integrated components. The candidate will be expected to provide technical solutions for new requirements and sustaining existing product portfolio and create prototypes for design verification though to production release.


**Your day to day responsibilities will include:**

* Responsible for the complete mechanical design process, including requirements specification, feasibility studies, cost management, and scheduling.
* Collaboration with cross\-functional teams to determine design requirements, implement best design practices, and achieve functional product design solution.
* Design mechanical components in CREO Parametric 3D \- Pro/E CAD software.
* Conduct or direct CFD and FEA analyses to optimize Semiconductor Equipment airflow requirements, and mechanical design.
* Reduce 3D mechanical designs to 2D drawing and proper application of mechanical tolerancing/GD\&T to achieve desired fit and functionality of manufactured parts.
* Collaborate with suppliers to develop components and sub\-system assemblies that will expedite product development timeline.
* Work closely with suppliers to ensure parts and assemblies are built per design, and cost and schedule requirements are achieved.
* Participate in entire design/build cycle, including design, 3D CAD modelling, design review presentations, 2D drawing generation, procurement of prototype parts, system integration, and prototype testing.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Holds Degree level qualification in Engineering or related subject (or have equivalent level of experience)
* Experience in design using 3D CAD software, ideally Creo.
* Demonstrate ownership of both project level and task level work, comfortable to lead and drive mechanical design projects.
* Candidate will ideally have experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, including design principles, materials selection, and fabrication/machining methods.
* Experience with 2D drafting and tolerance analysis.
* Experience in several of these areas is desirable: CREO Parametric 3D MCAD \- Pro/E software, CFD airflow analysis; FEA analysis; Design for manufacture (DFM); Design of welded sheet metal structures and frames; Measurement instrumentation, testing and data acquisition; Programming in Python, C/C\+\+/C\# and/or MATLAB.

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*

Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA . Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
**A bit of background on Rotageek**
-----------------------------------


Rotageek helps businesses optimise staff scheduling through data\-driven technology. By combining machine learning and advanced algorithms, we help organisations forecast demand, improve workforce management and give employees greater control over their schedules.


Our solutions drive operational efficiency, improve customer experiences and help reduce staff turnover across the retail and healthcare sectors. Rotageek is now part of the ELMO Software group, strengthening our ability to deliver industry\-leading workforce management solutions as part of a broader HR technology ecosystem.


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we’ll let you in on a secret: there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate.


Rotageek is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

**Our values: what we live by**
-------------------------------


**Start With People**: You champion the customer experience, create psychological safety and help the whole team deliver with confidence.


**Own It, Together**: You take responsibility for quality outcomes, collaborate across disciplines and help turn incidents into learning.


**Clear Is Kind**: You make defects, risks, coverage and quality decisions clear, actionable and respectful.

**Why this role is so important**
---------------------------------


Quality is central to the trust our customers place in Rotageek. As a QA Engineer, you’ll help make sure our product works for the people who rely on it every day, from the journeys they take through the product to the data and insights they use to make decisions.


You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product and Data colleagues from the beginning of the delivery process. You’ll help the team identify risk early, design effective coverage and make confident release decisions.


This is not a role where QA waits at the end of the process. You’ll combine automation, exploratory testing and customer thinking to find the risks that matter most and turn learning into better ways of working.


You’ll also have the opportunity to use AI\-assisted testing tools to broaden ideas, generate scenarios and accelerate automation, while applying the human judgement needed to validate the results.

**️ What you’ll be doing**
--------------------------

* Collaborate on requirements and designs early, helping the team make features clear, testable and valuable for customers.
* Plan testing for features and epics, identifying risk, dependencies, coverage needs and realistic timelines.
* Execute exploratory, functional, regression and smoke testing across important user journeys and real\-world scenarios.
* Apply risk\-based testing, focusing depth where customer impact, data sensitivity or failure consequences are highest.
* Design and maintain reliable automated tests at the right level, integrating them into CI/CD for fast feedback.
* Manage test data and environments so testing is repeatable, representative and appropriately isolated.
* Investigate and manage defects through to resolution, with clear reproduction steps, appropriate prioritisation and thoughtful root\-cause analysis.
* Validate performance, reliability, usability and accessibility at feature level.
* Work with Data Engineering colleagues to validate data integrity, completeness, consistency, transformations and customer\-facing analytics outputs.
* Use test results, defect trends, logs and production signals to communicate quality, risk and release readiness.
* Contribute to incident learning, test reviews, retrospectives and improvements to our tools, coverage and processes.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Professional experience in QA or software testing within an agile product team.
* Practical experience with exploratory, functional, regression and automated testing.
* Experience creating and maintaining automated tests and integrating them into CI/CD workflows.
* Strong defect investigation, reproduction, triage and root\-cause analysis skills.
* An understanding of test data, test environments, quality metrics and risk\-based coverage.
* Awareness of performance, usability, accessibility, security and reliability considerations.
* Clear communication and confidence working with Engineering, Product, QA and Data stakeholders.
* A customer mindset: you care about whether a feature works for the person using it, not just whether the implementation matches the specification.
* The judgement to use AI and automation to increase coverage and speed while retaining human responsibility for quality.

**Nice to have, but not essential**
-----------------------------------

* Experience testing data\-heavy products, analytics features, reporting workflows or business intelligence experiences.
* Strong SQL and experience validating datasets, transformations, aggregates, completeness, consistency or lineage.
* Experience testing data pipelines, ingestion workflows, event\-driven integrations or cloud data platforms.
* Familiarity with data contracts, semantic layers, warehouse models or tools such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, dbt or ThoughtSpot.
* Experience testing multi\-tenant systems, row\-level security, permissions, PII masking or GDPR\-sensitive workflows.
* Experience helping Engineering teams design for testability and observability.


You don’t need experience with every tool listed above. We’re more interested in your testing judgement, curiosity and ability to learn.

**How you’ll work**
-------------------

* You engage early, rather than waiting for a finished build.
* You automate where it gives reliable value and use exploratory testing where human judgement adds something unique.
* You think like a customer and focus on the journeys and outcomes that matter.
* You are pragmatic about scope: thorough on high\-risk areas without creating low\-value over\-testing.
* You communicate clearly about coverage, uncertainty, defects and release readiness.
* You share knowledge, improve the test suite and raise blockers early so the team can keep moving.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

* The team gets fast, trustworthy feedback without treating QA as a late\-stage gate.
* High\-risk customer journeys have the right balance of automated and exploratory coverage.
* Releases are made with a clear view of quality, risk and customer impact.
* Data quality issues are found before they become misleading product or analytics experiences.
* We learn from defects, incidents and customer feedback, improving the way we build and test.
* Engineering, Product and Data colleagues see you as a partner who improves delivery.

**The tools and ways of working**
---------------------------------

* Test automation for web, API and service\-level scenarios in a .NET product environment.
* CI/CD\-integrated testing, Git and test reporting or quality dashboards.
* SQL and structured test data, with an interest in validating data flows and transformations.
* Logs, metrics and observability tools for diagnosis and production feedback loops.
* Agile planning, quality discussions, defect management and collaborative release decisions.
* AI\-assisted testing tools used with human review, validation and responsible data handling.

**Why you’ll love it here**
---------------------------

* Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
* Flexible, hybrid working, with collaboration across the team and time to focus when you need it.
* 25 days’ holiday, plus one extra day after three years, and your birthday off.
* UK bank holidays, plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve afternoons off.
* Private medical insurance with enhanced mental health, dental and optical coverage via AXA.
* Employee Assistance Programme — support when you need it.
* Life insurance at 2x salary and matched pension contributions of 5%.
* Two volunteer days per year — give back to causes that matter to you.
* Access to Mintago for financial wellbeing, discounts and expert advice.
* Retail discount scheme — perks and savings just for being part of our team.

**The hiring process: let’s make it personal!**
-----------------------------------------------

**Screening call:** A virtual chat with one of our team to learn more about your experience, what excites you about the role and how you align with our people\-first culture.

**Competency interview:** You’ll meet the hiring manager and talk through your approach to quality, automation, risk\-based testing, defect investigation and working with Engineering, Product and Data.

**Final stage interview:** You’ll meet members of the wider team and explore how you would help us improve coverage, release confidence and customer outcomes.

jobs.title: Erfaren .NET-utvecklare till penningtvätt
jobs.description:
**Att jobba som .NET\-utvecklare**


Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?


Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.


Några anledningar till att välja rollen:


* Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
* Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
* Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
* Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
* Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.

Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).


Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.


Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:


* utveckla och förvalta IT\-lösningar i C\#, .NET och .NET Framework
* delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
* bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
* arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
* genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
* felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
* dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

**För att lyckas i rollen**


Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C\#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.


Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.


Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI\-utveckling är meriterande.


**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.


Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!


**Mer om Banken**


Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.


Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.


**Vårt erbjudande inkluderar:**
  

* **Låna:** Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* **Spara:** Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* **Betala:** Lönekonto samt smidiga kort\- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

jobs.title: Fullstack ShopFloor Engineer
jobs.description:
About Horse Powertrain
  
This role is employed by Aurobay Technologies, Sweden, a division of Horse Powertrain Limited and is based in Sweden. Horse Powertrain Limited is an independent new powertrain solutions business, with over 125 years of heritage from Renault and Geely. We develop and produce world\-class hybrid and combustion engines and transmissions to move our industry forward, offering many different paths to net zero.
  
Horse Powertrain has 19,000 dedicated and determined employees, working in 17 manufacturing plants, and 5 R\&D centers on three continents.
  
Why join us?
  
At Horse Powertrain, you’ll have opportunities to grow your career while making a difference. This is a dynamic, international environment, staffed by caring and collaborative people. If you’re ready to create excellence with us, you’ll be appreciated and rewarded. As a Fullstack ShopFloor Engineer, you will bridge between factory automation and enterprise systems by developing scalable Java\-based middleware and fullstack solutions. You’ll work with modern technologies to connect production hardware, MES systems, and cloud platforms in a high\-tech manufacturing environment.
  
  

Skills and Experience
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent real world experience as the employer sees as relevant.
  
Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in IT manufacturing systems or similar roles.
  
Expertise in factory IT systems like MES (PRIME), SAP modules, PLM (Teamcenter), and data analytics tools like Databricks.
  
Strong understanding of IT infrastructures, including on\-premise server setups, public cloud platforms (e.g., Azure), and hardware specifications for smooth system operations.
  
Familiarity with shopfloor tools like PVS (Production Visualization Screen), PhotoViewer, and Q\-DAS.
  
  

Your role at Aurobay
  
  

**As a Fullstack ShopFloor Engineer you will:**  

Develop and maintain IT solutions that interface factory systems, hardware, and enterprise software using fullstack and server\-side technologies, with a focus on Java for middleware solutions (VD).
  
Build and expand modular middleware using Java for connecting factory hardware (e.g., Atlas Copco tools, PLCs, nutrunners, cameras) with enterprise systems like MES, SAP, and Teamcenter.
  
Deploy and optimize applications for both public cloud platforms (e.g., Azure) and on\-premise servers, ensuring compliance with hardware specifications and network dependencies.
  
  

Equal opportunities employer
  
We are an equal opportunities employer. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply, especially women, people from ethnic minority backgrounds, and people with disabilities. Research has shown that women and people from ethnic minority backgrounds are less likely to apply if they don't match 100% of the criteria. As a company, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. If you believe you have the skills and passion to excel in this role, we would love to hear from you. Let's explore the possibilities together.
  
How to apply
  
Deadline to submit your application is September 30, but the selection process will be running continuously. Please note that due to GDPR, we do not accept applications via email.
  
We can’t wait to see what you can bring to our team!
  
  

Questions
  
If you have any additional questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact recruiting manager Oscar Svensson, oscar.svensson@horse\-powertrain.com.
  
  

**Questions concerning trade union:**  

**Unionen:** Ordf Joakim Dahlin, joakim.dahlin@horse\-powertrain.com

* Utveckla, underhålla och optimera våra applikationer, som är uppbyggda i en blandning av Windows Forms och WPF (med XAML \+ MVVM) i VB.NET.
* Ansvara för databasutveckling i SQL Server med primärt fokus på att skriva, optimera och underhålla lagrade procedurer (stored procedures) samt komplexa queries.
* Delta aktivt i allt från kravställning och design till utveckling, test, implementation och support.
* Säkerställa hög kodkvalitet genom versionshantering (Git) och kodgranskningar, samt förvalta och förbättra våra CI/CD\-pipelines i Azure DevOps.
* Dokumentera lösningar för att bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar i systemen och vårt gemensamma arbetssätt.

###### **Kvalifikationer**

* Flera års erfarenhet av VB.NET (.NET Framework) och Windows Forms i komplexa miljöer.

* Goda kunskaper i Git samt erfarenhet av Azure DevOps (inklusive pipelines och CI/CD).
* God förmåga att sätta dig in i befintlig kod, förstå komplex affärslogik och se hur systemen bäst kan utvecklas framåt.

###### **Personliga egenskaper**

* Strukturerad och noggrann med ett öga för detaljer och kvalitet.
* Självständig och ansvarstagande med en naturlig drivkraft att föra projekt i mål.
* Kommunikativ lagspelare som trivs med att diskutera tekniska lösningar med både utvecklare och kollegor inom verksamheten.

jobs.description:
At ScioTeq, we develop advanced visualization solutions in a dynamic **high\-tech environment** for the **Avionics**, **Air Traffic Control** and **Defense** **\& Security** markets. To support the continued growth of our Defense activities, we are looking for a **Mechanical Engineer** to strengthen our team in **Kortrijk, Belgium**.


Are you passionate about mechanical design and high\-tech product development? Do you enjoy turning ideas and technical requirements into practical, reliable solutions?


As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development of advanced Defense display and console solutions. Working in a multidisciplinary team, you will be responsible for the mechanical design of products from concept to implementation. You will join a highly experienced team where collaboration, knowledge sharing and long\-term commitment are key.

**Your responsibilities**

* You develop and maintain mechanical concepts and CAD designs using **Creo Parametric**.
* You translate customer and product requirements into practical, reliable and cost\-effective solutions.
* You work closely with electronics engineers, production teams, project managers and suppliers throughout the development process.
* You apply your knowledge of materials, manufacturing methods and mechanical engineering principles to create robust designs.
* You support the integration of existing technologies and adapt proven concepts to new applications.
* You contribute to solving technical challenges related to design, assembly, manufacturability and product quality.
* You support prototype development and testing activities.
* You ensure that your designs meet quality standards, technical requirements and customer expectations.

 **Your profile**

* You hold a Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanics, Industrial Design Engineering or equivalent through experience.
* You have experience in mechanical design and product development.
* You have experience with parametric CAD software, preferably Creo Parametric 8\.0 or higher.
* You have a good understanding of manufacturing processes, machining techniques and design for manufacturability.
* Knowledge of thermal (FloEFD) and structural (Creo Simulate) simulations is considered a strong asset.
* Experience with Windchill or similar PLM systems is a plus.
* You are analytical and solution\-oriented.
* You take initiative and work proactively.
* You can work independently while being a strong team player.
* You enjoy working in a collaborative and multidisciplinary environment.
* You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a strong plus.
* You recognize yourself in our company values: Customer Focus, Teamwork, Trust \& Respect and Ethical Behaviour.

**Offer**


ScioTeq is a growing international environment where innovation is key and where motivated colleagues work together on technologies that make a difference.


Our headquarters in Kortrijk are easily accessible by car, bike and public transport.


We offer a competitive salary, complemented by extra\-legal benefits:

* Meal vouchers of €9
* Internet allowance of €60 net
* Yearly bonus
* Group insurance
* Medical insurance
* Flexible salary plan with possibilities for a lease car, electric bicycle, tablet, etc.


In addition, we invest in personal growth by offering various training opportunities throughout the year ('Everyone Learns' program, Mtech\+ training courses, IT Awareness training, Viva Learning, on the job training \& much more).


Furthermore, we value a healthy work\-life balance and promote this by offering flexible working hours, possibility to work from home and 32 vacation days.


 If you join the ScioTeq family, you can also attend various events and activities (like for example a Company Celebration, Out of office party, Quizzes, buddy walks, …) that enhance the team spirit.

jobs.title: Developer .Net/Java (m/ž)
jobs.description:
#### **Chcete být u zrodu nového stavebního projektu? Do našeho útvaru investiční výstavby hledáme nového kolegu pro přípravu a realizaci nového výrobního a administrativního areálu Státní tiskárny cenin, s. p.****Hledáme samostatnou osobnost se zkušenostmi v oblasti přípravy a realizace stavebních projektů a chutí podílet se na projektu od prvotního návrhu až po jeho uvedení do provozu.**

#### **Co bude Vaše náplň práce?**

* Příprava, plánování a koordinace projektu výstavby nového závodu včetně zpracování návrhů záměrů a podkladů pro rozhodnutí vedení podniku.
* Příprava a koordinace výběrových řízení souvisejících se stavebními částmi projektu.
* Příprava smluv ve spolupráci s právním oddělením a dohled nad dodržováním smluvních podmínek.
* Dohled nad finančním čerpáním ze smluv, fakturaci a zajištění řízení změn.
* Spolupráce s projektanty, zhotoviteli a s technickým dozorem.
* Koordinace přípravy technických podkladů ve spolupráci s interními týmy a externími dodavateli, zajištění návaznosti projektové dokumentace napříč fázemi projektu.
* Kontrola a řízení zpracování projektové dokumentace ve všech stupních včetně řízení přípravy podkladů pro stavební povolení a jiná správní rozhodnutí.
* Zajištění komunikace mezi účastníky projektu, vedení kontrolních dnů a odpovědnost za předávání podkladů a výstupů v souladu s harmonogramem projektu.
#### **Co požadujeme?**

* SŠ nebo VŠ vzdělání stavebního směru.
* Praxe v oblasti přípravy a řízení stavebních projektů nejméně 5 let (SŠ vzdělání) nebo 2 roky (VŠ vzdělání).
* Znalost stavební legislativy a souvisejících předpisů.
* Orientace v projektové dokumentaci, rozpočtech a harmonogramech.
* Uživatelská znalost MS Office a nástrojů pro práci s projektovou dokumentací (např. AutoCAD).
* Řidičský průkaz skupiny B.
* Organizační, komunikační a vyjednávací schopnosti, schopnost týmové spolupráce i samostatného rozhodování.
* Schopnost plánování, kontroly a vyhodnocování projektových činností.
* Důslednost, zodpovědnost, proaktivita a orientace na kvalitu a výsledek.
#### **A co Vám za to nabídneme my?**

* Práci na plný úvazek a dlouhodobou spolupráci.
* Různorodou práci a příležitost získat mnoho zkušeností.
* Služební automobil i k osobnímu užívání.
* 5 týdnů dovolené a až 8 dnů placeného volna navíc v roce 2026\.
* Pružnou pracovní dobu v délce 7,5 hod. a pracoviště v centru Prahy nedaleko Václavského náměstí.
* Příspěvek na penzijní spoření a životní investiční pojištění.
* Čerpání příspěvků z Fondu kulturních a sociálních potřeb prostřednictvím systému Cafeterie.
* Možnost Multisport karty za zvýhodněnou cenu.
* Po plném zaučení občasný home\-office.
* Stravenkový paušál a firemní kantýnu přímo v budově.
* Dotované vzdělávání v rámci pracovní doby.
* Odměnu za odpracované roky (za každých 5 let) nebo při významném jubileu.
* Pojištění zaměstnanců za škodu způsobenou zaměstnavateli.
* Možnost pobytu v našich rekreačních zařízeních a hotelích/lázeňských domech VOLAREZA za zvýhodněných podmínek.
* Nástup možný ihned nebo dle dohody.
* Smlouvu na dobu určitou jednoho roku, poté prodloužení v případě spokojenosti.


Výhradně kvůli plynulosti inzertního textu je popis pracovní nabídky psán v jednom rodě. Státní tiskárna cenin, s. p. tím neupřednostňuje žádného kandidáta nebo kandidátku. Všechna došlá CV budou posuzována z hlediska kvalifikačních požadavků, a nikoliv na základě jakéhokoliv jiného hlediska, které by mohlo být považováno za diskriminační.



Státní tiskárna cenin, s. p. si vyhrazuje právo zrušit, přerušit toto výběrové řízení kdykoliv v jeho průběhu nebo nevybrat žádného uchazeče.



Uchazeči sami nesou náklady, které jim účastí ve výběrovém řízení vzniknou.

jobs.title: ATS Research Fellowship: Applied Physics and Engineering
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, physicists and engineers are probing the fundamental structure of the universe. Using the world's largest and most complex scientific instruments, they study the basic constituents of matter \- fundamental particles that are made to collide together at close to the speed of light. The process gives physicists clues about how particles interact, and provides insights into the fundamental laws of nature. Find out more on http://home.cern.ch

*Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization.*

 **Job Description** **Job Overview:**


We are offering one post\-doctoral research position in the field of applied physics and engineering. The successful candidates will be working in the Accelerator Systems departments of CERN. They will be performing research in the field of Accelerator Physics and System Design, including but not limited to:  

* Design, develop and optimise beam transfer systems supporting CERN's accelerator complex and future accelerator projects.
* Perform accelerator physics studies, including beam optics design, particle tracking and multi\-physics simulations, to support system design, validation and performance optimisation.
* Develop functional specifications for beam transfer systems based on accelerator physics requirements and engineering constraints.
* Develop and implement modern commissioning strategies using automation, numerical optimisation and data\-driven techniques.
* Analyse beam and system performance to improve beam quality, operational efficiency and system reliability.
**Candidate Profile:**

* You have a strong background in applied physics, engineering or a closely related field.
* You have research experience in applied physics and engineering, ideally linked to the design, development or operation of experimental systems.
* You are interested in pursuing a career in research or academia and in taking an active role within a research project.
* You are motivated to contribute to large\-scale experimental programmes in an international research environment.

**Technical Skills:**

* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills applied to experimental systems and technologies.
* You are able to work collaboratively within large, international and multidisciplinary teams.
* You communicate effectively in a scientific and technical environment.
* You are able to work independently while contributing to shared project objectives.
* Your PhD is in the fields of Applied Physics and Engineering.

 **Additional Information**  

CERN would very much like to benefit from your expertise, commitment and passion. In return, CERN will provide you with:

* An employment contract for in principle 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months.
* A stipend of 7004 Swiss francs per month (net of tax).
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Depending on your individual circumstances: an installation grant, family, child and infant allowances as well as travel expenses to and from Geneva.
* 2\.5 days of paid leave per month.

**Your future Life @CERN**


Get a glimpse of what it’s like to work at CERN: https://careers.cern/benefits and https://careers.cern/our\-people

**All applications should reach us no later than 05\.10\.2026** **at midnight (23:59 PM CET).**


Please note that all the documents you upload will remain attached to your Smartrecruiters profile. You do not need to upload them again for other applications you might submit.

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 7004 or 7425 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On\-the\-job and formal training including language classes.

**Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria**

* You are a national of a CERN Member State or Associate Member State. Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot and Croatian nationals, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached. A few exceptions are possible annually.
* By the application deadline, you have a PhD (or will obtain it within six months), and no more than 3 years’ research experience after completion of your PhD degree. Candidates with experience up to 6 years may exceptionally be considered.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* You have a good knowledge of English or French.
* Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.
* Please ensure that your application is submitted under the field of work indicated in the position title, as Experimental Physics, Applied Science and Engineering and Theoretical Physics are separate recruitment processes. All open positions within the programme are available on the Research Fellowship Programme page.

**You will need these documents to complete your application**

* Your CV (English or French)
* A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your school (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)
* Three recent letters of recommendation (not older than one year at the application deadline) outlining your academic and/or professional achievements, indicating the professional relationship from the referee to you. After submitting your application, you will receive a submission link to forward to your referees; letters must be uploaded confidentially before the closing date (uploading letters yourself is possible but discouraged).

**Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**

**More information about us,** **here**
