With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About The Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs.
Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction.
Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability.
Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment.
Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost.
Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & Background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.
Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices.
Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, and API design using REST and GraphQL.
Practical experience with Git branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.

AI-powered Engineering (required)

Deep, hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI coding tool such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work.
Practical fluency with AI productivity tools across the broader workflow: LLM chat assistants for design and review, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, and research.
Ability to design effective context for AI agents — writing good prompts, structuring repos and docs (e.g. CLAUDE.md / rules files) so agents perform well, and knowing when to delegate vs. when to drive manually.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and the broader pattern of connecting AI agents to internal tools, data sources, and services.
Awareness of the security, privacy, IP, and quality risks of AI-assisted development, and opinions on how to mitigate them at an organizational level.
Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities and agent-based components into backend products and workflows is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Erfaren .NET-utvecklare till penningtvätt
jobs.description:
Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.

Några Anledningar Till Att Välja Rollen

Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.

Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).

Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.

Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och förvalta IT-lösningar i C#, .NET och .NET Framework
delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.

Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI-utveckling är meriterande.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om Banken

Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.

Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.

Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar

Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

Join EQT Tech’s Architectural function, where you’ll play a critical role in future-proofing and scaling one of our cross-functional value streams—Fintech.

This is a unique opportunity to design and drive the technology supporting our financial operations — ensuring seamless integrations, efficiency, and innovation. If you're a strategic thinker with a strong technical foundation and a passion for designing scalable systems, we’d love to hear from you.

About The Tech Team – Fintech Value Stream

The Fintech Value Stream strives to improve and automate key financial processes to deliver a best-in-class experience for a broad range of business domains. We’re a cross-functional team collaborating closely with stakeholders across EQT to ensure data and technology strategically support business outcomes. Our team includes tech leads, data professionals, product managers and architects who together shape the future of finance operations through scalable, data-driven solutions.

What You’ll Do

As a Software and Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping EQT’s technical landscape within the Fintech Value Stream. Your primary responsibility will be to collaborate with Tech Leads, Engineers, and external partners to design and implement solutions that drive efficiency and scalability across EQT’s investment technology.

Beyond your work in the Fintech Value Stream, you'll also collaborate closely with peers in the Architecture function to shape EQT Tech's long-term architectural direction, ensuring consistency, reusability, and strategic alignment across value streams.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with tech leads and engineers to support the Fintech Value Stream in new projects & initiatives, engaging in technical discussions with both third-party service providers and internal teams to ensure a structured approach to solution development
Assess the current architecture, team capabilities, and resource allocation to determine the best approach for future implementations
Develop new architectural solutions and enhance existing ones to ensure they are harmonized, scalable, and efficient for all of EQT
Establish technical standards, best practices, and improved ways of working across EQT’s Tech teams
Collaborate with other Value Streams (Investment & Client) and Platform Teams to define interfaces, ownership, and capabilities within the Fintech domain
Design system integrations, ensuring seamless connectivity between internal systems, new external systems, and vendors
Work closely with the Head of Architecture and the Head of Fintech, supporting key strategic initiatives

Who are you?

We’re looking for an experienced Software and Solution Architect with a strong technical foundation and a strategic mindset. You should have a passion for problem-solving, system design, and technical leadership. You likely have 8–12 years of experience across software engineering and architecture, including time spent designing systems in regulated or data-sensitive environments.

Desired Skills & Experience

Strong software engineering background, with hands-on experience designing and maintaining complex, high-availability systems that handle sensitive data
Strong understanding of system integrations, APIs, and data architectures
Proven ability to drive implementation from initial requirements to high-level solution design and progress tracking
Strong leadership and coaching skills, with the confidence to take a firm stance in technical discussions
Excellent communication skills, able to engage effectively with key stakeholders and external partners
Proactive mindset, with a desire to learn, adapt, and drive continuous improvement
Curiosity about applying AI and advanced analytics to drive business value and innovation

Nice-to-haves

Hands-on experience with modern data stacks and frameworks (e.g., dbt, Snowflake, SQL, Fivetran)
Familiarity with financial systems such as Netsuite, Kyriba, Hazeltree, MRI, or Aaro, and BI tools like PowerBI or Hex

What We Offer

A fast-paced and dynamic work environment at a leading global investment firm
The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and develop the future of EQT’s financial tools
A collaborative and inclusive company culture where innovation is encouraged
Regular hackathons, workshops, and learning opportunities to develop new skills
Competitive compensation and benefits package
A vibrant office environment in central Stockholm

Inclusion at
EQT

Our vision for EQT employees is to build high performing & engaged teams. Our competitive edge comes from fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, empowered, and motivated to drive business impact. Our commitment to inclusion is not just about fairness; We understand and believe that being a great place to work drives the best performance.At EQT, inclusion is a business imperative and it's embedded into our talent strategy, decision-making, and culture to ensure that every individual and team operates at their full potential. By doing so, we unlock better collaboration, stronger innovation, and superior investment outcomes.

About EQT

EQT is a purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of over three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start-up to maturity. EQT has EUR ‌ 270 billion in total assets under management (EUR ‌ ‌141 billion in fee-generating assets under management), within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.

With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does. Är du en ingenjör som hellre automatiserar ett problem än löser det två gånger? Vill du vara med och bygga plattformen som levererar livsavgörande IT-system till sjukvården – snabbare, säkrare och mer repeterbart för varje release?

Här bygger vi verktygen, koden och processerna som gör att våra molnbaserade lösningar kan sättas upp och driftas på ett standardiserat sätt över hela världen. Vi letar efter dig som drivs av att förenkla, standardisera och ta bort manuella moment – och som vill se resultatet av ditt arbete varje dag i den operativa leveransen. Vi är på väg mot ett arbetssätt med mer DevOps och platform engineering – och du blir en av dem som bygger vägen dit.

Utveckla och förvalta automation för uppsättning av nya kundsystem – från infrastruktur och konfiguration till installation av våra medicinska IT-produkter.
Bygga automation och verktyg för operations så att återkommande driftmoment blir självbetjänade, förutsägbara och spårbara i stället för manuella.
Arbeta nära våra driftteam för att identifiera var tiden faktiskt går och omsätta det i konkreta förbättringar i kod och process.

Hos oss får du en roll som kombinerar teknisk utveckling med verklig operativ förankring. Du blir en del av ett erfaret och kompetent team där kunskapsdelning, kodgranskning och samarbete står i fokus.

Utveckling av automation och scripting för installation, konfiguration och uppgradering av våra system.
Design av standardiserade, återanvändbara lösningar som gör leveransen likadan oavsett kund och geografi.
Förbättring av arbetsflöden i drift genom verktyg, pipelines och infrastructure as code.
Felsökning och grundorsaksanalys – och att bygga bort problemet så att det inte återkommer.

,

Vi söker dig som har

En BSc eller MSc inom Datateknik, Teknisk Fysik, Medieteknik eller motsvarande.
Ett genuint intresse för kodning och automation – du behöver inte vara renodlad utvecklare, men du ska trivas med att lösa problem med kod.
Förståelse för hur IT-miljöer hänger ihop: virtualisering, nätverk, operativsystem och databaser.

Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Erfarenhet av scripting och automation, exempelvis PowerShell, Python, Bash eller Ansible/Terraform.
Kunskaper inom CI/CD pipelines, versionshantering, containerteknik eller infrastructure as code.
Kompetenser inom IT-säkerhet, virtuella Windows- eller Linux-miljöer, MS SQL Server AlwaysOn, Active Directory, lagringslösningar och MS Azure.
Tidigare erfarenhet av projekt i internationella miljöer.
Intresse eller engagemang utanför arbetet, exempelvis idrott, musik eller ideellt arbete.

Möjlighet att bygga automation som gör verklig skillnad för patienter och vårdgivare.
En roll där du får se dina lösningar användas skarpt, varje dag, av kollegor runt om i världen.

Ett team av engagerade och erfarna kollegor som stöttar och utmanar dig.

A specialist in identity, secure transactions, and digital services, IN Groupe is the global leader in secure identity and trust services. Every day, our 4,000 employees across 40 countries work to ensure that everyone has access to a reliable and secure identity, both in the physical and digital worlds. With our solutions and our international network of 10 R&D centers, we support governments and businesses in more than 130 countries.
Joining IN Groupe means helping to shape the future of the identity and secure transaction market. Become part of our international teams — driven by innovation and proud to design solutions that make life easier and protect personal data for millions of people around the world.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior backend engineer
to join our Stockholm office with strong, hands‑on expertise in modern Java, experienced in building and maintaining distributed systems and microservices. Brings solid proficiency in CI/CD and Azure DevOps (or comparable platforms), along with practical knowledge of cloud environments, containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, automated testing practices, and operating services reliably in production.

Wallenius Wilhelmsen is a global leader in roll-on/roll-off (RoRo) shipping and vehicle logistics, operating 125 vessels and 66 processing centers across six continents. With 9,500 employees in 28 countries, we move cars, trucks, and heavy machinery worldwide- sustainably and efficiently. Our ambition is clear: to be carbon-neutral by 2040.

To achieve this, we are driving a large-scale digital transformation across all parts of our business. The Shipping D365 CE architect plays a key role in this journey, connecting our global operations through modern, integrated technology built on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform.

As Shipping D365 CE architect, you will take a leading role in shaping the technology architecture that supports Wallenius Wilhelmsen’s global shipping operations. You’ll translate business needs across areas such as capacity planning, booking management and vessel operations into scalable, secure and future-ready digital solutions.

You’ll collaborate closely with business stakeholders, digital leads, and engineering teams to ensure that technology decisions align with enterprise architecture, support operational excellence and enable sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Define and maintain the solution and domain architecture for the Shipping area within the Dynamics 365 and Power Platform ecosystem.
Ensure that all solutions meet business objectives, technical standards, and security and compliance requirements.
Translate functional and operational needs into practical technical designs and roadmaps.
Guide and support developers and project teams through design and implementation.
Identify potential risks, performance challenges, or architectural gaps, and propose mitigation strategies.
Contribute to the overall enterprise architecture and digital transformation roadmap across the organization.

Your profile

5+ years’ experience as a Solution or Domain Architect, preferably within shipping, logistics, or complex operational environments.

Proven expertise with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Azure integration services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid).

Solid understanding of shipping and logistics processes such as capacity planning, booking management, and operational scheduling.

Strong collaboration and communication skills – able to connect business goals with technical execution.

Degree in Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Experience in enterprise-scale digital transformation projects is highly valued.

Why join us

At Wallenius Wilhelmsen, you’ll join a company that combines deep maritime expertise with a strong digital vision. You’ll be part of a global transformation, building the next generation of systems that power sustainable logistics and shipping worldwide.

Who We Are

At Wallenius Wilhelmsen, you'll join a global leader in shipping and logistics with more than 9,000 colleagues across 28 countries. Together, we help move vehicles, equipment, and goods around the world through innovative and sustainable solutions. Our ambition is to lead the way in transforming shipping and logistics.

jobs.title: Business Application Architect
jobs.description:
Would you like to use your skills to accelerate the global transition to a low-carbon circular economy?

About Cambi

Cambi is a world-leading provider of sustainable technology solutions that enable cities to turn wastewater sludge into valuable resources. We are a medium-size, Norway-based multinational company listed in Oslo on Euronext Growth, with offices in several countries. We have diligent employees from different backgrounds and more than 25 nationalities, and a growing sales network covering all continents.

Our core expertise lies in designing, testing, manufacturing, installing, and operating industrial process installations, used mainly for treating sewage sludge before or after anaerobic digestion in wastewater treatment plants. The technology, known as thermal hydrolysis, reduces greenhouse gas emissions and produces renewable energy, organic fertilizers, and various soil products while destroying pathogens and other harmful substances. Our systems have the capacity to cater to over 120 million individuals across more than 28 countries. We are proud of having cities like Oslo, London, Washington, Singapore, and Sydney among our clients.

About The Role

As a Business Applications Architect, you will be the technical owner of Cambi's Microsoft 365 landscape, ERP, CRM, and the integrations connecting them. You will translate business needs into platform functionality, aligned with the strategic direction for each system, and own the overall technical architecture across the full life-cycle of the platforms and their integrations – from design and implementation to ongoing evolution. This includes safeguarding the integrity, quality, and availability of the company's data as it flows across these platforms. The responsibility spans from high-level architectural direction to hands-on technical implementation, ensuring that strategic intent and operational detail remain consistently connected.

Key Responsibilities

Technically own the core business platforms and execute life-cycle enhancements to create business value.
Define and maintain architectural principles, standards, and documentation for Cambi’s core business applications and integrations.
Understand and translate business needs and foster cross-functional collaboration.
Ensure key processes have optimal system support.
Ensure technical changes are assessed and implemented with appropriate consideration for scalability, maintainability, security, data integrity, and life-cycle impact.
Embed data-driven thinking into architecture and technical decisions.
Operate within Cambi’s IT strategy, portfolio, priorities, and budget.

We are looking for

A data-first and data-driven mindset with a holistic way of thinking.
A consistent focus on ensuring that technology investments translate into tangible and measurable business value.
A genuine interest in platform solutions and the broader ecosystem they are part of.
A real appreciation for collaboration and cross-functional teams.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
A curious, technology-enthusiast approach to the work, with the drive and energy to help shape the role going forward.
Confident leading and participating in well-defined processes and appropriately scoped projects.
Willing to challenge the status quo, yet grounded and humble in how you do it.
Not afraid to get your hands dirty with day-to-day operational work, coding, and configuration.

Key qualifications and requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Relevant certifications and/or operational expertise within platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, ERP (platform-agnostic), CRM (Salesforce), integration development, and master data.
Significant, demonstrable experience in a comparable role is equally valid and will be given weight against formal education requirements.
Experience owning technical architecture and systems within a business context.
Experience in integration development, ideally with a background in software development (full-stack or backend).
Experience with system configuration and customization.
Experience with data platform architecture and the data engineering layer.
Hands-on skills in programming, scripting (PowerShell), and low-code (Power Automate, Power Apps) development within the ecosystem.
Experience with development methodology, including backlog and priority management.
Methodical project management experience, ideally from platform implementations or major upgrades.

At Cambi, we value people who share our commitment to the environment and the positive impact of the circular economy. Your personality should align with Cambi’s core philosophy, which centers around strong customer focus, delivering a high standard of quality in our solutions, products, and services, and always acting with integrity.

Why Join Cambi

Work globally: Encounter different cultures and work practices when working with the global organization.
Make an impact: Contribute to projects transforming organic waste streams into bioresources, boosting the circular economy, and leading to net-zero emissions in cities worldwide.
Immerse in diversity: Join a multicultural team with a mix of young and experienced colleagues from more than 25 countries and 18 different disciplinary backgrounds.
Grow personally: Embrace our values: quality, curious, reliable and teamwork, in a dynamic work environment grounded in a modern Code of Conduct applying to all employees and business partners.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career with us, we’d love to hear from you. We kindly ask you to upload your CV and answer three questions regarding your motivation for the role.

Delivering on our mission to enable a swift global transition to sustainable communities is contingent on attracting and retaining talented employees from diverse backgrounds.

Deadline for applying is the 18th of October 2026.
Please be informed that we will only accept and assess applications through our career site.

Contact

Kim Garberg, mob. 908 70 136, kim.garberg@cambi.com

Join our Cloud & AI team and help enterprise customers turn cloud and AI investments into measurable business value. As a Cloud Solution Architect, you’ll advise customers across AI and agents, applications, data, and infrastructure, shaping secure, resilient, and scalable solutions on Microsoft Azure. You’ll connect strategy to execution, remove complex technical blockers, and accelerate transformation from architecture through production and adoption.

Microsoft Customer & Partner Solutions accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.

We’re seeking a Cloud Solution Architect with broad expertise across AI and agents, applications, data, and infrastructure, and a passion for helping enterprise customers address complex technical and business challenges. In this customer-facing role, you’ll lead strategic technical engagements, advise C-level executives, and partner with Customer Success Leaders to shape and execute cloud strategies that advance transformation, modernization, sovereignty, resiliency, and security. You’ll guide customers through architecture, deployment, and operational excellence, helping them scale AI solutions, modernize applications and data platforms, and realize measurable value from Microsoft Azure. This role offers flexibility to work from home up to 30% of the time.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end technical delivery for a portfolio of strategic accounts, aligning engagements with customer success plans and ensuring customers realize measurable value from their Microsoft investments.
Serve as a technical advisor across the customer’s enterprise by helping technology and business leaders define Cloud and AI strategies, translate priorities into technical direction, and make informed architecture decisions that support long-term transformation outcomes.
Lead customers from strategy to production-ready solutions by guiding architecture design across AI, applications, data, infrastructure, security, resiliency, and agent-based scenarios; applying proven cloud architecture practices; and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and ready for adoption.
Accelerate customer value from Microsoft Azure and AI investments by identifying modernization, data, AI, and platform opportunities across the enterprise; resolving technical blockers; guiding high-impact engagements from concept through implementation; and helping customers realize measurable business outcomes faster.
Orchestrate Microsoft and partner capabilities around customer priorities by coordinating with customer success, sales, engineering, specialist, partner, and delivery teams; aligning roles and responsibilities; and bringing the right expertise together to deliver a connected customer experience.
Drive technical quality and customer trust across complex engagements by anticipating risks, validating architecture quality, reinforcing secure and resilient design patterns, and ensuring mission-critical workloads are optimized for performance, governance, reliability, and operational excellence.
Scale successful outcomes through repeatable delivery practices by using proven frameworks, reusable assets, automation, and delivery guidance; capturing lessons learned; and contributing practices that improve consistency, quality, and speed across customer engagements.
Represent customer needs and strengthen technical community impact by sharing adoption blockers, product feedback, and field insights with internal teams; maintaining deep expertise across priority Cloud and AI workloads; mentoring others; and contributing to technical communities and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND solid experience in Cloud & AI platform technologies, including Azure architecture, AI and agents, GitHub, Agentic DevOps, AI Agent development, data platforms, application modernization, resiliency, security, and production-scale cloud delivery, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
OR equivalent experience

Proficiency in Finnish language, with the ability to advise customers and conduct business discussions in Finnish.
Several years of experience in a customer-facing technology consulting role, advising enterprise customers, shaping cloud and AI strategies, translating business priorities into technical solutions, and guiding senior stakeholders through complex decisions from discovery through adoption.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Backend-udviklere til Mjølner i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Hos Mjølner får du som senior .Net-udvikler mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt i et stærkt fællesskab af dygtige kollegaer, hvor vidensdeling, sparring og arbejdsglæde er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du får spændende opgaver, frihed til at tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag og et solidt bagland, der støtter dig i din udvikling. Vi oplever i øjeblikket en sund og bæredygtig vækst, og vores kunder efterspørger flere af vores dygtige backend-konsulenter. Derfor udvider vi nu teamet i Aarhus.

Din rolle og hverdag hos Mjølner

Som backend-udvikler bliver du en del af vores største faglighed, hvor vi primært arbejder med .NET og Java, sikkerhed, arkitektur og DevOps.

Hos os får du det bedste fra to verdener: meningsfulde konsulentopgaver og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab at læne dig op ad. Typisk vil du være tilknyttet en konkret opgave hos én af vores kunder 2–3 dage om ugen, mens resten af tiden kan bruges hjemmefra eller fra vores kontor i Aarhus.

"For mig er Mjølner det modsatte af et ekkokammer. Der er altid nogen, der har et andet perspektiv, og som kan hjælpe og udfordre dig. Vi fylder ikke ugen op med møder, men om fredagen har vi til gengæld nogle fantastiske rammer for at sætte os sammen og vidensdele over morgenmad og spændende nyheder. Mjølner passer godt på sine konsulenter – og vi passer godt på hinand en,” fortæller vores Lead Software Developer Lea.

Du får mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for et bredt spektrum af teknologier og blive koblet på opgaver i forskellige brancher. Vores projekter har det tilfælles, at de skaber reel værdi for nogle af Danmarks mest interessante virksomheder, der virkelig sætter pris på vores kompetencer.

Konsulentopgaverne varer typisk 6–12 måneder, men ofte forlænges samarbejdet, og nogle opgaver strækker sig over flere år. Det giver dig mulighed for både faglig fordybelse og for at opbygge stærke relationer hos kunden. Uanset hvor du har din daglige gang, har du altid en stærk tilknytning til Mjølner og et bagland, der står klar til at hjælpe.

Det forventer vi af dig

• En relevant videregående uddannelse – fx som datalog eller softwareingeniør.
• Minimum 5 års erfaring med backend-udvikling og de nyeste .NET-teknologier (Java-erfaring kan også være relevant).
• At du kan tage ansvar for egne udviklingsopgaver og levere løsninger af høj kvalitet.
• Flair og interesse for konsulentrollen og en nysgerrig tilgang, hvor du trives med at sparre med både kunder og kollegaer om tekniske og forretningsmæssigeproblemstillinger.
• Lyst til at dele din viden og hjælpe kollegaer videre – både internt og ude hos kunden.

Det er en bonus, hvis du og
s å har:

• Erfaring fra konsulent branchen.
• Kendskab til Microservices, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, Azure/AWS eller CI/CD og lyst til at blive endnu skarpere fagligt .

Her udvikler du ikke kun løsninger for andre – du udvikler også dig selv

Du kan helt sikkert gøre os klogere, ligesom vi kan lære dig noget. Hos Mjølner bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor videndeling er centralt for vores måde at tænke, arbejde og agere på. Vi mødes i faglige guilds, hvor vi sammen dykker ned i tekniske emner. Om fredagen samles vi til fælles morgenmad – en fast tradition, hvor vi dyrker fællesskabet og holder hinanden opdateret.

Vores afdeling består af både erfarne og yngre kollegaer, og vi vægter diversitet højt. Vi kan lide at grine sammen og bruge tid sammen, men helst ikke mere end 37 timer om ugen. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes af mennesker, der har overskud – derfor prioriterer vi balancen mellem arbejde og fritid. Når vi mødes socialt, kan det fx være over et brætspil, til faglige talks, i løbeklubben eller til ølsmagning.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så skynd dig at ansøge via Apply-knappen.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores Manager, Dennis Kristensen på mail: dkr@mjolner.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

The role gives you the opportunity to build your technical skills while taking responsibility for your own tasks and working closely with experienced developers.

Develop and maintain software in our Market Communication platform, primarily within backend development.

Build and improve tools and automations used across trading, forecasting and operations.

Collaborate with neighbouring teams to ensure they receive the right data at the right time.

This is a great opportunity to develop your technical skills by working closely with experienced developers and contributing to real software and data challenges.
— Anders Borup, Head of Energy Asset Integration & Operations

What we are looking for

You are curious about software development, motivated to keep building your technical skills and comfortable working both independently and as part of a close team. For this role, we are looking for someone with:

Current enrolment in computer science, software engineering, data engineering or a related field, at 7th semester or later.
Experience with C# / .NET.
An interest in backend development, data processing or distributed systems.
Curiosity, reliability and a willingness to learn from experienced developers.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are growing fast and looking for someone to be the technical authority behind it. Someone who designs the AI architectures that large organisations build on, and who can hold the deep technical picture and the business outcome at the same time.

About KPMG NewTech

KPMG NewTech works with some of Denmark's largest organisations to put AI to work. Our team sits at the centre of this, operating across two areas that go hand in hand: we design and implement AI solutions and transformations, and we help organisations change how they work through AI adoption.

A big part of what makes us different is our NewPractice methodology, our approach to redefining how organisations build AI-native processes from the ground up. It is not about putting AI onto existing ways of working. It is about rethinking work itself.

We are a team that is motivated by learning, works well in changing environments and is accountable. We are growing quickly, and the people joining will have meaningful influence on where we go.

What You Will Be Doing

You will own the technical architecture of our most complex AI engagements. That means designing the platforms, reference architectures, and agent foundations that large organisations build on, and making the architectural calls that decide whether an AI solution scales or stalls.

Microsoft is at the core of what we do, so deep knowledge across the Microsoft AI and data platform is essential. Many of our clients run more than one cloud, so a working view of AWS or Google helps you design for the reality clients actually operate in.

You will sit at the executive table as the person clients trust on AI architecture, and you will set the technical standard for the team. As a Director or Senior Manager you also carry commercial weight: spotting opportunities, shaping proposals, and helping define where we take our AI services next.

A central part of the role is working with AI yourself. We use AI across everything we do, and you will set the standard for the team in how that is done.

In practice, that means:

Owning the technical architecture of complex AI and agentic solutions, from platform foundations through to production.
Designing enterprise AI reference architectures on Microsoft Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric) and, where it fits, across AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker).
Making the architectural calls that matter: platform selection, security, scalability, cost, and integration.
Being the technical authority that clients trust on AI strategy, platform, and delivery.
Advising the C-suite and technical leadership on how to build AI capability that lasts.
Setting the technical standards and patterns for the team and raising the bar on how we build.
Managing and mentoring architects, engineers, and developers.
Spotting opportunities, shaping proposals, and helping define where we take our AI services next.

What We Are Looking For

You have 8 or more years of experience, likely from consulting, a senior architecture role, or a similar technical leadership position. You have designed and delivered enterprise AI or data architectures that made it all the way to production, and you are as comfortable in an executive meeting as in a design session.

More specifically, we look for:

Deep, practical experience with the Microsoft AI and data platform: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, and the surrounding services.
Working knowledge of AWS AI services such as Bedrock and SageMaker, ideally with a view that spans both clouds.
Experience of designing and delivering AI or data architectures at enterprise scale that reached production.
A solid grasp of AI security, governance, scalability, and the realities of running AI in regulated environments.
Comfortable at the executive level, translating deep technical decisions into clear business language.
Experience leading technical teams and setting architectural direction.
A commercial instinct: you spot opportunities and help shape the work, not just deliver it.
Genuinely curious about where AI architecture is heading, agentic systems, and how to build for what is coming.
Relevant Microsoft and AWS architecture certifications are a plus.
Fluency in English and Danish.
A relevant master's degree or above, or equivalent depth of experience.

Interested?

Upload your CV, and a short cover letter via the Apply button. Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We review applications and interview on a rolling basis.

Feel free to contact Mårten Waldmann ( mwaldmann@kpmg.com ) for any questions. We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We look forward to hearing from you.

En central rolle med ansvar for Azure-arkitektur, teknisk presales og rådgivning i komplekse og forretningskritiske kundemiljøer.
Mulighed for at sætte den faglige retning, udvikle referencearkitekturer og løfte kvaliteten på tværs af vores Azure-leverancer.
Et stærkt fagligt miljø med tæt samarbejde mellem Solution Architects, konsulenter, Operations, Sales og Alliances.

Dine opgaver

Du leder den tekniske kundedialog fra discovery og assessment til løsningsdesign, estimering og et beslutningsklart oplæg.
Du identificerer og former nye Azure-projekter og sikrer, at løsningerne kan implementeres og efterfølgende driftes effektivt i Sentias managed services-model.

Du er

En erfaren og selvstændig Azure Solution Architect, der kan tage teknisk ejerskab, skabe fremdrift og træffe velbegrundede arkitekturbeslutninger.
Kundeorienteret, kommercielt bevidst og dygtig til at samle specialister og interessenter om en pragmatisk og holdbar løsning.

Vil du stå i spidsen for Azure-arkitektur og omsætte komplekse behov til løsninger, der skaber reel forretningsværdi? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Som Senior Azure Solution Architect får du ansvar for at omsætte kundernes behov og tekniske udfordringer til gennemtænkte Azure-arkitekturer. Du følger løsningen fra den indledende dialog og analyse gennem design og planlægning til implementering og en struktureret overdragelse til Operations.
Du bliver den tekniske ekspert i projekterne og sikrer, at løsningerne bygger på Microsofts anbefalinger og Sentias principper for sikkerhed, governance, standardisering og managed services. Du arbejder tæt sammen med vores Solution Architects, konsulenter og Operations og bidrager løbende med sparring, design reviews og kvalitetssikring. Når projektet kræver det, deltager du også i tekniske afklaringer og udvalgte dele af implementeringen.
Du kan arbejde hybridt fra vores kontor i Ballerup, Odense eller Aarhus, hjemmefra og efter behov hos kunder. Rejseaktiviteten er begrænset og vil primært være knyttet til relevante kundemøder og workshops.

Dine ansvarsområder

Designe sikre, skalerbare og driftsegnede Azure-arkitekturer, der understøtter kundens tekniske behov og strategiske mål.
Omsætte forretningsmæssige og tekniske krav til robuste, fremtidssikrede og implementerbare løsninger.
Drive tekniske assessments, workshops, design reviews og centrale arkitekturbeslutninger gennem hele projektets livscyklus.
Planlægge og guide migrationen af applikationer og workloads fra on-premises, private cloud eller hybride miljøer til Azure.
Udarbejde og vedligeholde arkitekturdiagrammer, løsningsbeskrivelser, tekniske standarder, beslutningsgrundlag og implementeringsplaner.
Arbejde tæt sammen med konsulenter og øvrige tekniske specialister og understøtte implementeringen med rådgivning, afklaringer og kvalitetssikring.
Deltage praktisk i udvalgte dele af implementeringen, når der er behov for at afprøve eller etablere centrale komponenter.
Sikre, at løsningerne følger Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected Framework og relevante principper for sikkerhed, governance, compliance og FinOps.
Kommunikere komplekse tekniske koncepter og arkitekturbeslutninger klart til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.

Din profil

Har solid erfaring som Azure Solution Architect, Cloud Architect eller i en tilsvarende rolle.
Har praktisk erfaring med design og implementering af Azure IaaS- og PaaS-løsninger.
Har stærke kompetencer inden for Azure Landing Zones, Cloud Adoption Framework, governance og design af enterprise Azure-miljøer.
Har erfaring med Azure-netværk, identitet og hybride løsninger, herunder eksempelvis Microsoft Entra ID, PIM, VPN, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall og private endpoints.
Har erfaring med at planlægge og gennemføre migrering af applikationer og workloads fra on-premises, private cloud eller andre cloudplatforme til Azure.
Har arbejdet med Infrastructure as Code og automatisering, eksempelvis Bicep, Terraform, PowerShell eller tilsvarende teknologier.
Har forståelse for Azure DevOps, CI/CD-pipelines og kontrolleret deployment af cloudplatforme og workloads.
Kan anvende principper for sikkerhed, governance, compliance, monitorering og FinOps i dine løsningsdesigns.
Kan udarbejde og kvalitetssikre arkitekturdiagrammer, løsningsbeskrivelser, tekniske standarder og implementeringsplaner.
Kan drive tekniske workshops og kommunikere komplekse løsninger tydeligt til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.
Taler og skriver engelsk på et professionelt niveau. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

En ny måde at arbejde med IT på

I Sentia trives vi ved at være vores kunders fortrukne og langsigtede samarbejdspartner. Derfor er det vigtigt for os at vi skræddersyer markedets bedste løsninger, som passer til kundens forretning, om det er pure Public Cloud, hybrid, Sentia Cloud eller andre managed services. Det vigtigste er, at vi skaber langsigtede løsninger sammen med vores kunder og derved sikrer et stærkt fundament for fremtidigt samarbejde.

Vi mener, at den digitale verden er kernen i enhver virksomhed, og vi drives af at finde den bedste IT-løsning sammen med vores kunder. Vi er i øjeblikket på en spændende transformationsrejse, hvor vi optimerer vores interne struktur, fra vores systemlandskab til at udfordre traditionelle arbejdsmetoder. Vi inviterer dig på denne spændende rejse, hvor vi konstant er i udvikling og derfor kan du ikke lade være med at vokse sammen med os.

Vil du med på rejsen?

Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette match. Vi vil derfor gerne invitere dig til at sende os dit CV og nogle passionerede linjer hvor du fremhæver hvorfor DU netop er det rette match for Sentia. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Director, AI Solutions and Engineering

At Lundbeck, we are building a bionic company. We believe competitive advantage will not come from AI models alone, but from how we combine them with Lundbeck’s unique neuroscience expertise, data and enterprise knowledge to transform how we work, discover, develop and deliver treatments. In a global, regulated pharmaceutical environment, this means moving with both ambition and responsibility; rapidly exploring what AI makes possible while ensuring what we scale is secure, trusted and sustainable.

As Director, AI Solutions & Engineering, you will lead Lundbeck’s enterprise capability for AI solution architecture, engineering and industrialization. Working closely with the Chief AI Office, business leaders and technology teams, you will turn strategic AI opportunities into scalable solutions that create measurable value across Lundbeck.

AI Solutions & Engineering enables and scales AI solutions across Lundbeck while exploring and advancing high-value applications of frontier AI. Your team will rapidly explore and de-risk emerging capabilities, build advanced and differentiated solutions where dedicated engineering creates value, and establish the reusable architecture, engineering patterns and paved pathways that enable teams across Lundbeck to build safely and move fast. A key part of your mandate will be creating a clear path from experimentation and citizen-built solutions to secure, scalable and professionally engineered enterprise solutions.

This role is based at Lundbeck’s headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark, and requires regular on-site presence.

Your Responsibilities

Lead a high-performing team spanning AI and software engineering, solution architecture and applied AI specialists.
Partner with the Chief AI Office and senior business leaders to translate strategic AI opportunities into well-defined use cases, experiments and scalable solutions, owning the technical pathway from opportunity to enterprise production.
Lead the architecture, engineering and deployment of advanced AI solutions, including assistants, agents and AI-enabled workflows, building on enterprise platforms where possible and developing differentiated solutions where dedicated engineering creates greater value.
Shape Lundbeck’s federated AI engineering model by establishing reusable components, architectural guardrails and paved engineering pathways across areas such as agents, integrations, evaluation, observability, identity and deployment.
Partner with data, digital and business teams to connect AI with Lundbeck’s data, enterprise knowledge, applications and processes through modern data, semantic, retrieval and integration patterns.
Explore emerging frontier-model capabilities and rapidly test their application to Lundbeck’s business and scientific challenges, scaling what demonstrates meaningful value.
Set technical direction and continuously evolve Lundbeck’s AI engineering practices in close collaboration with the Digital & AI Foundation team and other enterprise technology capabilities.

What You Bring To The Team

You combine deep technical credibility with strategic leadership and strong business judgment. You can translate emerging technology into practical business opportunities, guide senior technical teams and act as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders. You are collaborative and pragmatic, but also able to form and defend a clear technical point of view in a complex environment. Most importantly, you start with the business problem and value to be created, not the technology itself.

Moreover, you possess most of the following qualifications:

Experience designing, building and scaling AI solutions in large, complex or regulated organizations.
Strong expertise across Generative AI, large language models, intelligent agents, evaluation and AI operations, supported by strong software engineering and cloud fundamentals.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture and the ability to set AI solution architecture and engineering direction within broader enterprise principles and governance.
Experience connecting AI with enterprise data, knowledge and business systems through APIs, semantic and retrieval architectures and modern integration patterns.
Experience across leading AI ecosystems and model providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft, with the ability to evaluate emerging capabilities and determine where they can create value at enterprise scale.
A proven track record of building and leading multidisciplinary technical teams and establishing trusted partnerships with senior business leaders, technology teams and external partners.

Our promise to you

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further in addressing the significant unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with exciting challenges and development opportunities, balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve.

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final base salary within the stated range will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, and level of proficiency as well as internal pay equity.

Technology Group

We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new, and emerging technologies.

Business Partner & Solutions

You will help to explore new and existing technology to support our strategic and operational business needs across our Public Markets, Private Markets, Total Portfolio Risk, and Corporate Services.

What impact can you make in this role?

You will be empowered to be at the top of your game by providing strategic partnership, and innovative technology solutions that supports GIC’s vision of being a tech-driven, global, long-term investment firm.

What will you do as a Software Engineer (C#)?

As a Software Engineer at GIC, you will be at the forefront of financial technology innovation, driving the development of cutting-edge solutions that empower our investment strategies and operations. You will:

Collaborate and Innovate: Partner with portfolio managers, business managers, and product owners to tackle complex challenges and transform them into purposeful software solutions that drive our success
Design and Develop: Craft advanced algorithms and applications that significantly improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and propel strategic initiatives forward
Leverage Emerging Technologies: Harness the power of machine learning and artificial intelligence to create innovative solutions that give us a competitive edge in the industry
Champion Excellence: Lead peer code reviews and share your technical expertise to cultivate a culture of continuous improvement and excellence
Ensure Quality: Execute rigorous System Integration Tests and work closely with business users on User Acceptance Tests to guarantee top-tier deliverables
Document and Guide: Develop comprehensive documentation and user guides to ensure seamless adoption and utilisation of new systems
Stay Ahead: Continuously explore and integrate emerging technologies to keep our solutions at the forefront of innovation

What makes you a successful candidate?

At least 5 years of relevant experience in software development, and hands-on experience in solution designing, software testing, and production support
Proficiency in Agile software development methodologies and practices such as Scrum, Kanban, or Test-Driven Development
Hands-on technical skills and good competency in C# (.Net Core) and related frameworks such as ASP.NET Core
Experience with front-end technologies like Angular or React.js and familiarity with RESTful APIs
Preferred experience in relevant domains, including but not limited to the financial sector, such as trading systems (e.g., OMS), payment systems, and transactional operations, enabling a deep understanding of industry-specific challenges and solutions
Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure and containerisation technologies like Docker and Kubernetes
Strong team player who is keen to learn, independent, and possesses strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills
Passionate about understanding business requirements and using technology to transform or improve current state
Familiar with and interested in learning about current and emerging technology landscapes

Experience leading engineering teams and/or mentoring junior software engineers is advantageous, especially for VP candidates

All candidates are considered through a centralised recruitment process, ensuring a fair and standardised assessment journey before being shortlisted for roles across our Investment Technology, Enterprise and Data Technology, and Strategy, Architecture & Transformation Engineering teams. Shortlisting is based on team needs, including headcount, seniority, language, and domain knowledge requirements. Whichever team you join, you can look forward to meaningful work and the chance to make a real impact.

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

About the Role
:

We are looking for an enthusiastic Full Stack .NET Engineer to join our team. You will work in the Researcher Profiles Service
team, where we build and manage a global-scale academic data platform.
Through powerful APIs and intuitive UIs, we make critical research information accessible to the rest of the company and to end-users worldwide.

We have fully embraced AI-based spec-driven design
, integrating AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle. From specification to implementation, AI tooling shapes how we architect, build, and iterate — making us faster, more deliberate, and focused on what matters most. This isn't an experiment. It's how we work.

You will take ownership of high-impact projects and drive them to success in a team that's redefining how modern software is built.

Key Responsibilities
:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications using .NET and Vue.js
Enhance and support existing solutions built with older versions of .NET and Vue.js
Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other cross-functional teams to gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and determine optimal implementation strategies
Collaborate within a multinational, cross-functional team to deliver software solutions aligned with business needs
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to best practices
Ensure the quality of the delivered solutions
Optimise applications for performance, scalability, and responsiveness
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges
Conduct code reviews and mentor junior engineers
Willingness to learn, flexible approach, and staying current with emerging trends in IT to maintain an up-to-date technology stack
Business-oriented attitude with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes for end-users. Demonstrable experience in owning and driving full-stack projects end-to-end, from the specification refinement phase to the production monitoring

Requirements

5+ years of experience in software engineering, specializing in .NET Core/Framework
3+ years of hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (Vue 3 is a plus)
Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Deep expertise in Vue.js, including Vue 2 and Vue 3, with a strong understanding of state management, component-based architecture, and best practices for building scalable front-end applications
Strong expertise in SQL Server, including performance tuning, indexing strategies, query optimization, and troubleshooting production issues.
Heavy experience in implementing APIs with REST and GraphQL
Experience integrating AI solutions into customer-facing applications
Proficient in leveraging AI to enhance daily engineering work
Expexienced in owning complex, distributed system architectures
Solid understanding of microservices and micro-frontend concepts
Collaborative and thriving in a hybrid environment

Nice-to-Have Skills
:

Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB)
Experience with containerization platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

jobs.title: Programador full stack
jobs.description:
As a Medior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/Modern Frontend), you will join a friendly, agile, and fully remote DevOps team. We have a clear mission: We want to focus our efforts on evolving and enhancing our core Digital Signing application. To achieve this, your role will be a balance between building these new capabilities and helping us maintain and stabilize our existing ecosystem (Digital Signing, Document Creation, and File Transfer).

Your duties will revolve around designing and delivering resilient software solutions, ensuring high code quality through strong review practices and automated testing (we own our code from design to deployment!). We embrace modern tooling, so you will leverage AI-assisted tools to drive productivity and optimize our processes. As part of the team, you will participate in all agile ceremonies and actively contribute with your ideas and expertise. 

Skill set

Team spirit.
Autonomous and self-organized.
Be a persistent, creative problem-solver.
Flexible and willing to accept a change in priorities as necessary.
Strong attention to detail.
Outstanding collaboration.
Fluent English: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. English is our daily working language (meetings, documentation, and code). Our team is distributed in the Netherlands and in Spain. 
A positive, resilient attitude. We are looking for someone who brings good energy to the team, enjoys helping others, and navigates maintenance or legacy challenges with a constructive mindset.

Technical skill set

At least 5+ years' experience in web and software development (Medior level).
Strong backend experience: Solid knowledge of .NET / .NET Core architecture and API programming experience (REST).
Modern frontend knowledge: Experience with a modern frontend framework like React, Vue, or Angular using TypeScript. (Note: Our stack is Angular, but if you come from React/Vue and are willing to learn, we want you!)
Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude) to accelerate workflows while ensuring code quality.
Hands-on experience or strong interest in integrating LLMs and generative-AI services into applications (e.g., Azure OpenAI Service).
Familiarity with concepts like prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or vector search.
Microsoft Azure experience.
Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions experience (CI/CD pipelines).
SQL experience.
Experience handling integration challenges (authentication, rate limiting, error handling, resiliency, and messaging like Service Bus/Event Grid).
Awareness of data-privacy principles (GDPR/AVG), including the safe handling of personal and payroll data (encryption in transit and at rest).
Strong code review practices and critical thinking to evaluate technical trade-offs.
Experience working in an agile environment.
Experience with professional software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, source control management, build processes, automated testing, and operations.

Nice to have:

Direct hands-on experience specifically with Angular (TypeScript).
Experience with Document Generation libraries (e.g., TextControl).
Specific domain knowledge in Digital Signing or File Transfer applications.

Responsibilities

Drive our core product: Design, build, and maintain full-stack features fully hosted in Microsoft Azure, focusing on the evolution and enhancement of our core Digital Signing application for Youforce.
Support the ecosystem: Maintain, stabilize, and troubleshoot our existing ecosystem (Digital Signing, Document Creation, and File Transfer), which includes navigating legacy technologies and keeping our support baseline under control.
Own the quality: Take full ownership of software testing (Unit, Integration, E2E) and performance. We don't have a dedicated QA team, so our engineers own the code from design to deployment.
Smart AI Integration: Responsibly integrate AI APIs (like LLMs) into our products when needed, ensuring they handle personal and payroll data in strict compliance with GDPR/AVG and least-privilege principles.
AI Monitoring & Guardrails: Build guardrails, evaluation, and monitoring for any AI features you integrate, keeping a close eye on quality, cost, latency, safety, and bias. 
Architecture & Problem Solving: Architect and implement software solutions by analyzing business context, technical feasibility, and system scalability.
Code Excellence: Evaluate, refactor, and review code actively. Ensure high security standards, architectural integrity, and efficiency.
Take Ownership: Make informed decisions quickly and take ownership of services and applications at scale.
Team Collaboration: Actively participate in agile team meetings, propose creative solutions to daily challenges, share knowledge, and work collaboratively to achieve our goals.

What we offer

Our local staff is part of a dynamic and multicultural environment (average age of 41, 9 nationalities)
Challenging, exciting, and varied tasks.
An inclusive and inspiring work environment with skilled colleagues.
Exciting professional environment based on a high level of expertise.
Facilitation for professional and personal development.
Competitive pay.
Social benefits (ticket restaurants, teleworking expenses and health insurance).
Team building activities and social business life.

Solid experience with Unified Namespace concepts and enabling technologies:

We're Capital on Tap 👋

💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one.

🏡🏢 The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €55,000-70,000

This is a multiple-headcount role, so please don't be put off if you've seen it advertised for a while.

What You'll Be Doing

We're looking for Senior Full stack Engineers to help us build the best credit card and payment products for small businesses. If you're looking for an environment where you're given the freedom to make empowered decisions, research new technologies, and learn/share knowledge with your peers. Then keep on reading!

You'll build robust and scalable solutions using .Net technology
From the first line of code to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement - you'll own the SDLC
You'll craft slick, responsive user interfaces with modern JavaScript frameworks (React), making sure our products don't just work, they feel great to use
Teamwork makes the dream work - you'll partner with Product Managers, QA's, and fellow Software Engineers
You'll build bulletproof unit and integration tests to keep our software sharp and our users happy
Bugs happen. When they do, you'll be ready to troubleshoot and tweak as needed
You'll bridge the gap between tech speak and business goals, ensuring everyone's on the same page and moving forward together

We're Looking For 🔎

Required skills:

A minimum of 5+ years hands-on experience in C#, .Net Core, SQL Server, ideally JavaScript and React also!
Good testing practices, in both Unit and Integration testing
Good understanding of database technologies
Experience in using Agile development practices
A passion for learning new skills and technologies
A proactive, supportive, and collaborative team player

Our Tech Stack

Backend: C#, .Net, .Net Core
Frontend: React, JavaScript
Mobile: Flutter, Dart
Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
Cloud: Azure & GCP

Interview Process 🤝

Final stage: 90-minute Code Pairing + 30-minute Values Interview

Diversity & Inclusion
🌈

We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks

Check out our benefits:

🏥 Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare

🎁 Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)

🏖️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)

📖 Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget

🍫 Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info

✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin.

Excited to work here? Apply!
