About The Company

We believe in the positive power of energy – and in people who are ready to shape the future with their ideas and dedication. That’s why we established the EnBW Tech Hub in Portugal to drive innovation and develop digital solutions that support the energy transition and improve the way we work.

As a key pillar of EnBW’s technological transformation, the Tech Hub plays a vital role in our journey. EnBW is one of the largest energy companies, headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, employing approximately 30,000 people. ENBW IT SOLUTIONS, UNIPESSOAL LDA, a wholly owned subsidiary of EnBW, operates as an integral part of EnBW's IT division. In Lisbon, we bring together experts in IT, administration, project management and HR to collaborate in an agile, international environment and create smart, scalable solutions.

Our Benefits

Private supplementary health insurance including coverage for your immediate family, offering peace of mind beyond the public system.
Meal allowance to support your daily work routines.
Additional paid days off (24 December & Carnival Day) on top of statutory annual leave - giving you more time for what matters.
Hybrid working model with a mix of remote and office days to support flexibility and modern ways of working.
Intercultural collaboration & cross border projects - grow your international experience by working with colleagues in Germany.
Modern technology and continuous development opportunities to support your growth and keep you up to date in your field.
Bright, appealing offices in a trendy Lisbon area, designed for productive and enjoyable workdays.

Your tasks

You are part of a software engineering team that builds and operates BAPC, our internal business platform for monetization, including services for billing, accounting, payment, and collection.
You design, build, and operate cloud-native services on Azure Kubernetes Service, MongoDB Atlas, and other Azure services, increasingly supported by AI-coding agents. We use Go/Golang (preferred in this team), C#/.NET, Kotlin, and additional technologies in a complex, grown system landscape.
You contribute to a high-quality engineering culture by creating clean, well-tested code (unit and integration tests), applying Domain-Driven Design and resilience patterns, and maintaining production workloads responsibly.
You shape and maintain our infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines with a DevOps mindset, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes containerization to keep delivery and operations efficient and reliable.
You work closely with architects, business analysts, and process experts to clarify architecture and business requirements and support the customer journey.

Your profile

Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a comparable qualification
Experience: 3+ years of professional software development experience using Go/Golang, C#/.NET, Kotlin, Java, or similar languages in a cloud environment (Azure preferred)
Agile practices: Comfortable working in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), with a continuous-improvement mindset, shared ownership, and pragmatic problem-solving
Collaboration & communication: able to articulate and document technical decisions clearly, and collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders
Maintenance & operations: Willingness to share on-call responsibility and actively contribute to stable, observable, and secure production systems

Nice To Have

Experience with AI-based tools for agentic coding
Experience with processes around B2C CRM and billing or payment
Experience in a regulated environment or in the energy sector
Kubernetes know-how: K8s concepts, Helm charts, operators
Proficiency in gRPC, Protobuf, REST

Language Skills

Proficiency in English (C1 level or higher)
Portuguese (B1 level or higher)
German language skills are a plus

About The Department

Our Sales IT department is the Software Engineering powerhouse behind EnBW’s Sales, Marketing and Operations organization. We design, build and run scalable digital platforms and customer‑facing services for B2C businesses such as energy, utility services and e‑mobility. Working in cross‑functional, agile teams, we apply strong engineering principles such as Domain-Driven Design and Event-Driven Architecture, along with modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies and product‑oriented thinking to deliver high‑quality solutions and accelerate time‑to‑market for a digital energy future.

Our teams build and operate a broad portfolio of digital products almost entirely on the Azure cloud. This includes high‑traffic customer websites such as yello.de and enbw.com, mobile applications like the Zuhause+ App and the Yello App, as well as Mobility+, EnBW’s app for fast and convenient EV charging on the go. Behind these customer touchpoints, we develop and run a wide range of backend systems from energy core systems and EMP/CPO backends, to an Event-Driven integration platform and numerous APIs, including services for intelligent offer and pricing orchestration across sales channels.

If you are passionate about cloud-native backend development, thrive in a team that takes shared ownership of what it ships, and want to work on software that directly drives EnBW’s sales business we’d love to hear from you.

Client Suppoort Engineer

London, Belfast or Lisbon - hybrid working

Intapp is looking for a Client Support Engineer to join our Client Success & Support team. This is a technical, client-facing role focused on the investigation and resolution of issues across Intapp Time — our time capture and management platform — in both cloud and on-premise environments.

What you'll do

Own investigation, triage, and resolution of client-reported issues across Intapp Profitability, with a primary focus on Intapp Time in cloud and on-premise environments.

Diagnose issues across the Intapp Time ecosystem, including the web application, Admin, Desktop, Desktop Extension, Mobile, Capture, tenant configuration, and identity and access management.

Investigate common support scenarios such as time-entry and submission failures, missing client or matter data, validation and synchronisation issues, performance problems, login failures, and integration errors.

Use logs, error messages, configuration, browser diagnostics, API responses, and client-provided evidence to isolate root cause and distinguish product defects from configuration, data, network, or environmental issues.

Troubleshoot integrations between Intapp Time and clients' practice-management or financial-management systems using SQL, stored procedures, SOAP/REST APIs, data mappings, service accounts, and integration logs.

Support issues involving Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi) and Intapp Integrate, including schedules, connectors, mappings, credentials, queues, and process reporting.

Apply impact-based triage and prioritisation, taking account of production availability, affected users, business impact, and service-level expectations, and act promptly on high-priority or widespread issues.

Provide accurate, timely, and technically clear updates to client contacts, translating complex findings into practical next steps and maintaining ownership through to resolution.

Prepare complete escalation packages for product defects, including business impact, diagnostic evidence, steps to reproduce, and relevant logs.

Recognise when a request falls outside break-fix support and route it to the appropriate team while maintaining a smooth client handover.

Maintain accurate, audit-ready ticket records and contribute to knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides that improve consistency and time to resolution.

What you'll need

2+ years' experience supporting enterprise SaaS and/or on-premise software in a client-facing technical support or application support role.

Experience supporting integrations between enterprise business applications.

Practical experience with ticketing systems and support workflows, including impact-based prioritisation, SLA management, and accurate technical documentation.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex symptoms, interpret logs, and identify root cause.

Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL experience is highly desirable.

Working knowledge of SOAP and REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, JSON/XML payloads, and common integration or connectivity issues.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical client contacts.

A strong sense of ownership and client responsibility, with the ability to work independently, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and exercise sound judgement on when to escalate.

A genuine interest in using AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of support work; hands-on experience applying AI in a support or technical environment is an advantage.

Desirable

Experience supporting Intapp Time, other Intapp Profitability products, Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi), or Intapp Integrate.

Experience integrating time or billing applications with legal practice-management or financial-management systems such as Aderant, Elite/3E, or Carpe Diem.

Understanding of synchronisation, data mapping, scheduled jobs, and source-of-truth concepts in integrated enterprise applications.

Familiarity with Microsoft technologies such as .NET, Internet Information Services (IIS), Windows Server, PowerShell, or SQL Server, or relevant Microsoft, .NET, or SQL certification.

Experience with enterprise connectivity troubleshooting, including DNS, proxies, TLS certificates, firewall rules, load balancers, or network tracing tools such as Wireshark or Fiddler.

Experience with identity and access technologies such as SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, or Microsoft Entra ID.

Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or browser developer tools.

Experience creating knowledge-base content or support procedures that reduce recurring issues and improve resolution quality.

What you'll gain

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible, where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities.

jobs.title: MS Dynamics 365 Solution Architect
jobs.description:
The MS Dynamics 365 Solution Architect is responsible for defining, designing, and guiding the technical and
functional architecture for enterprise-wide Dynamics 365 solutions. This role requires a "hands-on" architectural
experince who translates complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and practical D365 designs. The
architect will actively lead real-world implementation cases, resolve complex technical blockers, and ensure the
ongoing performance, optimization, and maintenance of large-scale, high-volume D365 deployments across the
enterprise.
Key Focus Areas:
 Dynamics 365 Architecture & Solution Design
 Hands-on Implementation & Delivery
 Large-Scale System Maintenance & Optimization
 Integration & Power Platform Enablement
 Application Modernization & Upgrades
 Cross Domain Application Alignment
 Infrastructure, Security & Environment Strategy
 Drive Innovation
Job Description
Dynamics 365 Architecture & Solution Design
 Design end-to-end application architectures across the MS Dynamics 365 ecosystem (F&O, Commerce,
SCM, CE) and related enterprise platforms.
 Define application architecture standards, customization patterns (extension over over-layering), and best
practices for modular design, maintainability, scalability, and performance.
 Evaluate out-of-the-box (OOTB) capabilities versus custom development, identifying technical risks,
assessing cost versus benefit, and recommending fit-for-purpose architecture decisions.
 Create comprehensive Solution Blueprints that consider applications, data flows, integrations, infrastructure,
security, operations, and delivery constraints.

Hands-on Implementation & Delivery

 Actively participate in real-world implementation cases, rolling up sleeves to guide complex configurations,
custom extension designs (X++, C#), and advanced data migration strategies.
 Provide deep technical troubleshooting and hands-on guidance during delivery to resolve critical blockers
and ensure the implemented solution remains aligned with the approved design.
 Lead the technical design of complex customizations, ensuring engineering teams follow Microsoft best
practices for code quality and performance.
 Oversee and validate data migration strategies (DMF/DIXF) from legacy ERP/CRM systems into Dynamics
365.
Large-Scale System Maintenance & Optimization
 Architect and oversee the post-go-live maintenance of large-scale Dynamics 365 environments supporting
thousands of users and high-volume retail transactions.
 Proactively monitor system performance, identifying bottlenecks in database sizing, batch job scheduling,
API limits, and complex query execution.
 Guide the optimization of large-scale data sets, archiving strategies, and high-availability setups to ensure
continuous business operations across global outlets.
 Partner with Microsoft Support (FastTrack) and internal teams to resolve critical infrastructure, platform, or
product-level issues.
Integration & Power Platform Enablement
 Design robust integration architectures connecting D365 to enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, and legacy
applications using Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management) and Dataverse.
 Guide the practical adoption of the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) to extend
D365 capabilities without heavy custom code.
 Ensure integration choices (OData, Custom Services, Dual-Write, Virtual Entities, Business Events) are
secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
Application Modernization & Upgrades
 Manage the architecture strategy for continuous updates (Microsoft One Version), ensuring the enterprise is
prepared for platform updates with minimal business disruption.
 Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt by deprecating legacy customizations and replacing them with
newly released OOTB features or Power Platform solutions.
 Support legacy application assessment, rationalization, and modernization initiatives transitioning to the
Dynamics 365 cloud ecosystem.
Cross Domain Application Alignment & Security
 Work closely with enterprise, data, infrastructure, and security architects to ensure D365 solutions are aligned
across the broader technology landscape.
 Incorporate security by design principles, architecting robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Extensible
Data Security (XDS), and aligning with Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) for identity management.
 Ensure application designs properly address master data management (MDM) needs, reporting dependencies,
and operational dependencies.

Architecture Governance & Compliance Alignment
 Work with the Architecture Review Board and domain architects to ensure D365 solution designs follow
approved architecture standards and governance processes.

Chemelex is a global leader in electric thermal and sensing solutions, protecting the world’s critical processes, places and people. With over 50 years of innovation and a commitment to excellence, we develop solutions that ensure safety, reliability, and efficiency in diverse environments – from industrial plants and data centers to people’s homes. We deliver future\-ready technologies, advanced engineering capabilities and local expertise backed by global standards. Our offering includes a leading portfolio from our trusted brands: Raychem, Tracer, Nuheat and Pyrotenax.
  
  

**What you will experience in this position:**  

This is a technical and commercial sales role serving a wide range of industries, including oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, power, water, food and beverage and other process industries. You will sell electrical heat\-tracing and thermal\-management products, services and project solutions to industrial end users, contractors and OEM customers.

jobs.title: Jr. Automation Engineer
Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een engineer die erbij wil zijn als een nieuwe installatie voor het eerst echt gaat draaien. Iemand die een systeem kan brengen van "het werkte in de pilot" naar "het draait elke dag in productie". Onze technologie is nieuw en uniek, dus de meeste antwoorden bestaan nog niet. Jij helpt ze te vinden.

**Over Myne**
-------------


Myne Circular Metals ontwikkelt technologieën die een van de meest urgente uitdagingen in de grondstoffensector aanpakken: de uitputting van hoogwaardige metalen en de milieukosten van de productie ervan. Onze kerntechnologieën, de Xorter en MDX, zetten chaotische metaalafvalstromen om in grondstoffen die qua kwaliteit gelijkwaardig zijn aan primaire metalen, tegen lagere kosten en zonder downcycling. Dit doen we met \~75 mensen in Harderwijk, een jaaromzet van €400M en nauwe samenwerkingen met universiteiten en specialisten. We schalen snel op, met ambitieuze technische ontwikkelingen die nog volop in gang zijn.

**Rolomschrijving**
-------------------


Bij Myne staan engineers dicht bij het werk, en deze rol is geen uitzondering. Als Commissioning Engineer breng je nieuwe technologie en de installatie eromheen van pilot naar volledige productie en werk je aan de optimalisatie.

* **Commissioning:** je bouwt op, start op en valideert elk component tot het de prestatiedoelen haalt. Dat geldt ook voor nieuwe, zelf ontwikkelde technologie.
* **Optimalisatie:** je zet wat er misgaat om in blijvende verbeteringen, via instellingen, aanpassingen en werk dat je zelf met je handen doet.


Je werkt nauw samen met de engineers die de technologie hebben ontwikkeld. Zij weten hoe het ontworpen is, jij weet hoe het zich in de praktijk gedraagt met echt materiaal in de handen van echte operators. Daarnaast maak je deel uit van het Operations\-team in Harderwijk en de fabrieksvloer waar je je dag grotendeels doorbrengt.

### **Verantwoordelijkheden**

* **Eigenaarschap:** Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor nieuwe systemen en de installatie eromheen, van eerste opstart tot volledige productie
* **Commissioning:** Nieuwe componenten opbouwen, opstarten en valideren tot ze hun prestatiedoelen halen
* **Troubleshooten:** De oorzaak achterhalen wanneer een systeem zich anders gedraagt dan verwacht en werken aan een oplossing, of die nu in de mechanica, het proces of de manier van bedienen zit
* **Optimaliseren:** Bevindingen omzetten in blijvende verbeteringen via instellingen, aanpassingen en werk dat je zelf met je handen doet
* **Samen verbeteren:** Met andere teams werken aan ontwerpverbeteringen, en echte productiedata en storingsoorzaken terugkoppelen zodat we blijven verbeteren
* **Overdragen:** De procedures schrijven en de operators opleiden, zodat de fabriek ook zonder jou goed draait

**Wat we zoeken**
-----------------

* **Ervaring:** 0–3 jaar. Je hebt een technische basis in werktuigbouwkunde, industriële techniek of procestechniek en hebt bij voorkeur al met echte apparatuur gewerkt. Of dat uit een opleiding, stage, afstudeerproject of werkplaats komt, maakt niet uit; wat telt is dat je het in de praktijk kunt toepassen.
* **Hands\-on:** Je pakt liever zelf een sleutel om het uit te zoeken dan dat je wacht tot iemand het uitlegt. Je voelt je thuis rond pompen, leidingen, transportbanden en besturingskasten.
* **Diagnostisch inzicht:** Als iets niet werkt, werk je terug naar de oorzaak in plaats van te gokken. Je houdt bij wat je hebt veranderd en wat dat deed.
* **Technisch inzicht:** Je begrijpt hoe materiaal zich door een systeem beweegt en wat er verandert als je iets aanpast. Je kunt P\&ID's en PFD's lezen, of je wilt dat leren.
* **Zelfstandigheid:** Je neemt de leiding over jouw systemen, stelt je eigen prioriteiten en weet wanneer een probleem te groot is en opgeschaald moet worden.
* **Samenwerken:** Je werkt goed samen met operators en technici, en net zo makkelijk met de engineers die het systeem hebben ontworpen.
* **On\-site:** Harderwijk, dagelijks in een industriële omgeving waar dingen nog worden uitgezocht, en dat is precies wat het interessant maakt.
* **Opleiding:** HBO Werktuigbouwkunde, Industriële Techniek of Procestechniek, of gelijkwaardige ervaring.

**Wat we bieden**
-----------------

* **Salaris:** €3\.000–€4\.500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring en kennis (0–3 jaar)
* **Bonus:** Jaarlijkse prestatiebonus op basis van jouw bijdrage
* **Flexibele uren:** 32–40 uur per week
* **Arbeidsvoorwaarden:** Volledige reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling
* **Impact:** Baanbrekende recyclingtechnologie met een directe bijdrage aan de circulaire economie, samen met toonaangevende onderzoeksinstellingen
* **Team:** Een multidisciplinair team waar diverse achtergronden en de beste ideeën echt gewaardeerd worden
* **Groei:** Ontwikkelmogelijkheden die passen bij jouw ambities

**Solliciteren**
----------------


Enthousiast na het lezen van deze vacature? We verwelkomen jouw sollicitatie, **ook als je niet aan alle genoemde criteria voldoet.** Solliciteer vandaag nog en draag met ons bij aan een duurzame toekomst.

De directie Informatievoorziening is hét ICT\-bedrijf van de Belastingdienst. Met ruim 3\.000 collega’s zorgen we dat Nederland kan rekenen op betrouwbare informatievoorzieningen en ICT\-systemen. Heel Nederland? Ja, onze ‘klanten’ zijn niet alleen Belastingdienstmedewerkers, maar ook 8\.600 grote ondernemers, 2,2 miljoen mkb\-ondernemers en 8,5 miljoen burgers. En wist je dat wij werken volgens een agile\-mindset? Open, transparant en gericht op leren en kennis delen. Door de toepassing van een DevOps\-werkwijze en ons aanbod van geautomatiseerde technieken kunnen de systemen van de Belastingdienst dagelijks miljoenen data en euro’s verwerken.


Bij ons werk je in een moderne tech\-organisatie met ménsen als kloppend hart. Of je nu als engineer of in een andere rol bijdraagt aan effectieve ICT; jouw inzet doet ertoe. Net als jouw ontwikkeling, waarin wij graag investeren. En jouw ideeën, waar we graag naar luisteren. Ook is er volop ruimte om samen te innoveren met externe partijen. Niet alleen om te moderniseren, maar vooral om nieuwe producten en diensten te ontwikkelen die passen bij de belevingswereld van burgers, bedrijven en collega’s.
*“In dit team werken we met de nieuwste technologieën en dat maakt ons werk spannend. We verbeteren continu onze processen en ondersteunen elkaar goed. Ik waardeer vooral de samenwerking en de mogelijkheid om impact te maken.”* Mark, testautomatiseerder en scrummaster

**Be the true you**
-------------------



Je bent gedreven professional en enthousiast om je expertise binnen het NL Delivery Center verder te ontwikkelen. Je bent leergierig en geïnteresseerd in de nieuwste AI ontwikkelingen en technieken. Je bent gemotiveerd om snel nieuwe kennis en vaardigheden op te doen en actief bij te dragen aan kennisdeling binnen de organisatie. Je werkt graag in multidisciplinaire teams. Je begrijpt het belang van het leveren van een betrouwbare en hoogwaardige dienstverlening aan onze klanten en bent gemotiveerd dit samen met je collega’s te realiseren. Daarnaast sta je klaar om mee te bouwen aan ons nieuwe NL Delivery Center en op deze manier de impact van onze dienstverlening op klanten te vergroten.

* 3\+ jaar werkervaring in een relevante technische omgeving (bijvoorbeeld in AI/ML, Data Science, Data Engineering of DevOps functies).
* Minimaal een afgeronde hbo\-opleiding, of autodidact met de juiste werkervaring.
* Bewezen ervaring met het werken volgens Agile en Scrum.
* Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
* Een hands\-on mentaliteit met oog voor detail en kwaliteit.
* Het vermogen om analytisch, kritisch en probleemoplossend te denken.
* De bereidheid om te leren, je vaardigheden continu te ontwikkelen en actief bij te dragen aan kennisdeling in een dynamische en groeiende omgeving.


Je hebt ervaring met:

* AI, Data Science \& Machine Learning
* Python, SQL \& ETL/ELT
* DevOps \& CI/CD


Je hebt aanvullende ervaring met:

* GenAI/LLM: LangChain, Hugging Face, vector stores
* MLOps: MLflow, model registry of model serving frameworks (vLLM etc.)
* Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift)
* Monitoring en observability (Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk


**What impact will you make?**
------------------------------



Als (Senior) AI \& Data engineer bij Deloitte’s NL Delivery Center werk je aan de meest innovatieve systemen en platformen van onze klanten. Het NL Delivery Center is net gestart waardoor je de kans krijgt om samen met je collega’s iets vanaf de grond op te bouwen. In ons NL Delivery Center werken onder andere software, DevOps, Cloud en dataspecialisten die zich bezighouden met het runnen en onderhouden van essentiële bedrijfsdiensten, processen en functies van onze klanten. Wij bieden een hybride manier van werken, met een vaste standplaats in Breda, en een omgeving waarin persoonlijke groei, kennisdeling en experimenteren centraal staan. Je krijgt de beschikking over een ruim aanbod aan op maat gemaakte trainingen, erkende certificeringen en begeleiding binnen Deloitte.


**How do you do this?**
-----------------------



Als (Senior) AI \& Data Engineer ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de ontwikkeling, implementatie en continue verbetering van innovatieve, veilige en schaalbare (Gen) AI \& Data oplossingen voor onze klanten. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het nieuwe Netherlands Delivery Center (NLDC) van Deloitte binnen onze Operate practice waar je samen met je collega’s werkt aan het runnen en onderhouden van essentiële bedrijfsdiensten, processen en functies van onze klanten. Je gebruikt innovatieve AI \& Data toepassingen om kwaliteit en efficiëntie in werkprocessen te vergroten. Op deze manier weet je echt impact te maken.

**In deze rol:**

* Werk je aan de ontwikkeling, implementatie en continue verbetering van innovatieve (Gen) AI \& Data oplossingen voor onze klanten.
* Vertaal je complexe klantvragen naar innovatieve, veilige en schaalbare (Gen) AI \& Data oplossingen en leg je inzichten in begrijpelijke taal uit aan de klant.
* Ontwerp, bouw, optimaliseer en test je ML \& (Gen) AI\-modellen en data pipelines.
* Containeriseer je workloads met behulp van bijvoorbeeld Docker en Kubernetes.
* Implementeer en schaal je klantoplossingen met CI/CD\-frameworks en Cloud\-automatisering (MLOps).
* Neem je eigenaarschap over de technische architectuur en kwaliteit.
* Automatiseer je operationele taken met (AI) tooling om kwaliteit en efficiëntie te vergroten, en handmatige interventies in processen te verminderen.
* Werk je nauw samen met andere AI, Data, software \& DevOps specialisten in multidisciplinaire teams.
* Blijf je op de hoogte van de nieuwste technologieën en draag je actief bij aan innovatieve toepassingen en optimalisaties binnen het NL Delivery Center.

Operating across the full adjoe stack—backend services, SDKs, catalog, and integrations—we unblock strategic launches, build custom integrations, and resolve critical issues in production.


We act as the safety net for our product teams and the first line of defense for enterprise publishers like Venmo and PayPal. Beyond immediate troubleshooting, we build and scale high\-impact diagnostic tooling to automate root\-cause resolution across client\-side and microservice architectures. Combining cross\-stack technical depth with rapid execution, Product Operations ensures seamless performance wherever enterprise growth meets global scale.

**Your Mission \& Who We Are Looking For:**

* **5\+ years in Go, built for scale.** You have 3\+ years building production Go services and know how to profile and optimize applications under real traffic, not just identify bottlenecks, but eliminate them. You've worked on large Go applications with considerable daily request volume.
* **Distributed systems are your default context.** You design and operate microservice architectures using **Kafka** and **SQS/SNS** for reliable asynchronous communication, and are responsible for collecting and aggregating billions of daily API events into **Kafka** streams queryable from the data lake in seconds.
* **Data performance matters at every layer.** You work with **Druid**, **MySQL**, **Redis**, and **DynamoDB**, optimizing queries and data access patterns to deliver few\-millisecond response times. You know the tradeoffs between different storage solutions and when each one is the right tool.
* **Bridge product and Data Science.** You collaborate directly with Data Scientists to integrate ML algorithms that optimize ad delivery: translating complex mathematical solutions into production\-ready backend services.
* **Partner\-facing data ownership.** You support partners through well\-documented open APIs, providing raw or aggregated data transparently based on their business needs.
* **Infrastructure fluency is part of the job.** You have hands\-on experience with **Terraform**, **Docker**, and serverless infrastructure, owning services end\-to\-end from development to production.

**We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.**

**What’s in It for You?**


At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

* **Go Big.** Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.
* **Move Fast.** Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.
* **Be Direct.** Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.
* **Thrive Together.** Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.
* **Have Fun.** Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.


We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist – Optimization Algorithms & Software Development (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
ZEISS Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology


Enabler for smaller, more powerful, and more energy\-efficient microchips


Working for tomorrow today.


Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are produced using ZEISS technologies. As the centerpiece of every electronically controlled system, they have become an integral part of our everyday lives – whether in smartphones, smart homes or smart factories. ZEISS is a technology leader in the field of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With high\-precision lithography optics, photomask systems and process control solutions, ZEISS enables the production of ever smaller, increasingly powerful, and more energy\-efficient microchips, and thus plays a pivotal role in the age of micro\- and nanoelectronics.


As a developer for the system optimization of EUV lithography systems, you will help advance some of the world’s most sophisticated optical systems for semiconductor manufacturing. You will develop physical and mathematical models, optimization algorithms, and robust software solutions used in both system development and production. Working closely with experts from optical design, metrology, process development, production, system engineering, and software development, you will turn complex technical challenges into scalable and sustainable solutions. Depending on the task, you will coordinate technical activities or small expert teams and take responsibility for the quality, schedule, and results of your work.


**Your Role**
=============

* Design, refine, and implement physical and mathematical models as well as numerical algorithms for the adjustment and optimization of complex optical systems.
* Analyze system and production behavior, identify optimization potential, and validate solutions through simulations and experiments under realistic conditions.
* Translate mathematical and physical concepts into robust, maintainable, and testable software used in development and production, primarily in MATLAB and complementary software environments.
* Shape and drive the evolution of our software architecture, including modularization, interfaces, data flows, reusable components, and automated testing—while ensuring the continued operation of existing functionality.
* Establish and promote modern software development practices across projects through code and design reviews, regression testing, version control, knowledge sharing, pairing, and technical mentoring.
* Coordinate activities across optical design, metrology, production, system engineering, and customer interfaces; where appropriate, lead small expert teams and support the introduction of new processes and future technologies.

**Your Profile**
================

* A degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, natural sciences, or a related field; a PhD is an advantage.
* Strong expertise in mathematical optimization, numerical methods, physical modeling, or related algorithmic disciplines, with experience applying them to complex technical systems.
* Extensive experience in software and algorithm development, ideally for scientific, technical, or production\-related applications.
* Strong proficiency in MATLAB; experience with Python, C\#, C\+\+, or comparable languages is an advantage.
* Sound knowledge of software architecture and design, including modularization, interfaces, maintainability, testability, reusable components, and the incremental modernization of existing software systems.
* A proven ability to connect physical domain knowledge, mathematical algorithms, and professional software engineering, combined with fluent English at C1 level and a pragmatic, structured, and collaborative working style.

Your ZEISS Recruiting Team:


Sandra Köhler

jobs.title: Support Engineer (Snowflake)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Legal \& General (L\&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.

**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**


We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.

**Who we are**


Our Retail business supports customers throughout their lives, to help them save, plan, protect and enjoy retirement.


We’re a leading provider of retirement and protection solutions. We aim to support our c.12\.8 million policyholders and workplace members throughout their lifelong financial journeys.


We focus on helping the customers of today and tomorrow achieve better long\-term outcomes. We either talk with them directly or work with intermediaries and employers to meet their needs. We use the latest technology to connect with them quickly, efficiently and wherever possible in highly personalised ways.

 **Job Description**  

We’re looking for a Support Engineer to help keep our data services running smoothly. You’ll join a collaborative support team responsible for our Snowflake data warehouse, investigating pipeline issues, responding to internal queries and helping colleagues access the accurate data they need.


This is an opportunity to work with Snowflake, DBT, SQL and Azure technology in a varied environment where your troubleshooting and communication skills will be equally valued. We welcome candidates from different backgrounds who can demonstrate the relevant skills, even if they do not meet every desirable requirement.


What you'll be doing:

* Monitoring scheduled ETL jobs and data ingestion pipelines
* Confirming that data has loaded successfully into Snowflake
* Investigating pipeline failures and coordinating timely resolutions
* Responding to incidents and service requests from internal colleagues
* Troubleshooting missing, incomplete or inconsistent data
* Supporting technical and non\-technical users with Snowflake queries
* Communicating progress and solutions in clear, accessible language
* Prioritising issues effectively within a fast\-paced support environment


Who we're looking for:

* Practical experience of working with Snowflake
* Good working knowledge of DBT
* Strong SQL skills
* Previous experience within a support or service desk environment
* Effective troubleshooting and analytical problem\-solving skills
* An approachable communication style and the ability to explain technical subjects clearly
* The ability to remain organised and make sound decisions under pressure
* Experience of Azure Data Factory or the wider Azure ecosystem would be beneficial


Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance \-related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
* Generous pension contribution
* Life assurance
* Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
* At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
* Competitive family leave
* Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand\-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
* There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
* We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


\#LI\-NH1

 **Additional Information**  

At L\&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.


If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. **Company Description**  

Legal \& General (L\&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.

**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**


We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.

**Who we are**


Our Retail business supports customers throughout their lives, to help them save, plan, protect and enjoy retirement.


We’re a leading provider of retirement and protection solutions. We aim to support our c.12\.8 million policyholders and workplace members throughout their lifelong financial journeys.


We focus on helping the customers of today and tomorrow achieve better long\-term outcomes. We either talk with them directly or work with intermediaries and employers to meet their needs. We use the latest technology to connect with them quickly, efficiently and wherever possible in highly personalised ways.

 **Job Description**  

We’re looking for a Support Engineer to help keep our data services running smoothly. You’ll join a collaborative support team responsible for our Snowflake data warehouse, investigating pipeline issues, responding to internal queries and helping colleagues access the accurate data they need.


This is an opportunity to work with Snowflake, DBT, SQL and Azure technology in a varied environment where your troubleshooting and communication skills will be equally valued. We welcome candidates from different backgrounds who can demonstrate the relevant skills, even if they do not meet every desirable requirement.


What you'll be doing:

* Monitoring scheduled ETL jobs and data ingestion pipelines
* Confirming that data has loaded successfully into Snowflake
* Investigating pipeline failures and coordinating timely resolutions
* Responding to incidents and service requests from internal colleagues
* Troubleshooting missing, incomplete or inconsistent data
* Supporting technical and non\-technical users with Snowflake queries
* Communicating progress and solutions in clear, accessible language
* Prioritising issues effectively within a fast\-paced support environment


Who we're looking for:

* Practical experience of working with Snowflake
* Good working knowledge of DBT
* Strong SQL skills
* Previous experience within a support or service desk environment
* Effective troubleshooting and analytical problem\-solving skills
* An approachable communication style and the ability to explain technical subjects clearly
* The ability to remain organised and make sound decisions under pressure
* Experience of Azure Data Factory or the wider Azure ecosystem would be beneficial


Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance \-related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
* Generous pension contribution

* Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
* At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
* Competitive family leave
* Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand\-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
* There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
* We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience

jobs.title: Protection and Control Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Base Location**: Melksham, Oxford, Reading, Slough or Portsmouth  

**Salary:** £64,085 \- £76,581 \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.  

**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available



We are looking for an enthusiastic and diligent engineer to join the SSEN Protection \& Control (P\&C) Team working across the Southern  

Distribution Network.



As a Protection \& Control Engineer, you’ll work with a passionate team on projects from 6\.6kV to 132kV, taking designs from concept through construction and energisation. You’ll collaborate with stakeholders to deliver compliant, cost\-effective solutions on time. You’ll also engage in innovation, standardisation, technology assessments, and work with suppliers on new products and services.



Join us now to help tackle Net Zero challenges and embrace opportunities from new technologies and services.


**You will:**


* Develop scoping documentation and Main Connections \& Protection (MC\&P) Diagrams.
* Review Protection \& Control (P\&C) designs from third parties for 11kV, 33kV, and 132kV networks for SSEN.
* Specify P\&C equipment such as relays, CTs, and VTs.
* Produce detailed designs, including AC/DC schematics, and carry out protection grading studies with relay file/settings creation.
* Review Commissioning Plans, attend panel meetings, and witness FAT and on\-site commissioning as required.


**You have:**


* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in a relevant field is required.
* Proven experience working on Distribution Networks from 11kV to 132kV, ideally a UK Distribution Network.
* Background as a Protection \& Control Design Engineer, including work at 11kV, 33kV, and 132kV.
* Experience in protection relays, relay panels, CT \& VT sizing, protection grading studies, and producing accurate AC/DC schematics.
* Strong knowledge of UK electrical standards, CDM regulations, and a commitment to safety with experience in risk mitigation.


Regular travel is required and as a result we can only accept applications from candidates that hold a current driving license.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Distribution, part of the wider SSE group, powers 3\.9 million UK homes and businesses. Our team of more than 4,200 skilled engineers, customer service advisors and technical specialists keep customers connected to a safe, reliable supply of electricity while investing in and developing the flexible networks needed for our low carbon future.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact laura.morrison@sse.com / 01738 341814 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.
