Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to become our first dedicated internal QA professional and take ownership of quality across our products and services. This is a hands\-on, technical role with significant ownership. Our systems are primarily backend and API\-driven, so your focus will be on backend, API, integration, and end\-to\-end testing rather than simply testing the UI. You’ll work closely with developers and DevOps to understand how our systems work, identify risks early, investigate complex issues, improve test coverage, and ensure that releases are ready for production.

  

  

As our first dedicated QA hire, you’ll also have the opportunity to shape how QA is done across the company — from test strategy and automation to processes, tooling, and release quality. We’re looking for someone technical, pragmatic, and curious who enjoys going beyond the UI to investigate APIs, databases, logs, infrastructure, and real\-world system behavior.

  

  

**Your Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities:**


* Own and continuously improve our **QA strategy, processes, and testing approach**.
* Plan and execute **manual, exploratory, regression, integration, API, and end\-to\-end testing**.
* Test **REST APIs and end\-to\-end business flows** using Postman, cURL, or similar tools.

jobs.description:

Please apply via the following link: https://ypto.recruitee.com/o/sap\-domain\-architect\-supply\-chain\-management\-scm


**Comment pouvez\-vous faire la différence ?**
----------------------------------------------

  

**About the shERPa Project**
  

NMBS is undergoing a company\-wide transformation through the shERPa program, implementing SAP S/4HANA as a greenfield solution. This program will standardize processes, improve operational efficiency, and enable digital transformation across all business units — including Supply Chain, Rolling Stock maintenance, Infrastructure and Operations.


**Quel est votre rôle à la SNCB ?**
-----------------------------------

  

**Job Purpose**


We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SAP Domain Architect Supply Chain Management (SCM) to define and lead the target architecture for NMBS’s end\-to\-end supply chain processes. This includes Demand en Supply Planning across all planning horizons (log\-, mid\- and short term), Inventory \& Warehouse Management, Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Logistics Execution, and the Maintenance Supply Chain — all in the unique context of NMBS responsible for safety\-critical materials, rolling stock availability, Finance, HR and Customer Relations.
  

You will design the future\-state SCM architecture on SAP S/4HANA, ensuring strong integration with Maintenance (PM), Finance, Engineering, and NMBS's depot logistics. You will guide complex transformations and support NMBS in building a resilient, transparent, and regulatory\-compliant supply chain.

  

This vacancy is for a payroll profile

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Define the S/4HANA SCM target architecture tailored to NMBS’s depot operations, rolling stock maintenance flows, critical spare parts management, and logistics constraints.

Model processes and enterprise capabilities with ADOIT or ARIS for governance and compliance.

Everyone is unique. That's why we believe it’s important that you can be yourself — It makes SNCB stronger. We therefore place great value on diversity and inclusion.


**Qu'avons\-nous à vous offrir ?**

Choosing Ypto means choosing to contribute to the digital transformation of the Belgian railways. You will have a job with social impact and ample opportunity to make your own contribution. Alongside a healthy work\-life balance and a competitive salary, we offer:

You will work near Brussels\-South station.

jobs.title: OSI PI Engineer
jobs.description:
De functie combineert technische expertise in PI AF en PI Vision met een sterke focus op data\-contextualisatie, GxP\-compliance en betrouwbare dataflows. Vanuit een zelfstandige rol werk je nauw samen met het manufacturingteam, het PI\-team en de system owner.


**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------


### **PI AF\-configuratie \& data\-contextualisatie**


Je configureert PI AF (Asset Framework) om data uit de manufacturingprocessen op een gestructureerde en betekenisvolle manier te contextualiseren. De configuraties worden afgestemd op de specifieke noden van de productieomgeving en ondersteunen een betrouwbare verwerking en interpretatie van procesdata.


Daarnaast werk je mee aan de monitoring van Run2Run\-processen via PI Vision\-displays. Hierbij ligt de focus op de front\-end en op het overzichtelijk beschikbaar maken van relevante productie\-informatie voor de gebruikers.


### **Validatie \& change management**


Je valideert ontwikkelde PI AF\-configuraties volgens de geldende GxP\-vereisten en de gedocumenteerde procedures voor PI AF change management. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat configuraties op een gecontroleerde en gedocumenteerde manier worden voorbereid voor implementatie.


Na validatie implementeer je de configuraties in de PI\-productieomgeving. Wanneer procedures of werkwijzen wijzigen, draag je bij aan het actualiseren en onderhouden van de bestaande PI AF change managementdocumentatie. Afstemming met het manufacturingteam, het PI\-team en de system owner vormt hierbij een belangrijk onderdeel van de functie.


**Wie ben jij?**
----------------


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma of gelijkwaardige technische ervaring en hebt ongeveer 2 tot 5 jaar relevante ervaring opgebouwd binnen een technische of industriële omgeving. Je hebt een sterke kennis van OSI PI, met specifieke expertise in PI AF en PI Vision.


Ervaring binnen een GxP\-productieomgeving is belangrijk, net als een goed begrip van IT/OT\-systemen en de bijhorende datastromen. Je bent in staat om zelfstandig PI AF\-configuraties uit te werken voor concrete requirements en weet daarbij technische noden te vertalen naar een praktische en betrouwbare oplossing.


Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels. Kennis van Lean\-principes en ervaring met agile werkwijzen of tools zoals Jira en Confluence zijn een pluspunt.


**Wat maakt deze rol uniek?**
-----------------------------


* **Directe impact op manufacturing:** de PI AF\-configuraties en PI Vision\-oplossingen ondersteunen de datagedreven werking van de productieomgeving.
* **Techniek binnen een gereguleerde context:** de combinatie van OSI PI, GxP\-validatie en change management zorgt voor een uitdagende technische omgeving waarin kwaliteit en compliance centraal staan.
* **Zelfstandige verantwoordelijkheid:** de functie biedt ruimte om PI AF\-configuraties zelfstandig uit te werken en van validatie tot implementatie op te volgen.
* **Sterke samenwerking tussen disciplines:** je vormt de technische schakel tussen manufacturing, het PI\-team en de system owner.

**Laat je carrière knallen bij Enginity**
-----------------------------------------


Bij Enginity draait alles om technische expertise, persoonlijke groei en projecten die écht impact maken binnen industriële omgevingen. Als consultant krijg je de kans om jouw kennis in te zetten bij toonaangevende klanten, terwijl je blijft bouwen aan je eigen traject.


### **De kracht achter de knal**


Enginity maakt deel uit van de Cronos Groep en combineert de slagkracht van een sterk netwerk met de persoonlijke aanpak van een hecht team.


### **Kies je eigen traject**


Geen standaardpad, maar een carrière die mee evolueert met jouw ambities. Samen bekijken we welke projecten, opleidingen en uitdagingen aansluiten bij je expertise en groeidoelen.


### **Brandstof om vooruit te gaan**


Via gerichte begeleiding, kennisdeling en opleidingsmogelijkheden blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen in zowel technische als soft skills. Zo krijg je de ruimte om je expertise verder te verdiepen en breder inzetbaar te worden.


### **Meer dan collega’s: een familie**


Enginity staat voor een toegankelijke cultuur waarin mensen elkaar kennen, ondersteunen en versterken. We spreken niet voor niets over onze Enginity Family.


### **Hier geldt: 1 \+ 1 \= 3**


Door technische kennis, ondernemerschap en samenwerking te bundelen, ontstaan oplossingen die verder gaan dan het individuele project. Samen maken we het verschil bij klanten én binnen het team.


### **Klaar om te schitteren?**

jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een ervaren .NET-developer die de stap naar architectuur heeft gemaakt en zich de afgelopen jaren actief is gaan verdiepen in AI. Iemand met een stevige basis in C#/.NET, die weet wat er nodig is om software in productie te krijgen en te houden, en die zijn technische kennis en nieuwsgierigheid naar AI nu wil inzetten om het totaalontwerp van AI-oplossingen naar zich toe te trekken.

Concreet: samen met onze andere senior engineers bepaal je welke modellen en infrastructuur we inzetten, hoe die aansluiten op de bestaande systemen van ons en onze klanten, en je bouwt zelf mee om het werkend te krijgen. We zoeken nadrukkelijk geen AI-specialist zonder developmentachtergrond, en ook geen developer zonder affiniteit met AI. We zoeken de combinatie: een doorgewinterde .NET-engineer die het pad naar AI is ingeslagen.

Groeien met Hoppinger

We zijn eerlijk over waar we staan. Hoppinger is op dit moment nog geen AI-native organisatie. Onze platformen voor bedrijfskritische processen in zorg, housing, kennis en onderwijs en industrie zijn gebouwd op een stevige softwarebasis, met C#/.NET als belangrijk fundament. AI voegen we daar gericht aan toe.
De ambitie is wel duidelijk: we groeien naar een AI-first manier van werken, waarbij AI geen losstaand experiment is, maar een beheersbaar en schaalbaar onderdeel van het platform. Om die stap te zetten hebben we mensen nodig die hun technische ervaring en hun nieuwsgierigheid naar AI al effectief combineren in de praktijk. Jij helpt die transformatie waarmaken en geeft er mede richting aan.

Jouw rol: van bedrijfsprobleem naar werkende oplossing

Je vertaalt het vraagstuk van onze klanten naar een technische oplossing en bepaalt hoe AI wordt ingezet binnen hun platformen. Dat is breder dan modellen kiezen: het gaat om het ontwerpen van een complete oplossing, van architectuur tot productie. Je staat met één been in de code en met het andere aan het whiteboard bij de directie van onze klanten.
Je dagen zijn afwisselend en bestaan onder andere uit:
Het vertalen van een bedrijfsprobleem naar een technische architectuur
Het beoordelen welke AI-aanpak past: agents, klassieke ML of een combinatie, en de afweging tussen bouwen, kopen of een API aanroepen
Het zelf meebouwen aan oplossingen, in een omgeving waar C#/.NET en moderne frameworks de basis van onze platformen vormen
Het bewaken van non-functionals: schaalbaarheid, latency, kosten, beveiliging en compliance
Het werken aan agentic systemen: orkestratie, tool use, human-in-the-loop patronen en meer
Het samenwerken met experience architects, engineers en data-analisten, en het leiden van zowel een architectuurreview met developers als een whiteboard-sessie met een directeur

Wie ben jij

Je bent in de eerste plaats een ervaren software engineer met een sterke .NET-achtergrond, doorgegroeid naar een architectuurrol. Je hebt aantoonbaar software gebouwd en live gebracht, en je verdiept je actief in wat er nodig is om AI betrouwbaar in productie te draaien. Die laatste stap heb je al gezet of je bent er serieus mee bezig.
Je herkent jezelf hierin:
Ruime ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, met C#/.NET als vaste waarde in je gereedschapskist. Dit is voor deze rol een harde eis, geen pré
Kennis van softwarearchitectuur: API-design, microservices, event-driven architectuur en containerisatie
Ervaring met minstens één hyperscaler (Azure, AWS of Google Cloud)
Hands-on ervaring met LLM's en het bouwen van AI-toepassingen. Productie-ervaring is een pré, een aantoonbare en al actieve drive om hierin verder te groeien is een eis
Affiniteit met agentic development en de ambitie om je hierin te specialiseren
Het vermogen om technische keuzes uit te leggen aan niet-technische stakeholders, van product owner tot C-level
Relevante certificeringen (zoals Azure Solutions Architect of AWS Solutions Architect) zijn een pré, aantoonbare kennis en ervaring wegen zwaarder

Wat bieden wij

Veel vrijheid en een ambitieuze cultuur waar persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staat. Natuurlijk draait niet alles om werk, en bovenop alle gebruikelijke benefits die je mag verwachten bieden we ook:
Salaris :
een marktconform salaris, € 4.900 - € 7.500, o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring
Celebration Leave: ruil 3 nationale feestdagen in voor jouw eigen feestdagen
Alleo: kies extra benefits op basis van je eigen interesses
100% doorbetaald partnerverlof: voor een goede start van je gezin
Hybride werken: flexibiliteit om te werken vanuit onze inspirerende kantoren in Rotterdam en Utrecht (De Bilt) of vanuit huis
Multidisciplinaire teams: werk samen met ambitieuze collega's
Opleidingsbudget: voor jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling
Lerende organisatie: groei in een omgeving vol kennisdeling en innovatie
Gratis lunch: met aandacht voor gezond eten, samen lunchen en vaste tradities zoals Krokettenwoensdag

Even kort over Hoppinger

Hoppinger is een Digital Partner die organisaties helpt versnellen in hun digitale groei en innovatie. Wij gidsen opdrachtgevers bij strategische keuzes en de ontwikkeling van platformen voor bedrijfskritische klant- en kernprocessen. Door onze expertise over meerdere disciplines, sectorervaring en bewezen methodieken realiseren we digitale oplossingen die waarde creëren voor organisaties, medewerkers en eindgebruikers. Voor nu, en in de toekomst.
We werken voor organisaties in impactvolle sectoren zoals zorg, educatie, industrie en dienstverlening.

Technische installaties leveren steeds meer data op. Maar hoe zet je die data om in software waar engineers en assetbeheerders echt mee kunnen werken? Als AI Software Engineer bij Iv bouw je toepassingen die precies dat doen.

Je ontwikkelt schaalbare applicaties en API’s met onder andere Python, C# en FastAPI. Daarbij vertaal je technische vraagstukken naar oplossingen die betrouwbaar werken en praktisch toepasbaar zijn.

Een goed idee is pas waardevol als het ook in de praktijk werkt. Daarom denk je mee over de software-architectuur, werk je technische ontwerpen uit en bouw je mee aan de implementatie. Je doorloopt het hele ontwikkelproces en blijft betrokken bij de doorontwikkeling. De lijnen zijn kort, de sfeer is ontspannen en professioneel en we zoeken samen naar een oplossing die werkt. Tegelijk krijg je ruimte om jouw rol verder vorm te geven. Ervaring met Azure of een ander cloudplatform is een pré.

Je werkt gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het volledige ontwikkelproces.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Een uitdagende en gevarieerde baan bij het meest diverse ingenieursbureau van Nederland! Zo kun je rekenen op:

De gaafste projecten in alle sectoren: je werkt aan hoogwaardige oplossingen waar de maatschappij écht iets aan heeft. Van ’s werelds grootste offshore windplatformen, bruggen en sluizen tot fabrieken, waterzuiveringsinstallaties en onderzeeboten.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Hybride
jobs.description:
Wil jij eigenaar zijn van een platform dat er echt toe doet? Van cloudinfrastructuur en releases tot een vloot slimme kasten in het veld, en van security-audits van veeleisende klanten tot de storing die niemand anders kan vinden? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wij zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die de dagelijkse werking van ons platform draagt: de Azure-infrastructuur, het uitrollen van nieuwe klantomgevingen, CI/CD en releases, security en compliance, kostenbeheersing en de sleutelkasten en lockers die bij onze klanten draaien. Je bent de specialist op wie het team en onze klanten kunnen bouwen. Je adviseert onze Chief Software Officer over de technische keuzes en begeleidt junior en medior DevOps engineers in hun ontwikkeling.
Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior DevOps Engineer zorg jij dat wat het softwareteam bouwt betrouwbaar, veilig en herhaalbaar in productie komt en daar blijft draaien. Je ondersteunt de CSO bij strategische keuzes over architectuur en investeringen door te komen met onderbouwde voorstellen, die je uitvoert en bewaakt. Je werkt nauw samen met de Tech Lead en het softwareteam en bent het technische gezicht van Nauta Connect richting de IT- en securityafdelingen van onze klanten.
Platform en netwerk:
je beheert en ontwikkelt onze cloud- en on-premise infrastructuur via Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/deployment stacks/Azure Verified Modules), firewalls, loadbalancers, Front Door, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Services, ExpressRoute en VPN, DNS en certificaten.
Uitrol nieuwe klanten:
je zet de infrastructuur voor nieuwe klanten en omgevingen geautomatiseerd en volgens de standaard neer (spoke, netwerk, database, toegang en configuratie), ontwikkelt die standaard door en faseert omgevingen gecontroleerd uit.
Releases en pipelines:
je onderhoudt en verbetert onze CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps (smoke- en performancetests, quality gates, security scanning, geautomatiseerde databasemigraties) en voert de releases en hotfixes van onze productsuite uit, met minimale downtime via blue/green of canary deployments.
Security en compliance:
je werkt shift-left: je signaleert en dicht kwetsbaarheden met tooling als SonarQube, GitLeaks, OWASP Dependency-Check, Trivy en OWASP ZAP, stelt securityrapportages op, beantwoordt security-vragenlijsten van klanten en ondersteunt onze ISO 27001-audits.
Databases en observability:
je beheert onze SQL Server- en PostgreSQL-databases in productie (backups, herstel, migraties, performance) en richt monitoring in met Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics en Grafana.
Kosten:
je maakt de kosten van het platform per omgeving en per klant inzichtelijk, optimaliseert zonder verlies van beschikbaarheid of veiligheid en maakt de kostenimpact van elk voorstel expliciet.
Vloot en devices:
je bouwt en onderhoudt de Linux golden image voor onze kasten en lockers en beheert de vloot in het veld: provisioning, updates en het oplossen van problemen op de devices.
Incidenten en klantomgevingen:
je bent het eindstation voor storingen die support en het softwareteam niet kunnen oplossen, ook op het grensvlak van software en infrastructuur. Je bouwt testopstellingen die klantomgevingen nabootsen en helpt klanten ons product veilig in hun netwerk te landen.
Team en kennis:
je leidt de junior en medior DevOps engineers op, reviewt infrastructuur- en securitywerk en zorgt dat kennis in het team wordt vastgelegd in plaats van in één hoofd.

Wat motiveert jou?

Eigenaarschap:
je bijdrage heeft een echte impact op ons platform.
Breedte:
cloud, netwerk, pipelines, security, databases, kosten, embedded devices en klantnetwerken; weinig DevOps-rollen zijn zo veelzijdig.
Impact:
klanten als zorginstellingen en overheden vertrouwen dagelijks op wat jij draaiende houdt.
Groei:
bij bewezen diepgang volg jij het ontwikkelpad naar DevOps Architect.
Samenwerking:
korte lijnen met de CSO en de Tech Lead, en DevOps-collega's die van jou willen leren.
Flexibiliteit:
hybride werken en werktijden die bij je passen.

Dit bieden wij jou

Een compact, divers en gedreven team waarin jouw werk direct zichtbaar is
Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van je ervaring, en fijne secundaire voorwaarden
Tijd en budget voor opleidingen, certificeringen en conferenties
Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken
Laptop en telefoon van de zaak en wat je nodig hebt om ook thuis prettig te werken
28 vakantiedagen
Korting op je sportschoolabonnement, een vitaliteitsprogramma met allerlei (sportieve) activiteiten en gezellige teamuitjes.
Een cultuur waarin experimenteren mag, fouten maken erbij hoort en successen samen gevierd worden

Wat breng jij mee?

Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in IT of informatica, of gelijkwaardige kennis opgebouwd in de praktijk.
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in DevOps of platform engineering, met aantoonbare verantwoordelijkheid voor productieomgevingen.
Diepgaande kennis van Microsoft Azure (onder meer App Services, Container Apps, Functions, Key Vault, Front Door, Application Gateway, SignalR, Managed Redis) en van Azure-netwerken: landing zone, hub-and-spoke, VNet-peering, NSG's, private endpoints, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute en VPN.
Ruime ervaring met Infrastructure as Code met Bicep en/of Terraform, met containers (Docker, Container Apps, AKS) en met CI/CD in Azure DevOps Pipelines.
Ervaring met het geautomatiseerd uitrollen van nieuwe klantomgevingen.
Ervaring met high-availability-ontwerpen en minimal-downtime-releases (blue/green, canary) en met incidentonderzoek op basis van logs, traces en databases.
Ervaring met DevSecOps-tooling, CVE-afhandeling en securityrapportages binnen ISO 27001, de OWASP Top 10 en de NCSC-richtlijnen.
Ervaring met SQL Server en PostgreSQL in productie, met monitoring en observability en met Linux inclusief golden images.
Scripting in Bash en PowerShell, en voldoende leesvaardigheid in .NET/C# om applicatiecode op infrastructuur- en securityaspecten te reviewen.
Het vermogen om complexe technische zaken helder uit te leggen aan klanten en collega's, in het Nederlands en Engels.
Een pré:
ervaring met ARM en Ansible, MariaDB en MySQL, fleetmanagement van embedded devices, Python en/of C#, andere cloudplatformen, of certificeringen op het gebied van Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform of security.

Wie zijn wij?

Nauta Connect ontwikkelt slimme oplossingen voor de uitgifte en het beheer van sleutels en bedrijfsmiddelen: elektronische sleutelkasten en lockers, naadloos geïntegreerd met onze eigen Connect-software. Die software is het kloppende hart van onze oplossingen en wordt volledig in huis ontwikkeld. Onze klanten zijn onder meer zorginstellingen, gemeentes, onderwijsinstellingen en organisaties met hoge eisen aan veiligheid en beschikbaarheid.

Ons softwareteam is compact, hecht en denkt actief mee. We gaan graag de uitdaging aan om complexe problemen binnen organisaties op te lossen, waarbij onze hardware en slimme software samen het verschil maken. Korte lijnen, veel eigenaarschap en de ruimte om iets écht te bouwen.

Nauta Connect is onderdeel van de Nauta Group, een (h)echt familiebedrijf met het hoofdkantoor in Barneveld. Hoe gaat het met je? En heb je nog leuke plannen voor de komende dagen? Het zijn vragen die je vaak hoort in onze wandelgangen. We houden van persoonlijk contact met elkaar en met onze klanten, en werken iedere dag met een enthousiast team van zo'n 170 medewerkers aan het succes van ons bedrijf.

You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used

AUFGABEN MIT IMPACT

Du entwickelst CRM-Features und -Services für Kundenprofile, Suchen sowie Mandanten- und Tenant-Konfiguration, auf die sich interne Teams täglich verlassen

KI-gestützte Produktfeatures wie chatbasierte Assistenten, strukturierte Plan-Generierung, Ticket-zu-Umsetzungsplan-Workflows, PR-Zusammenfassungen und Übersetzungsentwürfe entstehen in deiner Verantwortung - stets mit einem Menschen im Loop

Mit einer statisch typisierten Backend-Sprache wie C#/.NET (unser Schwerpunkt liegt auf ASP.NET Core), modernem JavaScript/TypeScript und einem komponentenbasierten Frontend-Framework wie React arbeitest du sicher, ebenso mit Web-APIs wie REST, GraphQL oder gRPC

Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit React-Meta-Frameworks wie Next.js, dokumentenorientierten Datenbanken wie MongoDB, containerbasierten Deployments oder sogar mit LLM-APIs und Agent-SDKs mit - vieles davon kannst du dir bei uns aneignen

Lead cross-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.
Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level engineers.
Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

6 to 10+ years building production backend services, end-to-end.
Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
SQL and relational database fundamentals.
Writing and maintaining tests.
Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
Production experience with AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.

Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
Strong written and verbal communication.

Experience with ledgers, double-entry accounting, or other financial-data systems.
Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

Discounted Euronet ESPP

Healthcare

This role suits an engineer who wants to solve hard optimization problems in the field, work directly with customers, and feed what they learn back into the core product.

Background in workforce or resource scheduling domains.

Experience with large-scale data modelling.

Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms or vertical-specific optimization products.

Frontend: Angular, TypeScript

Optimization: Constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, heuristics, algorithm development.

Deployment: On-site and embedded customer environments, cloud-hosted platform

Customer scheduling and planning problems modeled accurately and solved within performance targets.

Working solutions shipped to customers, on tight timelines.

Optimizer performance and quality issues diagnosed and resolved efficiently.

Field learnings translated into concrete product and engineering improvements.

Strong, trusted relationships built with customer teams.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027 - Software Engineering & Innovation
jobs.description:
Software Engineering & Innovation Summer Internship 2027 (June - August)

A summer at Baillie Gifford could transform your career before it even starts. As an independent global investment management business, we rely on technology to underpin everything we do. That’s why we constantly invest in our technology and the team of professionals who bring it to life. Join us as a summer intern and show us what you can do!

What can you expect

You’ll be immersed in our technology environment from the word go on our paid summer internship. Expect to do real work and take responsibility as you gain hands-on experience with our technologies in an AI-native environment. You can look forward to being part of a refreshingly open, cooperative, and supportive team culture. Plus, you will get the training and support to broaden your skills and discover your future potential, from LinkedIn Learning, to Pluralsight and peer-to-peer working, a summer with us will transform your skillset and CV!

Interns will be placed into cohorts, working on different live technical projects aligned to either our Application Development and Enablement Department or our Innovation Department. While the projects and technologies used will vary, all cohorts will gain exposure to emerging technologies, including AI and large language models (LLMs), and will have opportunities to explore how these tools are applied across our technology teams. Which team and project our interns will land in will depend on business needs.

Our Software Engineers create scalable applications and solutions that drive our business and make it smarter for the future. We’ll introduce you to our modern programming languages, cloud platforms and DevOps practices and show you how software engineering shapes the future of investment management. You’ll have the opportunity to touch a wide range of tech, possibly including .NET, Angular, Azure Service Bus, Docker and Microservices Architecture, to name a few, as well as getting to grips with Agile methodologies in a business setting.

Within our R&D team, our Engineers push the boundaries of what is possible with disruptive tech and grapple with deeply interesting problems. They work with a broad range of technologies, including Python and platforms such as PyTorch, TensorFlow and Hugging Face, as well as Gen AI, LLMs, CI/CD, containerisation and cloud.

You’ll discover how technology drives the business forward in the fast-evolving investment management industry. Irrespective of which department you land in, you’ll be exposed to emerging tech and new ideas.

Your internship will start with structured overviews that introduce you to our business. Following induction, you and your fellow interns will work together within your cohort on a live technical project for the firm. We’ll ensure you spend quality time with our experienced technical and business leads, who will share their knowledge and support you throughout the process. You can expect to get hands-on with the latest tools and approaches in AI – from working with large language models to building agentic workflows and intelligent systems.

Running alongside your project, you will have various development opportunities with other teams in our technical departments to ensure broad exposure to the range of careers possible in tech. During your first weeks, you will build relationships and learn about the tech we use, which will feel very different to the learning opportunities that university life provides.

This won’t be a passive learning experience; you’ll be contributing to real outcomes, collaborating closely with experienced engineers and subject matter experts, and learning by doing. There will be plenty of opportunities to grow your skills and make a tangible impact.

If your cohort completes its core project ahead of schedule, you’ll be encouraged to proactively seek out further opportunities to contribute across your team or department. With support from colleagues, you’ll be able to explore work that aligns with your interests and development goals while responding to the priorities and needs of the business.

The type of Candidate that we’re looking for

A penultimate (second last) year student studying for a technology-related degree, with a proven interest in software engineering, cloud native development & automation and/or GenAI/ML and experimentation.
A passion for technology, we’re looking for people who have a genuine interest in how we can harness the benefits of technology to impact everything we do positively.
A desire to learn requires a thirst for learning and a willingness to embrace challenges.
Great relationship and networking skills – the internship involves building strong relationships and working collaboratively across teams, so you’ll need to be able to work with a range of people at all levels and operate effectively whilst outside of your technical comfort zone.
Critical thinking, you will enjoy problem-solving, we’re looking for people who enjoy working with complex scenarios and can collaborate with others to deliver a project successfully, always asking ‘why?’
Resilient by nature and comfortable working in a fluid environment, where ambiguity and emerging tech collide, where technical creativity and ‘what if’ go together.

Critical Skills

Adaptability
Digital Effectiveness (incl.AI)
Team Working
Systems Thinking
Improvement Mindset
Nurturing Relationships

You can apply for only one of our two
internship programmes, so please carefully consider which programme most closely aligns with your career aspirations.

To apply, you will share your CV and answer one scored question. We encourage you to carefully consider your answer to the scored question so that it demonstrates your way of thinking and feels authentic to you.

Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives. In turn, Baillie Gifford does not use any AI in our recruitment processes.

Please note that, due to the programme's short-term nature, Baillie Gifford cannot sponsor visas. All applicants must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for the programmes. Our internship is based in Edinburgh and, due to its short duration, is an on-site opportunity. You must be comfortable being based in Edinburgh for the entire duration, between mid-June and late August, and sourcing your own accommodation in the Edinburgh area, if you are not based locally or within a commutable distance.

The project(s) and team our interns join are determined by business demands at the time of onboarding. No guarantee is provided regarding the specific technical team interns join.

Intapp is looking for a Client Support Engineer to join our Client Success & Support team. This is a technical, client-facing role focused on the investigation and resolution of issues across Intapp Time — our time capture and management platform — in both cloud and on-premise environments.

What you'll do

Own investigation, triage, and resolution of client-reported issues across Intapp Profitability, with a primary focus on Intapp Time in cloud and on-premise environments.

Diagnose issues across the Intapp Time ecosystem, including the web application, Admin, Desktop, Desktop Extension, Mobile, Capture, tenant configuration, and identity and access management.

Investigate common support scenarios such as time-entry and submission failures, missing client or matter data, validation and synchronisation issues, performance problems, login failures, and integration errors.

Use logs, error messages, configuration, browser diagnostics, API responses, and client-provided evidence to isolate root cause and distinguish product defects from configuration, data, network, or environmental issues.

Troubleshoot integrations between Intapp Time and clients' practice-management or financial-management systems using SQL, stored procedures, SOAP/REST APIs, data mappings, service accounts, and integration logs.

Support issues involving Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi) and Intapp Integrate, including schedules, connectors, mappings, credentials, queues, and process reporting.

Apply impact-based triage and prioritisation, taking account of production availability, affected users, business impact, and service-level expectations, and act promptly on high-priority or widespread issues.

Provide accurate, timely, and technically clear updates to client contacts, translating complex findings into practical next steps and maintaining ownership through to resolution.

Prepare complete escalation packages for product defects, including business impact, diagnostic evidence, steps to reproduce, and relevant logs.

Recognise when a request falls outside break-fix support and route it to the appropriate team while maintaining a smooth client handover.

Maintain accurate, audit-ready ticket records and contribute to knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides that improve consistency and time to resolution.

What you'll need

2+ years' experience supporting enterprise SaaS and/or on-premise software in a client-facing technical support or application support role.

Experience supporting integrations between enterprise business applications.

Practical experience with ticketing systems and support workflows, including impact-based prioritisation, SLA management, and accurate technical documentation.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex symptoms, interpret logs, and identify root cause.

Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL experience is highly desirable.

Working knowledge of SOAP and REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, JSON/XML payloads, and common integration or connectivity issues.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical client contacts.

A strong sense of ownership and client responsibility, with the ability to work independently, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and exercise sound judgement on when to escalate.

A genuine interest in using AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of support work; hands-on experience applying AI in a support or technical environment is an advantage.

Desirable

Experience supporting Intapp Time, other Intapp Profitability products, Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi), or Intapp Integrate.

Experience integrating time or billing applications with legal practice-management or financial-management systems such as Aderant, Elite/3E, or Carpe Diem.

Understanding of synchronisation, data mapping, scheduled jobs, and source-of-truth concepts in integrated enterprise applications.

Familiarity with Microsoft technologies such as .NET, Internet Information Services (IIS), Windows Server, PowerShell, or SQL Server, or relevant Microsoft, .NET, or SQL certification.

Experience with enterprise connectivity troubleshooting, including DNS, proxies, TLS certificates, firewall rules, load balancers, or network tracing tools such as Wireshark or Fiddler.

Experience with identity and access technologies such as SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, or Microsoft Entra ID.

Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or browser developer tools.

Experience creating knowledge-base content or support procedures that reduce recurring issues and improve resolution quality.

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible, where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities.

Expand your skills

Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.

Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energised throughout the day.

Our Values

About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

jobs.title: Mid or Senior Level Software Engineers – Poland
jobs.description:
Location
: Rzeszów (remote/hybrid options available)
Salary
: 13-20K PLN gross per month – Umowa o Pracę
Job Type
: Full-Time, Permanent

Are you looking to make your mark in a developer-centric and technology-focused software company? NewOrbit are looking for skilful software engineers wanting to expand their experience and be a central part of our exciting and growing team.

About Us NewOrbit Poland is a sister company of NewOrbit, a successful, innovative UK-based business that has been delivering software for nearly 15 years. We are a skilled and close-knit team, who work together to deliver entirely bespoke, highly-scalable, cloud-hosted web applications for our clients. We collaborate with a wide variety of clients, which means you gain exposure to lots of different industries - and challenges to solve.
Our stack is typically React
, . NET
, and Azure SQL Server
or Cosmos DB
, but expect variations on that as NewOrbit host everything on Azure
using a wide range of the available technologies. We’re a Microsoft Solutions Partner
, working very closely with Microsoft, including on new Azure technologies before they are released to the general public.

Candidate Requirements Our ideal candidate is someone with breadth, including C#
, TypeScript
, HTML/CSS
, and SQL
. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them, but you do need some full-stack experience. Ideally, you’ll have had some exposure to distributed system design and the full life-cycle of software development.
You will be comfortable estimating and designing features, and communicating with others. For a more senior role, you’ll need experience in technical leadership. There’s no staff management required for this role, but if that’s your one of your career goals then we have opportunities for that too.
NewOrbit use Agile
software development methods, so you should understand these approaches. If you’ve done Scrum that’s ideal, but an Agile mindset is more important.
Although not essential for the role, some test automation experience (e.g. test architecture, CI/CD) would be advantageous.

Overview of Responsibilities Working as part of a small project team where everyone is involved in the planning and execution of work.
Producing clean code to agreed timescales and quality.
Owning features and delivering them with minimal supervision.
Reviewing and submitting pull requests.
Handing over features for acceptance testing.
Owning or contributing to technical design and architecture.

For more senior candidates you would also be:
Leading a small project team of developers, you would be working alongside a project manager and product owner, but still very ‘hands-on’ and in code day-to-day.
Mentoring other members of the development team.
Assessing new technologies and patterns.
Helping us to interview potential candidates for the team.

Why NewOrbit? Being part of NewOrbit is much more than just a salary and holiday allowance (although those are important too!). Your package will include the following benefits, so you can share in our success:
Hybrid and remote working options – expect to visit our offices occasionally, ideally weekly. But let us know if you need more — or less!
Profit share scheme (discretionary)
Private LuxMed healthcare
MultiSport card co-financing
A friendly environment full of fellow enthusiasts:
Meals out
Activity days & retreat weekends
Outdoor activities

Work with us to: Enjoy what you do
: We hire smart people who share our drive and are genuinely proud of our team. We do projects that we believe in and aren’t afraid to challenge clients (and say no). We get our work done and go home - there’s no late-night working culture here.
Grow your career
: Our supportive environment and clear career paths help you thrive. NewOrbit provide access to Pluralsight and Frontend Masters on-demand training and share knowledge within the team through tech talks & coding sessions. We can also provide you with time or learning resources to get Azure certified.
Stay interested
: We welcome innovation and stay at the forefront, actively encouraging side projects and experimentation. We provide you with monthly Azure credits that you can use for whatever you like.
Have an impact
: Our driver is to make a positive difference to our clients and the team, so we look for people who own problems and feel personal pride in what they do. We rely on everyone in the team to look outwards and help decide and drive our technical strategy. If you think there’s something we can do better, we’ll listen.

Application Process Interested?
Please send your CV and any useful links you might have (Stack Overflow, GitHub, open source projects) to recruitment@neworbit.pl.
The next step would be a short 10-15 minute telephone call to have a quick chat about what you are interested in and your past experience.
You will then be invited to complete a programming exercise at your own pace via TestDome – typically around an hour of coding, done whenever suits you best.
If the exercise goes well, we’ll invite you for a final conversation with one of our team – around an hour to dig into your experience, values, and of course an opportunity for you to ask us questions. You will then get feedback on our decision either way – and we might even make you an offer there and then!

We look forward to hearing from you.

Please note: This role is Poland based and candidates are required to have the legal right to work in the Poland for employment.
A background check (including criminal records check and references) is required for this role.
NewOrbit are committed to a safe work environment that supports and respects equality, diversity and inclusion within our team.

jobs.title: Azure Integration / Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Who We Are

While Xebia is a global tech company, our journey in CEE started with two Polish companies – PGS Software, known for world-class cloud and software solutions, and GetInData, a pioneer in Big Data. Today, we’re a team of 1,000+ experts delivering top-notch work across cloud, data, and software. And we’re just getting started.
What We Do

We work on projects that matter – and that make a difference. From fintech and e-commerce to aviation, logistics, media, and fashion, we help our clients build scalable platforms, data and AI solutions, and cutting-edge applications to shape the future of tech. Our clients include McLaren, Aviva, Deloitte, Spotify, Disney, ING, UPS, Tesco, Truecaller, AllSaints, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, Allegro, InPost, and many, many more.
We value smart tech, real ownership, and continuous growth. We use modern, open-source stacks, and we’re proud to be trusted partners of Databricks, dbt, Snowflake, Azure, GCP, and AWS. Fun fact: we were the first AWS Premier Partner in Poland!
Beyond Projects

What makes Xebia special? Our community. We support tech communities, organize meetups (Software Talks, Data Tech Talks), and have a culture that actively support your growth via Guilds, Labs, and personal development budgets — for both tech and soft skills. It’s not just a job. It’s a place to grow.
What sets us apart?

Our mindset. Our vibe. Our people. And while that’s hard to capture in text – come visit us and see for yourself.

You will be:

owning end-to-end solution architecture for Azure-based integration solutions,
designing integration patterns connecting Salesforce, Azure microservices, MuleSoft, banking systems, and legacy platforms,
defining API-first and event-driven architectures, including interface contracts, messaging, error handling, and reconciliation strategies,
designing cloud-native solutions using AKS, Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, and Azure Blob Storage,
defining authentication, authorization, and least-privilege security models in line with GDPR and client security standards,
defining non-functional requirements covering availability, scalability, performance, RPO/RTO, disaster recovery, security, and observability,
preparing and presenting solution designs, technical analyses, and architectural specifications to client stakeholders,
governing architecture changes, leading design reviews, and driving cross-team technical decisions.

Your profile:

have proven experience as an Integration Architect, Solution Architect, or similar role within an Azure ecosystem,
practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery,
have strong hands-on knowledge of Azure services, particularly AKS, Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, Blob Storage, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps,
have strong experience designing enterprise integration solutions and distributed systems,
understand API-first, REST, event-driven, asynchronous messaging, and contract-first integration patterns,
have experience integrating cloud solutions with Salesforce, banking systems, MuleSoft, or legacy platforms,
understand cloud security architecture and Secure-by-Design principles,
have knowledge of authentication and authorization concepts including OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC, SSO, MFA, and secrets management,
have experience defining non-functional requirements, disaster recovery strategies, monitoring, and operational readiness,
have strong architecture documentation and governance skills,
demonstrate excellent stakeholder management and communication skills,

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Own the backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix.

Oplane is an always-on security expert for AI-first engineering teams. Our biggest focus today is PR Analysis: every pull request reviewed against the customer’s architectural threat model before it merges, with findings and code-level fixes attached rather than a report handed over. Scanners find patterns. Oplane understands the system. That is where we are now, not where we stop, and we ship new capabilities constantly.

You are a senior hire on that backend. There is a working system with paying enterprise customers on it, so you are not starting from a blank repo, but large parts of it are still the first version that got us here and need someone senior to make them hold at scale.

What you’ll own
The backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix. Design, correctness, and the parts of reliability that live in the application layer.

What the job actually is
· Design and build the core backend. Python services, clean APIs, and the system design behind turning a customer’s code into a threat model and driving the fix. The analysis itself is AI-driven, so a lot of the interesting design is in orchestrating models reliably, not just moving data around. You own real system design here, not tickets handed to you fully specified.
· Build the APIs the product lives or dies by. Oplane only works when it is embedded in a customer’s repos, CI, pull request flow and coding agents. Part of that surface is how external coding agents talk to Oplane and run threat modeling directly. It has to be clean, stable, and hard to break, because other people’s pipelines and agents depend on it.
· Make it hold at enterprise scale. Companies with thousands of engineers, large codebases, concurrent analysis, and a lot of sensitive input passing through. You care about throughput, correct handling of customer code and secrets, and failure modes that do not silently drop a finding.
· Build the agentic way, because we mean it. This is the most agent-native codebase you are likely to have worked in. Our docs are written for coding agents to read, an agent reviews our pull requests, and we are building for a world where agents write most of the code. You will plan with an agent, build with one, and review with one, every day. We grow through agents rather than headcount, and if that reads as a threat to your craft rather than a multiplier of it, this is the wrong team.
· Work close to security. The whole product is about security architecture, and the team lives it, from prompt injection to secure-by-design, as a daily concern rather than an annual audit. You do not have to arrive as a security expert, but security experience is a real plus, and you should want to get good at it, because it is the domain the code is about.

Who this is for
· Around 10 years building backend systems in production. Depth in APIs, data, and system design matters more than any single language, and Python is a plus rather than a requirement.
· You think in architecture. You can hold a whole system in your head, see where it will break, own the design calls other people build on, and reason about a service end to end from data model to failure behavior.
· You can read what an AI agent produces and judge it. A lot of the code here is agent-written, and we need the architectural judgment to catch what it gets subtly wrong and steer it, rather than rubber-stamp it.
· You already use coding agents seriously in your own work and have opinions about where they help and where they do not. If you have not tried, this is the wrong team.
· Security experience is a strong plus. AppSec, secure design, working on a security product, or having been the person who reviewed everyone else’s threat model.
· Startup or scale-up background.
· Working language is English.

What you get
· A product with paying enterprise customers already running on the code you will own, so your work ships to real usage from week one. Teams like Miro, Tandem Health, Remotive Labs and Lightbringer already run Oplane, and we are SOC 2 certified.
· Real ownership of the backend, working directly with the founders.
· Backed by Seed Capital and Icebreaker.vc, with angel investors from Neo4j and Google, including Emil Eifrem. $5.2M seed.
· Based at our Malmö office, on-site five days a week. This is an in-person engineering team by design, not a distributed one.

How we work
Small team, ten of us today, real autonomy, and nothing between deciding something and doing it. We are honest about what is hard, including in this ad. We grow through agents rather than headcount, so the job is always to build the system that does the work rather than do the work by hand forever. Nobody here asks permission first. If you see it, do it, and tell us afterwards.

How to apply
Apply through the form on our site: https://www.oplane.com/careers/senior-backend-engineer
Use the Apply button on this post, which takes you there. We do not take applications through LinkedIn messages.

Tell us about a system you designed and one decision in it you would make differently now. Point us at code if you can.

jobs.title: Erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Bygma tilbyder vi faglig dybde og geografisk bredde. Derfor har du store muligheder, når du vil lægge næste lag på din karriere. I salg eller i stab. På lager eller i ledelse. Sådan hjælper vi med at bygge Danmark.

Fastansat/tidsbegrænset: Fastansat

Timer: 37.0

Erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma Gruppen

Vil du udvikle digitale løsninger og samtidig tage ansvar for at drive udviklingsopgaver fremad sammen med teamet?

Vi søger en erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma IT & Digitalisering. Du bliver en del af vores interne udviklingsteam, hvor vi arbejder med alt fra websites, CMS og e-commerce til webapplikationer, API'er og integrationer.

Vi udvikler selv en stor del af vores løsninger og følger dem fra udvikling til drift og videreudvikling. Derfor søger vi dig, der både er en stærk fullstack-udvikler og kan tage teknisk ansvar for en løsning - fra afklaring og løsningsbeskrivelse til udvikling og implementering.

Jobbet

Du bliver en del af Bygma IT & Digitalisering med ca. 35 kolleger og får en central rolle i udviklingsteamet med reference til Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov. Stillingen er med base på vores hovedkontor i Søborg.

Du arbejder selv hands-on med udviklingen og tager samtidig en drivende teknisk rolle i større opgaver. Sammen med interessenter og resten af teamet omsætter du behov fra forretningen til gode tekniske løsninger, får opgaverne brudt ned og bidrager til at skabe fremdrift hele vejen til implementering.

Vi arbejder tæt på forretningen og de løsninger, der er i brug hver dag. Derfor består jobbet både af nye udviklingsopgaver og den løbende videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger. Det betyder også, at du sammen med teamet tager fat på bugs, mindre forbedringer og konkrete forespørgsler fra forretningen, når de opstår.

Dine Opgaver Bliver Bl.a. At

udvikle og videreudvikle fullstack webapplikationer og digitale løsninger
tage ansvar for løsningsbeskrivelse og teknisk afklaring
nedbryde større udviklingsopgaver og drive dem fremad sammen med teamet
videreudvikle vores CMS- og e-commerce-platforme
udvikle både frontend og backend samt API'er og integrationer
håndtere bugs, forbedringer og løbende behov fra forretningen
sikre stabile, vedligeholdelsesvenlige løsninger, der er effektive at drifte
sparre om arkitektur, teknologi og best practices

Din profil

Du har flere års erfaring med fullstack webudvikling og gerne solid erfaring med CMS og e-commerce.

Vi leder efter en reel fullstack-profil, som er stærk i .NET/C#, men som også har solid erfaring med frontend-udvikling og selv arbejder med Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript og moderne webteknologier. Du trives med at arbejde på tværs af hele løsningen - fra brugerfladen i frontend til API'er, integrationer og data bagved.

Du trives med hele spændet i udviklingsarbejdet. Den ene opgave kan være en større ny funktion, den næste en fejl i en eksisterende løsning eller en konkret forespørgsel fra en kollega i forretningen. For dig er det naturligt at tage ansvar for begge dele.

Du har også blik for løsningen, når den er sat i produktion. Drift er en naturlig del af vores udviklingsansvar, og du tænker derfor stabilitet, performance, vedligeholdelse og effektiv drift ind i de løsninger, du er med til at bygge.

Vi Arbejder Bl.a. Med

.NET / C#
CMS og e-commerce – vi anvender pt. Optimizely / Episerver
Angular
JavaScript / TypeScript
SQL og databaser
Web API'er og integrationer

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af Bygmas digitale platforme og mulighed for at præge både løsninger og tekniske valg.

Hos os er IT tæt på forretningen. Vejen fra idé til implementering er kort, og det, du udvikler, bliver hurtigt brugt i praksis. Vi følger vores løsninger efter implementering og arbejder løbende med både drift, forbedringer og videreudvikling.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for at få tingene i mål.

Kan du se dig selv hos os?

Så søg jobbet via linket på denne side. Fristen er 8. oktober 2026. Vi holder løbende samtaler og kan derfor vælge den rette kandidat inden ansøgningsfristens udløb. Så skynd dig at sende os din ansøgning – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Bemærk, at vi kun modtager ansøgninger via vores rekrutteringssystem.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov på jefe@bygma.dk.

Om Bygma Gruppen

Bygma Gruppen A/S er den største danskejede leverandør af byggematerialer til det professionelle byggeri, og vi giver vores kunder rådgivning, service og kvalitet på branchens højeste niveau.

I Bygma Gruppen er vi fagfolk, som handler med fagfolk. Vi ved, at godt grej er afgørende for håndværkeren. At entreprenøren har brug for et samarbejde uden knaster. At en byggeplads kræver stram styring og varer til tiden.

Fundamentet for vores succes er vores medarbejdere. Derfor ansætter vi kun de bedste. Til lager og til lastbil. Til salg og til stab. Hos os er det ansvar, udvikling og kompetencer, der driver forretningen fremad. Og vi står sammen om at levere de gode resultater.

Bygma Gruppen beskæftiger ca. 3.000 medarbejdere fordelt på flere end 125 forretningsenheder i både Danmark, Sverige, Island, Færøerne, Polen og Grønland og omsætter årligt for over 10 milliarder kroner.

Internet connected and smart home products are growing areas for Dyson where we aim to continue our reputation of being innovative and disruptive. Since our first launch of products in connected space, we have grown fast to several millions of connected machines, and we are envisioning a steep growth in 2026 and beyond both in scale and connected features.

We want to build reliable, scalable, and secure services and features to support these increasing demands with innovative and competitive technologies in IoT, Machine Data Lake, Data Analytics and Machine Learning to support our vision. We have a ‘You build it, you run it’ ethos and run all our services within Amazon Web Services (AWS). Our teams are responsible for the architecture, development, testing, and operational support of their services in all environments. We are a global department with teams located in the UK, Singapore, and China and we encourage flexible, independent, and innovative thinking in our engineers to deliver solutions.

About The Role

As a Cloud Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the Out of the Box experience of all Dyson Connected products, this includes pairing the Dyson Link app with connected products and building API and microservices for Connected products.

You will be using Node.js, C# or whatever is right for the job - to run in containers or as serverless functions within the AWS cloud. You will be responsible for features from inception to delivery, ensuring that all software produced is to the highest standard. You will be working collaboratively with the team in paired programming and mobbing sessions to ensure that we deliver the right solution for the problem at hand.

The team follow agile methodologies and are keen to ensure that the latest and best practices for software development are followed; all team members are encouraged to contribute to these evolving standards.

You'll Be Doing

Designing, developing, testing and deploying micro-service applications

Working in team-based development sessions to share knowledge and responsibilities
Encouraged to learn new technologies and skills as part of Personal Innovation time.

Working experience with cloud platform (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP)
Working experience with Docker or other virtualisation tools
Knowledgeable in cloud-native technologies: microservices, serverless computing, containers, APIs.
Good hands-on experience with continuous integration and delivery techniques and tools.
Good Knowledge in DotNet Core or NodeJS development
Experience in building production quality software
Exposure to or hands on knowledge with automated testing (Unit / Integration)
Familiarity with Agile working practices
Outstanding communication skills

Benefits

Dyson Singapore monitors the market to ensure competitive salaries and bonuses. Beyond that, you’ll enjoy a transport allowance and comprehensive medical care and insurance. Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Smart Systems Engineer at Micron, you will be at the forefront of innovation in our semiconductor manufacturing environment across High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), Component Assembly and Test, and SSD operations. Collaborating with a multi-functional team, you will provide system solutions to improve operational productivity, efficiency, and product quality while driving cost reduction initiatives. Your role will encompass problem analysis, system development and building, vendor management, production testing, know-how training, and commissioning of solutions. You will define software specifications and research, develop, document, modify, and support software throughout the development process.

Responsibilities And Tasks

Provide solutions to meet operational needs to drive down manufacturing cost and cycle time while improving product yield and quality. Solutions may include both internal Micron applications and third-party vendor applications.
Explore opportunities to introduce new systems, including AI-powered analytics and automation tools, to improve organizational efficiency through system solutions.
Conceptualize, plan, and improve user interaction and engagement by conducting detailed analysis and understanding of application performance and user experience.
Build user interfaces that use insights from data analysis, incorporating visual, technical, and functional elements to ensure ease of access, intuitive understanding, and seamless usage.
Develop and maintain software applications using Micron-approved software languages, databases, standard tools, and solutions that promote reliability, maintainability, and portability of codes.
Analyze gaps and proactively introduce measures to improve the efficiency of existing systems by keeping abreast of the latest AI technologies.
Apply project management to lead projects and collaborate with business users and IT to define requirements, resolve issues, and carry out improvement and development efforts.
Coordinate, build, and manage the health of databases. Establish backup and recovery requirements and maintain documentation and procedures.
Own and govern assigned enterprise applications as system lead, accountable for ensuring availability and performance.
Provide active leadership to drive the group to higher levels of proficiency. Mentor peers or less experienced team members. Develop training materials and provide training and mentorship.

Job Requirements, Qualifications/Experience

Master's/Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or Computing
Familiar with the practical usage of AI technologies and tools (M365 Copilot), experience in AI agent creation is an advantage
Proficient in programming languages (Python, C#, ASP.net, SQL, Angular, HTML, etc.)
Knowledge in database technologies (Microsoft SQL, Oracle, Snowflake, etc.)
Good understanding of software development methodologies and the full software development life cycle

jobs.description:
About Ragnar Solutions

Ragnar Solutions Romania is the Romanian branch of Ragnar Solutions BV, a growing software company based in the Netherlands.
We build and maintain Deimos
, an e-invoicing integration platform used for compliance accross PEPPOL (multi-country), France, Poland, Spain and more.
E-invoicing is becoming mandatory in more and more countries, but every country has different rules, formats, and government systems. Deimos handles that complexity for our clients, helping make sure
their invoices are processed correctly and delivered to the right systems on time.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-level Full-Stack Developer
to join the team building Deimos.
You will own features end to end: from the CSV/SFTP intake and the background jobs that talk to national e-invoicing systems (Poland's KSeF, Spain's VeriFactu, the Peppol network) through to the Angular portals where clients see the result.

Our Stack

How it's built

A multi-tenant platform: two Angular portals (client and admin), an API gateway in front of two ASP.NET Core APIs, and multiple .NET background services
Services talk over RabbitMQ; calls to external systems go through an outbox with idempotent retries
Integrations over REST, SOAP and SFTP, with XML built and validated against official schemas (Peppol BIS / UBL, Poland's FA(3))

Backend

C# 14 on .NET 10, ASP.NET Core

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, Leadership, and clients while influencing senior technical teams through expertise rather than formal authority.

This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced architect who can raise technical maturity while remaining closely connected to delivery.

Accountabilities

Define detailed architecture blueprints, system designs, technical standards, reference patterns, and long-term technology roadmaps for complex platforms.
Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable distributed systems and integrations while balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational complexity.
Act as the primary architectural authority, guiding technical direction and modernization strategies across mature and evolving systems.
Architect and optimize cloud or hybrid infrastructures, including networking, IAM/RBAC, compute, storage, monitoring, security, governance, resilience, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and automation strategies using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or native cloud tooling.
Guide DevOps adoption, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, release workflows, environment management, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Support engineering teams with complex debugging, incident resolution, performance improvements, and architectural refactoring from a systems-level perspective.
Contribute selectively to architecture-critical code, prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews, design reviews, and technical troubleshooting when hands-on involvement is required.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success during pre-sales to assess technical feasibility, shape solution approaches, participate in discovery and proposals, and validate delivery commitments.
Ensure architectural context and decisions transition effectively from pre-sales into delivery and early project planning.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and modern automation approaches.
Mentor engineers and technical leads, identify capability gaps, promote engineering best practices, and strengthen overall architectural and technical maturity.
Influence senior technical stakeholders through strong communication, credibility, and sound judgment without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in architecture-focused roles.
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
Have proven experience designing, delivering, and evolving distributed systems in production, including large-scale or mission-critical environments.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, event-driven design, messaging, queues, buses, event-management systems, SQL, data models, and databases.
Have solid understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, TDD, EDD, Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service, security, governance, observability, and resilience.
Be capable of reading, understanding, and reasoning about complex codebases across multiple technologies, with sufficient code literacy to guide architectural decisions.
Have strong familiarity with modern cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure, including experience with Azure or comparable platforms.
Demonstrate experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automation, infrastructure architecture, and production operations.
Possess strong architectural judgment and a systems-thinking mindset, combined with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and demonstrate strong ownership in evolving and ambiguous environments.
Be comfortable influencing and guiding senior engineers without direct authority while respecting their expertise and autonomy.
Demonstrate curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies and new architectural approaches.
Experience modernizing legacy systems, evolving mature platforms, working with cloud-native or containerized architectures, microservices, workflow orchestration, event-driven platforms, or AI/ML integration is a plus.
Cloud or architecture-related certifications are considered an additional advantage.

Long-term, full-time employment.
Fully remote work.
Competitive salary in USD, based on the role and experience.
20+ paid time-off days.
Opportunity to work on complex, multi-domain technology platforms and influence long-term architectural strategy.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.
