Sicherstellung hoher Codequalität durch den Einsatz moderner Testing-Ansätze und Testautomatisierung. Anwendung bewährter Methoden zur Gewährleistung stabiler, zuverlässiger und wartbarer Software.
Technische Dokumentation & Wissenstransfer:
Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen zur Unterstützung von Wartbarkeit, Transparenz, Onboarding und Wissensaustausch innerhalb des Teams.
Datenmodellierung & Datenpersistenz:
Implementierung, Pflege und Optimierung von Datenbanklösungen sowie Unterstützung einer effizienten, konsistenten und performanten Datenverarbeitung.
Webentwicklung & Frontend-Technologien:
Entwicklung moderner Webanwendungen unter Berücksichtigung aktueller Technologien, Webstandards, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Performanceanforderungen.
Cloud & Infrastruktur:
Nutzung und Integration von Cloud-Technologien zur Bereitstellung, Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Anwendungen unter Berücksichtigung von Skalierbarkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit.
Deployment & Tooling:
Mitwirkung bei der Konfiguration und Optimierung von Entwicklungsumgebungen, Build-Prozessen und CI/CD-Pipelines zur Sicherstellung effizienter und stabiler Entwicklungs- und Deploymentprozesse.
Debugging & Performanceoptimierung:
Analyse und Behebung technischer Fehler sowie Durchführung von Performanceanalysen zur Verbesserung von Stabilität, Ressourcennutzung und Nutzererlebnis.
Versionierung & Teamzusammenarbeit:
Anwendung etablierter Versionskontroll- und Kollaborationsprozesse zur Unterstützung einer effizienten und transparenten Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Entwicklungsteams.
Security Best Practices:
Berücksichtigung sicherer Entwicklungsstandards sowie Mitwirkung an der Absicherung von Anwendungen, Daten und Schnittstellen gemäß aktuellen Best Practices.

jobs.description:
Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, enmacc is a high growth scale-up with a diverse team of over 100 professionals. We’re passionate about energy, technology, and building something that makes a real impact. If you are looking for an entrepreneurial environment where your work directly contributes to a more sustainable and digital energy future, we invite you to submit your application below.

Your Mission

Join us disrupting the international energy trading market and leave your mark in re-defining how energy traders work!
The Engineering Manager's main objectives are team empowerment and overseeing the successful delivery and performance of their team. This role acts as the interface between business, strategy, product and engineering teams. As a strong force multiplier, the engineering manager ensures that the team delivers and is responsible for the work activities through coordination and prioritization.

Your Responsibilities

Leadership and Technical Guidance: Lead a team in an agile environment. Display strong decision making skills and offer expert advice to support the team. Solve complex technical problems and ensure adherence to technical standards and requirements.
Maintain and Update Technical Expertise: Stay current with the latest technological advancements and industry best practices. This involves continuously updating one's own technical knowledge and skills to provide effective guidance, make informed decisions, and lead the team in implementing cutting-edge solutions and technologies.
Build and Maintain Team Culture: Align the engineering team with the company's goals and strategy, foster a positive and collaborative culture, and empower the team by building emotional/psychological safety
Mentorship and Career Development: Actively mentor team members, providing guidance for their career growth and skill development. This includes setting clear performance expectations, offering regular feedback, and identifying opportunities for professional advancement within the team.
Plan and Oversee Projects: Coordinate and supervise project execution, ensuring timely and efficient completion. This includes prioritising tasks, allocating resources, and collaborating with various departments.
Manage Stakeholder Relations: Communicate effectively with stakeholders like the design or product team, manage their expectations, represent the team's interests, and shield the team from external distractions.
Ensure Quality and Improve Processes: Guarantee the quality of engineering outputs through methods like code reviews, and continually seek opportunities to enhance efficiency and productivity within the team.

Your Profile

University studies in Computer Science or similar experience as an IT specialist
Several years of experience in software engineering combined with proven leadership responsibility (e.g., as Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, or Team Lead).
Ideally experience implementing scrum methodology
Be up-to-date and passionate about new technologies
Experience with the following technologies: Angular, Spring Boot, Amazon Web Services
Great communication skills
ability to work autonomously and in a result-oriented way
Strong written and spoken English skills

Don't match every single requirement? We still want to hear from you!

Our offer

Competitive compensation package, including 28 days of annual leave.
Entrepreneurial, impact-driven culture with flat hierarchies and high autonomy.
Hybrid & Workation flexibility that balances office connection with the freedom to work from home or abroad.
€2,000 annual L&D budget plus 5 dedicated "Level Up" days to fuel your growth (for all full-time employees).
Commute & Wellness support, including fully covered gym memberships and paid transportation for office days.
Inclusive, international team that celebrates diversity and offers language classes to help you settle in.
AI-first environment where you’ll collaborate with a dedicated AI Philosophy and cross-functional expert groups.
Premium tech & workspaces, featuring top-tier Apple/Bose hardware in modern, dog-friendly offices.

About enmacc

enmacc is Europe’s largest over-the-counter trading platform for energy and environmental commodities. We are digitizing the world’s energy markets by replacing manual, outdated processes with speed, transparency, and liquidity.
Our platform empowers a massive network of over 2,400 active traders to manage risk and accelerate the global energy transition. By providing a secure and efficient trading environment for 650+ companies, we facilitate more than 14,000 monthly requests for quotes and 8,000 monthly trades. With a traded volume exceeding 60 TWh per month, enmacc enables energy suppliers, industrial companies, and trading houses to access the liquidity they need to thrive in a shifting market.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, enmacc is a diverse environment where all backgrounds, identities, and cultures are welcomed and celebrated. If you're excited about this role, apply and help us shape the future of energy trading!

Team

Technische Verantwortung mit echtem Einfluss: Du bringst dein Know-how aktiv in unsere Projekte und die Weiterentwicklung des Teams ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Lösungen und unterstützt andere bei komplexen Fragestellungen.

jobs.description:
Title:
.NET Developer
Location:
Nottingham, UK (On-site)
Company:
Optio Systems (Valstone Portfolio)

About Optio Systems:

Optio Systems — formed through the merger of DSL and Datastor — is a leading provider of process control software, trusted by nearly 200 manufacturing sites worldwide. Around 70% of our customers are in the UK & Ireland, with the remainder spread across North America and beyond. While we are a long-established partner to the animal feed industry, our software is increasingly powering other sectors including paints and specialist chemicals.

About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on, web-focused .NET Developer to help us build, support and test the web applications that manage our industrial control platform.

Initially, this role is focused on full-stack web development — building and maintaining the .NET web applications at the heart of our industrial control platform. As you build familiarity with our codebase, products, and customers, you'll progressively take on responsibility for building our test automation capability, using tools such as Selenium and Azure DevOps to improve test performance, coverage and release confidence across the team. This is a genuine growth path rather than a dual role from day one: you'll spend your first months primarily writing application code, with automation responsibilities increasing as your product knowledge deepens.

You will own features from specification through to deployment and real-world usage, working across the stack in a Microsoft environment and turning complex plant data and workflows into clean, usable web interfaces for our customers. You should enjoy operating at the intersection of software and real-world engineering, be comfortable talking directly to customers when needed, and be motivated by seeing your work running in live manufacturing plants.

You will be based in our Nottingham office, collaborating closely with other developers and control engineers, with some time on customer sites to commission your work and understand how it's used on the ground. You'll be encouraged to take ownership early, with support from experienced colleagues to help you grow your skills and responsibilities over time.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain web applications using ASP.NET Core with C#, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS in Visual Studio.
Develop features end-to-end, from database schema and SQL queries through to UI and front-end behaviour.
Work closely with control and automation engineers to understand plant processes and translate them into intuitive web tools and dashboards.
Support deployments, troubleshooting, and diagnostics for web components in live environments.
Progressively take ownership of test automation processes, standards, technology and environment as your product knowledge grows.

Requirements

Hands-on experience building web applications with ASP.NET Core (or .NET Framework) and C#.
Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience writing SQL queries and working with relational database schemas.
Comfortable working across the full stack, from database through to UI.
Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative team and manage your own workload.
Proactive, comfortable taking the initiative, and keen to learn about our products and the industrial processes behind them.
Strong communication skills — clear and succinct, verbally and in writing, at all levels.

Desirable

Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium and Azure DevOps.
Experience working in a Microsoft development environment (Visual Studio, Azure DevOps).
Exposure to industrial control systems, plant data, or manufacturing environments.
Experience within the feed, grain, food, bulk materials handling, or wider process manufacturing industries.

Experience with our Imperium4 platform is not required — full training on our platform and internal engineering processes is provided.

How We Think About AI

We expect our engineers to use AI tools heavily to speed up the mechanics of writing code — so more of your time goes toward the things AI can't do for you:
Knowing what to build — understanding user needs, business context, and judgement that come from real development experience, not just an accurate description of the problem.
Evaluating quality beyond "tests passing" — judging whether a solution is maintainable, scalable, and understandable by the next person to touch it.
Navigating ambiguity — working out the right approach when requirements, priorities, and understanding are still evolving.
System-level thinking — understanding how a change in one part of the system affects everything else.

Our client is an established software business investing heavily in the next generation of its product suite. This is not an AI research role and it is not simply about connecting an application to an LLM API.
They need a strong software engineer who understands how to take AI functionality from an idea through to production-quality product engineering
.
You will work on genuine customer problems, combining traditional software engineering with modern AI techniques to build functionality that is useful, reliable, secure and commercially viable.

You will design, build and deliver AI-enabled functionality within established software products, working closely with Product, Engineering and other technical stakeholders.

Building Generative AI and LLM-powered product features
Developing RAG and retrieval-based solutions
Working with embeddings, vector search and knowledge retrieval
Designing agentic or orchestrated AI workflows

Building APIs and backend services using C#/.NET

Evaluating model behaviour, accuracy and reliability
Reducing hallucination and improving grounding
Designing appropriate guardrails and validation
Considering security, observability, scalability and cost

Working alongside Product to determine where AI genuinely adds value

What we're looking for

Strong commercial C#/.NET
software engineering experience

Clear understanding of how LLM-powered systems behave in production
Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications or backend services

AI agents
Prompt engineering
Model evaluation
Structured outputs

Job Description

At Aberdeen, our ambition is to be the UK’s leading Wealth & Investments group.

Strengthening talent and culture is one of our strategic priorities. We strive to make Aberdeen a great place to work so that we can attract and retain the industry’s best talent.

Our people put our stakeholders at the heart of everything they do by helping us to make a positive difference to the lives of our clients, customers, colleagues, shareholders, and society.

We are focused on growing our direct and advised wealth platforms and repositioning our specialist asset management business to meet client demand. We are committed to providing excellent client service, supported by leading technology and talent.

Aberdeen Comprises Three Businesses, Interactive Investor (ii), Investments, And Adviser, Each Of Which Focuses On Meeting And Adapting To Our Clients’ Evolving Needs

interactive investor, the UK’s second largest direct-to-consumer investment platform, enables individuals in the UK to plan, save, and invest in the way that works for them.
Our Adviser business provides financial planning solutions and technology for UK financial advisers, enabling them to create value for their customers.
Our Investments business is a specialist asset manager that focuses on areas where we have both strength and scale to capitalise on the key themes shaping the market, through either public markets or alternative asset classes.

About The Department

Digital Engineering delivers the platforms, applications and services that power customer and colleague experiences across Aberdeen. Working closely with product, security and business teams, the department modernises technology, strengthens resilience and supports innovation. The team promotes collaboration, continuous improvement and engineering excellence, helping enable our clients to be better investors.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Identity & Full-Stack Engineer to take technical ownership of our customer-facing identity platform while contributing to application, API and cloud engineering initiatives. Based in Edinburgh, this permanent opportunity combines identity platform leadership with hands-on software engineering across Microsoft Azure and modern digital technologies. This is an opportunity to shape critical services, influence engineering standards and continue developing your expertise in a collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

Own and evolve Aberdeen’s customer-facing Identity Provider (IDP) and IDaaS platform, ensuring reliability, security and continuous improvement.
Design and implement authentication, SSO, federation, user lifecycle and access governance solutions using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML and SCIM.
Build and support cloud-native applications, APIs and integrations on Microsoft Azure, taking solutions from design through to production support.
Drive automation and engineering excellence through Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines and scripting tools.
Troubleshoot complex incidents, perform root-cause analysis and strengthen operational resilience across digital services.
Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership, standards and best practices across Digital Engineering.

About The Candidate

Essential skills and experience:

Experience operating and supporting Identity Provider or Identity-as-a-Service platforms, ideally Okta but other Identity platforms will be considered.
Strong knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, MFA and identity security controls.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, identity integration and cloud-native services.
Strong software engineering capability across C# .NET APIs, backend services and secure integrations.
Experience with Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD automation and scripting tools.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to collaborate, mentor and support colleagues.

Desirable:
Okta administration, SCIM provisioning, access governance, GraphQL, Playwright, TypeScript, Terraform-based infrastructure provisioning, AI-assisted engineering tools and regulated financial services experience.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you have a disability and would like to apply to one of our UK roles under the Disability Confident Scheme, please notify us by completing the relevant section in our candidate questionnaire. There's more to working life than coming home with a good salary. We have an environment where you can learn, get involved and be supported.

When you join us, your reward will be one of the best around. This includes 40 days’ annual leave, a 16% employer pension contribution, a discretionary performance-based bonus (where applicable), private healthcare and a range of flexible benefits – including gym discounts, season ticket loans and access to an employee discount portal. You can read more about our benefits here.

Our business

Enabling our clients to be better investors drives everything we do. Our business is structured around three distinct areas – our vectors of growth – focused on our clients’ changing needs. You can find out more about what we do here.

An inclusive way of working

Whatever way you like to work, if you have the talent and commitment to join our team, we’d like to hear from you.

At Aberdeen we’ve adopted a ‘blended working’ approach. This approach combines the benefits of face-to-face collaboration, coaching and connecting in our offices with the flexibility of working from home. It enables colleagues to find a balance that works for their roles, their teams, our clients and our business.

An inclusive culture, where diverse perspectives drive our actions, is at the core of who we are and what we do. jobs.description:
About Heidi

Heidi was born to make it easy for more and more people to discover the power of the mountains. We burst onto the ski holiday market in 2018 (formally known as Ski Zoom) and have seen exponential growth.

The company came from a desire to fix the lack of flexibility in the winter ski market. We help skiers and mountain lovers discover resorts that are hidden gems alongside the classics, and our clever tech is helping them to do it in a way that suits them best. We’re a youthful, challenger brand, with an awesome culture, and we’re shaking up a very traditional ski/mountain holiday industry.

Looking to the future, we have huge ambitions for growth. We have grown year on year and expect 2026 to be our biggest yet. In that time we came 63rd in the Times top 100 fastest growing UK companies, securing £5.6 million investment and just had our most successful season ever in which we were able to hit profitability . Key to that is also growing the Heidi team with even more brilliant people than we have now. So we are looking for someone who will be fundamental to the success of our vision and is excited to help us drive that forward.

Our Supply
Team

You'll be joining a team of four, reporting to our Senior Developer and Team Lead. Our Head of Product leads product direction, and you'll work alongside another developer. It's a tight group where everyone has real influence on what gets built and how.

Why this role is interesting

You'll see the direct impact of your work. A supplier integration you build means new holidays appear on the site
The problem space is genuinely varied: one week you might be integrating a new accommodation API, the next you're solving a data mapping challenge for flight availability
You'll be part of a small, close team (4 people) where your contribution is visible and matters
Heidi is growing fast. We're a challenger brand shaking up a traditional industry, and supply breadth is one of our biggest competitive levers

What a week might look like

Monday you're debugging a data mapping issue where a supplier changed their availability format without telling anyone. Tuesday and Wednesday you're building out the API integration for a new transfer company. Thursday you're pairing with a teammate on the mix-and-match transfers project. Friday you're deploying your transfer integration to staging and writing up what you learned about the supplier's quirks for the team.

What you'll be responsible for

This isn't a task list. It's what you'll own and be accountable for:
Supplier integrations:
Building and maintaining the connections between Heidi and our suppliers. You'll work with third-party APIs, handle data mapping, error handling, and monitoring.
Data quality:
The data flowing through your integrations feeds our pricing engine and search platform. When it's wrong, customers see wrong prices or missing availability. You'll care about getting this right.
Supply breadth projects:
Contributing to the team's work on expanding what Heidi can offer: mix-and-match transfers, open jaw flights, and more flexible accommodation options.
Your own growth:
Whether you're stepping up from mid-level or bringing senior experience, we expect you to develop strong views on how the supply systems should evolve and to take on increasingly complex work over time.

What you bring

Here's what actually matters for this role:
You can build and maintain backend services in C# / .NET Core. Whether you're a few years in or deeply experienced, you need to be comfortable working in this stack day-to-day.
You understand relational databases (we use MySQL and SQL Server) and can write queries that perform well, not just queries that work.
You've worked with third-party APIs before. You know that documentation lies, error handling matters, and retry logic isn't optional.
You can work through ambiguity. Supply integrations rarely come with a clean spec. You'll need to read API docs, ask good questions, and figure things out.
You communicate clearly with non-technical people. The Supply team works closely with our Head of Product and the wider business.

Bonus if you have experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure (Azure), or frontend work with React/Next.js, but none of these are required.

How big is the team?

Engineering:

1x CTO
1x Lead engineer
2x Senior software engineers
4x Software engineers
1x Senior data engineer

Product:

1x Head of product
1x Senior product manager
1x Product manager
1x Design lead
1x Senior product designer

Who's going to be your manager?

You’ll be reporting to JP Our tech lead.

The interview process

Screening call (30 mins)
with our TA Lead
Competency interview (45 mins)
where you show us your experience through real examples
Technical interview (2 hrs) where we pair program and do a system design task

Values interview (45 mins)
with one of our co-founders

Our employee benefits

Salary of £75- £100K based on experience
25 days annual leave + bank holidays + 4 “me/wellbeing” days
We have a hybrid working policy and are happy for people to balance their working week between the office and home.
Vitality health insurance.
Enhanced parental leave for primary /secondary carers and adoptive parents.

Additional employee perks

£1,000 Heidi holiday credit + additional holiday discounts.
A fun packed company social calendar including our summer party, end of term conference and budget for team celebrations
£300 work from home budget

Our Commitment to inclusive hiring

We want to create an inclusive environment that celebrates the diversity of our people whilst enabling them to do the best work of their careers. We are committed to ensuring that all our people processes are equitable. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, sex, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status ,national origin, veteran, neurodiversity status or disability status

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Software Engineer

Locations
: Manchester
Salary:
£64,005 – £68,185 (depending on skills and experience) with an opportunity to qualify for additional allowances and a skills-related payment under the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework (GDDPCF) - formerly known as DDaT.
Hours
: 37 hours per week.
Flexible working:
we support full-time, part-time, compressed hours and other flexible working patterns. This is primarily an office-based role, and therefore, opportunities for home or remote working will be limited and dependent on business needs.

About us

MI5 keeps the country safe from serious threats like terrorism and attempts by states to harm the UK, its people and way of life. We carry out investigations by obtaining, analysing, and assessing intelligence, and then work with a range of partners including MI6 and GCHQ to disrupt these threats. Through our protective security arm, we provide advice and guidance to government, businesses and other organisations about how to keep themselves safe. A role in MI5 means you'll do unique and challenging work in a supportive and encouraging environment, making a real difference to UK national security.

The role

Technology sits at the heart of everything we do at MI5. We're looking for Software Engineers with multiple years of experience who are prepared to take on a more senior role within a multi-disciplinary product team. You’ll develop solutions, mentor less experienced colleagues whilst working alongside a range of technical specialists including Product Owners, Business Analysts, Delivery Managers, Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers, to build and run secure applications and products. You’ll be using agile methodologies to deliver products that are core to MI5’s operations, and you’ll be using cloud technologies such as AWS and Azure as well, supporting on-premises platforms and long-established technologies and frameworks.
You’ll share our collective responsibility to keep the country safe and be keen to constantly improve yourself and your team, taking on ownership of large problems, breaking them down and working with the team to deliver new features throughout the engineering lifecycle. You’ll support the products owned by the team, working with users to identify and fix defects (providing on-call support if necessary) developing automated tests to maintain the assurance of our products and deploy through continuous integration pipelines.

You’ll support and mentor less experienced colleagues and help them to understand what great engineering looks like, promoting best practises, participating in our engineering community and guilds, and encourage cross-organisation initiatives to help build our community of engineers. Many of our engineers work directly within our mission teams and all engineers have a unique opportunity to see first-hand how their work contributes to UK national security, while remaining part of a supportive and inclusive technical profession.

Our tech stacks vary between products (such as Java, Python, C#, React.js, Oracle, Mongo, Elastic Search and Hadoop to name a few). We embrace DevSecOps mindset, and our teams automate, run and support what we build. You’ll be working under the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework (formerly known as DDaT), which recognises and rewards specialist expertise. Due to the nature of our work, most of the teams only work from the office. There are limited opportunities to work in a hybrid way. This is not guaranteed and dependent on the business need. Whether it’s building a platform to enable the analysis of data systems to track the progress of our investigations, developing robust and scalable capabilities for our Data Science teams, compliance services to ensure we are operating legally or tooling to improve our developer experience, the nature of our work presents unique and fascinating engineering challenges.

About you

You’ll be proficient in developing enterprise or commercial software in at least one common language (for example Java, C#, Python or JavaScript) and are familiar with the principles of a modern standards approach such as continuous integration and delivery, test driven development and cloud services. You can demonstrate proficiency in the use of the agile methodology and have awareness of design patterns and how to implement them appropriately with security in mind.
We value your solid communication skills, as you communicate effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues. You’ll demonstrate competency in leadership and you’re continuously looking for opportunities to develop and learn new engineering practices and approaches.

Training and development

We’re committed to developing you and recognise this will look different for everyone. We’ll use the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework (formerly known as DDaT). as a compass to provide guidance and tools to support you. You can find out more about the framework here: Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework . There’ll be opportunities to gain qualifications and pursue specialist pathways, as well as undertaking tailored training, coaching and mentoring. You will also have up to 20% innovation and personal development time.
As you develop, grow, and maintain your technical skills, you will have the opportunity to progress through GDDPCF pay points. You’ll need to regularly demonstrate and accredit your skills based on the framework. If you don’t maintain the required skills, you’ll be given the opportunity and support to rectify this, as you could revert to a lower level of capability and pay.

Rewards and benefits

You’ll receive a starting salary of between £64,005 – 68,185
(depending on skills and experience) plus other benefits including:
25 Days Annual Leave automatically rising to 30 days after 5 years' service, and an additional 10.5 days public and privilege holidays
opportunities to be recognised through our employee performance scheme
dedicated development budget
interest-free season ticket loan
excellent pension scheme
cycle to work scheme
facilities such as a gym, restaurant and on-site coffee bars (at some locations)
paid parental and adoption leave.

Equal opportunities

At MI5 diversity and inclusion are critical to our mission. To protect the UK, we need a truly diverse workforce that reflects the society we serve. This includes diversity in every sense of the word: those with different backgrounds, ages, ethnicities, gender identities, sexual orientations, ways of thinking and those with disabilities or neurodivergent conditions. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from everyone, including those from groups that are under-represented in our workforce such as women, those from an ethnic minority background, people with disabilities and those from low socio-economic backgrounds.
Find out more about our culture, working environment and diversity on our website.

We’re Disability Confident

MI5 is proud to have achieved Leader status within the Department for Work and Pensions’ Disability Confident scheme. This initiative encourages employers to think differently about disability and take action to improve how they recruit, retain, and develop disabled people. As a Disability Confident Organisation, we aim to ensure that a fair and proportionate number of disabled applicants who best meet the essential criteria for this position will be offered an interview, where it is practical for us to do so. (This is known as the Offer of an interview.)
To secure an interview for this role, you must meet the minimum criteria, all of which are assessed at the application sift. These criteria (in order of application process) are:
Demonstrate ability in developing software in at least one common language (assessed at application form sift)
Demonstrate an understanding of the principles of modern standards approaches such as continuous integration and delivery, test driven development and cloud services (assessed at application form sift)
Demonstrate taking on a more senior role within a team. Provide technical direction and the ability to guide and support others with regards to software developing (assessed at application form sift)

What to expect

Our recruitment process is fair, transparent, and based on merit. Here is a brief overview of each stage, in order:
1. You’ll be invited to upload your CV and complete an online application form.
2. If you pass, you’ll be invited to an interview where you will be asked questions relating to your motivation and our core competencies.
3. If you pass, you’ll be invited to a technical skill-based interview based on the Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework for the role. This will cover drawing upon your experience for the following areas:
a. Programming & Build including User Focus
b. Information Security
c. System Design
4. If you pass, you’ll be made a Conditional Offer of Employment, subject to vetting
Please note, you must successfully pass each stage of the process to progress to the next. Your application may take around 6 - 9 months to process including vetting, so we advise you to continue any current employment until you have received your final job offer.

Before you apply

To work at MI5 you need to be a British citizen or hold dual British nationality. You can read our full eligibility criteria here.
This role requires the highest security clearance, known as Developed Vetting (DV).

Please note, you should only launch your application from within the UK. If you are based overseas, you should wait until you visit the UK to launch an application. Applying from outside the UK will impact on our ability to progress your application. You should not discuss your application, other than with your partner or a close family member.

.

.

.

skills and experience with PostgreSQL
.

jobs.title: Client Enterprise Architect – Dual-Track & AI-Driven Delivery at Toshiba
jobs.description:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a hands-on Senior Client Enterprise Architect to lead end-to-end solution delivery for major retail platforms.

In this role, you will own architecture leadership
(design, trade-offs, governance), active implementation
(mentoring, code reviews, select hands-on features), and operational ownership
(delivery sign-off, post-release support) of high-impact solutions, bridging business requirements to working implementations. You will drive Dual-Track Agile processes
, guiding the Discovery Track
for clarity and design exploration, and the Delivery Track
to ensure quality, traceability, and measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines deep architecture expertise
with hands-on coding
, practical prototyping, and AI/agent workflow integration
across the software lifecycle — from analysis and design to testing, documentation, and code generation. You will mentor teams, make critical technical trade-offs, and take full accountability for delivery sign-off and post-release support.

This role requires strong retail platform domain knowledge
(POS systems, store operations), cloud-native architecture experience
, and fluency with generative and agentic AI tools
to accelerate development while preserving architectural integrity. You will be a key driver of engineering excellence
, ensuring solutions are both innovative and operationally robust.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end solution delivery across Discovery and Delivery Tracks, converting business needs into validated prototypes, formal designs, decomposed deliverables, and accepted technical implementations.
Lead the Discovery Track under Dual-Track Agile, rapidly prototyping and demoing solutions to validate feasibility and align stakeholders before full implementation.
Translate discovery outcomes into delivery backlog items, ensuring design intent, architecture standards, and non-functional requirements are preserved throughout implementation.
Lead architecture design and governance across products and integrations: produce ADRs, interface contracts, data models, sequencing diagrams, migration/rollback plans, and traceability matrices.
Serve as active technical lead in client engagements: facilitate workshops, present technical solutions, make trade-off decisions, drive approvals, and act as a subject-matter expert for assigned platform areas.
Implement and demo reference code or critical components, applying hands-on coding in modern retail platform stacks, reviewing and approving deliverables from implementation teams.

Secure SDLC and privacy by design

team, which owns the pipeline that brings 3D construction models from tools like Revit, Navisworks, and IFC-based authoring software into our platform, and powers the fast, in-browser 3D viewing and coordination experience our customers rely on daily.

We're looking for a senior engineer to join our BIM Engineering team, focused on the geometry and data-processing layer that converts industry-standard CAD/BIM file formats into our internal 3D scene representation. This is deep, specialized work: you'll be responsible for parsing, translating, and optimizing complex 3D construction data so it renders quickly and accurately for our customers, at scale.

You'll act in a senior technical capacity leading complex projects, setting technical direction, and mentoring other engineers, while partnering closely with Product, Design, and adjacent engineering teams (platform infrastructure and 3D viewer/rendering) to ship features built on cutting-edge BIM 3D technology.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain parsers and data-processing pipelines that convert industry file formats (e.g. IFC, RVT, DGN) into our internal geometry and scene format
Work on geometry processing problems spanning parametric CAD data, point clouds/scans, and GIS data
Establish engineering standards and best practices across development teams; collaborate with infrastructure and platform teams on shared architecture
Help design and build systems aligned with a service-oriented architecture, supporting both enterprise and international customer needs
Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and UX to design solutions that solve real customer problems
Mentor other engineers reviewing designs and code, and helping the team consistently ship high-quality software
Diagnose and resolve data-fidelity issues (e.g. geometry or metadata discrepancies) reported by customers, tracing them through the parsing/processing pipeline
Contribute to safe, incremental rollout of changes to production data-processing systems, with attention to backward compatibility and rollback safety

Skills Required

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Professional software development experience with 5+ YOE and with strong proficiency in C++
Experience with geometric modeling parametric curves and surfaces (splines/NURBS)
Experience handling engineering/CAD data, and ideally exposure to laser scan/photogrammetry or GIS data
Familiarity with common 3D/CAD file formats: IFC, RVT, DGN, glTF, or similar
Experience with relevant libraries/SDKs, such as: Open Cascade, Assimp, Open Design Alliance (ODA), MeshLab, or GDAL

Nice to have

Experience with Rust
Background in 3D rendering and real-time rasterization techniques (PBR, IBL)
Familiarity with spatial acceleration structures (BVH, K-d tree, octree)
Experience with 3D graphics techniques: triangle meshes, BREP, point clouds, level-of-detail (LOD), mesh decimation/simplification, mesh cleanup and optimization
Exposure to hardware-accelerated ray tracing (e.g. Nvidia OptiX, DX12)

jobs.title: Senior Engineer (Cloud / D-Fend)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

At D-Fend Solutions - now proudly part of the Motorola Solutions family - our people are our greatest strength, and technology is our passion. As the global leader in cyber-takeover counter-drone technology, we design and deliver advanced, software-defined solutions that empower our customers to detect, take control, and safely land unauthorized drones.

The Mission In Krakow

Following the acquisition, our Krakow MSI engineering center is partnering directly with the D-Fend group to drive a technological transformation: moving a critical configuration application to the Cloud. We are assembling an elite, highly agile team capable of diving deep into the existing solution, leveraging Motorola’s vast cloud expertise, and delivering high-impact results at startup speed.

We’re seeking passionate, top-tier professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, creative, and collaborative environment. If you want to build cutting-edge airspace security innovation alongside the best engineers in the industry, this is your place.

Job Description

The Role:

We are building a powerhouse Cloud/Platform team in Krakow, and we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer
to be a part of this group. You will play a crucial role in implementing, maintaining, and scaling a massive multi-tenant SaaS distributed ecosystem
,
migrating on-premise components into a modern cloud architecture.

We are looking for a highly adaptable, heavyweight engineer who is "hot on code"
and loves being deeply hands-on.

As a Senior Engineer in this elite team, you must be:

Highly Adaptable: Completely comfortable and highly effective in a rapidly changing, dynamic environment.
A Fast Learner: Able to quickly absorb new domain knowledge and master new technologies on the fly.
Decisive: Capable of making quick, pragmatic, and highly technical decisions without getting stuck in analysis paralysis.
A Team Player: Ready to collaborate effectively with top-tier engineers, sharing knowledge, and driving collective success.

(Note: While this role is heavily focused on backend engineering and cloud infrastructure, we operate with a strict 'You Build It, You Run It'
culture. End-to-end ownership is key, and you will occasionally dive into the frontend (React) to deliver complete features).

What You Will Do

Drive the Cloud Transition: Play a hands-on role in building and running multi-tenant SaaS applications designed specifically to take full advantage of cloud-native architecture.
Build Distributed Systems: Implement highly complex, high-throughput backend services and distributed systems, ensuring seamless data flow across Cloud, On-Premise, and Edge layers.
Write Exceptional Code: Write sharp, scalable, and maintainable code. You will help set and maintain the highest engineering standards.
End-to-End Ownership: Take full ownership of your features - from technical design and backend coding to automated deployment and production monitoring.
Collaborate & Accelerate: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with senior peers across MSI and D-Fend to leverage shared expertise, unblock technical challenges, and deliver results rapidly.

Basic Requirements

Requirements

Experience & Mindset: 5+ years of backend engineering experience. You thrive in a dynamic environment, make quick, pragmatic technical decisions, and excel at collaborating with top-tier engineers.
The Core Stack: Expertise in Node.js and TypeScript (including frameworks like NestJS or Express). You are highly hands-on and write extremely clean, scalable code.
Cloud & Observability: Strong experience building event-driven microservices in a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) and implementing modern Cloud Observability patterns (metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging).
Data & Infrastructure: Solid proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), in-memory caching (Redis), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
End-to-End Ownership: Practical experience with (or a strong willingness to touch) React to help the team deliver complete, end-to-end features when necessary.

Big Advantages (Bonus Points)

Infrastructure as Code: Experience treating infrastructure as software using Terraform, AWS CDK, or Serverless Framework.
AI Tooling: Experience enriching and optimizing development using dev-assisting GenAI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude or Cursor).
Security & ZTA: Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) and mTLS.
Data Scale: Experience with time-series telemetry pipelines and long-term storage tiering.
Observability: Experience implementing and utilizing observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).

In Return For Your Expertise, We’ll Support You In This New Challenge With Coaching & Development Every Step Of The Way. Also, To Reward Your Hard Work You’ll Get

Private medical coverage with dental package
Life insurance, MultiSport card
IP Tax Relief
PPE (Employee Pension Plan)
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Yearly salary increase (depends on individual performance)
Yearly bonus (depends on company performance)
Flexible working hours
Comfortable work conditions (high class offices, parking space, volleyball field on site)
Trainings and broad development opportunities
Great team atmosphere (small scrum teams)

None

jobs.description:
Är du en tekniskt stark ledare som drivs av att utveckla både människor och teknik? Vill du leda ett kompetent utvecklingsteam samtidigt som du driver den tekniska utvecklingen mot moderna, molnbaserade lösningar? Hos Hogia Redovisning & Revision får du en nyckelroll där du kombinerar ledarskap, teknikstrategi och innovation med ett nära samarbete med verksamheten.

Om rollen

Som Engineering Manager har du det övergripande ansvaret för ett utvecklingsteam med ca 10 medarbetare bestående av utvecklare och testare. Ditt främsta fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för teamets framgång genom ett närvarande och utvecklande ledarskap, samtidigt som du leder den tekniska utvecklingen framåt.

Du ansvarar för att driva de strategiskt viktiga teknikfrågorna inom området och säkerställa en hållbar utveckling av våra produkter. Rollen innebär ett stort fokus på modernisering, automation och AI-drivna arbetssätt där du tillsammans med teamet identifierar möjligheter att effektivisera utveckling, kvalitetssäkring och leverans. Du följer aktivt utvecklingen inom teknikområdet, omvärldsbevakar och omsätter relevanta trender till konkreta initiativ som stärker både produkterna och arbetssätten.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att balansera förvaltningen av våra hybrida Core-produkter med den fortsatta utvecklingen av våra molnbaserade lösningar. Du arbetar nära produktledning, kravställare och andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa rätt tekniska vägval över tid.
Rollen är huvudsakligen strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, men beroende på situation och behov kan du även bidra operativt i tekniska frågor eller utvecklingsarbete.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi tror att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande samt flera års erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling. Du har tidigare haft personalansvar eller lett utvecklingsteam och känner dig trygg i att kombinera ett coachande ledarskap med tekniskt beslutsfattande.

Du har erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmiljöer och molnbaserade lösningar samt ett intresse för hur automation och AI kan skapa effektivare utvecklingsprocesser och bättre produkter.
Vi arbetar bland annat med: C#, .NET Core, Microservices, Azure DevOps, Git, React, HTML/CSS, SQL, Cosmos DB, C++, MFC, XML.
Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga tekniker, men du har en bred teknisk förståelse och en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.

Som person är du en trygg och prestigelös ledare som bygger engagemang, tydlighet och samarbete. Du är strukturerad och har förmågan att prioritera, skapa riktning och driva förändring även när flera initiativ pågår samtidigt. Du trivs med att arbeta långsiktigt, har ett genuint intresse för ny teknik och inspireras av att omsätta nya möjligheter till affärsnytta. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska och samarbetar naturligt med kollegor, chefer och externa samarbetspartners.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss bygger du lösningar som används av tusentals kunder och blir en viktig del av vår resa mot framtidens molnbaserade affärssystem. Du får möjlighet att påverka både teknikval, arbetssätt och teamets utveckling i en organisation som värdesätter innovation, kvalitet och långsiktighet.
Vi erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och fritid samt attraktiva förmåner. Vi satsar på hälsa och erbjuder flera träningsaktiviteter, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan och en arbetsmiljö där kompetensutveckling uppmuntras.
Hos Hogia får du en roll där ditt ledarskap och din tekniska förståelse blir avgörande för att forma framtidens produkter.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stenungsund med möjlighet till att arbeta två dagar i veckan på distans.
Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi kommer börja kontakta intressanta kandidat i mitten av augusti. Under semesterperioden har vi begränsade möjligheter att besvara frågor.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Hogia-gruppen

Hogia utvecklar, säljer och supportar programvaror och IT-system för företag som effektivt vill fokusera på sina verksamheter i stället för krånglig och tidsödande administration. Vi erbjuder allt från mindre löne- och bokföringsprogram för småföretagaren till kompletta, branschspecifika IT-lösningar och -system för exempelvis kollektivtrafik, åkerier, godsterminaler, revisionsbyråer och fastighetsbolag. I Hogiagruppen finns 30 operativa bolag, som vart och ett verkar inom ett väl definierat verksamhetsområde. Vår organisationsform bygger uttalat på småskalighet och entreprenörsanda. Företagskulturen skapar engagerade medarbetare. Tillsammans ger vi våra kunder de bästa tänkbara affärslösningarna. Hogia startade sin verksamhet 1980 i Stenungsund. I dag har den privatägda koncernen totalt 650 anställda på kontor i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Mer information om Hogia finns på www.hogia.se.
Vi på Hogia utvecklar och levererar branschspecifika, verksamhetsstödjande system. Vi har mängder av affärskritiska branschanpassade system som underlättar livet, för att inte tala om lösningar inom ekonomi, lön/HR som passar alla, oavsett bransch.
Vi är experter på att göra administrativa och operativa processer enklare, effektivare och faktiskt lite roligare.
Välkommen till en hel värld av smarta branschlösningar!

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

De flesta organisationer ser idag att data och AI är avgörande för framtida konkurrenskraft. Utmaningen är att veta var man ska börja och hur man skapar rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas över tid.

Våra kunder står inför strategiska beslut kring plattformar, arkitektur, styrning och AI-adoption. De beslut som fattas idag kommer att påverka deras förmåga att utveckla verksamheten, skapa innovation och dra nytta av data under många år framöver. 

Att fatta rätt beslut från början är avgörande. Fel arkitektur kan bromsa utveckling, öka kostnader och begränsa möjligheten att skapa värde från investeringar i data och AI.

Modernisera äldre data- och analysmiljöer 
Definiera framtida arkitekturer 
Etablera skalbara och säkra plattformar 
Säkerställa att teknikinvesteringar stödjer affärsmålen 
Skapa de förutsättningar som krävs för AI-adoption

Ta fram strategier för data, analys och AI 
Designa arkitekturer baserade på Microsoft Fabric och Databricks 
Leda arkitekturworkshops med verksamhets- och teknikledare 
Driva större transformationsinitiativ inom dataområdet 
Stödja organisationer i arbetet med ansvarsfull AI-adoption

Tekniker och plattformar 

Microsoft Fabric 
Azure 
Databricks 
Data Governance 
Analytics Platforms 
AI Services 
Enterprise Architecture

Du får möjlighet att lära av erfarna kollegor, påverka tekniska beslut och arbeta nära kunder i projekt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

För dig innebär det möjligheten att arbeta med moderna teknologier, erfarna specialister och några av marknadens mest spännande data- och AI-initiativ.

A central part of the role is contributing to reusable architectures and standards so that each new engagement builds on the last rather than starting from scratch. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so must
be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve. To give some examples:

Distributed systems (e.g., intermittent connectivity and byzantine actors)
Embedded computing (e.g., resource-constrained compute and reverse-engineering)
Robotics (e.g., control systems and tasking)
Networking (e.g., long-range low-bandwidth radios and cross-medium routing)
Deployment infrastructure (e.g., air-gapped devices and heterogenous fleets)
Security (e.g., data sharing in low-trust, no-TLS networks and actually-secret data handling)
Machine learning (e.g., systems for model development, storage, and dissemination)

In several of these areas, we are working near the state-of-the-art; we actively read (and sometimes implement) research papers, and often need to push even further to make theory work in practice. In others, we are applying well-known techniques to real-world situations (with real-world limitations) that have never been used in before, which requires skill, diligence, and honing a deep understanding of the underlying technologies.

The day-to-day

Review code contributions, proposals, and RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others takes precedence over spending more time on your own work.
Propose and implement new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or even full products across our stack. We encourage our engineers to look beyond their immediate team for missed opportunities, and to speak up when they identify one.
Become a mentor, find a mentee, and help support and develop our interviewing pipeline. The people make or break the company, and we want as many engineers as possible to be part of fostering and growing the organisation.
Share your experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, get together for smaller “let’s learn together” groups, run topical office hours (e.g., on Rust), etc. to help each other get better with time.
Maintain our existing software stack, including working with internal and external customers to identify issues, improving operational reliability and performance, and fending off technical debt. The stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections.
Further develop our tests and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and an extensive and ever-improving test suite is key to achieving that. And without thorough benchmarks, we would be flying blind.
Present your work at our weekly demo sessions. We want engineers to come together around what they are working on and to feel like they are not endlessly squirrelling away at something that doesn’t matter. To that end, we host (and actively work towards) demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing.

You should apply if you

Can write legible, maintainable, and performant code.
Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing.
Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming.
Are comfortable working asynchronously (writing PRs and RFCs, having discussions by email).
Have backend development experience, ideally with a language like Rust, Java, Go, or C++.
Are familiar with backend interface tools like REST, GraphQL, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, and Arrow.
Strive to improve yourself, your peers, and the culture you work in over time.
Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of engineering.

Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to have

Rust and Python specifically.
Container-based and cloud-native application architectures (e.g., Docker, Azure, AWS).
Metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
SQL and streaming database systems.
Routing protocols (e.g., IGP, BGP).
Cryptographic protocols (e.g., Signal, WireGuard).
Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino).
Robotics (e.g., control systems).
Production ML systems.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.

What We Offer

A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking
Competitive compensation and VSOP options
Relocation support
Social and education allowances
Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Motivated by our mission and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes at scale

Strong hands-on engineering background building cloud-based, user-facing systems
Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines and seniority levels
Experience with Agentic AI

Experience with TypeScript, serverless architectures and AWS

Experience with computational geometry, spatial algorithms, or CAD/BIM data models

Why join us

Work on real-world problems with measurable environmental impact
Shape technical direction at a platform level
Collaborate with experienced engineers across disciplines
Competitive compensation, pension, and benefits

We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement listed. Curiosity, empathy, and a growth mindset matter just as much to us.
