jobs.title: Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
Werk jij graag met moderne front-end technologie en wil je bijdragen aan een grote migratie van een Sitecore- naar een headless ContentStack-omgeving? Word Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r. in Heerlen.

Als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, een belangrijke inkomensverzekeraar in het zuiden van Nederland, werk je aan de vernieuwing van een belangrijk digitaal platform voor klanten en collega's. Je speelt een centrale rol in de migratie van de bestaande Sitecore-omgeving naar een moderne headless ContentStack-omgeving en helpt mee om het platform klaar te maken voor de toekomst. Daarbij ligt de nadruk op front-endontwikkeling met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript, terwijl je ook betrokken bent bij API's en de verdere modernisering van de back-end. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, testers, een businessanalist en de product owner aan oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt. Bovendien krijg je ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen richting back-enddevelopment en mee te denken over de technische koers van het platform. Wil jij bouwen aan een nieuw digitaal platform binnen een betrokken team dat volop in ontwikkeling is? Solliciteer dan nu als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r.!

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack Developer bij a.s.r.
je ontwikkelt en verbetert de front-end van het nieuwe digitale platform met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript

je vertaalt ontwerpen naar toegankelijke, schaalbare en onderhoudsvriendelijke front-endoplossingen
je koppelt front-endcomponenten aan API's en ContentStack

je werkt mee aan de migratie van technisch complexe functionaliteit naar nieuwe API's en services

je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van API's in .NET, inclusief documentatie via Swagger

Dit bieden we je
een bruto salaris van € 4.100 - € 5.800 op basis van 38 uur per week, een 13e maand en 8% vakantievergoeding. Een thuiswerkvergoeding en korting op verzekeringen
een goede pensioenregeling met veel flexibiliteit en een hoge bijdrage van de werkgever
een NS-Business Card met vrij reizen (ook privé) of een kilometervergoeding
veel aandacht voor je ontwikkeling, je inzetbaarheid en je gezondheid
hybride werken: gemiddeld 60% vanuit huis en 40% op kantoor en veel ruimte om je eigen werktijden te bepalen
werk waarmee je een positieve invloed hebt op de samenleving van morgen; samen stropen we onze mouwen op voor een eerlijkere en duurzamere toekomst

Deze vacature is echt iets voor jou, want jij
hebt ervaring met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript of vergelijkbare moderne front-end frameworks
hebt ervaring met contentmanagementsystemen; ervaring met een migratietraject is een pré (bijvoorbeeld Sitecore of een headless CMS zoals ContentStack)

hebt affiniteit met back-endontwikkeling en API-integraties

hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met businessanalyse, requirementsanalyse en technische analyse
communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s en werkt graag samen binnen een scrumteam

Hier ga je werken als Fullstack Developer in Heerlen
Je gaat aan de slag in Team Apollo binnen Loyalis. Samen met ongeveer 7 DevOps-engineers, een product owner en een scrum master werk je aan de Loyalis-website en de verwerking van nieuwe polisaanvragen. Daarbij krijg je te maken met verschillende technologieën, zoals Sitecore en ContentStack, Vue en Nuxt, .NET-services en OutSystems. De komende periode staat in het teken van belangrijke vernieuwingen, waardoor je volop kunt meebouwen aan de toekomst van het platform. Het team werkt in sprints van 3 weken en komt 2 keer per week samen op kantoor voor overleg, samenwerking en kennisdeling. De overige dagen kun je vanuit huis werken. Loyalis, een merk van a.s.r., is dé verzekeraar voor inkomen en zekerheid binnen de sectoren overheid, onderwijs, zorg, vervoer, bouw en nutsbedrijven. We bieden producten en diensten op het gebied van arbeidsongeschiktheid en helpen onze klanten om uitval te voorkomen. Werken bij Loyalis heeft nog méér voordelen: een fijne werksfeer, een uitstekende werk-privébalans, alle ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen én de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken! This position is responsible for building a robotic manipulation software platform that transforms proven bin-picking technologies into a scalable, maintainable, and deployable product for rollout across manufacturing facilities worldwide. The successful candidate will lead the internalization, standardization, and productization of the company’s robotic manipulation software platform.

Strong knowledge of robotic bin-picking systems and related AI solutions, including pose estimation, synthetic data generation, reinforcement learning, and imitation learning.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Peste 30.000 de freelanceri, medici, IT-iști și antreprenori români au ales în ultimii 5 ani să își gestioneze PFA-ul cu SOLO — și asta ne face și mai ambițioși. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

SOLO este o companie de tehnologie care construiește produse folosite zilnic de zeci de mii de antreprenori din România.

Suntem într-o etapă în care AI-ul devine o componentă centrală în modul în care dezvoltăm produsul. Căutăm un inginer care vede AI-ul nu ca pe un tool auxiliar, ci ca pe o componentă de bază în construcția sistemelor.

Vei lucra la probleme reale, cu impact direct în produs, și vei contribui la modul în care integrăm AI în procesele noastre de dezvoltare în următorii ani.

Este un rol dificil, dar cu impact major asupra direcției tehnice a companiei.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei construi și livra funcționalități care ajung rapid în producție și sunt folosite de un număr mare de utilizatori.
Vei folosi AI pentru a automatiza fluxuri existente și pentru a construi sisteme noi — de la procese interne până la funcționalități direct în produs.
Vei contribui la decizii de arhitectură și la definirea modului în care folosim AI în dezvoltare. Nu există încă un playbook clar — o parte din rol este să îl construim.
Vei lucra direct cu fondatorii, CTO-ul și cu o echipă care pune accent pe simplitate, viteză de execuție și calitate.

Ce ne dorim de la tine

Ai experiență solidă ca software engineer (focus pe .NET) și poți livra constant într-un mediu cu ritm rapid.

Poți transforma probleme neclare în soluții funcționale, fără să depinzi de specificații perfecte.

Ești un power user real de AI. Scrii prompturi ca pe specificații tehnice. Ai construit sau cel puțin ai încercat să construiești un agent autonom, chiar și ca proiect personal de weekend.

Ai instincte bune despre când AI-ul e soluția și când nu e. Ești genul care citește release notes-urile OpenAI și Anthropic în ziua în care apar.

Comunici bine, colaborezi ușor și îți asumi responsabilitatea pentru ceea ce construiești.

Cultura noastră este orientată către performanță, energie și disciplină. Ne dorim colegi care împărtășesc un stil de viață sănătos, iar acest lucru nu este compatibil cu fumatul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (14.000 - 20.000 RON net, în funcție de nivel)
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim)
Program flexibil
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc) și buget de utilizare.
Lucrăm de la biroul nostru din București (Aviatorilor/Ch de Gaulle), pentru viteză și colaborare

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.

Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.

Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

Software ontwikkelen die dagelijks door miljoenen mensen wordt gebruikt. Dat is wat je wil. Samen met je DevOps-team. Software voor het uitwisselen van medische en administratieve gegevens tussen ketenpartijen in de zorg, voor duurzame energieoplossingen of voor de robotisering van distributiecentra. Veilig, betrouwbaar, 100% vakmanschap. Met jouw drive om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen in jouw vakgebied wil je uitgroeien tot de top van de Nederlandse IT.

Bedrijfskritische software ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en in productie brengen voor onze klanten. Dat is waar jij als medior .NET Engineer aan bijdraagt. Samen met een team van collega’s. Applicaties voor medische en administratieve gegevensuitwisseling in de zorg, logistieke en besturingssystemen binnen de industrie, maar ook gebruikers- en werkgeversportalen voor banken en verzekeraars. Systemen die vaak in korte tijd grote hoeveelheden data verwerken. Dit vraagt om betrouwbare, schaalbare en onderhoudsbare software die 24/7 beschikbaar moet zijn. Als medior .NET Engineer weet jij hoe je deze software moet bouwen. Je beschikt over fundamentele en conceptuele kennis van software development en past deze toe in de praktijk. Je deelt kennis en inzichten met collega’s, teamleden en de klant.

Je werkt vaak in een multidisciplinair team dat bestaat uit meerdere Developers, een Architect, Product Owner, Scrum master en een Requirements Engineer. Samen met je team draag je zorg voor het hele traject van ontwerp tot en met het succesvol in productie brengen en laten draaien van de software.

Wat bied jij Info Support?

Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring als .NET Developer. Je kan projectmatig werken in een professionele omgeving en bent in staat om projecten zelfstandig op te starten. Je levert kwaliteit, beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en hebt de ambitie om te blijven groeien; als vakinhoudelijk expert of bijvoorbeeld in een rol als Lead Developer.

Daarnaast:

heb je een passie voor software ontwikkeling;
heb je een bachelor- of universitaire master in ICT, Software Engineering of gelijkwaardig;
houd je ervan om complexe vraagstukken op te lossen, zodat jij de beste oplossing kunt bieden aan de klant;
ben je bereid te fungeren als aanspreekpunt voor junior developers;
ben je gewend zelfstandig te werken en beslissingen te nemen;
wil je voorop lopen in je vakgebied.

Wat biedt Info Support jou?

Uiteraard bieden we je een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden met verschillende keuzemogelijkheden. Denk hierbij aan:

Vakantiegeld, winstuitkering, onkostenvergoeding, bijdrage pensioen
Leasebudget met tankpas (ook voor het buitenland)
Fietsleaseplan
Laptop en smartphone (of BYOD), facilitering thuiswerkplek
Een marktconform salaris en transparant salaris- en beloningsbeleid

Gedurende de eerste twee jaar van je dienstverband volg je onder werktijd naast vakinhoudelijke cursussen en opleidingen regelmatig sociale, bedrijfskundige en commerciële trainingen. Na die twee jaar kan je daardoor eventueel al doorgroeien naar andere rollen.

Ook na de eerste twee jaar krijgt je alle ruimte om je nog verder te ontwikkelen en je doelen en ambities waar te maken. Daar helpen we je bij door samen met jou een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan op te stellen waarin jij op inhoudelijk én persoonlijk vlak nog verder kunt groeien.

Daarnaast biedt Info Support jou:

Collegiale en gepassioneerde IT-collega’s die je continu uitdagen en verder brengen
Veel vrijheid in hoe je je werk indeelt en uitvoert
Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende bedrijven die ervoor kiezen hun complexe vraagstukken bij Info Support neer te leggen
Een gegarandeerde plek in een van onze communities waar je op de hoogte blijft van de allerlaatste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied
Veel ruimte voor vakinhoudelijke en persoonlijke ontwikkeling door opleiding, training, coaching en conferenties
Leuke team-, unit- en bedrijfsuitjes en de mogelijkheid om je aan te sluiten bij de kook-, boeken-, gaming-, cycle-, muziek- of (mud)runclub of een nieuwe club te starten
Werken bij een solide groeiende en financieel gezonde werkgever!

Over Info Support

Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Mechelen (BE) en Veenendaal (NL). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst.

De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan.

Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden.

To support our continued growth and digital transformation, we are expanding our software development team with a Web Developer. In this role, you will join our software development department of 35 professionals covering analysis, development, and testing. The team is highly autonomous and works closely with Product Owners to build in house, business driven applications.

Our architecture is Angular, API first, cloud native, and centered around Microsoft Azure, with Apigee for API management and Okta for identity and access management. Knowledge of WEB design is highly valued.

To be successful as a WEB developer, you are analytical, technically strong, and comfortable translating business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable software solutions.

What will you do?

As a WEB Developer, you will:

Develop and maintain scalable web applications using modern front end (Angular) and back end (Dotnet) technologies within Azure
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement responsive and intuitive user interfaces
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
Implement security and data protection measures
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
Write and maintain technical documentation

What do we expect from you?

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an Informatics or IT related field
Proven experience as a WEB developer
Strong proficiency in front end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and modern frameworks (Angular preferred, React or Vue.js)
Experience with Agile development methodologies
Experience with version control systems (Git)
Knowledge of web security best practices and OWASP guidelines
Good command of the English language (spoken and written)
Currently living in The Netherlands within commuting distance of Haarlem

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud platforms (Azure)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines
Experience with testing frameworks and TDD
Knowledge of TypeScript

How does the process work?

Throughout September and October, we will review and shortlist potential candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for onsite interviews in October.

  Why work at Hillebrand Gori?

With great pride, we can say that Hillebrand Gori is the largest beverages logistics company in the world. Founded in 1844, we are active in over 90 countries. Within our department around 15 different nationalities work together.

We believe that “Our people and our reputation are our greatest assets.” You will work in an environment where you can make impact, influence strategic technology decisions, and grow both personally and professionally.

Are you looking for a role where you can apply deep WEB development expertise, shape technical architecture, and deliver direct business value? Then we’d like to meet you.

A salary tailored to your qualities and experience

Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities to realize your ambitions in an international environment

Professional training
a fun place to work, with room for recreation; weekly and monthly drinks, quarterly company meet ups, regular company festivities

jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Solution Architect Expert

Onafhankelijke Ziekenfondsen

Bij de Onafhankelijke Ziekenfondsen geloven we in een toekomst waarin zorg menselijker, slimmer en efficiënter is. En daar werken we elke dag met veel goesting
aan.

Onze Landsbond telt meer dan 1.000 gemotiveerde medewerkers die samen één doel delen: de gezondheidszorg van morgen vormgeven. Drie ziekenfondsen maken deel uit van onze groep: Partenamut, Helan en de Freie Krankenkasse. Samen staan we paraat voor meer dan 2,3 miljoen leden.

Bij ons krijg je geen gewone job, maar een ZINvolle uitdaging.
We zetten complexe vraagstukken om in concrete, haalbare en slimme oplossingen. Vrij en onafhankelijk van politieke of religieuze banden streven we elke dag weer naar de beste service voor onze leden.

Onze medewerkers bruisen van talent, kennis en initiatief.
Ze nemen hun carrière in eigen handen en denken mee over hoe het beter kan. Die gedrevenheid en flexibiliteit maken ons sterk.

Respect, ondernemerschap en resultaatgerichtheid vormen de basis van onze cultuur. We geloven in flexibel werken, in tijd én in ruimte. Moderne kantoren en een open sfeer maken het plaatje compleet.

Klaar om je talenten in te zetten voor zorg die mensen vooruithelpt? Ontdek onze vacatures en groei met ons mee.

Ontdek onze vacatures op www.mloz.be

Functieomschrijving

Als Solution Architect draag je bij aan het ontwerpen van het IT-landschap van de organisatie op basis van de business-strategie. Je fungeert als de belangrijkste schakel tussen de business en IT voor strategische initiatieven en bent ook de technische leider van een transversale squad die verantwoordelijk is voor een portfolio van kritieke businesstoepassingen.

Je komt bij een team dat momenteel bestaat uit een product owner, een scrum master, een analist en een ontwikkelaar. In deze rol leg je de technische visie vast, stuur je architecturale beslissingen aan, mentor je teamleden en waarborg je de duurzaamheid op lange termijn van de oplossingen die onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid vallen.

Een bijzondere uitdaging van deze positie is dat de squad meer dan 40 kritieke businesstoepassingen beheert, inclusief verschillende legacy systemen en moderne, op Azure gebaseerde, oplossingen. Je moet in staat zijn om aan meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te werken en daarbij de operationele stabiliteit waarborgen en de lopende transformatie-initiatieven ondersteunen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Betrokkenheid bij de ontwikkeling van projecten

Helpen businessbehoeften en -vereisten in kaart brengen tijdens workshops en ontdekkingssessies.
Verschillende oplossingsopties evalueren en de meest geschikte architectuur aanbevelen op basis van de business-strategie, architecturale principes, kosten, risico’s en overgangsplannen.
Oplossingsarchitecturen definiëren, documenteren en communiceren aan belanghebbenden uit zowel de business als de IT, en de bijbehorende architecturale modellen en documentatie opstellen en bijhouden.
De gevolgen en onderlinge afhankelijkheden tussen bestaande toepassingen, lopende projecten en toekomstige initiatieven identificeren, en prioritering binnen de roadmap van de organisatie ondersteunen.
Businessvereisten omzetten in haalbare technische oplossingen en implementeringsroadmaps.
Bijdragen aan discussies over technisch ontwerp, en ontwikkelingsstandaarden en beste praktijken vaststellen.
Ondersteuning bieden bij financiële prognoses, het inschatten van de benodigde inspanningen, het identificeren van risico’s en het opstellen van plannen voor risicobeperking.

Technische Leiderschap

Optreden als de technische leider van de squad en advies geven over architecturale en technische beslissingen.
Ontwikkelaars en andere teamleden coachen, mentoren en ondersteunen in het versterken van hun technische expertise.
Beste praktijken voor software engineering, codekwaliteit, beveiliging, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid bevorderen.
Technische reviews leiden en ervoor zorgen dat de architecturale standaarden worden nageleefd.
Het oplossen en verhelpen van complexe technische kwesties in het volledige toepassingenlandschap ondersteunen.
Initiatieven voor voortdurende verbetering binnen het team aansturen.

Profiel kandidaat

Ervaring en opleiding

Masterdiploma in computerwetenschappen of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Minstens 5 jaar ervaring als Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Senior ontwikkelaar, of een gelijkaardige rol, idealiter in complexe bedrijfsomgevingen.
Ervaring met agile en SAFe-omgevingen; ervaring in de verzekeringssector, gezondheidszorg of andere sterk gereguleerde sectoren is een grote troef.
Frans of Nederlands is vereist, met een zeer goed begrip van de andere taal, alsook een uitstekende beheersing van het Engels.

Technische Vaardigheden

Uitstekende kennis van oplossings- en integratiearchitectuur, met een sterke achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling en levenscyclusbeheer van toepassingen.
Sterke ervaring met .NET/C# en uitgebreide kennis van JavaScript/TypeScript, inclusief Angular en Single Page Applications (SPA).
Hoge bekwaamheid in Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL en T-SQL.
Hands-on ervaring met Microsoft Azure-diensten, cloud-native architecturen en REST API’s; ervaring met Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event-driven Architecture of Azure PaaS is een groot voordeel.
Ervaring met het implementeren van DevOps-praktijken en CI/CD-pipelines, met een sterk begrip van Git; vertrouwdheid met Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Docker en containerisatie is een pluspunt.
Kennis van ArchiMate, BPMN en UML (certificering is een troef).
Ervaring met kostenramingen, risicobeheer en technische governance.

Niet-technische profielvereisten

Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde en georganiseerde aanpak.
Het vermogen om verschillende projecten en prioriteiten tegelijkertijd te beheren, en om zelfstandig te werken met beperkt toezicht.
Een resultaat- en klantgerichte instelling, met een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en een sterke teamgeest.
Uitstekende vaardigheden op het gebied van interpersoonlijke communicatie en het omgaan met stakeholders, met het vermogen om complexe technische concepten over te brengen aan zowel technische als niet-technische doelgroepen.

Geboden wordt

Een topjob in een zinvolle sector
Een solidaire organisatie waar het fijn werken is
Een moderne werkomgeving, in een toegankelijke groene omgeving, ongeacht je favoriete vervoerswijze
Een goed evenwicht tussen privéleven en werk, met flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om tot 3 dagen per week thuis te werken
Initiatieven die het welzijn bevorderen en de onderlinge band versterken: yoga, padel, inspirerende workshops, filmavonden, seizoensgebonden drinks, rondetafelgesprekken in het Nederlands of Frans, …
Een plek waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn en gelijke kansen krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen
Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket
Een contract van onbepaalde duur
Toegang tot het Flexible Income Plan waarmee je zelf je loonpakket kan beheren in functie van je behoeften en je situatie
Talrijke extralegale voordelen, zoals aansluiting bij Dentalia Up en Hospitalia Plus, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, groepsverzekering en een gsm

37 dagen verlof per jaar
Een grondige opleiding over de ziekenfondssector bij aankomst en regelmatig opleidingen in de loop van je carrière

We develop and build complex high-tech products, often at the limit of what is technologically possible. From the development of embedded software for optimal control of high-tech equipment to state-of-the-art application software, for example for operating equipment, image and data analysis, process management, and providing insight into information.

What excites you as a Software Architect?

From our office in Eindhoven and sometimes at our clients' premises you like to keep yourself busy with:

Lead the architectural design and development of complex software systems, ensuring they meet performance, quality, and reliability requirements.
Prepare offers and feasibility studies for projects in close cooperation with the project manager, the account manager and customer.
Collaborate with the project manager to define the project organisation, estimate project timelines, and identify risks and related mitigation strategies.
Deploy technical guidance and leadership to project teams and the development processes.
Develop and support the deployment of training programs through individual coaching, training, and supervising colleagues during their assignments.
Keep up with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in embedded systems and application software, and apply this knowledge to drive innovation within the projects and related teams.

Sounds good so far? We'd love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
You have gained more than 10 years of experience with technical software development in various roles and in various (product) environments and/or projects.
You have experience as a software architect, and you want to expand this experience in a different environment.
Proficiency in programming languages such as C# and C++ for different operating systems, including state machines and real-time aspects.
You have extensive experience with various and modern development methods, tools, and technologies (OOAD, Agile, TDD, MDSD, etc.) and use these to setup appropriate development processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex software and process-related issues and implement effective solutions.
You are used to working in a dynamic environment with fast-changing priorities, parallel projects, and various stakeholders with probably conflicting interests.
Good communication skills, easy to present technical information to technical and non-technical partners.
Valid European driving license
Willingness to travel up to 10% worldwide.

This is what you can expect in return

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to buy an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from family festivals and sparkling Christmas parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community.
Our Sioux office is located in a prime location in the heart of the Brainport region. At our main office you can enjoy lunch, sports, making music, and sharing your knowledge with colleagues in one of our Tech Labs.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

jobs.title: AI software engineer (Dutch language required)

Wat ga je doen

Bij UWV ontwikkelen we AI-systemen die dagelijks worden gebruikt door duizenden medewerkers. Geen prototypes of experimenten, maar productieklare software die betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en uitlegbaar moet zijn.

Als Senior AI Software Engineer bouw je aan systemen waarin AI een component is binnen grotere softwareproducten. Je werkt aan generatieve AI, automatisering en intelligente ondersteuning, en maakt voortdurend technische afwegingen tussen externe AI-diensten, open-source modellen en self-hosted oplossingen.

Je bent in de eerste plaats een software engineer: je ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt robuuste systemen die in productie draaien.

Wat ga je doen:

Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van productieklare AI-oplossingen.
Integreren van AI-diensten, LLM’s en interne systemen binnen het UWV-landschap.
Ontwerpen van schaalbare architecturen met containers, asynchrone verwerking en integratiepatronen voor AI-toepassingen.
Ontwikkelen van betrouwbare workflows voor AI-toepassingen, inclusief monitoring, evaluatie en observability.
Maken van technische afwegingen tussen commerciële AI-diensten, open-source modellen en self-hosted oplossingen.
Samenwerken met Product Owners, architecten, software engineers, data engineers en AI-specialisten.
Coachen van collega’s en bijdragen aan technische standaarden binnen het AI-domein.

Waar werk je aan?

Voorbeelden van onderwerpen waar je mee bezig kunt zijn:

Generatieve AI-oplossingen voor medewerkers.
RAG-architecturen en kennisontsluiting.
AI-workflows met queue-based verwerking en asynchrone processen.
Integratie van AI-functionaliteit binnen bestaande bedrijfskritische systemen.
Monitoring, evaluatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van AI-output.
Inference-platformen voor open-source modellen.
Veilige en uitlegbare AI-toepassingen binnen de kaders van de AI Act.

Waarom dit interessant is:

Veel organisaties experimenteren nog met AI. Bij UWV ligt de uitdaging een stap verder: hoe bouw je AI-oplossingen die betrouwbaar genoeg zijn voor dagelijks gebruik binnen processen die direct impact hebben op mensen?

Dat vraagt om meer dan alleen kennis van modellen. Het vraagt om sterke software engineering, schaalbare architecturen en doordachte productontwikkeling.

Je krijgt de ruimte om technische keuzes te maken, nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken en mee te bouwen aan het AI-fundament van UWV.

Wat we van je verwachten

Must-haves

HBO- of WO-opleiding in Computer Science of vergelijkbaar.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At HMS Industrial Networks, we value the dedicated contributions of our employees, and we recognize that it is our people that make HMS successful. We work hard to maintain our vibrant, innovative, and welcoming culture, and we strive to support our staff as they grow and develop both personally and professionally.

About The Team

You'll join a dynamic agile software development team at HMS Delft, The Netherlands, where we develop innovative software solutions for industrial diagnostics and cloud products. Our mission is to design, implement, and maintain reliable software that helps customers monitor, diagnose, and optimize their industrial operations.

Working in an international environment, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across different HMS locations and product teams. Our team develops both embedded software for industrial devices for diagnostics and cloud-based solutions for remote access. As HMS continues to expand its Cloud platform, built on AWS and leveraging technologies such as Java, Spring, and Angular, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to software that connects industrial edge devices with modern cloud services.

Role And Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer
, you will contribute to the development of software for our industrial diagnostics products and cloud-connected solutions. You will be involved throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and implementation to testing and maintenance.

Your Responsibilities Include

Designing, developing, and maintaining embedded software for industrial diagnostics products.
Contributing to the development of cloud-based applications and services on the Ewon Cloud platform using Java, Spring, and Angular.
Implementing and executing unit, integration, and E2E tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
Collaborating with product owners, architects, and fellow engineers to define and deliver new features.
Writing clean, maintainable code following software engineering best practices.
Participating in code reviews and technical discussions to continuously improve the quality of our products.
Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues across embedded and cloud-based systems.
Contributing to the design and evolution of software architectures for both embedded and cloud solutions.
Expanding the use of AI in our development processes.

About You

You are a software engineer with a strong problem-solving mindset and a passion for developing reliable, high-quality software. You enjoy working on technical challenges across different domains and are motivated by delivering solutions that create value for customers.

You combine solid technical skills with a pragmatic and collaborative approach. You are eager to learn, take ownership of your work, and contribute to a team environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are valued.

Only candidates currently based in the Netherlands will be considered.

Required Experience

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or equivalent experience.
Several years of experience in software development.
Strong proficiency in Java development & in-depth experience with the Spring framework.
Knowledge of software design principles, testing methodologies, and debugging techniques.
Experience with version control systems such as Git, ideally with GitLab.
Familiarity with networking concepts and communication protocols.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative international environment.

Nice to have

Experience with Angular is a huge plus.
Experience with AI agentic workflows.
Knowledge of Cloud Infrastructure & Services (e.g., AWS concepts like EC2, S3, Docker, Kubernetes) to understand deployment environments.
Experience with testing frameworks (e.g. Robot for E2E testing, JUnit, Mockito for Java; Jasmine, Karma, Jest for Angular).
Experience with RabbitMQ or other messaging queues.
Experience developing REST APIs and distributed systems.
Familiarity with Linux-based development environments.
Experience with embedded software development using C++.
Understanding of software architecture and system design principles.
Knowledge of industrial communication protocols and connectivity solutions (Profinet, Ethernet/IP and Profibus).

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Architect

Als Azure Cloud Architect ben jij de cruciale schakel in onze projecten. Jouw rol gaat verder dan alleen adviseren; je leidt en voert ook actief projecten uit met behulp van de nieuwste Azure-tools en technologieën.

Je bent een Architect met een passie voor Azure Cloud en complexe technische uitdagingen. Je werkt graag in een team en weet hoe je anderen kunt inspireren. Je bent analytisch sterk en combineert technische kennis met een proactieve houding.

Bekend met de nieuwste Azure Cloud-technologieën, waaronder AKS, Azure DevOps, en IaC.
Bedreven in het ontwerpen en implementeren van moderne cloudoplossingen en het integreren van complexe systemen.
Sterke verbale en schriftelijke vaardigheden voor effectieve samenwerking met klanten en teamleden.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer  Lab Automation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to

models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The newComputational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients Worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

As a senior lab automation software engineer, you will be the essential link to the automation scientists in the lab. Using your background in both software development and hardware integration, you will work with a team of software-focused engineers to build, test and do what is needed to bring the software and hardware layers into production.

The Opportunity

To excel in this role, you will bridge the gap between complex software engineering and laboratory research in drug discovery through the following responsibilities:

Design, program and troubleshoot high-throughput lab workflows
Build orchestration systems, hardware abstraction layers, and instrument drivers that manage retries and allow unattended operation
Implement logging, metrics, and alerts across hardware and software to identify failures. Fix root causes using software or vision models instead of relying on manual workarounds or vendor support
Build systems to maintain a digital representation of the lab, including sample identity, instrument state, and resource availability. Connect instruments via APIs and integrate with LIMS and ELNs
Manage hardware requirements, site constraints, reagent selection, and work cell integration from initial design to deployment
Work directly with software engineers, automation scientists, and hardware engineers to turn scientific processes into technical architectures

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering and hardware integration
Experienced in programming commercial liquid-handling or laboratory automation platforms and integrating robotic manipulators
Proficient in C# or Python for building software and integration frameworks
Familiar with molecular biology, biochemistry, or wet lab workflows to help translate scientific needs into engineering solutions
Prototyping design experience, including CNC milling, laser cutting, and CAD
A clear communicator who collaborates with scientists and multidisciplinary teams to build complete solutions
Skilled at using APIs and SDKs to interact with complex laboratory software ecosystems
Experienced in designing workflow orchestration or scheduling systems that manage shared resources, dependencies, and priorities

Preferred Skills And Experience

Skilled with computer vision models (such as OpenCV, YOLO, or SAM) for automated error handling and object or anomaly detection
Experienced in training, evaluating, or adopting AI/ML models, including reinforcement or imitation learning for robotics
Capable of building and evaluating AI-enabled systems, defining evals, establishing guardrails for determinism versus nondeterminism, and measuring reliability
Knowledgeable about sensors, microcontrollers, and task-and-motion planning
Familiar with cloud infrastructure and digital twin simulation

A cover letter is not necessary, you will be required to fill a questionnaire.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team
. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health
Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers
Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Qualities we look for

Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, monitor the systems in production, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn
A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. Pigment is the AI powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.

With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, San Francisco, and Toronto, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product.

Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the backend and the frontend.

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology.

Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.

Our technical stack is C# on .NET Core Linux, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Platform, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, RabbitMQ and Circle CI.

Explore Our Tech Blog:

If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture and our organization, we invite you to explore our Tech Blog!

About This Role

Who you are

More than knowledge of a specific language or framework, we are looking for great software engineering skills: ability to translate functional requirements into an elegant and simple design, and then deliver the code.

We are also looking for engineers who understand the product and the customer's needs in detail and can suggest innovative ideas: in the end, it's all about delivering value to end users.

In any case, you have:

Experiences as a software engineer working on a product in production.
Demonstrated experience in infrastructure (Kubernetes, IaC tooling, public cloud) and a drive to help teams work effectively and autonomously.
Proven experience designing object oriented software with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, Python or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive).
Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude.
A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!).

Folks from underrepresented minorities: science shows that you are less likely to apply if you feel that you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites. If this description matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply.

What you will get

Competitive salary
Equity
Trust and flexible working hours
Brand new offices in the heart of Paris, London, New York and, Toronto
Remote-friendly environment

jobs.title: Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Department: Engineering

Based at: Salford Quays

We’re looking for a Technical Architect to take complex high-level designs and manage them through build — designing out the detail of our most complex server-side and cloud solutions, and getting hands-on through delivery to make sure what gets built achieves the product goals set out by our clients across finance and retail to health and sport.

As a Technical Architect you’ll turn a solution’s shape into a detailed design a delivery team can build, own the cloud infrastructure decisions behind it, and take on the infrastructure problems the team can’t get past. On our larger engagements you’ll work in collaboration with a Solution Architect; on smaller ones there might not be one and the design is yours from the first conversation.

You’ll work with the engineers who’ll build it — Lead Server Engineers, Technical Leads and their teams — so the design is understood, challenged and owned rather than handed down, and you’ll be the person clients bring their hardest technical questions to.

What You’ll Be Working On

You will provide the overarching technical steer for the overall architecture, making high-stakes decisions that ensure scalability and resilience. As a primary client-facing lead, you will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elegant technical solutions, while fostering a high-performance culture through mentorship and the evolution of our agile engineering standards.

Act as the primary technical consultant for major clients. Consulting on early client engagements, translating business goals into technical strategies and building deep-rooted professional trust.
Take high-level designs and produce the detailed designs - occasionally producing the high-level designs where needed.
Identify, adapt and document design and patterns for a solution, including the risks and document how they will be mitigated.
Own non-functional requirements, covering security, performance, resilience, observability and the running cost of what you build.
Own cloud infrastructure decisions across compute, storage, identity, governance, networking and security — and own the problems when they land.
Manage and coordinate the technical dependencies coming from clients and third parties.
Champion and evolve agile methodologies and DevOps cultures, identifying bottlenecks in the delivery lifecycle and implementing systemic improvements.
Lead by example by contributing to mission-critical code, setting the gold standard for clean, maintainable, and high-performance engineering.
Support bids and pitches as the technical expert, including the specifications that let bid teams estimate honestly.
Drive the technical discovery phase for new large-scale engagements, performing feasibility studies and defining MVP boundaries.

What You’ll Bring To The Team

You are a seasoned technologist with a track record of delivering complex, large-scale applications. Your expertise extends beyond code; you are a strong communicator who thrives in client-facing environments and possesses the strategic mindset required to navigate the challenges of global enterprise digital transformation.

Deep, practical AWS or Azure experience of modern large-scale solutions across compute, storage, identity and governance.
A deep understanding of cloud networking.
A deep understanding of cloud and application security.
Strong experience in Node.js and TypeScript or .Net.
A strong grasp of Domain-Driven Design.
Knowledge of modern architectural patterns and the ability to articulate the pros and cons of each clearly.
The ability to articulate architecture to technical audiences of varying ability, to get a team and a client pulling in the same direction, when faced with challenges your instinct is “yes, if” rather than “no”.

jobs.title: Senior Architect, ADC/Quant
jobs.description:
We are seeking an expert Senior Architect to drive the technical vision, system design, and architectural governance for a large-scale, technically diverse engineering program. Operating across multiple complex domains, you will serve as the premier technical authority, designing mission-critical enterprise systems, overarching data ecosystems, and leading our artificial intelligence (AI) integration strategy.

The successful candidate will set the architectural target state, establish design patterns for highly resilient systems, and ensure technical coherence across a highly heterogeneous technology stack. You will partner with business stakeholders and engineering management to translate strategic objectives into robust, scalable, secure, and AI-ready architectures, navigating the complexities of a highly regulated, high-expectation environment.

What You’ll Bring (Experience & Competencies)

Extensive Architectural Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, with at least 3+ years acting as a Principal or Senior Architect designing large-scale, high-throughput, and mission-critical enterprise distributed systems.

Deep Technical Breadth & Depth:

Advanced data architecture experience using Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and large-scale data processing (Data Mesh/Lakehouse patterns).
Strong background in data integration and relational platforms
Proven experience designing highly available Hybrid and Multi-Cloud architectures (Azure & AWS).
AI & Machine Learning Exposure: Experience designing architectures that support AI/ML workloads, including integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), predictive analytics, and vector search into enterprise applications.
Enterprise Governance & Security: Deep understanding of security architecture, secure SDLC practices, data privacy, and compliance requirements typical of the London financial services sector.
Resilience & SRE: Advanced knowledge of building fault-tolerant architectures leveraging modern SRE principles, robust observability, and cloud-native resilience patterns.
Matrix Leadership: Exceptional stakeholder and client communication skills, with a track record of influencing cross-functional engineering pods, product managers, and C-level executives without requiring direct reporting lines.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

Define and own the end-to-end target state architecture across diverse systems, data platforms, and cloud integrations.
Publish, maintain, and champion architectural blueprints, design patterns, and engineering excellence standards.
Lead the Architecture Review Board (ARB) process for the domain, ensuring technical designs strictly adhere to non-functional requirements (NFRs) such as scalability, maintainability, performance, latency, and security.

AI Strategy & Adoption

AI Architecture Roadmap: Lead the architectural design for integrating AI and Machine Learning capabilities (including Generative AI) into existing and new enterprise products.
AI Governance & Security: Establish secure guardrails, data privacy controls, and ethical compliance standards for AI consumption within a highly regulated environment.
Developer Productivity: Champion the adoption of AI-driven engineering tooling (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated testing generation) to enhance developer velocity and code quality across the portfolio.
Data Readiness: Architect robust, scalable data pipelines (MLOps/LLMOps) to support reliable model training, fine-tuning, and low-latency inference.

Technical Leadership & Governance

Act as a senior technical leader and mentor to Principal Engineers and Tech Leads across multiple engineering domains.
Ensure architectural coherence across a diverse technology stack, balancing the need for enterprise standardization with the autonomy of agile delivery teams.
Take ownership of technical debt management strategies and long-term platform health, preventing fragmented or sub-optimal legacy solutions.

Complex Problem Solving & Hands-on Contribution

Lead technical investigations into complex performance bottlenecks, major systemic incidents, and architectural pivots.
Remain heavily hands-on in the R&D space; write prototype code, execute Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs), and directly validate architectural assumptions (specifically around new AI tools or cloud services) before scaling them to development teams.

Stakeholder Alignment & Commercial Awareness

Collaborate closely with business leadership, product owners, and Development Managers to translate strategic commercial objectives into executable technical roadmaps.
Act as a trusted advisor, articulating complex technical trade-offs, risk mitigation strategies, and system capabilities in clear, business-centric language.

Technology Environment

You will be architecting solutions within a broadly evolving and heterogeneous technology landscape, notably encompassing:

Compute & Services: Java, .NET, Python, Cloud-native microservices

Data & Analytics: Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AWS Glue, Athena, Event Streaming (e.g., Kafka)

AI & ML: Azure OpenAI, LLM Integration patterns, Vector Databases

Integration & Storage: Azure Data Factory (ADF), SQL Server, Enterprise relational platforms

Infrastructure: Azure, AWS, and Hybrid Cloud networks

Candidates are not expected to be absolute experts in every single technology listed but must demonstrate the architectural abstraction skills to design systems spanning varied stacks and the ability to rapidly build context.

What This Role Is (and Is Not)

This is not solely an "ivory-tower" architecture role; pragmatic execution, hands-on prototyping, and deep collaboration with delivery teams are essential.

This is a role for a visionary technologist who thrives under pressure, sets uncompromising engineering standards, and naturally commands the technical respect of a large engineering organization.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Manager | Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Technology Consulting | Belfast

In Digital Engineering we shape, concept and build innovative solutions that address the most important issues and opportunities for our clients. Our engineers work in agile, cross-functional teams addressing some of most significant issues facing society today, such as transition to sustainable energy, digitisation of government, scaling high-growth businesses, exploiting the potential of AI and improving wellness with digital healthcare.

The core capabilities of our team include:

Digital strategy, horizon scanning, and strategic planning. Working in combined teams with Business Designers, Researchers, Strategists, Industry and Functional Specialists, we develop a vision, roadmap and case for change to address fundamental issues facing our clients, such as “how can we grow?”, “how do we respond to disruption?” and “what can we do next?”
Digital technology delivery management. Using principles of lean start-up and agile, we manage large-scale delivery programmes that include custom software and SaaS solutions, using an ecosystem of EY, client and partner agency resources. We have a range of skills across programme management, solution architecture, product management, business analysis and delivery management,
Digital software engineering. Many of our solutions involve custom engineering of unique solutions and experiences created from modern web-scale technologies, including SPAs, JavaScript, Microservices, Cloud Computing and Machine Learning.

As a technologist in Digital Engineering, EY offers you the opportunity to apply your skills in a highly strategic context, working on meaningful and impactful solutions that build a better working world. EY is a leader in Business Transformation services, and the Digital Engineering team is rapidly growing to enable us to deliver more of our technology work. This is an exciting time for new joiners who will have many opportunities to make their mark on the business and accelerate their personal and professional growth.

The opportunity

EY is actively growing our Digital Engineering team in Belfast and is expanding our engineering capability. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly capable developer who is ready to operate at a senior level, combining hands-on delivery with technical leadership, mentorship, and ownership of complex systems. We are looking for someone who is ready to challenge themselves by learning new technologies, lead developer teams and understand a product from end to end.

Your Key Responsibilities

Actively participate and own the design, development and delivery of full stack products from frontend to backend.
Build and maintain responsive, high-quality user interfaces using modern frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue.
Design and implement robust APIs and services, ensuring security, reliability and maintainability.
Work closely with product teams to understand complex business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Present delivered features and technical solutions confidently to stakeholders and clients.
Perform thorough peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and maintaining high engineering standards.
Support and lead non-functional improvements, including technical debt reduction, performance optimisation and creation of clear API documentation.
Play a key role in defining the engineering strategy for Digital Engineering, advocating for consistent standards, practices and approaches across teams and client engagements.
Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior developers, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong professional full-stack development experience, with increasing levels of responsibility.
Strong backend development experience using Node.js, Java, Python, .NET or similar technologies.
Proven ability to design and build scalable APIs and distributed systems.
Solid experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Experience with testing frameworks, unit testing, integration testing and automated testing strategies.
Strong understanding of software development best practices, system design, maintainability and code quality.
Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams and contributing to delivery planning and estimation.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP, CI/CD pipelines or DevOps practices would be beneficial.
Exposure to NoSQL databases, microservices or event-driven architectures would be desirable.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Strong technical decision-making ability.
Excellent problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to challenges.
Confident communicator, able to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A mentor mindset with a passion for developing others and raising team capability.
High level of ownership, accountability and attention to detail.

What We Look For

We’re interested in candidates who can take end-to-end ownership of complex features and systems, balancing hands-on engineering with technical leadership. You should bring a strong voice in shaping our engineering culture in Belfast and the wider Digital Engineering capability. You will influence how the team builds, delivers and scales software, with a proven ability to improve code quality, team processes and system architecture. If you’re serious about joining Digital Engineering and ready to help deliver meaningful, scalable solutions for our clients, this role is for you.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in building a better working world.

Apply now.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Job Description

Norton Rose Fulbright is a global law firm with more than 3,000 lawyers advising clients across locations in the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia, Australia, Africa and the Middle East. We provide a full scope of legal services to the world’s preeminent corporations and financial institutions.

Our vision is to be a world class business, profitable, ambitious, cooperative and considerate, supporting our clients and people through our global business principles of Quality, Unity and Integrity.

With over 7,000 employees worldwide, our culture is the thread that connects us. Our strategy and culture are closed connected – defined by shared ambition, global collaboration and a one-team mindset. We believe pioneering work happens when people are empowered to think beyond boundaries, explore new opportunities and grow through diverse experiences. Alongside the right skills and experience, we are looking for people who are innovative, commercially minded, and motivated by the impact of the work they do – ready to share in our ambition and help shape what comes next.

Because while individuals can do well, together we achieve something extraordinary.

The Role

The Data Platform Engineer will ensure Norton Rose Fulbright’s enterprise data platform is a stable, secure and supportable IT service. The platform is built on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and associated Azure services, supports the firm's strategic data capability across EMEA and EMEAPAC, and is governed through Terraform, Azure DevOps and a standardised deployment framework.

The role is hands-on and service-focused. It provides the operational foundation needed to keep the platform reliable, observable, governed and ready for controlled production use. Its emphasis is on platform health, support processes, quality assurance, release readiness, incident response and continual service improvement.

The successful candidate will work closely with Architecture, Information Security, Service Delivery, Infrastructure, suppliers and consuming business teams to ensure platform changes are deployed safely through established CI/CD processes, supported by appropriate monitoring, operational controls, documentation and governance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Provide L2/L3 operational support for Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, and associated Azure services.
Maintain platform health, availability, resilience, and supportability across the data platform estate.
Perform routine platform administration, operational checks, and capacity and utilisation monitoring.
Monitor platform performance, identify optimisation opportunities, and maintain cost awareness.
Troubleshoot issues across platform, identity, networking, storage, security, and integration layers.
Manage incidents, problems, and service requests in line with established ITSM processes.
Investigate and resolve operational issues, ensuring timely restoration of service.
Support major incident response activities where platform services are impacted.
Contribute to root cause analysis and implement actions to improve platform stability and reduce issue recurrence.
Collaborate with internal teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to deliver effective operational support.
Support change, release, and environment management activities across the platform estate.
Maintain release readiness checklists and operational acceptance criteria.
Validate platform changes prior to production deployment to ensure supportability and risk controls are in place.
Support the management of Development, Test, and Production environments.
Ensure configuration consistency across environments and platform services.
Contribute to CI/CD, version control, and release automation practices for platform assets.
Promote operational excellence through continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and robust documentation.

Quality, Monitoring and Governance

A key part of the role is to define and execute operational QA checks for platform changes, integrations and supplier-delivered components. The engineer will verify that monitoring, alerting, logging, access controls, runbooks, escalation routes and support processes are in place before production release. They will support service acceptance and transition activity, assessing readiness against availability, recoverability, supportability, security and control requirements.

The role will implement and maintain monitoring, alerting and observability across Fabric, Databricks and Azure services. It will develop service health reporting, operational dashboards and exception monitoring, and maintain runbooks, known error records, support documentation and knowledge articles. The engineer will contribute to service reviews, operational assurance and continual improvement.

The role will support governance, security and compliance by assisting with access control, role management, privileged access processes, audit evidence, metadata, lineage, auditability and policy enforcement. It will work with Risk, Privacy, Information Security and Architecture to ensure platform operations remain aligned with NRF policies, approved architecture patterns and applicable control requirements.

Key Skills And Experience

Experience supporting cloud-based data platforms in production or near-production environments, ideally including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, or both.
Strong understanding of Azure services and operational dependencies, including workspaces, capacities, lakehouses, pipelines, clusters, jobs, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, OneLake, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Entra ID, managed identities, secure networking, and private endpoint architectures.
Proven experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), including incident, problem, change, release, and service request management.
Experience working with ServiceNow or equivalent service management tools.
Knowledge of production support models, escalation processes, service transition, and knowledge management practices.
Ability to create and maintain runbooks, operational procedures, technical documentation, and support knowledge articles.
Practical experience of quality assurance, release governance, and operational readiness activities.
Experience validating technical changes, defining operational acceptance criteria, and managing Development, Test, and Production environments.
Understanding of test and deployment evidence reviews, rollback planning, and identifying operational support gaps before go-live.
Experience with monitoring, logging, diagnostics, dashboards, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD tooling, and automation.
Working knowledge of scripting and infrastructure-as-code tools such as PowerShell, Python, and Terraform.
Understanding of data platform governance, security controls, data classification, retention policies, privacy requirements, and audit processes within regulated environments.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

To attract the best people, we strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone can bring their whole selves to work, have a sense of belonging, and realize their full career potential.

Our new enabled work model allows our people to have more flexibility in the way they choose to work from both the office and a remote location, while continuing to deliver the highest standards of service. We offer a range of family friendly and inclusive employment policies and provide access to programmes and services aimed at nurturing our people’s health and overall wellbeing. Find more about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion here.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from individuals who can complement our existing teams. Secure. Connected. Intelligent.

Symphony is an AI-powered communication and technology company fueled by interconnected platforms: messaging, voice, directory and analytics.
