Role Description

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior SDET, Compliance to play a critical role in ensuring the quality, security, and regulatory reliability of Symphony’s compliance-driven solutions across both backend and frontend systems.

At Symphony, compliance is foundational. It means operating under strict regulatory, security, and data-governance requirements for financial institutions and other regulated industries. This includes secure call records, robust encryption, strict access controls, comprehensive audit logging, data-privacy protections (e.g. GDPR, CCPA), and adherence to industry certifications and audit standards.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will design and build automated compliance validation frameworks, define and evolve compliance testing strategies, and integrate quality deeply into our development lifecycle. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and security teams to ensure compliance is not an afterthought, but a built-in capability of our platform.

If you are passionate about quality engineering, automation, and building trust in mission-critical systems, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Own and drive compliance quality initiatives across backend and frontend systems.
Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks focused on compliance validation.
Define, evolve, and execute the next generation Compliance Test Strategy.
Perform white-box testing to validate regulatory, security, and data-governance requirements.
Embed shift-left testing practices, working closely with developers early in the SDLC.
Validate compliance behavior across Cloud (AWS/GCP), Kubernetes, and Windows 10/11 environments.
Identify, debug, and resolve compliance-related quality and risk issues.
Mentor other SDETs and act as a quality leader and compliance advocate within engineering teams.
Continuously improve compliance testing processes, tooling, and quality metrics.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

Strong programming skills in C# and Python.
Proven experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks.
Hands-on experience with compliance testing (e.g. data retention, auditability, regulatory validation).
Strong background in white-box testing of APIs, services, and system internals.
Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) and containerized environments (Kubernetes).
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern testing tools.
Familiarity with Windows 10/11 environments.
Strong understanding of software development practices and modern testing methodologies.

Soft Skills

Proven ability to lead and influence compliance-focused quality initiatives.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills across engineering, product, and security teams.
Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and risk awareness.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Proactive, self-driven, and deeply invested in quality and regulatory excellence.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in QA or SDET roles, with a strong focus on compliance and quality.
2+ years in a senior or lead role, driving quality or compliance initiatives at scale.

You will help ensure that Symphony’s platform remains trusted by the world’s largest financial institutions, enabling secure, compliant communication in the most demanding regulatory environments.

This Is Helix. Powered by You.

At BMC Helix
, we don’t do ordinary. We’re the AI-native engine
behind the world’s most forward-thinking IT organizations, helping them focus on what matters most. What are we passionate about? We're here to reset the economics of enterprise IT and help others realize the ROI of AI.

who believe tech should change the game—not just play it. We celebrate wins, support each other, and laugh a lot.

empowers autonomous agents to drive real outcomes with speed, accountability, and precision.

We are laser-focused on delivering real value to our customers by accelerating innovation and the application of applying agentic AI in digital service and operations management for IT organizations around the world.

The Solution Engineer is the technical authority for BMC Helix throughout the customer lifecycle. While anchored in pre-sales, this role is accountable for designing solutions that deliver measurable adoption and long-term retention — not just technical wins. Solution Engineers translate customer requirements into BMC Helix architectures, lead technical validation activities, and partner with Customer Adoption Engineers, Value Engineers, and Partner Adoption Engineers to ensure that what is sold is what gets used.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design and Technical Validation

Architect BMC Helix solutions (AI Service Management, AIOps, and HelixGPT Agentic AI — embedded across the portfolio and as configurable standalone agents) aligned to customer technical requirements, business objectives, and desired operational outcomes.
Design HelixGPT agent use cases tailored to the customer's environment, including agent scope, data access, guardrails, governance considerations, success criteria, and integration with customer workflows.
Support Sales with discovery workshops to identify customer business objectives, technical requirements, operational challenges, and success criteria. Conduct demonstrations, technical deep-dives, proofs of value (POVs), and proofs of concept (POCs) to validate solution fit and expected outcomes.
Respond to RFx documents and develop technical proposals, solution architectures, implementation assumptions, and deployment recommendations in collaboration with Professional Services and delivery partners.
Validate interoperability and integration feasibility across the customer's enterprise ecosystem, including ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Ivanti, Halo, Freshworks...), observability tools (Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace...), CMDBs, cloud services, automation platforms, data sources, and third-party applications.
Ensure proposed solutions align with customer security, compliance, governance, scalability, and operational requirements.

Pre-Sales to Post-Sales Continuity

Document solution intent, business objectives, technical requirements, success criteria, assumptions, risks, and agreed solution architecture in a structured handover artifact that enables the Customer Adoption Engineer (for direct accounts), Partner Adoption Engineer (for partner-led accounts), and customer stakeholders to execute successfully.
Partner with the Customer Adoption Engineer during the first 90 days of deployment to validate architectural decisions, assist in technical challenges, and ensure design assumptions remain valid in production environments and validate value objectives.
Identify technical, operational, organizational, and adoption risks throughout the sales cycle, and recommend mitigation strategies, phased approaches, or scope adjustments when necessary to improve customer outcomes and long-term retention.
Ensure customer expectations regarding capabilities, AI use cases, integrations, timelines, and adoption outcomes are clearly documented and aligned across customer, partner, sales, and delivery teams.

Customer and Internal Enablement

Play an active role in the development and maintenance of reusable demonstration assets, reference architectures, technical playbooks, and HelixGPT agent design patterns that incorporate field-proven best practices, deployment guidance, and customer success learnings.
Enable account teams and partners through technical mentorship, coaching, and knowledge-sharing on BMC Helix capabilities, AI use cases, competitive positioning, solution differentiation, and best practices for technical qualification, adoption, and expansion.
Act as a subject matter expert for designated solution domains, contributing to internal communities of practice, technical enablement programs, and thought leadership initiatives.
Collaborate with Customer Adoption Engineers, Partner Adoption Engineers, and delivery teams to capture and share repeatable success patterns, lessons learned, and emerging customer requirements.
Provide structured feedback to Product Management on customer requirements, adoption challenges, competitive trends, product gaps, and emerging use cases to help influence product strategy, roadmap priorities, and future product enhancements.
Develop and maintain relationships with customer technical champions. Develop customer references to support sales and analyst customer validations.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated expertise in at least two of the following domains: IT Service Management (ITSM), AIOps, observability, IT operations management, service automation, or AI-driven IT operations.
Strong working knowledge of generative and agentic AI concepts, including their application in designing, orchestrating, and governing enterprise AI agents in IT environments.
Proven ability to lead technical and value-based discussions with stakeholders ranging from system administrators and architects to senior executives (CIO/CTO level), translating technical solutions into business outcomes.
Hands-on proficiency with REST APIs, scripting (Python or PowerShell), and enterprise integration patterns across cloud, SaaS, and on-premise environments.
Demonstrated track record of pre-sales engagements that resulted in successful production deployments and measurable customer adoption and value realization.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with BMC Helix or comparable enterprise IT operations platforms, such as ServiceNow, Ivanti, or similar ITSM solutions, along with observability and AIOps platforms such as Dynatrace, Moogsoft, or equivalent enterprise tooling ecosystems.
Hands-on experience designing, deploying, or operating agentic AI use cases in enterprise environments, including integration into production workflows, governance of AI behavior, and alignment with operational and security requirements.
Industry certifications such as ITIL Foundation or higher, and/or cloud platform certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP) or Kubernetes certifications; additional exposure to AI/ML or platform engineering certifications is a plus.
Experience supporting complex global enterprise accounts across multiple regions and time zones, including coordination across distributed technical teams, stakeholders, and delivery partners in production environments.

Success Measures

Technical win rate on qualified opportunities, weighted by deal complexity and strategic importance.
Pre-sales-to-production conversion rate, measured by successful deployment of architected solutions into production environments with defined customer success criteria.
Measurable value realization in accounts influenced by the Solution Engineer, including operational efficiency gains, automation outcomes, and improvements in service performance where applicable.
Quality of solution handover as rated by Customer Adoption Engineering and validated against deployment readiness, completeness of documentation, and clarity of success criteria.

jobs.description:
At a Glance

Location:
Cambridge

In-office expectation:
Flexible hybrid, once in the office every two weeks

Employment type:
Permanent

Salary:
£60,000 to £75,000, subject to experience

Why This Role Exists

Redgate's product teams move fast, across a growing set of AI and cloud-native technologies, and security can't just be a gate at the end of that process. This role exists to embed security expertise directly into how our engineering teams build and ship software: setting the standards, running the threat modelling, and making the judgement calls that keep pace with delivery instead of slowing it down.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases their organisations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company: domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match. AI handles the heavy lifting, our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.

Why Join Our Product Security Team

You'll shape how security works across multiple product teams, rather than enforcing policy from the sidelines.
There's real scope to specialise in emerging areas like AI security, work most security roles don't get exposure to yet.
We value pragmatic, real risk reduction over checkbox compliance, so the judgement you bring carries genuine weight.

About The Role

This role sits within our Product Security function, embedded across multiple product and engineering teams rather than a single one. You'll define and operationalise security requirements throughout the SDLC, from initial design through to release, with real authority to make independent security calls rather than deferring to what a scanner tells you. It's a role built on trust: teams will come to you for guidance, and the judgement you bring to triage, threat modelling, and governance decisions will shape how security actually gets done here.

Partner directly with engineering and product teams to define and operationalise security requirements across the full SDLC
Own or co-own application security governance: secure-by-default standards, patterns, guardrails, and risk exceptions
Lead threat modelling for new features and architectural changes, turning findings into practical engineering work
Drive SAST/DAST adoption and quality, from tool tuning to severity calibration and developer-facing triage guidance
Support product teams adopting AI, including LLMs, SLMs, and MCP, giving you visibility into work most security roles wouldn't touch

What Makes You a Great Fit

Hands-on product or application security experience, embedding security practices across a modern software development lifecycle
Ability to review code and communicate security issues clearly to developers, primarily within a C# ecosystem, with exposure to Java or Python
Strong knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and practical mitigation patterns
Experience implementing or improving SAST/DAST processes: tool tuning, triage workflows, and reducing signal to noise
Working understanding of cloud and container security fundamentals, ideally with AWS and Docker

What We Offer

Salary range:
£60,000 to £75,000, subject to experience

Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office
Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off
Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression
Private health insurance

Link to full benefits page here

What Happens Next?

Your application will be reviewed by a person. We don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications, and every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.
You'll hear back within a few days. Whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.
Our interview process is straightforward and consistent. You'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

You can read more about how we approach belonging and inclusion at Redgate on our Belonging at Redgate page here.

About This Role

We're hiring a senior QA engineer who owns quality end-to-end and shapes how the team tests, from test design and automation infrastructure through to release gating and production observability. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll catch problems before code that moves money hits production, design the test automation other engineers depend on, and lead modernization of the test estate as new capability ships. You'll work in a small team with direct access to engineering, product, and compliance, own quality strategy for your domain, lead test architecture decisions, mentor mid-level QA engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain quality decisions.

Lead the design of the test automation that gates code into production, across onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting flows.
Set the balance of manual and automated testing for your domain: write test cases, run manual tests where they are the right tool, and lead automation in Playwright and equivalent frameworks.
Own CI/CD quality strategy for your domain (release-blocking signals, flaky-test triage, test infrastructure health), lead production incident investigation, and translate findings into automated tests and process improvements.
Lead design reviews of test architecture, set quality direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level QA engineers.

6 to 10+ years building production test automation, end-to-end.

SQL and relational database fundamentals (for test data, validation, and debugging).

Strong written and verbal communication.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Enterprise | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Business Acceleration Track (BAT)
. This is the engine room of DeepL’s global growth. While our Research teams build the models, BAT builds the Revenue Flywheel
that allows 200,000+ Enterprises (like the Fortune 500) to actually use and pay for them at scale .

We are moving upmarket. We are transitioning from a consumer-focused app to a mission-critical Enterprise Platform. You will be part of the team architecting the "Financial Nervous System" of DeepL — handling everything from Identity & Access Management (SSO, SCIM) to complex multi-seat Subscription Architectures and Fraud Prevention .

We don't hire engineers to just implement UI tickets. We hire Missionaries
who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will own the full vertical: from the user-facing Admin Console in React to the distributed billing logic in C#/.NET.

Your Responsibilities

Architect Revenue-Critical Flows: You will design and ship complex, high-stakes features like "Enterprise Licensing" or "Automated Seat Provisioning." You ensure that when a customer upgrades, the UX is instant, and the billing ledger is immutable.
Own the "Enterprise Experience": You will build the tools that empower CIOs and IT Directors to manage DeepL. You translate complex backend constraints (RBAC, Rate Limits) into simple, elegant UI workflows.
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You work directly with Sales, Product, and Finance to translate "Annual Recurring Revenue" goals into scalable technical architectures .
Drive System Reliability: You understand that billing systems cannot fail. You build for idempotency and resilience, ensuring that our financial data is auditable and flawless, while maintaining a high-velocity frontend experience.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.
Full-Stack Fluency: You are comfortable traversing the stack. You can design a React component for an Admin Dashboard in the morning and debug a distributed transaction in the backend in the afternoon.
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS—Identity (SAML/SSO), Monetization, and Compliance. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .
High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

to zespół w PwC Polska liczący 50 specjalistów. Senior .NET Developer (GenAI)

Twoja przyszła rola:

projektowanie i implementacja rozwiązań z wykorzystaniem GenAI (OpenAI API, Document Intelligence, Microsoft Foundry) w oparciu o C# i .NET,
tworzenie i rozwój backendu aplikacji webowych (API, logika biznesowa) oraz – w przypadku profilu full stack – również warstwy frontendowej w Angular,
integracja usług backendowych (REST API, mikroserwisy) z modelami GenAI oraz innymi usługami chmurowymi,
projektowanie i optymalizacja struktur danych oraz zapytań w SQL Server,
budowa rozwiązań cloud native w Azure (App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure SQL),
współpraca z Product Ownerami i analitykami – od koncepcji, przez PoC i MVP, po wdrożenie produkcyjne i rozwój istniejących systemów,
udział w decyzjach architektonicznych dotyczących skalowania, bezpieczeństwa i wydajności rozwiązań AI,
dbałość o jakość kodu (przeglądy kodu, testy automatyczne, dobre praktyki).

Aplikuj, jeśli:

masz co najmniej 5 lat doświadczenia jako .NET/C# Developer,
masz praktyczne doświadczenie z GenAI (integracja z LLM API, Document Intelligence, orkiestracja modeli),
bardzo dobrze znasz C# i .NET 6/8+,
swobodnie pracujesz z SQL Server (modelowanie danych, złożone zapytania, optymalizacja),
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu aplikacji webowych (architektura warstwowa, REST API, autoryzacja, bezpieczeństwo),
masz doświadczenie w pracy z chmurą Azure,
potrafisz samodzielnie prowadzić zadania end to end (od koncepcji po wdrożenie i utrzymanie),
komunikujesz się w języku polskim i angielskim na poziomie umożliwiającym pracę z dokumentacją i zespołem międzynarodowym,
cenisz sobie jakość i czytelność kodu oraz rozumiesz znaczenie dobrych praktyk (SOLID, Clean Code, wzorce projektowe).

Mile widziane:

doświadczenie z GenAI i przetwarzaniem dokumentów, w tym projektowanie promptów (prompt engineering) i integracja LLM z kontekstem biznesowym,
znajomość języka Python w kontekście projektów AI/ML (skrypty, prototypowanie, integracje),
doświadczenie z RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) i wektorowymi bazami danych,
doświadczenie w przetwarzaniu dokumentów (PDF, skany, duże archiwa),
doświadczenie w obszarze Agentic AI systemy wieloagentowe, autonomiczni agenci AI, orkiestracja agentów (również od strony koncepcyjnej),
znajomość ekosystemu Microsoft Azure: Azure OpenAI / Cognitive Services, App Service, Functions, Storage, SQL, Key Vault,
doświadczenie z Azure DevOps (CI/CD dla aplikacji .NET/Angular i zasobów Azure, praca z repozytoriami, tablicami i procesem release’ów),
umiejętność efektywnego korzystania z GitHub Copilot lub Cursor (tworzenie, refaktoryzacja i dokumentowanie kodu z użyciem asystenta AI),
doświadczenie w projektach enterprise lub systemach o wysokiej dostępności.

elastyczne warunki - hybrydowy model pracy (min. 2 dni pracy z biura w tygodniu), elastyczny początek dnia, workation, sabbatical leave,
rozwój i podnoszenie kwalifikacji - pełne wsparcie zespołu podczas procesu wdrożenia, mentoring, szkolenia, warsztaty, certyfikacja współ-/finansowana przez PwC oraz konwersacje z native speaker,

możliwość stworzenia indywidualnego planu benefitowego (wybór m.in. lunch pass, pakiet ubezpieczenia, concierge, pakiet weterynaryjny dla pupila czy masaże) oraz dostęp do kafeterii - w środku m.in. vouchery, zniżki na urządzenia IT i zakup samochodu,
3 godziny płatnego urlopu w miesiącu na wolontariat,
dodatkowy dzień wolnego z okazji urodzin,
a kiedy polubisz to miejsce tak, jak my, możesz polecić znajomych do PwC.

uzupełnij formularz oraz prześlij CV,
porozmawiaj telefonicznie z Rekruterem,

jobs.description:
Role Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

We’re modernising a mission‑critical communications layer that routes messages and files between core systems and the outside world (clients, ECB, etc...)
. As a Senior .NET Developer, you will design, build, and operate resilient, event‑driven services on Azure, helping us evolve from legacy integrations to cloud‑native, containerised workloads. This role is hands‑on and leadership‑oriented: you’ll set engineering standards, and deliver high‑reliability software for a regulated environment (finance or similar).

Adherence to Euroclear values : The role requires strong delivery focus and accountability for translating strategy into measurable outcomes with integrity. Candidates put clients at the centre, take collective ownership, and collaborate effectively while caring about the impact of decisions on colleagues and the long term. They demonstrate courage to challenge ways of working and curiosity to continuously improve efficiency, quality, and results.

About the context: The STP tribe operates messaging and group applications that ensure data, files, and messages are processed seamlessly end‑to‑end. This role directly contributes to that mission.

What You’ll Do

Design & deliver modern integration services to replace/upgrade the communications layer (message/file ingestion, transformation, routing, delivery; synchronous and async models).
Design for resilience and scale: apply patterns such as circuit breaker, retries with backoff, timeouts, idempotency, outbox/inbox, DLQs, bulkheads, and compensating transactions/sagas.
Build event‑driven systems leveraging Azure messaging (Service Bus/Event Hubs) and/or Kafka‑style pub/sub; define contracts, schemas, and versioning for backward compatibility
Develop high‑quality .NET services (.NET , C#, ASP.NET Core, worker services, gRPC/REST), with TDD as a default practice and strong emphasis on code quality, security, and performance.
Containerise and operate workloads on Kubernetes (OpenShift/AKS), using Helm and Git‑based pipelines (Azure DevOps). Enforce enterprise container standards: image hardening, secrets via platform mechanisms, TLS everywhere, and Kubernetes network policies.
Own observability: structured logging, tracing, and metrics (e.g., App Insights/Splunk/OpenTelemetry);
Collaborate in an agile product setup (Scrum), contributing to backlog refinement, DoR/DoD, iterative delivery, and cross‑tribe ceremonies when needed.
Lead and mentor: pair with, unblock, and coach junior developers; champion engineering best practices across the squad and Communities of Practice.

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of professional software engineering, including 5+ years building mission‑critical or high‑throughput distributed systems (preferably in financial services or similarly regulated domains).
Expert .NET engineer (C#, .NET, async/await, DI, testing frameworks).
Azure hands‑on experience: AKS, Functions, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Storage, Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure DevOps (Pipelines/Repos).
Containers & orchestration: Docker and Kubernetes (preferably AKS), Helm, image lifecycle, secure supply chain.
Event‑driven architecture fundamentals: pub/sub, event streaming, consumer groups
Test‑Driven Development (TDD) and automation mindset; CI/CD pipelines
Proven resilience engineering knowledge (timeouts, retries, circuit breaker, backpressure, outbox/inbox, DLQ, bulkhead, saga).
Ability to work autonomously

Nice to have

Experience with Kafka (self‑managed or cloud), Azure Event Hubs, or Service Bus at scale; schema registries
Observability stack: OpenTelemetry, Splunk, distributed tracing; performance and load testing at message/file‑transfer scale.
Knowledge of secure file exchange and enterprise integration patterns
Dapr/KEDA, gRPC, and API gateway experience.
Familiarity with financial messaging standards and non‑functional controls (availability, integrity, confidentiality).

Ways of working

Work in a tribe/squad setup with Product Owner, Scrum Master, and Solution Architect, aligned to quarterly/PI objectives and Definition of Ready/Done.
Participate in tribe ceremonies (e.g., planning, SoS, release boards) and cross‑tribe syncs when impacting shared platforms.
Collaborate closely with platform teams for container, security, and networking standards compliance.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

In this role, you will work within a cross-functional product team responsible for modernising the user experience, backend services and cloud platform capabilities of one of WTW’s strategic cloud platforms.

You will contribute to a business-critical distributed compute platform that executes large-scale insurance modelling workloads across the organisation. The platform dynamically provisions Azure compute resources, runs computationally intensive jobs submitted by multiple business applications and provides a shared cloud foundation for analytical services.

The role combines frontend and backend development, cloud-native engineering and modern software engineering practices. You’ll help replace legacy technologies, rebuild AngularJS portals, modernise backend services, introduce Infrastructure as Code, migrate workloads to Azure Container Apps and improve deployment automation and operational resilience.

Working alongside experienced platform engineers, architects, product owners, DevOps engineers and QA specialists, you’ll help transform the current platform into a modern Azure-native platform while gaining deep knowledge of cloud platform engineering and distributed systems.

Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through well-tested engineering changes.

Modernise legacy platform functionality while preserving business continuity.
Implement scalable, maintainable and secure software following modern engineering practices.

Contribute to cloud-native platform modernization initiatives.
Participate in modernisation of deployment pipelines and release automation.

Contribute to zero-downtime deployment improvements.

jobs.description:
Staff Architect II / Tech Lead – 

Demand Generation , Artemis

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll join Coro, Bain’s persistent product development and engineering organization supporting our digital solutions across Commercial Excellence and the newly established Demand Generation Suite. Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for our clients and case teams.
Within Coro, you’ll be part of the newly established business-to-consumer pillar, helping build the technical foundation for Artemis—Bain’s AI-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform and one of three products within the Demand Generation Suite.
You’ll work closely with Product Managers, AI Engineers, Full Stack Engineers, Data Science teams, the Head of Engineering, and broader product leadership to shape and deliver the Artemis platform.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

As a Staff Architect II / Tech Lead, you’ll own the technical architecture, engineering quality, and day-to-day engineering leadership for the Artemis product workstream.
You’ll be the senior engineer and team lead, partnering with the Product Lead to make key design decisions and recommend technical approaches. You’ll define how data moves through the platform, shape the AI agent architecture, establish how services integrate with Bain’s broader technology platform, and set engineering standards across the workstream.
This is an opportunity to help shape a high-impact product from the ground up while remaining hands-on with its development. Alongside writing code, you’ll lead the team’s delivery cadence, remove blockers, maintain momentum against the roadmap, and help other engineers grow.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Architecture and technical governance

Define and document the architecture for the Artemis workstream, ensuring alignment with the shared Demand Generation Suite platform design and Bain-wide Azure infrastructure.
Make key technical design decisions across data flows, service boundaries, and integration patterns.
Own the engineering quality bar for the workstream, including code reviews, test coverage expectations, pull request standards, and documentation practices.
Ensure the team produces maintainable solutions that can be supported by a distributed engineering organization.
Create, communicate, and maintain technical designs, architecture artifacts, best practices, and engineering principles for both technical and executive audiences.

Platform integration

Manage integration points between Artemis, other Demand Generation Suite applications, and Bain’s wider technology platform.
Define and maintain API contracts, agent and skill registry contributions, and shared user interface components.
Support Artemis integrations with Bayesian marketing mix modelling capabilities and campaign performance data pipelines.
Partner with AI Engineers to design large language model orchestration and tool-calling architectures for Artemis-specific agents, with a focus on reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency at scale.

Roadmap delivery and team leadership

Partner with Product Managers to translate prioritized initiatives into clear technical scopes, estimate complexity, identify dependencies, and sequence work across the team.
Own sprint-level task assignment, remove blockers, and help the team deliver against committed timelines and roadmap priorities.
Lead the workstream engineering team, including technical stand-ups, workload management, and structured feedback.
Support the growth of junior team members while maintaining a strong pace of delivery.
Work effectively with stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
Support recruiting activities, including resume screening and interviews.

Innovation and emerging technologies

Explore new approaches to complex business and technical challenges.
Participate in technical discovery, proofs of concept, and innovation workstreams to assess new tools, technologies, and designs.
Stay current on emerging developments across data, AI, and AI-agent technologies, and share relevant knowledge with the wider team.
Bring an entrepreneurial mindset and a willingness to test new approaches.
Turn ambiguous requirements into well-scoped engineering work within a consulting-adjacent product environment.

ABOUT YOU

Essential experience and capabilities

8–10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years as a staff architect or technical team lead responsible for delivering large features or complete products.
Experience in software and data architecture within a senior technology leadership role.
A track record of building and operating scalable, cloud-based business-to-business software products.
Strong Python backend engineering experience using FastAPI or an equivalent asynchronous framework.
Proficiency in TypeScript and React, with the ability to work effectively across the full technology stack.
Deep experience with cloud-native architecture on Azure, including Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions, infrastructure-as-code, and containerized deployments using Docker.

jobs.title: Engineer – AI och Produktutveckling
jobs.description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten

Vill du vara med och bygga nästa generations mjukvarulösningar med AI som en central komponent?

Hos oss får du utveckla moderna mjukvaruprodukter där AI används som en naturlig del av både utvecklingsprocessen och de lösningar vi bygger. Vi utforskar kontinuerligt nya möjligheter inom AI – från intelligenta arbetsflöden och automatisering till AI-agenter och andra tillämpningar.

Du blir en del av en etablerad produktorganisation där du får arbeta hands-on med modern mjukvaruutveckling, påverka tekniska vägval och bidra till hur vi utvecklar våra produkter och arbetssätt framåt. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera din erfarenhet som utvecklare med ett växande område inom AI och omsätta idéer till lösningar som används i verkligheten.

Du behöver inte redan vara specialist inom AI. Vi söker framför allt dig som har en bra grund inom mjukvaruutveckling, är nyfiken på möjligheterna med AI och vill utvecklas vidare inom området.

Det här är inte en roll med fokus på förvaltning. Du får vara med och bygga nytt, testa idéer och bidra till hur vi använder AI och ny teknik i vår produktutveckling. Du arbetar nära verksamhet, kunder och andra specialistroller och får goda möjligheter att påverka både lösningar och arbetssätt.

Vad vi erbjuder:

✅Möjlighet att kombinera din erfarenhet inom mjukvaruutveckling med AI och ny teknik

✅Vara med och påverka produkten, tekniska vägval och hur vi arbetar med AI

✅Arbeta med moderna AI-verktyg och AI-drivna lösningar som en del av utvecklingsarbetet

✅Möjlighet att arbeta med hela utvecklingskedjan – från idé och design till produktion

✅ Nära samarbete med verksamhet och kunder där du ser resultatet av det du bygger

Placeringsort: Stockholm, Malmö eller Karlstad

Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter

Som Senior Engineer blir du en viktig del av vår produktutveckling. Du arbetar tillsammans med verksamhet, kunder och andra specialistroller för att förstå behov och omsätta dem till användbara tekniska lösningar.

Vi arbetar idag brett med produktivitetsverktyg och AI-relaterade initiativ i flera delar av organisationen. Nu samlar vi dessa satsningar i ett gemensamt team för att accelerera utvecklingen av både interna verktyg, arbetssät och nya funktioner som skapar värde för våra kunder.

Du kommer bland annat att:

Utveckla moderna mjukvaruprodukter där AI är en viktig del av lösningen
Arbeta med integration av AI-tjänster, API, verktyg och affärsprocesser
Utforska nya möjligheter inom AI, testa idéer och omsätta dem till praktiska lösningar för kunder och användare
Bidra till tekniska vägval, systemdesign och utvecklingen av våra arbetssätt
Arbeta med moderna utvecklingsmetoder, automatiserad testning och CI/CD
Dela med dig av din erfarenhet och bidra till kunskapsdelning och teknisk utveckling i teamet

Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och ett stort intresse för hur AI kan användas för att utveckla bättre produkter och arbetssätt. Du behöver inte redan vara specialist inom AI – viktigare är att du har en stabil utvecklarbakgrund, är nyfiken på tekniken och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom området.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:

Erfarenhet av modern mjukvaruutveckling, exempelvis i Python, TypeScript, .NET eller liknande teknologier
Förståelse för systemdesign och hur olika delar i en modern mjukvarulösning hänger ihop
Erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmetoder, CI/CD och automatiserade utvecklingsflöden
Intresse för AI och hur tekniken kan användas i mjukvaruutveckling och produkter

Du har gärna börjat använda AI-baserade verktyg som exempelvis Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, Codex eller motsvarande i ditt utvecklingsarbete. Det viktigaste är dock inte vilka verktyg du redan behärskar, utan att du är nyfiken och vill utforska hur AI kan bidra till bättre lösningar och arbetssätt.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande områden:

Utveckling av AI-lösningar eller AI-drivna funktioner
Lösningsarkitektur och skalbara system
DevOps, automatisering och säker utveckling
Agent frameworks såsom LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel eller AutoGen
RAG, vector databases, AI-evaluering eller prompt engineering
Azure eller andra molnplattformar
Docker, Kubernetes eller andra containerbaserade miljöer
Nutanix eller liknande infrastrukturplattformar

Som person är du nyfiken och gillar att utforska nya tekniska möjligheter. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, samarbetar gärna med andra och vill vara med och utveckla både produkterna och hur vi arbetar med ny teknik.

Som en del av den här rekryteringsprocessen genomför vi bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidaten. Kontrollen omfattar en kreditupplysning via UC samt ett registerutdrag, vilket inkluderar uppgifter från belastningsregistret och domstolar.

Syftet är att säkerställa efterlevnad av omvärldens krav, våra kunders ökade fokus på säkerhet samt CGI globala standard.

Om det finns ytterligare information som du vill att vi ska känna till i samband med rekryteringen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef.

Har du frågor om rollen? Hör gärna av dig till Pär Jönsson, Director Consulting Delivery, via e-post par.jonsson@cgi.com.

Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.

Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.

Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.

About The Role

Public 360 integrates cloud-based AI capabilities into standard enterprise software. We are building solutions for 600+ public organizations in the Nordics, and our AI platform runs customer deployments at scale and is evolving fast with GenAI and agentic AI.

As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale.

What You Will Do

Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred).
Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers
Build secure, compliant foundations: landing zones, identity, networking, encryption, secrets, logging, and policy-as-code.
Architect for scale and automation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, self-service environments, and operational runbooks.
Own platform reliability: observability, SLOs, incident patterns, performance, and cost optimization (FinOps).
Define patterns for AI product integration: APIs, event-driven processing, data pipelines, and multi-tenant considerations.
Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring.
Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware).
Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams.

What You Bring

Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.
Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID).
Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus

jobs.description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively seeking for Data Ops Analyst to join its Data Platform & Engineering team, supporting the reliability and performance of its Databricks-based enterprise data platform. The role focuses on monitoring data pipelines, managing incidents, coordinating releases and production handovers, and ensuring data products are well-governed, scalable, and operationally ready. Working closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, you'll play a key role in delivering trusted data solutions while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as
Data Ops Analyst

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:

Support the operation and reliability of Primark’s modern data platform helping manage Databricks, dbt Cloud and Azure data services while ensuring data products are production-ready, supportable and aligned with engineering standards.
Monitor and maintain critical data pipelines and platform services proactively identifying failures, delays, data quality issues and operational risks while coordinating incident triage, escalation and resolution to minimise business impact.
Coordinate releases, deployments and production handovers managing environment readiness, promotion activities, change governance, operational checklists, release schedules and service readiness documentation to ensure smooth delivery.
Drive operational excellence through governance and documentation maintaining runbooks, support guides, monitoring dashboards, service catalogues and reporting on platform health, SLA performance, deployment activity and support trends.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Platform, Cloud, Security, BAU and SIAM teams supporting access management, environment support, platform issue resolution, service reviews and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability and supportability.
Contribute to Primark’s data platform modernisation journey supporting the migration from Teradata to Databricks, validating production readiness, improving monitoring and automation capabilities and helping embed modern DataOps practices across deployment, observability and support processes.

What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

2-4 years’ experience in Data Operations, Application Support, Platform Support, Data Engineering Support or a similar operational role supporting business-critical systems and data platforms in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of modern data platforms and DataOps practices with exposure to Azure DevOps, Databricks, dbt Cloud, Azure data services, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT processes, job scheduling, monitoring, observability and deployment automation.
Experience supporting production environments and service operations including monitoring, alerting, incident management, ticketing systems, release management, environment management, change governance and enterprise support processes.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate incidents methodically, identify root causes, assess business impact and drive issues through to resolution while maintaining high operational standards.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, Governance, SIAM, Analytics and business teams while clearly communicating technical issues and recommended actions.
Proactive, detail-oriented and continuous improvement focused with experience maintaining operational documentation, runbooks, handover materials and support processes while identifying opportunities to improve reliability, reduce recurring issues, increase automation and enhance overall platform supportability.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.

So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior AI Cloud Architect (AI Platform)- Public 360°- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tietoevry Public 360 - building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Role

Public 360 integrates cloud-based AI capabilities into standard enterprise software. We are building solutions for 600+ public organizations in the Nordics, and our AI platform runs customer deployments at scale and is evolving fast with GenAI and agentic AI.

As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale.

What You Will Do

Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred).
Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers
Build secure, compliant foundations: landing zones, identity, networking, encryption, secrets, logging, and policy-as-code.
Architect for scale and automation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, self-service environments, and operational runbooks.
Own platform reliability: observability, SLOs, incident patterns, performance, and cost optimization (FinOps).
Define patterns for AI product integration: APIs, event-driven processing, data pipelines, and multi-tenant considerations.
Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring.
Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware).
Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams.

What You Bring

Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.
Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID).
Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus
Hands-on experience with automation: Terraform and/or Bicep, CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), and modern deployment practices.
Proven security architecture skills: threat modeling, zero trust, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.
Experience building or operating AI/ML platforms: Azure ML/MLflow, model serving, data pipelines, and LLM integration patterns.
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic architectures and communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders.

Nice to have

Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and guardrails: content filters, prompt injection defense, red teaming, and evaluation.
Knowledge of data engineering components: Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, data streaming, and search/vector databases.
Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.

Impact you will have

Own the reference architecture for our cloud-first AI platform supporting AI capabilities for public organizations in the Nordics.
Raise the security and compliance baseline with zero-trust patterns, policy-as-code, and audit-ready controls.
Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments.
Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices.

Tech we use

Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience.

What Success Looks Like In 6 Months

A clear platform roadmap indicating the next steps for our data and ai platform as baseline for our product teams, supporting our vision of AI-first and agentic-first software offerings in the public sector domain.
Review and implementation of defined improvements of automation framework and pipelines in place for core platform services.
Operational excellence established: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and incident playbooks used in day-to-day operations.
Security and Trustworthy AI governance embedded: threat models, risk assessments, and guardrail patterns for GenAI use cases.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact.
A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end.
Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI).
Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.

Practicalities

Location and work setup: flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen or Espoo). Fluent English required; Nordic language skills are a plus.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Geir Are Bjørnsrud (geirare.bjornsrud@tietoevry.com)

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring.
Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware).
Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams.

What You Bring

Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.
Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID).
Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus
Hands-on experience with automation: Terraform and/or Bicep, CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), and modern deployment practices.
Proven security architecture skills: threat modeling, zero trust, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.
Experience building or operating AI/ML platforms: Azure ML/MLflow, model serving, data pipelines, and LLM integration patterns.
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic architectures and communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders.

Nice to have

Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and guardrails: content filters, prompt injection defense, red teaming, and evaluation.
Knowledge of data engineering components: Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, data streaming, and search/vector databases.
Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.

Impact you will have

Own the reference architecture for our cloud-first AI platform supporting AI capabilities for public organizations in the Nordics.
Raise the security and compliance baseline with zero-trust patterns, policy-as-code, and audit-ready controls.
Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments.
Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices.

Tech we use

Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience.

What Success Looks Like In 6 Months

A clear platform roadmap indicating the next steps for our data and ai platform as baseline for our product teams, supporting our vision of AI-first and agentic-first software offerings in the public sector domain.
Review and implementation of defined improvements of automation framework and pipelines in place for core platform services.
Operational excellence established: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and incident playbooks used in day-to-day operations.
Security and Trustworthy AI governance embedded: threat models, risk assessments, and guardrail patterns for GenAI use cases.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact.
A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end.
Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI).
Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.

Practicalities

Location and work setup: flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen or Espoo). Fluent English required; Nordic language skills are a plus.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Geir Are Bjørnsrud (geirare.bjornsrud@tietoevry.com)

Are you motivated by optimizing production equipment and processes in a high-tech production? Do you thrive at the intersection of software development, production technology, and continuous improvement? Are you ready to take ownership of solutions that support automated production and make a tangible impact on daily operations in an international organization?

Here Is What The Job Entails

As our Software Developer you will be responsible for the development of manufacturing software solutions that are essential to our automated production. You will help ensure scalability, reliability, and continuous improvement across multiple production technologies. Furthermore, you will manage and contribute to robust software solutions that support our high-tech production by working across the full development lifecycle.

More specifically, you will be:

Designing, developing, and maintaining manufacturing software solutions for automated production lines
Participating in specification, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring of software applications
Collaborating with stakeholders to translate business needs into robust technical solutions
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives across production equipment, processes, and technologies

We offer a position where you will have significant influence on software solutions that are central to our production. You will join a highly skilled environment with broad exposure to production technology, automation, and software development, while being empowered to take ownership and drive improvements from idea to implementation.

Meet your future team

With direct reference to our Senior Manager, PT & MSW, H/C SC, you will be a part of our Production Technology and Manufacturing Software team, consisting of 9 colleagues. Together, we work on implementing new technologies and optimizing production processes across our Heat/Cooling production to ensure high product quality, uptime, and delivery performance. You will become part of a highly skilled team characterized by challenging tasks, close cross-functional collaboration, and an informal working environment.

Less About Us, More About You

We are looking for an experienced Software Developer who is motivated by developing reliable and scalable software solutions while working closely with colleagues and stakeholders across production and technology. You naturally take responsibility for driving software solutions from design to deployment, ensuring they are both technically robust and aligned with business needs.

In order to succeed we imagine that you:

Have 5-10 years of professional software development experience, preferably from manufacturing, industrial automation, supply chain or product development.
Have worked with business-critical systems in production, logistics, supply chain or industrial environments
Bring experience with object-oriented development in C#/.NET or similar technologies, including integration with hardware, instruments or actual production lines
Are comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders and translating business needs into technical solutions

We are more than an ordinary workplace

We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

Work life balance through flexible working hours
Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic
An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community
Beneficial health care and insurance package

CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

CrowdStrike is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) for our NG-SIEM Product Group. NG-SIEM is powered by one of the highest-scale event search and detection platforms anywhere in the cyber-security industry.

In this role, you will own building and ensuring the proper operation of the distributed test and release automation that ensures the quality of this platform. jobs.description:
Temasek is a global investment company headquartered in Singapore, with a net portfolio value of S$518 billion (US$401b, €350b, £304b, RMB2.77t) as at 31 March 2026. Our Purpose “ So Every Generation Prospers ” guides us to make a difference for today’s and future generations. We seek to build a resilient and forward-looking portfolio that will deliver good sustainable returns over the long term.    

We have 13 offices in 9 countries around the world: Beijing, Hanoi, Mumbai, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore in Asia; and Brussels, London, Mexico City, New York, Paris, San Francisco, and Washington, DC outside Asia. 

For more information on Temasek, please visit www.temasek.com.sg    
For Temasek Review 2026, please visit www.temasekreview.com.sg
For Sustainability Report 2026, please visit www.temasek.com.sg/SR2026

Introduction
Agentic AI engineering is a frontier discipline that requires both deep AI system knowledge and the full-stack engineering rigour to ship production-grade systems that operate reliably at enterprise scale. Building an agent that works in a notebook is table stakes; building one that handles edge cases gracefully, integrates securely with enterprise systems, and can be monitored and maintained by a team is the real engineering challenge. 

The Full Stack Agentic AI Engineer at Temasek is a hands-on builder responsible for designing, building, and operating AI-powered products and agent workflows across Temasek's investment and operations functions. You will work end-to-end — from LLM integration and agent orchestration through to front-end interfaces, API integrations, and production monitoring — with a relentless focus on reliability, observability, and user experience. You will be building systems that investment professionals and operations teams depend on for real decisions, not demos.

Responsibilities
Agentic AI system engineering

Design and implement multi-step agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration (single-agent and multi-agent coordination), tool-calling architectures, memory and state management, and planning and reasoning loops using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom orchestration.
Build production-grade RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines: document ingestion and chunking strategies, embedding generation and management, vector store integration (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or equivalent), semantic search, and hybrid retrieval architectures.
Implement robust tool and API integration layers that allow AI agents to safely interact with enterprise systems — including investment data platforms, portfolio management systems, market data APIs, and internal knowledge bases — with appropriate access controls, rate limiting, and error handling.
Engineer agent prompting and context management systems: system prompt architecture, dynamic context construction, prompt versioning, and evaluation-driven prompt optimisation using automated and human evaluation frameworks.
Contribute to the design and extension of Temasek's MCP (Model Context Protocol) server ecosystem — building new tool connectors and extending the platform's tool library with reusable, well-documented integrations.

Full-stack product engineering

Build the full application stack for AI products: React or equivalent front-end interfaces designed for professional user workflows; Python or Node.js back-end services; RESTful and streaming API layers; and enterprise integration middleware.
Design and implement real-time AI interaction patterns: streaming LLM responses, progressive disclosure of agent reasoning steps, asynchronous long-running agent task management, and WebSocket-based live update interfaces.
Own API design and documentation for AI product services — ensuring clean contracts, versioning discipline, and integration documentation that enables downstream consumers (other internal systems, citizen developer tools) to build reliably on your services.
Collaborate with data engineers to design the data access layer for AI products: query optimisation for AI-readable data, structured data extraction from unstructured sources, and data pipeline integrations that keep AI product knowledge bases current.

Production engineering and reliability

Instrument all AI systems with comprehensive observability: structured logging of agent actions, LLM call tracing (latency, token usage, model version), error rate monitoring, and alerting calibrated to the failure modes specific to agentic systems.
Design for graceful degradation: ensure AI systems fail safely, fall back to human escalation paths when uncertain, and communicate their limitations clearly to users — critical in a financial services context where AI failures have real consequences.
Implement testing strategies appropriate for non-deterministic AI systems: unit tests for deterministic components, evaluation suites for LLM behaviour (using frameworks such as LangSmith Evals, RAGAS, or custom evaluation pipelines), regression testing for prompt changes, and integration testing across the full agent workflow.
Participate actively in code review, architecture discussions, and production incident response — with a culture of collective ownership over system reliability and continuous improvement.

Requirements
Experience and background

Strong AI Engineering experience with proven expertise in designing, building, deploying, and operating production-grade AI systems. Candidates should have 5-8 years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on AI/ML engineering and hands-on delivery of LLM-powered products in production.
Hands-on experience with modern agentic AI frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent; strong familiarity with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs and their tool-calling and streaming APIs.
Demonstrated experience shipping production AI systems with real users — not research experiments, but deployed products with monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement cycles.
Experience in financial services, fintech, or data-intensive regulated industries is advantageous.

Technical capabilities

Languages and frameworks: Python (primary, including FastAPI, asyncio, Pydantic), TypeScript/JavaScript (React, Next.js, Node.js); comfortable across the stack without deep specialisation limiting your ability to contribute end-to-end.
AI/ML stack: LLM integration (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini), embedding models, vector databases, RAG pipeline components, evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, RAGAS, custom), and observability tooling (Helicone, LangFuse, or equivalent).
Infrastructure and DevOps: containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, and basic security hygiene for AI systems (input sanitisation, output validation, access-scoped tool permissions).
Data engineering basics: SQL proficiency, familiarity with data pipeline tooling (dbt, Airflow, or equivalent), and ability to design data access patterns optimised for AI consumption.
